shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni// dngos po brgyad kyis yang dag bshad// ces sogs so// 'grel pa ji ltar yin snyam na/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa la// de'i rgyan tshig le'ur byas pa dag /ces gsungs so// dri ba bzhi pa'i lan ni/ bam po dang po zhes pa ste/ ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis/ mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa ba bam po gnyis su byas shing*/ lo ts+tsha ba chen pos bam po lngar mdzad/ bam po zhes pa ni tha snyad rnying pa ste/ dbus pa blo gsal gyis brda gsar rnying shan 'byed pa'i me long las/ mnyam po'i don du bshad do// bstan bcos las/ lhad mi 'jug pa'i phyir lo ts+tsha bas byas pa yin gyi/ rgya dpe la bam po'i tha snyad med do// spyir bam po'i tshad la nges pa mi 'dug ste/ sh+lau ka lnga brgya la bam por byas pa spyod 'jug lta bu dang*/ sher snying bam po gcig tu byas pa dang*/ sh+lau ka stong gi gsum cha la bam por byas pa dang*/ sh+lau ka sum brgya la byas pa las/ 'dir phyi ma la bya dgos te/ 'di'i rgya dpe'i tshad la sh+lau ka stong lnga brgyar bshad pa'i phyir ro// sh+lau ka zhes pa ni bod skad la tshigs su bcad pa ste/ rkang pa bzhir longs pa'o// rkang pa'i tshad la'ang nges pa med de/ me tog phreng 'dzin la tsheg bar nyer gcig dang*/ rtag rnam par rtsen pa la tsheg bar bcu bdun dang*/ rjes su bsngags pa la bdun pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i dbyangs la dgu par snang ba'i phyir ro// tshig lhug pa la ni tsheg bar sum cu rtsa gnyis la sh+lau ka re re byed par grags so// bam po byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rgya gar gyi sh+lau ka'i tshad des/ bod kyi tshig bcad ma tshang ba dang lhag pa ci rigs su 'gyur bas sh+lau ka'i tshad dang de smos ma nus pas/ tshad de mnyam por bgos nas bam por byas pa'o// dri ba lnga pa'i lan ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas ston te/ mdo sde'i sde snod du gtogs par shes pa'i don du rgyal po bkas bcad kyi phyag tu byas pa'o// de yang ska cog gi 'gyur la yin gyi gzhan la ni nges pa med do// zhes snar thang gi dkar chag las gsungs shing*/

bu ston rin po ches/ phyogs gar gtogs ngo shes pa'i phyag gi tha snyad bkas bcad na med ces gsungs so// sde snod du gtogs pa shes pa la dgos pa khyad par can yod de/ de ltar shes pas bka' bsdu ba pos bsdus par shes shing*/ de las gsung rabs la 'jug par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// brgyad stong don bsdus las/ dad ldan 'jug pa'i yan lag tu// ston pa dbang po 'khor dang ni// yul dang dus kyang nges bstan pa// zhes 'byung ba ltar ro// ci'i phyir sde snod ces bya zhe na/ saṃ skṛ ta las/ piṭa ka zhes 'byung la/ piṇa ka zhes yi ge bsnan na/ gong bu'am/ bsdus pa/ so sta/ kam zhes sbyar na/ glegs bam/ yang na/ pita ka ni yul ma ga dha'i bre bo che'i ming yin la/ bre bo che'i nang du bre'u chung mang po bsdus pa ltar/ 'di'i nang du brjod bya sde tshan mang po bsdus pa'i phyir de skad ces bya'o// gnyis pa yan lag can gyi bstan bcos la/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan bshad pa la 'jug pa'i bya ba dang*/ bshad pa nyid nye bar dgod pa/ bshad pa mthar phyin pa'i bya ba dang gsum/ dang po la mchod par brjod pa'i don/ slob dpon snga mas ji ltar phye ba'i tshul/ rang nyid 'grel pa rtsom pa'i rgyu dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gong du 'grel pa zhes pa la 'phros nas/ 'o na khyod kyi 'grel pa 'di'i bshad bya mdo sde gang la bya/ de'i 'chad byed bstan bcos de gang*/ bstan bcos de'i don 'grel pa 'dis ji ltar 'grel/ bstan bcos kyi brjod bya'i don de gus pa'i yul du rung ngam/ mi rung zhe na/ rim pa ltar/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa zhes dang*/ de rgyan tshig ler byas pa zhes dang*/ kun gyi rgyan du 'gyur bar ni// rnam par dbye zhes dang*/ la gus phyag 'tshal zhes pas lan 'debs par byed do// chos kyi bshes gnyen dang*/ sher 'byung blo gros ltar na/ 'dis 'grel pa 'di'i dgos sogs chos bzhi bstan par bzhed/

'dir dag ces pa/ rnam dbye gnyis pa byin pas nyung tshig yin la kun zhes pa rnam dbye gsum pa byin pas mang tshig yin pa las/ kun de gang la bya zhe na/ gser gling pa sde snod gsum la bzhed/ chos bshes yum gsum la bzhed/ ye shes zhabs dang*/ ral gri yum bzhi la bzhed/ gnyis pa la/ 'bum phrag gsum pa 'di ltar 'chad de/ phyogs chos bsgrub pa/ gtan tshigs 'god pa/ dam bca' la sbyar ba'o// dang po ni/ kun gyi rgyan du 'gyur bar ni zhes smra na/ kun gyi rgyan yin par gang las rtogs zhe na/ bla ma snga ma'i man ngag dang*/ rang gi shes rab dang*/ yi dam lha'i byin rlabs te/ rgyu gsum las rtogs zhes ston pa ni/ 'gro la nas/ ya mtshan no zhes pa'i bar ro// yum don rnyed pa na/ dbye rigs pas khyab/ dper na 'phags grol bzhin/ zhes spyi khyab bsgrub pa ni/ de ltas shin tu rnyed dka' ba nas/ rigs kyi bar ro// de'i shugs kyis gtan tshigs bkod nas/ dam bca' la sbyar ba ni/ rnam pa kun tu bdag gi ni// zhes sogs lo ts+tsha ba chen po ltar na rnam par dbye zhes smra na/ yum don rtogs nas sam ma rtogs par dbye/ dang po ltar na/ mngon sum du rtogs nas sam/ bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas dbye/ dang po ltar na mi rigs te/ khyod la so so rang gis rig pa'i ye shes med pa'i phyir zhe na/ de'i lan du ston to// chos kyi bshes gnyen dang*/ rnam bshad ltar na dbye/ zhes pa la 'phros nas/ sngon gyi slob dpon dag gis phye ba yod dam med/ yod na zlos par 'gyur la/ med na rang bzo'i nyes pa yod do// zhe na de'i lan du/ 'gro la nas rnam bshad byas yan chad gsungs so// 'dir 'phags pa thogs med btang snyoms su bzhag cing*/ dbyig gnyen dang*/ btsun pa la zur za/ 'phags pa grol sde la mngon par bstod pas/ 'jam chos rtsub chos btang snyoms su bzhag pa'i bshad pa byas pa legs sam snyam na/ snga ma dag na re/ 'bum phrag gsum pa dang*/

lo chen/ chos kyi bshes gnyen gyi bshad srol gsum po la 'jam rtsub btang snyoms kyi bshad pa zhes ming 'dogs par snang ngo*// yang gser gling pa 'di ltar bzhed de/ rnam par dbye zhes pa mi 'thad de/ 'di mkhas pa 'jug pa'i lam min pa'i phyir zhe na/ min te/ dus gsum gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis dbye bar rigs pa'i phyir zhes ston pa'i dbang du byas na/ 'phags pa thogs med ces pa nas/ spro ba skyes pa'i bar ro// bdag gi blo la 'di ltar shar te/ 'grel pa 'di'i dgos don 'chad pa ni/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa la// zhes pa'o// bsdus don 'chad pa ni/ 'gro la chags pa nas/ spro ba skyes pa'i bar ro// tshig don ni/ 'phags pa byams sogs dkyus ma rnams so// brgal ni/ la la las don sogs so// mtshams sbyar ni/ rtogs pa sla'o// chos kyi bshes gnyen na re/ kun chags mdzad ces 'don pa ni nor pa ste/ dgag pa'i a thung mtshams sbyor la shes pas dang po/ ring por ston pa'i phyir/ dper na/ 'gro la chags pas chags med mdzad// ces 'don dgos so// zhes gsung*/ ral gri na re/ 'di nyid rigs te/ sems can kun la shas cher chags// nam mkha' lta bur chags pa med// ces pa ltar ro// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa la/ rang gi rtogs pa gzhan las khyad zhugs pa bsgrub/ dbye bar rigs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ khengs skyungs te rtsom par dam bca' ba dang gsum/ rim pa ltar/ de ltar dang*/ de ltas dang*/ rnam pa kun tu zhes pas ston par byed do// yang gser phreng mdzad pa po tshigs bcad dang po bstan pa la 'jug pa'i sgo skyabs 'gro dang*/ tshigs bcad bar pa bzhis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i tshul dang*/ lhag ma rnams kyis 'grel pa rtsom pa'i rgyu bstan par bzhed/ bshad pa nyid nye bar dgod pa la/ spyir yum gyi gdul bya yum tsam la gus pa bskyed pa'i rgyu ni gang*/ bye brag tu yum de brjod byar ston pa'i bstan bcos 'di la thos bsam gyi 'jug pa'i thabs ni/

'jug bya bstan bcos kyi rang bzhin ji lta bu zhe na/ de'i lan la/ gus pa'i yan lag mchod brjod/ bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i yan lag dgos 'brel/ bstan bcos kyi brjod bya mngon rtogs bshad pa dang gsum gyis ston to// 'dir mchod brjod dang dgos 'brel ni rtsod lan gyi 'brel te/ dngos su mchod par brjod nas shugs la rtsom par dam bcas pa la/ rtsom pa mi 'thad de/ dgos sogs bzhi dang mi ldan pa'i phyir zhe na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam// zhes sogs ston pa'i phyir/ dgos 'brel dang bstan bcos 'di 'jug thabs dang 'jug yul du 'brel te/ dgos sogs de dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos de gang yin zhe na/ de'i lan du/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni// zhes sogs ston dgos pa'i phyir/ 'o na bstan bcos 'dis mdo'i don bshad thabs yan lag du'i sgo nas bshad/ 'grel pas rtsa ba'i don bshad thabs yan lag du'i sgo nas 'chad ce na/ slob dpon chos kyi bshes gnyen na re/ mdo'i don bshad thabs yan lag rnam pa lnga'i sgo nas 'chad pa ni rje btsun nyid kyi zhal nas brgyud pa'i man ngag yin te/ rnam bshad rigs pa las/ gang zhig bdag pas blo dman zhing*// mdo rnams 'chad 'dod de dag la// man ngag cung zhig sbyin par bya// dgos pa bsdus pa'i don bcas dang*// tshig don bcas dang mtshams sbyar bcas// brgal lan bcas te bsnyad par bya// zhes gsungs pas so// zhes gsung ngo*// 'o na gzhung gang gis bstan zhe na/ brgyad stong 'grel chen las/ dgos 'brel gyi dgos don/ lus rnam gzhag gi bsdus don dang*/ yan lag rgyas bshad kyi tshig don ston par gsungs la/ go rim de ltar ston dgos pa'ang yin te/ rnam bshad rigs pa las/ mdo don che ba nyid thos nas// nyan pa dang ni 'dzin pa la// nyan pa po de gus byed pas// thog mar dgos pa brjod par bya// dgos pa'i don ni bsdus don las// de grub de ni tshig don las// go rim rigs pa snga phyi dag

/mi 'gal ba ni gnyis las so// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ go rim mi 'gal ba ni mtshams sbyar yin la/ rigs pa dang mi 'gal ba dang*/ snga phyi mi 'gal ba ni brgal lan no// de gnyis po gzhung gi cha shas gang gis ston zhe na/ slob dpon chos kyi bshes gnyen na re/ mtshams sbyor don gyis thob pa dang*/ slob dpon gyis dngos su bkod pa dag las/ skabs dang po la mtshams sbyar so drug gnyis pa la nyi shu/ gsum pa la bcu bzhi/ bzhi pa la so lnga/ lnga pa la nyer bdun/ drug pa la gcig bdun pa la lnga/ brgyad pa la bcu/ bar ma la bzhi/ bsdus pa la gcig ste/ brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum yod par bzhed/ brgal lan ni/ grangs med la sogs bstan pa rnams// zhes sogs kyis ston no// 'grel pas kyang rtsa ba'i don bshad thabs yan lag lnga'i sgo nas 'chad la/ de la yang*/ spyi'i bshad thabs yan lag lnga ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar yin la/ so so'i bshad thabs ni/ mchod brjod la bshad pa ltar rang rang gi skabs su 'byung ba rnams so// dang po mchod brjod la/ bshad bya'i mdo dgod/ mdo'i dngos bstan la tshig gi 'bru bzhag shugs bstan bstan bcos su ji ltar bsdus pa'i tshul/ bsdus don 'grel pas gang du bkral ba dang rnam pa bzhi/ dang po ni/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab bya rgod phung po'i ri la dge slong lnga stong tsam gyis bskor te thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ dbang du gyur pa/ sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ cang shes pa/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid pa kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag par kun shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ sems kyi dbang thams cad la pha rol tu phyin pa'i mchog thob pa sha stag dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs so// gang zag gcig ma gtogs pa ni 'di lta ste/ slob pa rgyun du zhugs pa tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo'o// dge slong ma grags 'dzin ma dang*/

skye dgu'i bdag mo chen mo la sogs pa lnga brgya tsam dang*/ dge bsnyen dang dge bsnyen ma shin tu mang po chos mthong ba dag dang yang thabs gcig go /byang chub sems dpa' chen po bzang skyong dang*/ rin chen 'byung gnas dang*/ ded dpon dam bca' dang*/ skyes bus byin dang*/ chus byin dang*/ dbang pos byin dang*/ blo gros dam bca' dang*/ byams pa la sogs pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma dag dang yang thabs gcig go /zhes pa ni thun mong gi gleng gzhi'o// thun mong ma yin pa'i gleng gzhi ni/ de nas de'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis/ gdan seng ge'i khri bshams nas sku drang por srangs dgongs pa mngon du gzhag nas skyil mo krung bcas nas bzhugs so// zhes pa nas bzung ste/ gang na 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa 'dug pa/ lha'i bu blo gros rab gnas dang*/ gzhan yang gzi brjid chen po dag 'khod pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams pad+mo can bzhin du gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang*/ lha dang bcas/ bdud dang bcas/ tshangs pa dang bcas/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dang skye dgu'i bdag po dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'dus shing*/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nur gyur pa rnams kyang 'dus par gzigs par gyur to// zhes pa'i bar gsungs so// gnyis pa la/ thun mong gi gleng gzhi bshad pa dang*/ yum gyi gleng gzhi bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ dus dang*/ ston pa dang*/ gnas dang*/ 'khor te/ phun sum tshogs pa bzhi'i sgo nas shes par bya ste/ brgyad stong don bsdu las/ ston pa dbang po 'khor dang ni// yul dang dus kyang nges bstan pa// dad ldan 'jug pa'i yan lag rgyu// sdud po rang nyid tshad mar ni// rab sgrub phyir yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na zhes pas dus phun sum tshogs pa ston ste/ de yang brgyad stong 'grel chen las/ 'di ltar 'byung ste/ 'di skad thos zhes pas tshig tsam thos kyi don khong du ma chud ces pa'o// bdag gis thos zhes pas/

brgyud pa gzhan med ces pa'o// dus gcig la thos zhes pas thos pa mang bar ston/ chos la sbyar na/ yum 'di rnyed dka' bar ston/ dus gcig na bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la bzhugs/ zhes pas/ gzhan gyi tshe gzhan na bzhugs par ston/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa ni bcom ldan 'das so// gnas ni rgyal po'i zhes sogs so// khyim pa dang rab tu byung ba'i phyogs gnyis bsdu ba'i phyir/ gnas gnyis smos so// gsum pa 'khor phun sum tshogs pa la/ theg dman dang*/ theg chen gyi 'khor ro// dang po la grangs ni/ rgyas 'bring gnyis la lnga stong dang*/ bsdus pa la stong nyis brgya lnga bcu ste/ khyad par ni sngar bshad pa ltar ro// yon tan ni/ dgra bcom pa la sogs pa'o// theg chen gyi 'khor ni/ byang chub sems dpa' bzang skyong la sogs pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong dang yang thabs gcig tu bzhugs so// zhes pas bstan no// gnyis pa thun mong min pa sher phyin gyi gleng gzhi la nyi khri gzhung 'grel las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ gdan la/ bshams pa/ bzhugs pa/ bzhugs nas cho 'phrul mdzad pa/ mdzad nas chos gsung ba'i dus gzigs pa'o// dang po la/ gdan bshams pa/ bzhugs pa/ dang po ni/ chos ni thun mong min pa'i mchod 'os chen por bstan pa dang*/ phyi rabs kyi skye bo'i zhum pa bsal ba dang*/ 'khor gdul ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis seng ge'i khri bshams so// gnyis pa ni/ chos 'di mnyam par gzhag pa kho nas rtogs so zhes bstan pa'i phyir/ sku drang por srang dgongs pa mngon du bzhag skyil mo krung bcas te bzhugs so// gnyis pa cho 'phrul mdzad pa la gsum ste/ ting nge 'dzin gyi cho 'phrul/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul/ chos gnang ba'i cho 'phrul lo// dang po la/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po'i chos 'phrul/ seng ge rnam par rol pa'i cho 'phrul lo// dang po la/ rgyu mnyam par gzhag pa dang*/ 'bras bu 'od zer bkye ba gnyis/

dang po ni/ der bzhugs na ting nge 'dzin gang du ting nge 'dzin thams cad khong du chud pa/ 'du ba dang rjes su 'brang bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag go /de nas dgongs shing yang dag par mkhyen nas/ ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te/ lha'i spyan gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad la rnam par gzigs so// zhes pa'o// 'bras bu 'od zer bkye ba la/ yan lag dang*/ nying lag las 'od zer bkye ba/ ba spu'i bu ga nas bkye ba/ rang bzhin gyi 'od zer bkye ba/ ljags las 'od zer bkye ba rnams ni rim pa bzhin/ de ltar gzigs nas sku thams cad nas 'od zer rab tu bkye ste/ de'i zhabs kyi mthil gnyis 'khor lo'i rtsibs dang ldan pa las kyang 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong drug cu drug cu byung ngo*// zhes sogs dang*/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi ba spu'i sgo las 'od zer rab tu bkye bar mdzad de zhes sogs dang*/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin gyi 'od gang yin pa sogs dang*/ de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgo nas ljags kyi dbang po bkram nas/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dag thams cad/ ljags kyi dbang po des khyab par mdzad nas ljags kyi dbang po de las 'od rab tu bkye ste/ 'od zer de las 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma thon te/ 'od zer gyi rtse mo de las kyang rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi pad+ma gser gyi mdog tu snang ba/ 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa sha stag gnas par gyur te/ pad+ma de dag la yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chos ston par mdzad cing gnas pa rnams bzhugs te zhes sogs so// 'od zer des byed las gnyis byed de/ 'jig rten gyi khams snang bar byed pa dang*/ gdul bya'i sems can rnams phyir mi ldog par byed pa'o// gnyis pa seng ge rnam par rol pa'i cho 'phrul la rgyu mnyam par gzhag pa dang*/

'bras bu zhing sbyang ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gdan seng ge'i khri de nyid la bzhugs bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin seng ge rnam par rol ba zhes bya ba la mnyam par gzhag ste/ zhes so// 'bras bu zhing sbyang ba la/ snod kyi zhing sbyang ba dang*/ bcud kyi zhing sbyang ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ de lta bu'i gzugs kyi rdzu 'phrul kyi mngon par 'du mdzad do// ji 'dra gzugs kyi rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pas/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ zhes sogs so// gnyis pa bcud kyi zhing sbyang ba la/ mtho ris la 'god/ mtho ris nyes med la/ spyod pa dag pa la/ bsam pa khyad par can/ bde ldan la/ shes ldan la 'god pa dang drug ni/ de nas de'i tshe/ skad cig yud tsam thang gcig la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ mi khom pa thams cad zad par gyur to// zhes pa nas/ ched du rjod pas ched du brjod par gyur to'i bar ro// gnyis pa rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul la/ sprul pa'i cho 'phrul dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i cho 'phrul lo// dang po la sprul sku gzhan zil gyis mnan pa/ rang bzhin gyi skus zhum pa bsal ba/ de lha dang mi rnams kyis mchod pa gsum ni/ rim pa bzhin seng ge'i khri de nyid la bzhugs pas/ gtsang ma'i gnas dang bcas pa 'di zil gyis mnan te/ 'od dang*/ sku mdog dang gzi brjid dang dpal gyis mdzes shing lham me lhang nge lhan ne'o// zhes dang*/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rang bzhin gyi sku ci 'dra ba de bzhin du bstan te/ zhes dang*/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ lha gang ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad kyang lha rdzas kyi gzhan mang po thogs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der phyin nas bcom ldan 'das la gtor ro// zhes sogs so// gnyis pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i cho 'phrul la/

byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ sku nyams su bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i steng gi nam mkha' la me tog gi khang pa brtsegs pa stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams tsam du red de gnas par gyur to// gnyis pas sku nyams su bstan pa ni/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mi thams cad dang*/ lha thams cad kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku lta bas chog mi shes pa de mthong bas 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdag cag gi mdun na bzhugs shing chos ston no snyam mo// zhes pa'o// gsum pa chos gnang ba'i cho 'phrul la/ 'jig rten gyi khams bstan pa dang*/ 'khor bsdu ba/ phyi ma la'ang ltas kyi rgyu zhus pa/ lan btab pa/ zhus pa/ gnang ba/ skyes bskur ba/ gsung sgrub ste phyogs gcig tu 'khod pa rnams kyi sgo nas shes par bya'o// gsum pa chos gsung ba'i dus la gzigs pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nur gyur pa rnams kyang 'dus par gzigs par gyur to// gsum pa shugs bstan bstan bcos su ji ltar bsdus pa'i tshul la/ dge slong lnga stong tsam gyis bskor te zhes pas rten gyi gang zag de bstan/ de'i don ni nyan thos zhi ba tshol rnams zhes pa'o// thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa sogs kyis 'bras bu bstan/ de'i don nyer zhir khrid mdzad gang yin dang*// zhes pa'o// byang chub sems dpa' chen po bye ba khrag khrig ces pas rten gyi gang zag de bstan/ de'i don 'gro la phan par byed rnams zhes pa'o// thams cad kyang gzungs rab tu thob pa sogs kyis 'bras bu bstan/ de'i don/ 'jig rten don grub mdzad pa gang*// zhes pa'o// bcom ldan 'das zhes pas rten gyi gang zag de bstan/ de'i don/ thub rnams zhes pa'o// pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa 'di nyid kyis ston par mdzad do sogs kyis 'bras bu bstan/

de'i don/ rnam pa kun ldan sna tshogs 'di gsungs pa// zhes pa'o// gsum ka'i thabs mdo'i sbas don du gnas pa rje btsun gyis dngos su gsungs pa ste/ kun shes nyid kyis dang*/ lam shes nyid kyis dang*/ gang dang yang dag ldan pas zhes pa rnams so// ral gri na re/ rkang pa dang po gsum gyis gzhan don sgrub byed kyi yum dang*/ rkang pa tha mas zag med kyi phung po bskyed par bstan/ zhes gsung*/ rin chen bsam 'phel ltar na/ dang po gsum gyis yum yin pa'i sgrub byed dang*/ phyi ma dam bca' bzhag par bzhed/ rnam bshad chen po ltar na/ bstod pa dang phyag 'tshal ba gnyis kyis ston no// 'o na 'dir/ mkhyen pa gsum po kho na yum yin nam zhe na/ 'phags seng gnyis kyis ni mngon par rtogs pa brgyad ka'i yum du bzhed par mngon/ nyi khri snang bar/ mchod brjod kyi sher phyin gang yin dris pa'i lan du/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni// dngos po brgyad kyis yang dag bshad// ces 'byung bar bstan pa'i phyir/ ces dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ de la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyis ni don brgyad bsdus la/ de dag kyang yum yin zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ a bh+ya ka ra/ rat+na kirti/ bud+dha shrī gsum kyang de ltar bzhed de/ gnad kyi zla 'od las/ 'o na mkhyen pa gsum gyi sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba ci zhe na/ de nyid kyi rtogs pa chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po'i dbye ba la dgongs nas/ kun mkhyen gsum gyi sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba yin no// zhes dang*/ grags cha las mkhyen pa gsum ni dngos po'i dbye ba las phye ba yin la/ lnga po rnams ni 'di las spros pa yin no zhes dang*/ shes rab sgron ma las/ yul nyid dang*/ sbyor ba nyid dang*/ 'bras bu nyid kyi sgo nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang gsum gyis mngon par rtogs pa brgyad bsdus zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro// shān+ti pa ltar na/ nyan thos byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yum zhes brjod pa na/

nyan rang dag byang sems kyi yum yin par mi 'gyur ro// 'o na bu dang bcas pa'i pha'i chung ma zhes brjod pa na/ bu'i chung mar thal lo zhe na med de/ bcas pa'i don ni lhan cig pa yin pa'i phyir zhe na rnam mkhyen nyid yum du bzhed/ chos kyi bshes gnyen yang de dang cha mthun par bzhed de/ tshig gsal las/ yum la gsum du phye ba ni rang bzhin gsum du phye ba min te/ dbye bar mi nus pa'i phyir/ 'o na ci zhe na/ gdul bya'i bsam pa'i dbang gis sras thams cad kyi yum yin no// zhes bstan gyi/ rnam par nges pa'i dbang du byas pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas rje btsun kho na'i yum yin gyi/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas g.yung po lta bu ni/ bud med rin po che lta bu'i yum 'dis ga la zhig bskyod/ de ci'i phyir na/ yum 'di'i mthus che ba ni 'gro ba ma lus pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rgyal po kho nar bsgrub pas na/ rab tu mtshar du bya'o// yum gyi mthu'i khyad par de nyid ston pa'i gzhung dag kyang gzhung gzhan pas mchog yin no// dran pa nyer gzhag las/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i 'jug pa tsam gtso bor ston pas/ gzhung phyogs gcig pa yin la/ sdong po bkod pa las/ theg pa chen po'i bya ba'i tshul dang*/ 'bras bu la sogs pa gtso bor bstan gyi/ nyan rang rnams kyi lam dang 'bras bu ma bstan pas gzhung phyogs gcig pa yin no// rgyal ba'i yum 'dir ni rigs thams cad bstan pas shin tu rgyas pa'i sde yin no// des na yum 'di du mar snang ba dang*/ gcig nyid du bsgrub pa'i mthu dang ldan par bstan pa'i phyir/ tshul gsum pa zhes smos so// zhes bshad/ 'di la dpags nas/ rje btsun la sogs pa/ bod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po rnam mkhyen nyid byed las mi 'dra ba'i cha nas 'phags pa'i yum du bzhag pa yin gyi/ dngos po la yum yin na 'bras bu rnam mkhyen yin pas khyab ces bzhed par snang ngo*// bzhi pa bsdus don 'grel pas gang du bkral ba la 'grel chen du ni mchod brjod la bshad pa ma mdzad la/

'grel pa 'dir ni/ bshad thabs lnga'i sgo nas 'chad de/ de yang rnam bshad kyi dgongs pa ltar na/ dgos don bshad pa'i sgo nas mtshams sbyar ba ni/ 'phags pa byams pa zhes so// bsdus don 'chad pa'i dbang du byas nas/ 'dis ni zhes pa'o// dgos don phyi 'grel gyis rgyas par 'chad pa'i dbang du byas nas/ de thos nas zhes so// bstod pa'i rgyu mtshan 'chad pa'i dbang du byas nas/ de la thams cad mkhyen pa zhes so// tshig don 'chad pa ni/ nyan thos dang zhes so// brgal lan ni/ lo ts+tsha ba bzhed pa ltar/ de ltar phyag 'tshal ba dang zhes so// ar gyis/ bsdus don 'dis ni zhes pa yin la/ brgal lan ni/ de la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces pas bstan par bzhed/ bcom ral sogs ni bsdus don dgos don gyi gong du 'chad na/ rnam bshad rigs pa dang 'gal bas bsdus don ni/ de la thams cad ces pas bstan par bzhed bu ston/ mtshams sbyor shugs la 'chad/ mchod brjod bshad thabs lnga'i sgo nas 'chad/ ces pa/ chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis bzhed pa'o// shes rab 'byung gnas blo gros ni/ mngon par rtogs pa'i yan lag mngon par rtogs pa'i bsdu ba/ mngon par rtogs pa rnam par bzhag pa gsum du byas nas/ dang po ni/ de thos nas re shig dad pa'i rjes su zhes sogs/ gnyis pa ni/ de la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid// ces sogs/ gsum pa ni/ nyan thos dang zhes so// de dang mthun par/ bstan bcos rtsa ba la'ang gsum po rim pa ltar dgos 'grel dang*/ lus rnam gzhag dang*/ yan lag rgyas bshad rnams kyis ston par bzhed de/ 'phags pa ltar na/ mchod brjod kyi ngag bkod pa'i dgos pa ni/ bstan bcos rtsom par dam bcas pa yin par bzhed de/ nyi khri snang ba las/ 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi dbang du mdzad nas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyis thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan nye bar dgod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod pa 'di ni/

de'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi man ngag bshad sbyar du bya'o// snyam pas rnam par dgrol bar bya'o// zhes mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi bshad pa ni sbyar bar dam bcas pa yin no// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bya ba rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin/ de ltar phyag 'tshal ba nye bar dgod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa yang dag par mtshon pa'i don 'di yod pa yin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// slob dpon rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa ltar na/ rang nyid dam par rtogs shing gdul bya yum la dwang ba skyes pa de dgos par bzhed/ 'o na mchod brjod kyi ngag 'dis bstan bcos kyi brjod bya mtha' dag la bstod dam/ phyogs gcig la bstod/ phyi ma khas mi len pas/ dang po ltar na mngon par rtogs pa brgyad ka la ma bstod pas gsal/ gal te gsum gyis brgyad bsdus pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis gsum po kho na la bstod na/ 'o na rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis/ 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad bsdus pa'i phyir/ zhes bshad pas rnam mkhyen kho na'i sgo nas bstod par rigs so zhe na/ nyes pa dang po med de/ gsum gyis brgyad ka bsdus pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ de la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyis ni don brgyad bsdus pa'i phyir/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi sgo nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bstod do// zhes pa'o// nyes pa gnyis pa la'ang*/ de med de/ gzhi shes dang lam shes kyi sgo nas ma bstod na/ nyan rang dang*/ byang sems gzhon nu'i sa kho na don du gnyer ba rnams yum la dwang bar mi 'gyur ba las/ mkhyen pa gsum ka'i sgo nas bstod pa na/ rigs can thams cad yum 'di la rang rang gi bzhed don bsgrub pa'i nus pa yod par shes nas/ yum la 'jug par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ mkhyen pa gsum po de dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin zhing*/ mkhyen gsum des kyang 'chad par 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis zhes sogs so// 'o na mkhyen gsum gyis/

'phags bzhi'i bzhed don ji ltar bsgrub ce na/ de ston pa ni/ nyan thos dang zhes sogs so// chos shes dang*/ g.yag ṭīka gi dgongs pa'o// rnam bshad kyi dgongs pa ni/ gsum gyis brgyad bsdus kyang*/ brgyad pa yum yin pa mi 'thad do zhe na/ brgyad po dag kyang sher phyin yin zhing*/ brgyad po de dag kyang zhes ston no// 'o na gsum gyis brgyad ji ltar bsdus she na/ 'phags pa grol sdes mkhyen pa gsum gyis 'phags pa thams cad kyi mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag bsdus shing*/ bsdus pa ltar mtha' dag yum yin par bzhed/ slob dpon gyi lugs 'di la/ lo chen/ rgya che bas chung ba bsdus par bzhed/ 'dre/ rang bzhin gyis gnas skabs bsdus par bzhed/ ar/ mtshon byed kyi chos sum cus mkhyen gsum bsdus par bzhed/ khyung*/ spyis bye brag bsdus par bzhed/ bud+dha shrī/ yul nyid dang*/ sbyor ba nyid 'bras bu nyid kyi sgo nas bsdus par bzhed/ de dag ni gsum gyis lnga bsdus par bzhed pa'i phyogs yin la/ dgongs pa mi mthun pa cher mi snang ngo*// chos kyi bshes gnyen/ 'phags pa bzhi'i mngon rtogs la mkhyen gsum du byas pa de mkhyen gsum tsam gyis bsdus/ sbyor bzhi lam shes/ chos sku rnam mkhyen gyis bsdus par bzhed de/ de ni gsum gyis brgyad bsdus pa'i phyogs so// chos kyi bshes gnyen 'di ltar bzhed de/ 'dir/ mkhyen gsum gyis mngon par rtogs pa brgyad bsdus par bstan pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ skabs brgyad du phye ba'ang skabs gsum du 'dus par shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs zhing*/ 'di nyid slob dpon gyi dgongs pa'ang yin te/ 'grel chen las/ stong phrag brgya pa la sogs pa'i mdo'i don/ byang chub kyi sems dang*/ gdams ngag la sogs pa bsgrub pa'i rang bzhin skabs brgyad kyi dbye bas phye ba thams cad/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// 'dir mkhyen pa gsum la bstod pa'i go rim mi 'thad de/

yan lag rgyas bshad kyi go rim dang 'gal ba'i phyir zhe na/ de'i lan la/ sgros rnying ltar na/ mchod brjod gleng gzhi'i 'grel pa yin pas/ gleng gzhi'i go rim dang bstun pa'o// rnam bshad ltar na/ nyan thos kyi rigs can yum la rim gyis dwang ba bskyed pa'i ched yin la/ yang na 'dir ni/ rgyud la skye ba'i rim pa yin la/ yan lag rgyas bshad du bshad pa'i go rim yin pas mi 'gal lo// de ltar phyag 'tshal ba dang zhes pa'i gzhung 'di gang la 'phros pa yin zhe na/ bzhed pa'i rnam grangs bkod pa dang*/ 'thad pa'i cha bzhag pa gnyis/ dang po la/ nyi khri snang bar/ gzhung 'di dgos 'grel gyi mjug tu gsungs pas/ 'di ltar mngon te/ mchod brjod kyi shugs la bstan bcos rtsom pa tsam zhig dam bcas pa la/ ci'i don du rtsom zhe na/ lan du/ bde blag tu ni rtogs pa zhes// bya ba rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin// zhes ston no// 'o na mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag bde blag tu rtogs pa'am/ phyogs re bde blag tu rtogs pa gang yin zhe na/ de'i lan du/ ci mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'di gzhi bsdus pa'am zhes pa nas/ mngon par rtogs pa yongs su rdzogs pa mtha' dag bstan pa yin no// zhes bya ba 'di 'thad pa yin no// zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ brgyad stong 'grel chen ltar na/ brgyad stong pa 'di'i brjod bya gang yin zhe na/ thogs med kyi rjes 'brang rnams gzhi kho na brjod byar 'dod/ dpal ldan chos skyong gi rjes 'brang rnams/ lam kho na brjod byar 'dod/ klu sgrub kyi rjes 'brang rnams rnam pa kho na brjod byar 'dod pa/ phyogs dang po ltar na zhes sogs kyis bkag nas cho 'phrul gsum gyi sgo nas yum rgyas 'bring gnyis las ma bstan pa de brgyad stong pa'i yang brjod par bya ba yin no// zhes ston pa ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam// ston pas 'di las gsungs pa gang*// zhes so// 'o na zlos par 'gyur ro zhe na/

mdor bsdus pa la dga' ba rnams kyis/ mdo don bde blag tu rtogs pa de brgyad stong pa'i dgos pa yin no zhes ston pa ni/ gzhan gyis myong ba ma yin te/ nas dgos pa yin zhes pa'i bar ro// 'grel pa 'di'i lugs la'ang*/ ar dang*/ 'bum phrag gnyis pa ltar na/ dgos 'brel gyi snga 'grel du bzhed/ lo ts+tsha ba mchod brjod kyi brgal lan ston par bzhed do// dar ṭīka pa/ dgos 'brel gnyis te/ bstan bcos rtsom pa dgos med kyi log rtog spangs nas brjod bya mkhyen gsum spyi'i rnam gzhag ston pa dang*/ mdo dang zlos pa spangs nas dgos pa yod par bsgrub pa gnyis rim par 'chad pa ni/ de ltar zhes sogs dang*/ skye bo blo gros dman pa dag /zhes sogs so// gnyis pa mchod brjod dang*/ dgos 'brel la so sor sbyor ba ni/ gzhung don ye nas ma rtogs pa'i rnam 'gyur yin te/ dgos pa'i gtso bo spong ba/ skye bo'i blo gros sogs yin zhing*/ gzhan snga ma rnams de'i mtha' gcod pa'i yan lag yin no zhes gsungs/ dgos pa'i gtso bo gzhung phyi mas spong ba min te/ nyi khri snang bar/ gzhung snga ma rdzogs par bkod nas/ gzhung phyi ma 'di zur tsam yang ma gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'grel pa 'dir gzhung snga ma gnyis so sor 'byed dgos te/ tshig gsal las 'thad pa yin no zhes pa'i mjug tu/ de ltar phyag 'tshal ba bstan nas/ da ni dgos pa la sogs pa bsnyad pa'i don bkrol bar bya ste/ zhes dang*/ shes 'byung blo gros kyis/ phyag 'tshal ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'i don rnam pa gsum po 'di nyid bstan bcos su bstan par bzhed nas/ skye bo blo gros dman pa dag /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i rtsod pa smras so// zhes dang*/ rtogs dka'i snang ba las/ skye bo blo gros dman pa dag /zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/ bstan bcos kyi dgos pa med pa la sogs pa nyid du rtogs pa la/ dam bca' 'jug pa'i yan lag brjod par bya ba la sogs pa ston pa yin te/

zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// des na g.yag ṭīka pa ltar na/ bstan bcos 'di gzhi kho na'am/ lam kho na'am/ rnam pa kho na'am/ gsum ka brjod byar bsdus/ dang po gsum ltar na/ mngon pa dang zlos pa sogs kyis skyon yod la/ bzhi pa ltar na/ bstan bcos rdzas tha dad pa gsum du thal ba'i skyon yod de mkhyen pa gsum po de'i rigs can gsum gyi mngon rtogs yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i dogs pa bkod nas/ phyogs dang po gsum khas mi len la/ nyes pa bzhi pas mi gnod de/ sher phyin 'di rigs can thams cad kyi lam rgya cher bstan pas/ gzhung shin tu rgyas pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa'i dbang du byas/ mdor bsdus pa las kyang*/ nyan thos kyi sa la slob par 'dod pas yum 'di nyid la bslab par bya'o// zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs la/ zhes pa'o// 'di chos shes kyi dgongs par yang snang ngo*// gnyis pa rang lugs ni/ nyan thos zhi ba 'tshol rnams zhes pas bstan bcos rtsom par shugs la dam bcas pa la rtsod/ ji ltar rtsod na/ bstan bcos 'dis gzhi gnyen rnam gsum gang rung re re kho na brjod byar bsdus sam/ gsum char brjod byar bsdus/ dang po ltar na/ mngon pa dang zlos pa sogs kyi skyon yod la/ gnyis pa ltar na yang bstan bcos 'di mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag gi rgyan du mi 'thad de/ phyogs gsum po des mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag bsdus mi nus pa'i phyir zhe na/ lan la gtan tshigs dgod/ sgrub byed bshad/ thun mong gi mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan chos can/ re re kho na bsdus pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ mngon pa dang zlos pa sogs kyi skyon yod pa min par thal/ gsum car bsdus pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ de ni min te/ zhes pa'o// yang chos can gsum car bsdus kyang mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag gi rgyan du mi 'thad pa'i nyes pa yod pa min par thal/ gsum car gyis mkhyen gsum bsdus/

des mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag bsdus pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ gang gi phyir nyan thos dang sogs so// mdo 'di dag ni theg pa gsum car thob pa'i rgyu zhes pa'i mdo yin la/ gsum car gyi lung 'dren pa ni/ kun gyi rgyan du 'gyur bar ni// zhes pa'i gzhung 'dzugs pa yin gsung ngo*// de ltar na bstan bcos 'dir theg pa gsum ka rgya cher ston pas/ gzhung gzhan las khyad par du 'phags par grub bo// gnyis pa dgos 'brel la/ bshad bya'i mdo ni yum gyi gleng gzhir/ cho 'phrul gsum gyi chos gsung bar bstan pa'i mdo rnams ste/ bcom ldan 'das cho 'phrul rnam pa gsum gyis 'gro ba mtha' dag la rjes su ston par mdzad pa/ zhes bshad pa ltar ro// de'i don 'chad pa ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam// zhes sogs so// 'di la mtshams sbyar/ rtsa ba/ 'grel pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ mngon par rtogs pa ril rdzogs par bstan pa yin no// zhes pa la 'phros nas/ byams pa chos can/ mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag rdzogs par byas pa'i bstan bcos rtsom mi dgos par thal/ mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag yum gyi mdo las bstan zin pa'i phyir/ zhe na de'i lan du brjod bya/ dgos pa/ nying dgos gsum dngos su bstan cing*/ 'brel pa shugs la ston pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gnyis gsungs so// zhes mtshams sbyar ba'i dbang du byas nas/ skye bo blo gros dman pa dag /zhes sogs so// 'grel pa 'di'i lugs so// 'grel chen ltar na/ gzhung 'di la 'jug par bya ba min te/ brjod par bya ba sogs med pa'i phyir snyam na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam// la sogs smras so// de skad du yang 'grel chen las/ 'brel pa dang*/ brjod par bya ba rnams ma smras na/ de'i tshe smyon tshig la sogs pa ltar 'brel med pa dang*/ don med par dogs pas nyan pa la su yang 'jug par mi 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// rtsa ba la slob dpon ltar na/

rkang pa dang po gnyis kyi brjod bya/ gzhan gyis nas/ 'gyur yan chad kyi dgos pa'i dgos pa/ phyir man chad kyi dgos pa bstan/ 'brel pa ni shugs kyis rtogs te/ 'grel chen las/ 'brel pa ni dgos pa las logs shig tu bstan par mi bya ste/ 'bras bu med pa'i phyir zhes gsungs/ ka ma la shī las/ 'brel pa ston par byed pa'i sgra// dngos su yod pa ma yin mod// 'on kyang de ni rnam 'byed la// don gyis thob par byed pa yin// zhes pa ltar ro// bud+dha shrī/ rim pa bzhin/ gsum dang gsum dang*/ gnyis kyis bstan par bzhed/ shān+ti pa/ gzhan gyis myong ba ma yin te// blo dang ldan pas rtogs par 'gyur// zhes yar blangs nas tshig bcad dang pos rtsom pa'i gtso bo'i dgos pa dang*/ tshigs bcad tha mas gtso bo min pa'i dgos pa bstan par bzhed/ rat+na kirti yang*/ gzhung snga ma ltar bton nas tshig bcad dang pos dgos pa/ gnyis pas nying dgos bstan par bzhed/ g.yag ṭīka ltar na/ chos spyod bcu yi bdag nyid kyi/ mdo don zhes pas brjod bya bstan// chos spyod bcu'i bdag nyid kyi mdo don blo dang ldan pas bde blag tu rtogs pa zhes bya ba rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin/ zhes pas dgos pa bstan/ chos spyod bcu yi bdag nyid kyi// mdo don dran pa la bzhag nas// ston pas 'di las bshad pa gang*// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam// gzhan gyis myong ba ma yin te// blo dang ldan pas mthong 'gyur phyir// bya ba rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin// zhes pas nying dgos bstan par bzhed/ 'o na mngon par rtogs pa brgyad ka bde blag tu rtogs pa de dgos par rigs pa las/ 'dir rnam mkhyen gcig tu smos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ shān+ti pa na re/ sgrib pa kun gyi dri med pa// zhes pa ltar yin la/ de yang btsal bar bya bas na lam yin gyi/ tshol bar byed pas lam ni min zhes gsung*/ rat+na kirti ni/ rnam mkhyen ni 'bras bu chos sku yin la/

lam ni mngon par rtogs pa gzhan bdun no// a bha ya/ bgrod par byas pas na lam 'bras bu chos sku dang rnam mkhyen gnyis yin la/ bgrod par byed pas lam gzhan drug go /slob dpon gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid ni sangs rgyas kyi lam ste/ mngon par rtogs pa thams cad nye bar mtshon pa lhur len pa yin no// zhes gsungs/ dgos pa ni 'di yin te/ rnam mkhyen smos pas mngon par rtogs pa brgyad ka rtogs par 'gyur te/ rnam mkhyen gyis mngon par rtogs pa brgyad ka bsdus pa'i phyir te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid kyi 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad bsdus pa'i phyir/ zhes 'byung ba ltar ro// 'di ni ral gri'i dgongs pa'o// bdag gi blo la 'di ltar shar te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam// zhes pas rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu po nyid bstan te/ 'grel chen las/ de la 'bras bu bstan pas byang chub don du gnyer ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems bskyed pa la sogs pa rnam pa yongs su shes par byed pa'i phyir na dang por rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid brjod do// zhes dang*/ tshogs ni nges par 'byung bcas rnams// thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid// ces pa ltar ro// chos bcu po 'dis mngon par rtogs pa brgyad ka bsdus te/ 'grel chen las/ byang chub kyi sems dang gdams ngag la sogs pa'i rang bzhin gnas skabs brgyad kyi dbye bas phye ba thams cad dang*/ chos shes kyis/ sgrub pa bzhi dang sbyor ba bzhi sbyar nas/ rnam mkhyen gyis skabs brgyad ka bsdus pa'i tshul gsungs pa ltar/ rgyan 'dir bstan pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rim pa mtha' dag rdzas kyi dbang du byas na/ sems bskyed nas nges 'byung sgrub pa'i bar gyis bsdus pa'i phyir ro// yang na ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la sogs pa'i lam zhes brjod rgyu yin pa las/ sogs sgra mi mngon par byas pa ste/ dper na/ dang zhes bya ba'i sgra bsdus pa/

lam shes pa nyid la sogs pa sngar bshad pa dag kyang yin te/ zhes pa lta bu'o// mkhan chen pa'i 'brel sgrig na/ lam gyi rnam par shes pa nyid// chos spyod bcu gcig bdag nyid kyi// zhes sbyar nas de bzhin du lhag ma rnams la'ang sbyor zhes bris pa'ang snang ngo*// 'dir chos spyod bcu po de gang la bya zhe na/ shān+ti pa dang*/ bud+dha shrī/ dbus mtha' nas bshad pa ltar/ yi ge 'dri mchod sbyin pa la sogs pa 'dod/ dhi ra pa la dge ba bcu la bzhed/ a bha yas gnad kyi zla 'od las/ chos ni sems bskyed dang gdams ngag la sogs pa rnam pa bcu'i khongs su gtogs pa mngon par rtogs pa brgyad rab tu phye ba/ de'i spyod pa rnams kyis bde blag tu rjes su gnas par 'gyur zhes gsung*/ slob dpon gyi dgongs pa la/ chos bshes gser gling pa/ sher blo rnams sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i phar phyin bcu la 'chad/ lo chen gyis chos spyod bcu ni/ phar phyin bcu dang*/ des mtshon pa'i sa bcu po yin par bzhed cing*/ 'dir sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam ste zhes pa dang*/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam la pha rol tu phyin pa bcu ste zhes pa dang 'grig par snang ngo*// rnam bshad ltar na/ 'grel chen ltar rnam mkhyen gyi chos bcu la bzhed cing*/ 'dir rtsa bar rnam mkhyen smos pa dang*/ 'grel par byang chub kyi sems dang*/ sgrub pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid gdul bya rnams kyis bde blag tu rtogs par 'gyur ba ni/ zhes gsungs pa dang shin tu 'grig go /gsum pa 'grel pa dgos 'brel gyi ngag 'di yang bshad thabs yan lag lnga'i sgo nas 'chad dgos pas/ ji ltar 'chad ce na/ don la the tshom bskyed pa nyid kyis 'jug pa'i yan lag ces pas dgos don bstan/ brjod par bya ba dang zhes sogs kyis bsdus don bstan/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni zhes pas brgal lan bstan/ lhag ma rnams kyi tshig don no// dgos 'brel gyi dgos pa la/

slob dpon 'di dang*/ slob dpon chos mchog gnyis/ dbyig gnyen gyis/ gang phyir 'jig rten don gnyer ni// the tshom las kyang 'jug phyir ro// zhes pa'i rjes su 'brang nas/ dgos med kyi log rtog bsal nas/ dgos sogs yod dam snyam pa'i don 'gyur gyi the tshom skyes pa de dgos par bzhed/ dzñā na shrī/ nges pa skyes pa de dgos par bzhed/ bram ze bde byed dga' ba/ glo bur du gzhung bkod na mi mdzes pa'i phyir/ gzhung mdzes pa bskyed pa de dgos par 'dod/ bud+dha shrī/ the tshom skyes pa/ nges pa skyes pa/ gzhung mdzes pa skyes pa gsum ga dgos par bzhed de/ shes rab sgron ma las don la the tshom bskyed pa nyid kyis 'jug pa dang*/ gzhan dag kyang rjes su 'brangs nas nges par 'gyur ba'am/ rab tu byed pa'i lus yang dag par mdzes pa nyid kyi phyir/ yang 'jug pa'i yan lag go /zhes bzhed/ lo ts+tsha ba chen pos/ rgya gar na nges pa bskyed pa/ the tshom bskyed pa/ gzhung mdzes pa bskyed pa gsum las/ kho bo cag gsum pa'i rjes su 'brangs te/ gzhung gi dbu rgyan dang bcas par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ dper na lha la dbu rgyan gsol ba bzhin no// zhes bzhed/ don la gnas pa ni mchod brjod kyi skabs nas bstan pa ltar/ dbang rtul la nges pa bskyed pa dang*/ dbang rnon la don 'gyur gyi the tshom bskyed pa de dgos pa yin no// 'dir 'brel pa dang*/ mtshams sbyor don gcig go /yang*/ bdag gi blo la 'di ltar shar te/ bstan bcos rtsom pa'i go rim gyi dbang du byas na/ mchod brjod thog mar yod kyang*/ 'chad pa po rnams kyis 'chad pa'i go rim gyi dbang du byas na/ dgos 'brel thog mar 'chad dgos te/ rnam bshad rigs par/ thog mar dgos pa brjod par bya// zhes pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas 'grel chen du/ 'di skad ces bya ba la sogs pa la thams cad kyi 'brel pa dang*/ brjod par bya ba dang*/ dgos pa dang*/ dgos pa'i dgos pa rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i 'jug pa ni/

thams cad du don 'gyur gyi the tshom gyis yin te/ des na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la 'brel pa la sogs pa brjod pa yin no// zhes thog mar dgos 'brel ma bshad na/ gdul bya gleng gzhi la'ang mi 'jug pas/ dgos 'brel bshad zin pa'i 'og tu gleng gzhi'i bshad pa mdzad pas/ 'dir yang*/ thog mar bstan bcos kyi dgos pa ma bshad na/ gdul bya mchod brjod la'ang*/ thos bsam gyis 'jug par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// de ltar na 'di ltar 'chad de/ man ngag gi bstan bcos zhes pa'i ming la 'phros nas/ mu stegs gyi paṇ+ḍi ta ku ma ra na re/ bstan bcos dag ni thams cad dang*// yang na las ni 'ga' zhig la// ji srid dgos pa ma brjod pa// de srid du ni su zhig 'dzin// zhes smra ba ltar/ bstan bcos kyi dgos pa ji lta bu zhig dang ldan pas man ngag tu 'gyur zhe na/ de'i lan du/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam// zhes gsungs te/ 'di las bshad pa gang zhes nye tshig smras pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las zhes ming la bsnyeg go /ston pas 'di las bshad pa gang*// zhes pa la 'phros nas/ ji ltar bshad ce na/ 'grel par/ bcom ldan 'das cho 'phrul rnam pa gsum gyis 'gro ba mtha' dag la rjes su ston par mdzad pa de nyid kyis rgyal ba'i yum rnam pa gsum car las zhes gsungs/ 'o na cho 'phrul rnam pa gsum gyis chos ston pa'i tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das rang nyid kyis gdan seng ge'i khri bshams te zhes sogs ting nge 'dzin gyi cho 'phrul/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul chos snang ba'i cho 'phrul te gsum gyi sgo nas yum gyi mdo ji ltar gsungs pa'i gleng gzhi dang*/ rnam pa kun ldan sna tshogs 'di gsungs pa// zhes sogs mchod brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa sbyar nas 'chad pa ni mchod brjod do// 'o na mchod brjod kyi sher phyin de gang zhe na/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni// dngos po brgyad kyis yang dag bshad// ces ston no// 'phags pa bzhed pa ltar ro// de'i phyir nyi snang dang*/

'grel chen gnyis kar du mchod brjod kyi brgal lan/ dgos 'brel gyi 'og tu gsungs pa yin no// don 'di la dgongs nas/ brgyad stong 'grel chen du/ dgos 'brel gyi gong du mchod brjod la bshad pa zur tsam yang ma mdzad pa yin no// de ltar shes na/ dar ṭīka pa/ mchod brjod dang gleng gzhi sbyor ba mi 'thad de/ slob dpon gyis gleng gzhi'i bzhed pa gzhan du byas pa'i phyir/ zhes rtsod pa de yang rang grol lo// de ltar bstan bcos kyi dgos don rnam par bshad nas/ dgos pa'i don ni bsdus don las zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bstan bcos 'di'i bsdus don de gang zhe na/ gsum pa bstan bcos kyi brjod bya mngon rtogs bshad pa la/ bstan bcos 'di la bsdus don ni rnam pa gsum ste/ rgyas pa la dad pa la brgyad du phye ba/ bar pa la dad pa la drug du bshad/ bsdus pa la dga' ba la gsum du bsdu ba'o// 'o na bsdus don rnam pa gsum du yod na tshig don yang rnam pa gsum yod dgos shing*/ med na bsdus don gsum byas pa la dgos pa ci yod/ gsum po'i mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni gang yin zhe na/ bsdus don mi 'dra ba gsum yod kyang tshig don mi 'dra ba gsum gyis bshad dgos pa ni min te/ bsdus don gcig rnam par bshad pa na/ gsum ka rnam par bshad pa 'gyur ba'i phyir/ snga ma kho na bzhin du bshad par bya ba yin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ bsdus pa'i don gyi tshig le'ur byas pa rnams ni/ bstan bcos mdzad pa nyid kyi sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir zhes bya ba la sogs pa 'chad par 'gyur ba'i bstan bcos mtha' dag gis 'chad pas de dag rnam par bshad pas bshad par bsams te/ zhes 'byung ba ltar ro// de lta na yang bsdus don gsum du gzhag pa la dgos pa med pa min te/ bsdus don phyi ma gnyis kyis bsdus don snga ma'i go rim la log par rtog pa dang grangs la log par rtog pa bsal nas/

zhar la bsdus don bsdus 'bring gnyis la dga' ba'i gdul bya rjes su 'dzin dgos pa'i phyir/ dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang sngar bshad pa'i dngos po brgyad kyi rim pa de yang bshad pa'i rim pa yin gyi/ rgyud la skye ba'i rim pa ni min nam snyam pa dang*/ rgyud la skye ba'i mngon rtogs kyi rim pa la yang*/ mkhyen pa gsum mam/ sbyor ba bzhi gang rung gis chog pas/ brgyad du bshad pa lhag pa'am/ yang na ma tshang ngo snyam pa dang*/ yum gsum la tshig la rgyas bsdus kyi khyad par yod kyang*/ don la rgyas bsdus kyi dbye ba byar med na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni tshig gi dbye bsdu la mkhas pa tsam yin gyi/ don gyi dbye bsdu la mkhas pa min no snyam du dogs te/ don bsdus pa la dga' ba dag 'jug par mi 'gyur bas yum gsum car yang don rgyas 'bring gsum gsum gyi sgo nas bshad pa yin no// yum re re dang re re sbyar bar bya ba ni min te/ yum thams cad kyi don bsdus pa gzhan rnam pa drug ste zhes dang*/ yum kun la'ang don bsdus de tsam shes par bya/ zhes yum gsum ka la bsdus don gsum ka yod par gsungs pa'i phyir ro// bsdus don gsum po yang dngos po'i rkang grangs mang nyung tsam du zad kyi/ bstan bcos kyi lus rdzas tha dad pa gsum ni min te/ nyi khri snang bar/ yang brgyad du bshad pa de nyid rnam par bshad pa ni/ mtshan nyid de yi sbyor ba dang*// zhes sbyar ba dang*/ 'grel chen las/ de ltar rnam pa gzhan gnyis kyis ni bsdus pa'i don nyid 'chad par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ re shig bsdus pa'i don ni gcig nyid yin no zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// tshul 'di ni lo ts+tsha ba chen po dang*/ chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i dgongs pa bri gang med pa yin no/ dar ṭīka pa bsdus don gsum po yan lag rgyas bshad kyis 'chad dgos pa la khyad par med par 'dod pa bzhin/ slar yang gsum po'i khyad par yan lag rgyas bshad kyi don rags pa rnams la yid dpyod kyis nges pa 'dren nus mi nus la 'dod pa ni cir yang mi rung ste/

dngos po brgyad kyi rkang grangs tsam smos sam/ don bdun cu'i rkang grangs smos pas yan lag rgyas bshad kyi don rags pa la yid dpyod kyis nges pa 'dren nus pa gang yin/ dang po ltar na dngos po drug dang gsum gyi rkang grangs smos pas kyang ci'i phyir mi nus/ gnyis pa ltar na/ bsdus don gsum gyi khyad par du ma song gi don bdun cu'i rkang grangs smos ma smos kyi khyad par du song bas/ bsdus don gsum ka don bdun cu'i sgo nas 'chad dgos pa 'gal lo// 'o na gsum po go rim 'di ltar ston pa mi rigs te/ yi ge nyung dang mchod par 'os// dang por bshad pa 'thad pa yin// zhes 'byung ba'i phyir snyam na/ nyes pa med de/ sngar bshad pa ltar/ bsdus don phyi ma gnyis kyis snga ma 'chad dgos pa'i phyir rnam pa gcig tu/ bsdus don gsum po la yi ge mang nyung gi khyad par yang cher yod pa min te/ sems bskyed pa dang gdams ngag dang*// zhes sogs ni/ gsum ka'i thun mong gi chos yin pa'i phyir te/ 'grel chen las/ don bsdus pa drug po 'dis snga ma kho na bzhin du rgyal ba'i yum bshad par bya ba yin no// zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ 'o na bsdus don gsum po don gcig na/ don bsdus gzhan zhes gsungs pa ji ltar grags zhe na/ de ni skabs brgyad du bshad pa las gzhan skabs drug dang*/ gsum gyi sgo nas 'chad ces pa'i don ni/ nyi khri snang ba las/ 'di ni bshad pa'i rnam grangs gzhan yin no zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gsum po de'i nang nas brgyad du bshad pa la/ bsdus don lus rnam gzhag tshig don yan lag rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po yang bshad thabs yan lag lnga'i sgo nas 'chad rigs pa las/ thog mar dgos pa'i sgo nas mtshams sbyar ston pa ni/ de ltar 'brel pa la sogs pa bsnyad nas zhes sogs so// 'dir lus rnam gzhag gsungs pa'i dgos pa ni gnyis te/ nyan pa po nyan sla ba'i dgos pa dang*/ 'chad pa po 'chad sla ba'i dgos pa'o// dang po ni/

gdul bya rnams kyis bde blag tu rtogs par bya ba'i phyir zhes pas ston/ de yang*/ bde blag tu ni rtogs pa zhes// bya ba rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin// zhes pa dang 'di mi zlos te/ snga ma ni mdo'i don bde blag tu rtogs pa yin la/ 'dir ni bstan bcos kyi don bde blag tu rtogs pa yin pas so// gnyis pa ni/ bstan bcos kyi don rnam par dbye ba byas pa yang ma 'dzings pa nyid kyis bshad par bya sla bar gzigs nas/ zhes pas bstan/ de'i don yang 'dir don bdun bcu po dngos po brgyad kyi sde mtshan so sor 'chad pas ma 'dzings zhes pa'i don yin gyi/ sems bskyed dang*/ gdams ngag lta bu'i go rim ma 'dzings zhes pa la dogs pa'i gnas med do// de skad du 'grel chen las/ bstan bcos kyi don rnam par dbye ba byas pa ni/ 'chad pa po rnams kyis bshad sla ba des na zhes gsungs so// 'phros ni slob dpon gyi dgongs pa 'di ltar mngon te/ bsdus don gyi dgos don 'chad dgos pas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid lam// ston pas 'di las bshad pa gang*// zhes bstan na/ bshad pa de rnam mkhyen kho na yin nam snyam na/ min te/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni// dngos po brgyad kyis yang dag bshad// brgyad po gang zhe na/ rnam kun mkhyen nyid sogs so// brgyad po de mdo las bstan pa med do snyam na/ mdo las sems bskyed sogs chos bcu gsungs pa de rnam mkhyen shugs la ston byed yin no zhes 'chad pa ni/ sems bskyed pa dang*/ nas thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar ro// de bzhin du lhag ma rnams la sbyor/ de ltar shes na mtshon byed kyi chos shes pa'i tshig dang legs par 'byor ro// 'phags pa'i dgongs pa ni sngar bshad pa ltar mchod brjod las 'phros par bzhed pa'o// gnyal zhig ni/ 'di bstan bcos kyi bshad par dam bca' yin par bzhed/ bdag gi blo la 'di ltar snang ste/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan zhes pa la 'phros nas/

mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan du ji ltar 'chad ce na/ de'i lan du'o// 'o na dngos po brgyad dang*/ mngon par rtogs pa brgyad dang*/ skabs brgyad la khyad par ci yod ce na/ bsdus don sgron mar mngon rtogs shes rgyud rim pa ste/ dngos po brgyad ni brjod bya la// skabs ni brjod byed shān+ti gsungs// zhes 'byung ba ltar yin la/ dngos po brgyad po skabs brgyad du phye nas/ de nyid le'u brgyad dang sbyor ba ni/ nyi khri snang ba dang*/ le brgyad ma gnyis la snang ste/ 'di ltar rab 'byor gyi le'us rnam mkhyen/ mtha' gnyis rnam dag gi le'us lam shes/ spyod pa khyad par can gyi le'us gzhi shes/ de bzhin nyid kyi le'us rnam kun/ bslab pa yongs su dag pa'i le'us rtse sbyor/ rim gyis 'jug pa la bslab pa'i le'us mthar gyis pa/ bslab pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i le'us skad cig ma/ bslab pa'i 'bras bu'i le'us chos kyi sku bshad do// nyi khri le mang*/ brgyad stong pa dang*/ 'bum rnams la 'di'i skabs brgyad kyi mtshams dang mthun par le'u'i mtshams so sor phye ba med de/ zhib tu 'grel chen sogs las rtogs par bya'o// 'o na shugs bstan dngos po brgyad po de dngos bstan sems bskyed sogs kyis 'chad na/ yan lag gi grangs ci tsam du gnas she na/ mkhas pa snga ma rnams la don bdun bcur grags la gzhung gi dngos bstan dang*/ slob dpon 'di'i bzhed pa ltar na bdun bcu rtsa gcig tu snang ste/ chos sku la bzhir phye ba'i phyir ro// 'phags pa'i bzhed pa ltar na/ sku gsum du bsdus pas 'grig cing*/ rnam pa bzhir brjod ces pa/ 'phrin las logs su bgrangs pa'i phyir ro// 'on kyang*/ don bdun bcu'i grangs nges par 'dzin mi 'os te/ rgya 'grel dri ma med pa rnams na de'i tha snyad mi snang ba'i phyir dang*/ bod rnams rtse sbyor chos brgyad du byed pa la shes byed med/ mar me mdzad kyi rtse sbyor don bdun du'ang bshad pa'i phyir/

'on kyang tha snyad 'gog pa ni min no// lus rnam gzhag gi dgos don de nyid kyang bsdus don gyis 'chad pa ni/ de la tshig le'ur byas pa dang po gnyis kyis ni sogs so// tshig don rgyas par ma bkrol ba'i rgyu mtshan 'chad pa ni/ bsdus pa'i don gyi tshig le'ur byas pa rnams ni zhes sogs so// 'di ni ral gri dang rnam bshad kyi dgongs pa yin no// gnyis pa tshig don yan lag rgyas par bshad pa la/ thos bsam gyis gtan la phab par bya ba'i yul mkhyen pa gsum/ nyams su len pa'i thabs sbyor ba bzhi/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku dang gsum gyis ston te/ sher phyin lus thams cad 'dir nges pa'i phyir te/ don du gnyer bya'i byang chub ni shes bya'i yul gsum/ nyams su len pa'i sbyor ba bzhi/ thob bya'i 'bras bu dang brgyad kyis mthar phyin dgos pa'i phyir/ de skad du/ yul ni rnam pa gsum po rgyu// zhes sogs gsungs pa yin no// de yang shes bya'i yul ma rtogs par sbyor bas nyams su len mi nus shing*/ sbyor bas nyams su ma blangs na 'bras bu mi thob la/ 'bras bu med na sbyor bas nyams su blangs pa don med pa'i phyir ci'i phyir/ shes bya'i yul la gsum du nges zhe na/ thog mar 'bras bu la spro ba skye nas de'i rgyu la nan gyis 'jug dgos shing*/ de la mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i rab dbye shes dgos pa'i phyir gsum du grangs nges so// yang na 'di las gang rung zhig ma tshang na mngon par rtogs pa thams cad bsdus mi nus shing 'di tsam gyis mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag bsdus pa'i phyir ro// ci'i phyir nyams su len pa'i thabs sbyor ba bzhir nges zhe na/ slob dpon ltar na/ dbang du byed pa rgyu 'bras med na/ bstan pa rgyu 'bras mi 'byung zhing*/ de med par yang chos sku mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ bzhir nges so// 'phags pa ltar na 'bras bu chos sku ni sgrib pa ma lus pa spangs shing*/

yon tan ma lus pa rdzogs pas rab tu phye ba yin la/ de la mi mthun phyogs spong ba'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang du byas nas sbyor ba dang po gnyis bzhag cing*/ yon tan mngon du byed pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang du byas nas sbyor ba phyi ma gnyis bzhag pa yin zhes gsungs so// dngos po brgyad kyi go rim kyang de kho na ltar nges pa yin te/ thog mar 'jug yul thos bsam gyis gtan la ma phab na/ sbyor bas nyams su len mi nus shing*/ nyams su ma blangs bar yang 'bras bu mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro// dper na so nam gyi sbyar thabs ma shes par so nam lag len du byed mi nus shing*/ de ma byas par ston thog phun sum tshogs pa mi 'byung ba bzhin no// de skad du yang a ti shas/ go rim skye ba'i rim pa ste// dang po thos bsam byed pas na// de yi yul ni mngon du bshad// ces pa ltar ro// 'dis ni dar ṭīka mdzad pa/ mkhyen gsum dang sbyor ba bzhi bshad pa'i rim pa tsam yin gyi/ rgyu 'bras kyi rim pa min zhes zer ba'ang bkag go /mkhyen pa gsum gyi go rim kyang*/ dang por 'bras bu la don gnyer gyi blo bskyed pa'i phyir du rnam mkhyen bstan/ de lam shes pa nyid med na mi 'byung bas lam shes bstan/ de yang gzhi mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i rab dbye shes pa la rag las pas/ de nas gzhi shes bstan no// dper na tshong pa tshong gi khe mthong nas tshong la 'jug cing*/ de spangs blangs gi rim pa shes dgos pa bzhin/ de skad du yang*/ de yang dang por 'bras shes byed// de nas rgyu dang spang bya dag /rim pa bzhin du gtan la 'bebs// zhes dang*/ gzhon nu dpal gyis/ 'bras bu la brod pa bskyed pa'i phyir rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang por bstan no// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ 'grel chen las/ chos thams cad sgyu ma dang 'dra ba nyid du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis rjes su rig par byed pa dang*/

lam shes pa nyid kyis rnam par dpyod pa dang*/ thams cad shes pa nyid kyi 'jug par byed pa dang zhes gsungs so// sbyor ba bzhi ni skye ba'i rim pa ste/ de'i sbyor ba dang*/ de rab de yi go rim dang*// de mtha' zhes dang*/ a ti shas/ sbyor ba bzhi'i rim pa yang*// rnam kun mngon rdzogs tshogs lam nas// yod pas dang por bstan pa yin// de nas gsum po rim bzhin skye// zhes bshad pa ltar/ 'o na 'dir rnam mkhyen yang 'bras bur bshad na/ chos sku dang zlos snyam na/ bsdus don sgron ma las/ chos kyi sku dang mi zlos te// 'di ni ma ru bshad pa ste// chos sku rang las skye ba'o// zhes 'byung ba ltar yin no// dang po yul mkhyen pa gsum la 'bras bu thun mong min pa rnam mkhyen/ rgyu thun mong min pa lam shes/ blang dor bya ba'i yan lag gzhi shes dang gsum/ dang po la 'brel dgod pas mtshams sbyar/ mtshon byed kyi chos rgyas par bshad/ skabs kyi sgo nas 'jug bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid// ces bshad pa de gang zhe na/ de nyid chos bcu'i sgo nas dang por 'chad do zhes ston pa ni/ de ltar bsdus pa'i don kun bstan nas zhes so// 'o na skabs dang por rnam mkhyen bstan na/ rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid dang dbye ba la sogs pa 'di lta bu zhes mi ston par sems bskyed la sogs pa'i chos bcu ston pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ lo ts+tsha ba chen po ni/ rgyu sems bskyed la sogs pa'i chos bcu po 'di nyams su blangs pa las 'bras bu rnam mkhyen 'byung ngo zhes rgyus 'bras bu mtshon pa'i tshul gyis bstan pa yin la/ rgyu yang khyad chos bzhi dang ldan te sgrub pa'i rten dmigs pa ched du bya ba/ sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo'o// rten yang khyad par bzhi dang ldan te/ bsam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ sbyor ba gdams ngag nyan pa dang*/ 'bras bu nges 'byed yan lag la gnas pa dang*/

chos dbyings kyi rigs dang ldan pa'o// zhes gsungs/ 'dre ar sogs/ de lta na skabs gnyis par lam shes bstan pa dang zlos so zhes dgag pa brjod nas/ yul gyis yul can mtshon pa'i tshul gyis bstan zhes gsungs la/ spyir lugs de gnyis ka yang 'gal ba med mod/ 'dir slob dpon gyi dgongs pa ni/ yul gyi yul can mtshon par gsal te/ 'grel chen las/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kho na sems bskyed la sogs pa'i rang bzhin rgyu dang 'bras bu'i bdag nyid kyi sgo nas 'dir yang nas yang du bzlos pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs shing*/ chos shes kyis/ skabs dang por bstan pa'i rnam mkhyen 'di la/ rgyu 'bras kyi gtso bo mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen zhes tha snyad mdzad pa'i phyir/ de ltar na/ skabs dang po gsum du yul gzhi lam rnam gsum gyis yul can mkhyen pa gsum mtshon nas bstan zhes bya ste/ de bas na mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan ni gzhi dang gnyen po dang rnam pa rnams bsdus pas/ mngon par rtogs pa ril rdzogs par bstan pa yin no zhes dang*/ 'dis mngon par mtshon pa'i gnas nyid yin pas mtshan nyid ces gsungs pa 'grig go /bcom ldan ral gri na re/ 'dir byang chub sems pa'i rgyud la yod pa'i rgyu'i rnam mkhyen de bstan pa yin te/ 'di'i rnam pa rnams ni byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par gsal bas so zhes kyang ngo*// gnyis pa mtshon byed kyi chos rgyas par bshad pa la/ spyi'i 'brel dang*/ so so'i 'brel gnyis/ dang po la bsam pa dang sbyor ba gnyis/ bsam pa ni byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa ste/ rnam mkhyen don du gnyer ba'i phyir/ rnam mkhyen gyi chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pas dang por bstan no// sbyor ba la'ang sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ gdams ngag ste/ sems bskyed kyi bslab bya'i don/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub de gdams ngag gis tshol dgos pa'i phyir/ de gnyis par bstan no// 'di gnyis ni tshogs lam gyi gnas skabs so// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la'ang*/

sbyor ba po rten gyi chos dang*/ de dang ldan pa sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i rim pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ nges 'byed yan lag rnam bzhi ste/ las dang po pas gdams pa ltar gyi don nyams su blangs pa las/ nges 'byed rnam pa bzhi 'byung ba'i phyir gsum par bstan no// gnyis pa la'ang*/ rten la ji ltar bstan pa dang*/ de la brten nas ji ltar nyams su len pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgrub pa'i rten te/ sbyor lam thob nas sgrub pa'i rten du gyur pa'i rigs dang ldan pa'i phyir bzhi par bstan no// 'di ni kun mkhyen chos rje'i bzhed pa'o// 'o na mdo sde rgyan las gsungs pa ltar/ rigs las sems bskyed 'byung dgos pas 'dir bstan pa'i rim pa mi 'thad do snyam na/ de'i lan la/ nyi khri snang ba las ni/ de na rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung ba rgyu 'bras don gyi rim pa yin la/ 'dir ni 'bras bu las rgyu rtogs par byed pas rtogs pa'i go rim yin te/ 'bras bu theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun ni/ rgyu rigs la mi 'khrul ba'i phyir te/ drod nas theg chen du rigs nges ba'i phyir/ theg dman gyi nges 'byed ni/ rigs la 'khrul te/ mdzod las/ gnyis slob rigs las log nas ni// sangs rgyas su 'gyur gzhan gsum yang*// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i don du bshad/ de'i ltar na/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sbyor ba'i sngon du snying rje dang*// mos pa dang ni bzod pa dang*// dge ba yang dag spyod pa ni// rigs kyi rtags su nges par bshad// ces gsungs pa ltar/ rigs kyi sngon du rigs kyi rtags bshad pa yin no// kho bo cag ltar na/ spyir rigs tsam la 'grel chen du/ de la dang por rigs nus pas// snying rje'i sa bon rab sad cing*// sbyor dang bsam pa phun tshogs pas// byang chub sems ni yongs su gzung*// zhes drangs pa de ltar yin kyang 'dir ni/ khyad par can bsgrub pa'i rten gyi dbang du byas pa yin pas/

sbyor lam yan chod kho na la 'jog dgos te byang chub sems dpa' rnam pa bcu gsum po kho na'i chos dbyings la rigs su bstan pa'i phyir/ snyam du sems so// 'di na sbyor lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar te/ mdor na de yan chad du rten gyi chos bshad pa yin no// gnyis pa de la brten nas ji ltar nyams su len pa la/ yul dang 'bras bu'i khyad par gang yin pa dang*/ ngo bo'i khyad par gang yin pa'o// dang po la dmigs pa dang*/ ched du bya ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dmigs pa bcu gcig ste/ de yang sgrub pa'i rten chos dbyings kho na yin pa ltar/ dmigs pa'ang chos dbyings kho na yin na ni/ dmigs pa dag pa gong nas gong du 'gror med pa'i skyon 'byung bas/ sgrub pa'i rten byang chub sems dpa'i dmigs pa gang yin snyam pa la/ rang bzhin bden stong gis khyad par du byas pa'i chos can sna tshogs la dmigs pa yin no zhes ston pa'i dbang du byas nas dmigs pa lnga par ston/ 'di ni 'phags seng gi bzhed pa dri ma med pa yin te/ nyi snang las/ de ltar byas nas rang bzhin gtso bor gyur pa ni rigs yin la/ rnam 'gyur gtso bor gyur pa ni dmigs pa yin te/ gnyis ka yang*/ gnyis kar ma bkag pas rten dang dmigs pa dag gis mtshan nyid kyi dbye ba dang*/ dmigs pa dag pa'i mthar thug par 'gro ba yang 'thad par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs shing*/ 'grel chen du'ang de nyid drangs pas so// 'o na dmigs pa chos can sna tshogs pa sgyu ma lta bur sgom pas dag pa'i mthar thug par 'gro na/ mthar thug pa'i ched du bya ba de gang yin snyam na/ 'bras bu'i khyad par ni chen po gsum ste/ rgyu sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i snga rol du 'bras bu la spro ba skyed pa'i ched du chen po gsum dus drug par bstan no// gnyis pa ngo bo'i khyad par la'ang*/ rgyu spyod pa rjes su sgrub pa dang*/ thob bya 'bras bu rjes su bsgrub pa gnyis/ dang po la/

bsam pas bsgrub pa dang*/ sbyor bas sgrub pa gnyis/ gnyis pa la'ang*/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu bsgrub pa dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu sgrub pa gnyis te/ go cha 'jug pa'i bya ba dang*// tshogs ni nges par 'byung bcas rnams// zhes pa'o// go rim ni/ rgyu 'bras kyi rim pa ste/ nyi khri snang ba las/ go bgos pa ni 'jug go /zhugs pa ni dpung gi tshogs bsog go /dpung gi tshogs bsags pa ni ma rgyal ba las rgyal ba thob pas nges par 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dper na dmag dpon rin po ches dang por go bgos/ bgos pa ltar lam du zhugs zhugs pa ltar dmag gi tshogs bsags/ bsags nas pha rol po'i dgra pham par byed pa ltar 'khor ba'i g.yul ngo bzlog par 'dod pa'i byang chub sems dpas kyang*/ thog mar sbyin sogs la 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i go cha bgos pa ltar sbyor ba theg chen la zhugs/ zhugs pa'i 'og du tshogs gnyis kyi dpung bsags te/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs las nges par 'byung ba'i phyir ro// de ci'i phyir chos bcu po 'dis lam gyi rim pa lhag chad med pa gcig kho na bstan pa'i tshul 'di ni ci tsam nas bshad kyi/ nang tshan gyi dbang du byas na lam gyi cha tshang la ma nor ba bcur 'gyur te/ dang po dang tha ma'i las bstan pa'i rim pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de ltar na bcu po 'dis mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'dir bstan pa'i nyams len gyi rim pa mtha' dag bsdus pa yin te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo'i don ma lus pa mngon par rtogs pa brgyad kyi bdag nyid/ byang chub kyi sems dang*/ zhes dang*/ 'grel chen du/ stong phrag brgya pa la sogs pa'i mdo'i don/ byang chub kyi sems dang gdams ngag la sogs pa'i sgrub pa'i rang bzhin skabs brgyad kyi dbye bas phye ba thams cad zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ skabs gnyis pa man chad du'ang*/ chos bcu po 'di lam gyi gzhung shing du khyer dgos te/

chos bshes kyis/ mkhyen gsum gyis 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa'i sgrub byed du/ sems bskyed sogs chos bcu po 'dis mngon par rtogs pa mtha' dag bsdus pa'i rgyu mtshan rgyas par gsungs pa bzhin no// gnyis pa so so'i 'brel la/ bsam pa sems bskyed pa dang*/ sbyor ba sgrub pa la 'jug tshul gnyis/ dang po la/ sems bskyed chos bcu'i dang por 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/ 'di'i bshad bya'i mdo de gang*/ de'i bstan bcos su ji ltar bkral/ zhe na/ dri ba dang po'i lan la/ dpal ldan zla ba'i zhal snga nas stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi sems bskyed pa ni rgyal ba'i lo thog bskyed pa la thog mtha' bar gsum du gal che ba yin pa'i phyir/ dang por zhes bzhed de/ 'jug par/ snying rje'i sems dang gnyis su med blo dang*// byang chub sems ni rgyal sras rnams kyi rgyu// gang phyir brtse nyid rgyal ba'i lo thog phun tshogs 'di'i// sa bon dang ni spel la chu 'dra yun ring du// longs spyod gnas la smin pa lta bur 'dod 'gyur ba// de phyir bdag gis thog mar snying rje bstod par bgyi// zhes 'byung ba ltar ro// shān+ti pa ltar na/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sa bon yin pa'i phyir dang por 'chad/ ces bzhed/ btsun pa grol sde sher phyin la spyod pa la sems bskyed sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes bzhed/ slob dpon ltar na/ bskal pa grangs med nges 'byung zhing*// mos pa rnam par 'phel byed pa// ji ltar chu'i rgya mtsho bzhin// zhes 'byung ba ltar/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i byang chub sems dpas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la dmigs pa sngon du 'gro bas sher phyin sgom pa'i phyir dang por bstan zhes bzhed/ rje btsun nyid kyis/ chos la mos pa sa bon dang*// pha rol phyin mchog ma las skyes// zhes gsungs so// dri ba gnyis pa'i lan ni/ rgyal ba'i yum rnam pa gsum car las bya ste/

brgyad stong pa las/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis pha rol tu phyin pa las brtsams te spobs par byos shig ces sogs mgo smos pa tsam gsungs kyi/ dbye ba rgyas par ma gsungs te/ 'grel chen las/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i dbye ba rnam pa thams cad du ston pa'i gzhung ni/ stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa las yin te/ 'dir gzhung mang gi dogs nas shes byed du ma bris so zhes gsungs/ rgyas 'bring gnyis las ni/ mtshan nyid mdor bstan pa dang*/ dbye ba rgyas par bshad pa gnyis gnyis kyi sgo nas ston te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la bka' stsal pa/ shā ri'i bu/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas sher phyin la bslab par bya'o// zhes pas/ byang chub mdor bstan/ shā ri'i bu/ byang sems chen pos gnas pa med pa'i tshul gyis yum la gnas te/ sbyin pa dang gtong ba dang*/ len pa mi dmigs pa'i phyir gtong ba med pa'i tshul gyis sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rdzogs par bya'o// zhes sogs kyi byang chub rgyas par bshad/ sems can thams cad tshul khrims dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ zhes pa nas phung po lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings la 'god par 'dod pas yum la bslab par bya'o zhes pas gzhan don mdor bstan/ ser sna can la sogs pa rnams sbyin pa la sogs pa la 'god par 'dod ces pas/ gzhan don rgyas par bshad/ ces nyi khri snang bar gsungs so// de'i don bstan bcos su ji ltar bkral ba ni/ sems bskyed pa ni/ zhes sogs kyis mdor bstan/ de yang*/ zhes sogs kyis rgyas par bshad/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis kyis mdo ji lta ba bzhin bshad do zhes ngo sprod pa ni/ de dang de ni/ zhes sogs so// zhes pa rnam bshad kyi dgongs pa'o// de yang mdor bstan gyi mdo de dag dbye ba nyer gnyis po la ma gtogs pa'i gong gi mdor bstan gyi mdo ni min te/

'phags pas/ mdo dang po de sa lta bu'i sems bskyed dang sbyar zhing*/ byang chub rgyas bshad dang*/ gzhan don bstan bshad kyi mdo rnams kyang dbye ba lhag ma rnams dang sbyar ba'i phyir ro// des na mdo'i rim pa gcig la bstan bcos su mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis kyi sgo nas bshad pa yin la/ mdo nyid las ni/ 'dun ldan sems bskyed mdor bstan/ lhag ma nyer gcig rgyas bshad du 'gyur ro// des na/ grol sde gnyis/ slob dpon/ bud+dha shrī rnams ltar na/ mtshan nyid yul gyi sgo nas bzhag pa dang*/ dmigs yul mdo la khungs phyung ba dang*/ mdo las ji ltar bshad pa'i dbye ba bstan pa dang*/ dbye ba de nyid lam lnga dang sbyar ba'i sa mtshams bzhi po rim par ston pa ni/ rtsa ba'i rim pa gsum dang*/ de la dang po gsum ni zhes so// yang na/ rtsa ba'i rim pa gsum gyis dgos don/ bsdus don/ tshig don gsum 'chad ces sbyar na'ang 'gal ba med par sems so// dang po la/ mtshams sbyar rtsa ba 'grel pa gsum/ dang po ni g.yag ṭīka ltar na/ rnam mkhyen de yang sems bskyed la sogs pa'i dbye bas rnam pa bcu yin pa las dang por/ sems bskyed pa rang gi ngo bo dmigs pa dang bcas pa 'chad de/ 'grel chen ltar na/ byang chub kyi sems de nyid ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi snying po yin no zhes sdong po bkod pa sogs las gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba la/ sems bskyed pa ni/ zhes pas mtshon bya de bstan/ lhag mas mtshan nyid de bstan/ ji ltar bstan na/ 'phags seng a bh+ya rnams ni/ ngo bo ni gtso bo rnam rig yin par bzhed de/ nyi snang las/ sems ni rnam par rig pa ste/ rnam par shes pa'o// rnam par shes pa de yang gang zhe na/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa ste/ dkar po'i chos thams cad la dmigs pa yang de la srid pa'i phyir ro// zhes bshad/ gnad kyi zla 'od las/ 'dir sems dang*/ yid dang*/ 'dod pa dang*/ 'dun pa dang*/ mos pa dang*/

don du gnyer ba rnams rnam grangs su 'dod do// zhes bshad/ shān+ti pa dang*/ mar me mdzad/ ngo bo 'dod pa nyid yin no zhes bzhed/ dol po ba na re/ 'phags seng gi bzhed pa 'di/ mdo dang bstan bcos gnyis ka dang mi mthun no zhes zer ro// 'grel pa la dngos dang rtsod pa spangs pa gnyis/ dang po la/ 'dir smon 'jug gnyis su mdzad pa ni/ zhi ba lha'i rjes su 'brangs pa yin gyi/ rje btsun gyi gzhung na med do// gnyis po'i khyad par la/ chos kyi bshes gnyen/ smon pa ni smon pa tsam ste/ sems bskyed pa'i cho ga tsam yang blangs par ma byas pa'o// zhes bzhed/ sher blo/ lus ngag dang yid kyi las yod pa dang med pa las mtshan nyid tha dad par rtogs par bya'i/ dmigs pa tha dad pa ni min te zhes bshad/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ smon pa byang chub kyi sems ni 'jig rten pa thams cad kyi yin la/ 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems ni sa rab tu dga' ba nas brtsams te/ zhes bzhed/ bud+dha shrī/ bsam pas smon pa dang sbyor bas 'jug pa zhes bzhed de don gcig go /gnyis pa rtsod pa spong ba la/ gang la rtsod na/ 'dod ces pa la rtsod/ ji ltar na/ 'dod ces pas/ 'dod pa kho na sems bskyed du bstan snyam du bsams nas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa nyid dam kho na chos can/ sems bskyed min par thal/ sems byung yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ rje btsun nyid kyis/ don gnyis ldan pa'i sems byung ba// zhes sems dpa' dang mtshungs ldan du byung ba'i gtso bo rnam rig la sems bskyed du bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i dbang du byas nas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa nyid de/ zhes sogs so// don ni/ 'dun pa ni ma 'ongs pa la dmigs pa yin la/ sems bskyed ni/ don gnyis kyi ngo bo da ltar snang ba can yin pa'i phyir/ 'dzin stangs 'gal snyam du bsam pa'o// de skad du yang*/ nyi snang las/ sems ni yul so sor rig pa'i ming can yin la/

don du gnyer ba zhes bya ba ni sred pa yin pas so// zhe na/ zhes gsungs so// phyogs snga'i 'dod pa 'di ni/ blo brtan gyi dbus mtha'i 'grel bshad du/ rnam par shes pa dang khyad par med par thal bar 'gyur bas/ rnam pa mtshungs pa min no zhes 'byung ba de nyid do// lan la bstan bshad gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bden mod kyi/ zhes pa ste/ 'dod pa ni sems bskyed du bstan na skyon de 'jug ces khas blangs pa'o// 'o na ci zhig bstan zhe na/ bshad pa la gnyis te/ gzhan don phyir/ 'dod ces pas rgyu ming 'bras bu la btags pa yin la/ yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod// ces grogs ming grogs can la btags pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ 'on kyang zhes sogs dang*/ rnam pa gcig tu zhes sogs so// 'dir bdag gi blo la 'di ltar shar te/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ don gnyis ldan pa'i sems 'byung ba// zhes ston nas sems bskyed kyi ngo bo sems byung du 'dod pa ni/ rje btsun gyi bzhed pa min te/ rgyan las/ 'byung ba zhes smos pa'i phyir/ 'o na ci zhe na/ 'phags pa grol sde/ sems ni rnam par rig pa'o// zhes bzhed pa ltar yin no// 'o na gzhung 'di dang*/ mdo sde rgyan 'gal bar 'gyur te/ 'dir 'dod pa nyid du bshad pas so snyam na mi 'gal te/ 'dir rgyu 'dod pa'i ming gis 'bras bu sems bskyed bstan pa yin la/ mdo sde rgyan las/ 'bras bu sems bskyed de nyid kyis dngos ming gi bstan pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ rtsod lan snga ma gnyis so// 'o na thogs med kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi smon lam gyi mchog ni sems bskyed pa'o zhes bshad pas/ de la brgal bar spobs sam zhe na/ de'i dgongs pa 'chad pa ni/ rnam pa gcig tu zhes sogs so// de ltar byas na 'dir zhes pa'i tshig gi nus pa thon par 'gyur zhing smon lam zhes pa'i tshig la 'brel yod par grub bo// gnyis pa dmigs yul mtshams sbyor ni/

sems bskyed kyi ngo bo 'dod par bstan pa la dogs pa'i gnas yod par ma zad/ dmigs yul gzhan don dang rdzogs byang la'ang dogs pa'i gnas yod pas de bshad dgos pas so zhe na/ rtsa bas ston no// rnam bshad kyi dgongs pa'o// bdag gi blo la 'di ltar snang ste/ lus rnam gzhag tu/ sems bskyed pa dang zhes bshad pa de gang zhe na/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir// zhes bstan nas/ da dung dogs pa ma chod do// gzhan don dang byang chub de gang zhe na/ de dang de ni zhes so// brjod ces pa la 'phros nas ji ltar brjod na/ brjod ces bstan pa/ de yang sa gser zla ba me// zhes sbrel lo// mtshams sbyar gyi don de ltar yin pa yang*/ nyi snang las/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub dang*/ gzhan gyi don de yang gang yin zhe na/ de dang de ni zhes gsungs so// bu ṭīka las/ mtshams sbyar du dri ba gsum mdzad nas/ dri ba dang po ngo bo'i dri ba la lan 'debs pa ni/ de ltar sems bskyed pa ni/ zhes sogs yin par gsungs/ de'i dgongs pa ni/ gzhung du/ gang 'dod pa'i bdag nyid dang zhes 'byung ba la dgongs par snang zhing*/ 'grel chen du/ gong 'og gnyis sh+lau ka gcig tu sbrel nas mtshams sbyar thun mong du yod pas dang zhes gsungs dgos pa yin gyi/ 'dir de mi dgos kyang*/ 'grel chen rgyas bkab nas bris par gsal lo// rtsa ba la 'grel chen ltar na/ brjod do// gang las na/ brgyad stong pa las so// ji ltar na/ stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa'i mdo bzhin no// ji skad du/ byang chub de dang gzhan gyi don ni gang yin zhe na/ 'phags pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa'i mdo ji lta ba bzhin du/ brjod par bya'o zhes so// 'grel pa 'di ltar na/ chos shes kyis bshad pa ltar/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir// zhes bstan pa de rje btsun nyid kyis rang stobs kyis yin nam zhe na min te/ rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gsum gyi mdo ji lta ba bzhin du brjod do// 'grel par/

kyang zhes smos pa ni gsum po phan tshun bsdus pa'o// rigs kyis byin pa slob dpon gyi dgongs pa 'chad pa na/ brjod do// gang la na/ yum las kyang ngo*// ji ltar na/ dkon mchog sna bdun gyi mdo bzhin du'o// zhes gsungs/ rigs ral/ mdo de 'dra med zer/ bu ṭīka blo gros mi bzad pa'i mdo dang*/ sdong po bkod pa las zhes zer/ ar dang g.yag ṭīka bang mdzod sogs kyang de ltar bzhed do// rnam bshad las ni/ 'di mi 'thad pa la 'grel chen dang 'gal ba'i phyir/ zhes gsungs so// 'on kyang nyi khri rnam 'grel du'ang*/ lugs snga ma yod pas dpyad par bya dgos so// mi 'gal bar zhes pa/ yum gyi mdo dang*/ bstan bcos su brjod pa mthun no// zhes pa'i don yin gyi/ dar ṭīka pa ltar/ yum bar ma dang mi 'gal bar rgyas bsdus gnyis su brjod ces pa 'grel pa 'di'i dgongs pa ni mi rung ngo*// des na/ yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod// ces pa/ rang bzo min par grub bo zhes ston pa ni de ltar na/ zhes sogs so// 'o na gtsug lag gi gzhung skabs kyi/ zhes sogs kyi gzhung 'di gang la 'phros pa yin zhe na/ g.yag ṭīka bang mdzod las/ yum gsum car las sems bskyed kyi dmigs yul sdong po bkod pa sogs kyi mdo bzhin du brjod na/ mdo de dag 'dir mi 'dren pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ de'i lan du bzhed/ ral gri/ mdo bstan bcos du ma zhig dang 'di sbyar bar nus mod/ ces pa'i don du 'chad/ chos shes ni/ thams cad la yang gsung mod kyi/ zhes ston nas/ sems bskyed nas 'phrin las kyi bar thams cad la'ang yum gsum ka dang sbyor du yod mod kyi zhes 'chad/ rnam bshad/ sems bskyed/ yum gsum ka dang sbyar ba ltar ba ltar/ gdams ngag sogs lhag ma rnams kyang sbyar dgos pa las mi sbyor ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/ gsum car las ma gsungs pa yin nam ce na/ de'i lan/ thams cad las kyang gsung mod kyi 'dir khungs su ma bris te/

tshig mang du dogs pa'i phyir/ zhes ston te/ go bar sla phyir tshig dang ni// zhes sogs dang don gcig go /dar ṭīka pa/ yum gsum car gyi lung khungs smos nas lung rgyas par mi 'dren pa'i rgyu mtshan la sbyor zhing*/ gong du yang mdo'i tshig sna bsdus pa min par bzhed/ bdag gi blo la 'di ltar shar te/ rje btsun byams pa'i bstan pa ni/ bstan pa 'di ma nub kyi bar mi 'byung bas/ bstan pa 'di la rje btsun gyi gsungs pa'i gsung rabs rnams ni/ shākya thub pa'i bstan pa 'di'i dbang du byas pa yin no// zhes shes par bya ba'i phyir/ sems bskyed la rje btsun nyid kyi mdo'i khungs brjod pa bzhin du/ gdams ngag sogs la'ang rje btsun nyid kyis mdo'i khungs smos dgos so zhe na/ rtsa bar ma bris pa'i shes byed du ston no// de dag gang ltar yang*/ de dang de ni mdo bzhin du// bsdus dang rgyas pa'i sgo nas brjod// ces pa'i gzhung ni don bdun bcu po thams cad la rung mthun du sbyar bas don bdun bcu po mdo dngos bstan yin par bsnyon mi nus par bsgrubs so// gsum pa mdo las dbye ba ji ltar bstan pa la mtshams sbyar ba ni/ da ni zhes sogs te/ lus rnam gzhag gi dkyus ma'i don min pas/ bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa zhes gsungs te/ dbye ba zhar la brjod nas zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// rtsa ba la rnam bshad ltar na/ mtshan nyid de dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed de/ de yang zhes pa'i don du gsungs/ blo la shar ba ni/ bsdus dang rgyas pa'i sgo nas brjod// ces dam bcas nas/ da rgyas bsdus gnyis kyi brjod dgos so zhe na/ brjod ces bstan pa de yang rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis so// zhes sbyar na mdo dang 'grig ste/ de yang byang chub mdor bstan gyi mdo de ni/ sa lta bu'i sems bskyed kyi mdo yin la/ gzhan don mdor bstan gyi mdo de ni/ bang mdzod lta bu'i sems bskyed kyi mdo yin pas so// 'dir sems bskyed nyer gnyis su bstan pa de gdul bya nye ba'am grangs nges pa gang yin zhe na/

slob dpon ni/ 'dis tshogs lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar gyi lam thams cad bsdus pa'i phyir/ zhes grangs nges par bzhed/ 'grel chen las/ ji skad bshad pa'i go rim dang*/ rab tu dbye ba 'di nyid yin gyi/ lhag par yang ma yin ma tshang ba yang ma yin/ go rim bzhin du bstan bya ba yang ma yin no// zhes gsungs/ mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel pa dang*/ dag ldan/ thub pa dgongs rgyan rnams su/ blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo las gsungs pa'i mi zad pa brgyad cu dang*/ nyer gnyis po sbyar nas bshad la/ thub dgongs su/ brgyad cu po 'dis theg chen gyi 'bras bu dang bcas pa bsdus pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs/ brgyad cu ni dag ldan las/ sems bskyed bsam sbyor lhag bsam dang*// pha rol phyin drug tshad med dang*// mngon par shes dang bsdu dngos bzhi// so sor rig ston tshogs gnyis dang*// byang chub phyogs mthun zhi gnas sogs// gzungs spobs chos kyi mdo bshad dang*// bgrod cig lam dang thabs mkhas so// zhes gsungs shing*/ phyin drug re re bgrangs nas sbyar// gzhan ni 'dir 'byung ba ltar ro// 'di dag smon 'jug gang gi dbang du byas pa yin zhe na/ sher blo ni/ smon pa sems bskyed ni smon pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ dbye ba med la/ nyer gnyis po 'jug pa'i dbye ba yin no zhes gsung*/ a bh+ya dang*/ slob dpon skal ldan ni/ 'dun sogs gsum gyi dbye ba las// smon pa'i sems ni rnam pa gsum// 'jug pa zhes bya'i sems rnams ni// bcu dgu rnams su 'dod pa yin// zhes gsungs/ chos kyi bshes gnyen ni/ 'dun sogs gsum ni sems bskyed dngos yin la/ sbyor ba dang*/ sbyin pa sogs sems bskyed 'phel ba'i grogs der brtags shing*/ bgrod pa gcig pa sogs ni sems bskyed kyi 'bras bu yin pas der btags pa yin no// zhes zer/ bzhi pa sa mtshams 'chad pa'i dbang du byas nas/ las dang po'i sa nas bzung ste/
