zhes sogs so// 'o na mdo las/ nyer gnyis pa byang sems kyi sems bskyed du bshad pa dang*/ rgyan las/ rgyal sras rnams kyis sems bskyed pa// zhes bshad pa dang*/ 'dir sangs rgyas sa'i bar gyis bsdus par bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ 'grel chen las/ sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed khungs su mdzad nas/ rgyu'i dbye ba tsam gyis de'i dbye ba rnam pa thams cad du byas par mi 'gyur bas dbye ba yongs su rdzogs par mi 'gyur ro zhes mdo'i don rigs pas 'grel bar mdzad pa yin la/ mdo dang mthun par byed na/ 'di'i sangs rgyas sa bcu pa la 'chad ces gsungs pa ni/ rnam bshad kyi rang lugs min te/ de ltar na/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos dang*/ so sor dbye ba mi 'thad pa'i phyir ro// 'phags pa grol sde sems bskyed la sa mtshams mi bzhed/ ces jo bos gsungs la/ 'grel chen du 'phags pa'i dgongs pa 'chad pa na/ sems bskyed tha ma brgyad po kho na/ byang chub sems dpa' las khyad par gyi lam gyis bsdus par bshad/ nyi snang las ni/ sems bskyed ces pa ni/ ma skyed par byed pa'i phyir dang po'i mtshams kyi dngos po bstan pa'i don du/ zhes gsungs so// rat+na kirti sa mtshams slob dpon dang mthun no// gnyis pa sbyor ba bsgrub pa la 'jug tshul la/ bsgrub pa'i thabs ston pa gdams ngag thob bya bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu/ 'jug bya bsgrub pa'i yan lag gi chos so// dang po spyir bstan pa dang*/ rtogs dka' ba bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ snga phyi'i 'brel btsal ba dang*/ 'brel pa can gdams ngag gi go rim ji ltar yin pa'o// dang po ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ mgo la sems can khur chen khyer ba yi// sems dpa' mchog de dal gyis 'gro mi mdzad// bdag gzhan sna tshogs 'ching bas rab bcings pas// brtson pa brgyad 'gyur du ni bya ba'i rigs// zhes 'byung ba ltar/ sems bskyed kyi dam bcas pa'i don de nyid sbyor bas bsgrub dgos pa'i phyir/

sems bskyed kyi 'og tu gdams ngag 'chad ces ston pa ni/ dbye ba zhar la brjod nas zhes sogs so// 'di yang dgos pa'i sgo nas mtshams sbyar ba yin pas/ gdams ngag nyan pa'i dgos pa ni gnyis ston te/ sngar yod kyi yon tan mi nyams pa gdams pa'i dgos pa dang*/ sngar med kyi yon tan thob pa rjes su bstan pa'i dgos pa'o// dang po ni/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i yon tan thob pa yongs su bsrung ba'i don gyis mngon par 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir zhes pas bstan no// gnyis pa ni/ des 'phangs pa'i chos 'grub par bya ba'i phyir zhes pas ston/ de skad du yang nyi snang las/ thob zin pa'i yon tan yongs su skyong ba'i don gyis mi nyams par byed pa ni gdams ngag yin la/ de'i 'og tu yon tan ma thob pa thob par byed pa'i phyir ni rjes su bstan pa yin no// zhes dang*/ 'grel chen las/ dang por thob pa'i yon tan mi nyams pa bya ba'i phyir bslab par bgyi zhing*/ phyis ma thob pa'i yon tan thob par bya ba'i phyir rjes su bstan par bgyi ste/ zhes 'byung ba ltar ro// 'o na sems bskyed des 'phangs pa'i chos de gang la bya zhe na/ chos shes rdzogs pa'i byang chub la bzhed/ gser gling pa chos dkar po thams cad kyi gzhi'i dngos po sogs la bzhed/ bdag gi blo la shar ba ni/ tshogs lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar gyi yon tan mtha' dag ste/ mi zad pa brgyad cu'o// yang na des 'phangs pa sher phyin te/ des 'phangs pa'i chos kyi ngo bo nyid kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes pa ltar ro// sems bskyed dang gdams ngag gi go rim 'di yang*/ theg chen gyi gdams ngag thos pa ltar nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas kyi/ theg chen gyi gdams ngag nyan pa tsam la ni/ theg chen sems bskyed sngon du 'gro mi dgos te/ dam chos pad+ma dkar po las/ mgon po bdag cag de ring nyan thos gyur// byang chub dam pa yang dag sgrag par bgyi// byang chub pa yi sgra yang rab tu brjod// de bas bdag cag nyan thos mi zad 'dra// zhes 'byung ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la bshad bya'i mdo dgod/

de'i don bstan bcos su ji ltar bkral ba'o// dang po la/ mdo snga phyi'i 'brel dang*/ 'brel pa can gyi mdo la rgya gar mkhas pa'i 'bru bzhag pa'o// dang po ni/ sems bskyed kyi skabs su/ gang dang gang 'dod pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab par bya'o// zhes gsung pa la 'phros nas/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ji ltar bslab par bgyi/ zhes dris pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ shā ri'i bu/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yod bzhin du/ byang sems chen po yang dag par rjes su mi mthong*/ byang sems ming dang*/ byang chub dang byang chub kyi ming dang*/ yum dang yum gyi ming yang dag par rjes su mi mthong*/ spyod ces bya bar mi spyod ces bya bar spyod kyang spyod la mi spyod kyang mi spyod ces bya bar spyod par yang ma yin/ mi spyod pa'ang min par yang dag par rjes su mi mthong*/ de bzhin du gzugs yang dag par rjes su ma mthong*/ tshor ba dang*/ 'du shes zhes pa nas/ shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' chen po yum la spyod pa'i tshe 'di ltar yongs su brtag par bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba 'di ni ming tsam mo zhes sogs gsung*/ de de la yod bzhin du/ zhes dang*/ ming tsam mo zhes pas/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa las mi 'da' bar bstan/ yang dag par rjes su ma mthong zhes sogs kyis don dam pa'i bden pa las mi 'da' bar bstan/ mdor na/ spyod pa po dang*/ spyad 'bras dang*/ spyad bya dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ mi spyod pa dang*/ gnyis ka dang*/ gnyis min dang*/ yul gzugs sogs la mi rtog par spyad par bya'o// zhes pa'i don no// mkhas pa chen po rat+na a kar shān+ti pa ni/ rnam g.yeng gi rnam rtog bcu'i gnyen por mdo 'di gsungs te/

bcu ni/ dag ldan las/ dngos po med dang dngos po dang*// sgro 'dogs pa dang skur 'debs dang*// gcig pa nyid dang tha dad dang*// ngo bo nyid dang khyad par dang*// ming ni ji bzhin don la ni// don la ji bzhin ming la zhen// rnam par g.yeng ba'i rnam rtog gang*// de ni rnam pa bcur bzhed do// zhes gsungs/ de la dngos po med pa'i rnam par rtog pa ni/ byang sems kun rdzob tu'ang med par 'dzin pa ste/ yod bzhin du zhes pas gnyen po ston no// dngos po'i rnam par rtog pa ni/ byang sems bden par 'dzin pa ste/ yang dag par rjes su ma mthong zhes sogs kyis de'i gnyen po ston no// sgro 'dogs pa dang skur pa 'debs pa'i rnam par rtog pa ni/ gzugs sogs kyi stong pa nyid chos nyid yin na/ chos nyid bden par yod pa bzhin du/ gzugs sogs kyang bden par 'dzin pa dang*/ gzugs sogs bden par med na/ stong pa nyid kyang bden par 'dzin pa ste/ de'i gnyen por gzugs yang dag par rjes su ma mthong zhes sogs dang*/ gzugs kyi stong pa nyid kyis stong pa ma yin zhes sogs dang*/ gcig pa nyid dang tha dad du 'dzin pa ni/ gzugs sogs dang*/ de'i stong nyid rang bzhin gcig yin na/ tha dad gtan med kyi gcig yin nam snyam pa dang*/ gzugs sogs dang*/ de'i chos nyid gcig pa bkag pa'i tha dad yin na/ de'i tshe tha dad du bden no snyam du 'dzin pa ste/ de'i gnyen por gzugs kyi stong pa nyid gang yin pa de ni gzugs ma yin zhes sogs dang*/ gzugs ni stong pa nyid las gzhan min zhes sogs so// gzugs sogs kyi ngo bo bden par 'dzin pa dang*/ gzugs sogs skye 'gag sogs su bden par 'dzin pa'i blo ni ngo bo nyid dang khyad par du 'dzin pa ste/ de gnyis kyi gnyen por/ rab 'byor gzugs zhes bya ba ni ming tsam mo zhes sogs dang*/ ngo bo nyid ni skye ba med pa 'gag pa med la/ gnas pa med pa zhes sogs so// ming ji lta ba bzhin don la zhen pa ni/

bden pa bzhi po mi rtag sogs su bden par zhen pa'i blo dang*/ don ji lta ba bzhin ming la zhen pa ni/ don thams cad ji lta ba bzhin ming la yod de/ ming yin pa'i phyir sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i tshig bzhin zhes rnam par rtog pa ste de'i gnyen por/ ming ni chos so so la bcos ma yin zhing*/ de dag kyang btags pa ba yin te/ ming glo bur ba tha snyad du byed pa yin no zhes sogs dang*/ ming de dag thams cad byang chub sems dpa' chen pos yang dag par rjes su ma mthong zhes sogs kyis ston zhes bshad do// de dag ni shes rab kyi khyad par ro// thabs kyi khyad par nyan thos dang thun mong min pa ni/ shā ri'i bu phyogs bcu re re zhing gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'di/ dge slong shā ri'i bu dang*/ mo'u 'gal gyi bu sha stag gis 'di lta ste dper na/ 'dam bu'i tshal lam/ 'od ma'i tshal lam/ bu ram shing gi tshal lam/ smyug ma'i tshal lam/ 'bras kyi tshal lam/ til gyi tshal ltar yongs su gang bar gyur kyang*/ de dag gi shes rab gang yin pa des byang sems chen po'i yum la spyod pa'i shes rab nyin gcig sgom pa tsam gyis brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro/ stong dang*/ brgya stong dang*/ bye ba brgya stong dang*/ grangs su yang*/ char yang*/ bgrang bar yang*/ rgyur yang*/ dper yang*/ nye bar mi 'gro'i// shā ri'i bu de la yum la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i shes rab nyin gcig bsgom pa gang yin pa des ni/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi shes rab zil gyis gnon par byed do// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i shes rab ni sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i slad du nye bar gnas pa yin no// nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi shes rab ni de lta min no// zhes gsungs/ de'i don nyi khri snang ba las 'di ltar bshad de/

'dam bu la sogs pa'i dpe drug gis rtogs pa'i chos drug bstan pa las/ de yang*/ 'dam bus nyan thos kyi drod bstan te/ 'dam bu ltar las dang nyon mongs pa'i gnod pa chung ngu mi bzod pa'i phyir/ 'od mas rtse mo bstan te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bcad mi nus pa'i phyir/ bu ram shing gis bzod pa bstan te/ bde 'gro rgyun ma chad par sgom pa'i mngar ba las ma 'das pa'i phyir/ smyug mas chos mchog bstan te/ smyug mas pags pa myur du 'bigs pa ltar/ 'dir myur du bden pa mngon par rtogs par byed pa'i phyir/ 'bras kyis mthong lam bstan te/ 'bras 'bru rnams kyi dang po yin pa ltar/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rtogs pa dang po yin pa'i phyir/ til gyis sgom lam bstan te/ til me tog la sogs pa'i dngos po tha mi dad kyang*/ nus pa'i khyad par mi 'dra ba bzhin du/ sgom lam dgu po yang bdag med mthong zin sgom pa tsam du 'dra yang sgom pa las spangs pa'i khyad par mi 'dra ba thob pa'i phyir/ tshal zhes smos pa ni rigs gcig par ston pa yin la/ lam lam zhes pa snga ma rnams ni dpe phyi ma phyi ma drangs pa'i phyir yin la/ lam tha ma smos pa ni/ 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams kyis mthong chos la bde bar gnas pa'i dpe gzhan drangs bar bya ba'i ched yin no// 'o na dpe gzhan de ci'i phyir ma brjod ce na/ mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas pa rnams ni rang bzhin sna tshogs pa nyid kyis rigs bsdus pa'i ngo bo shes par bya ba'i don yin te/ so sor dper brjod par brtag na ni dpe ji snyed cig brjod par bya zhing*/ nye bar bshad pa la mi mkhas pa nyid du 'gyur ro// sha stag ni/ ji skad bshad pa'i rtogs pa mthun mthun rnams so// brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro sogs kyis/ grangs kyi mthu'i/ rigs kyi rgyu'i/ dpe las 'das pa'i khyad par rnams rim par bstan no// 'o na shes rab nyin gcig bsgom pa'i byang sems de gang yin zhe na/

skye ba gcig gis thogs pa min te/ sa bcu pa la de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du brjod pa'i phyir/ phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems yang min te/ sa brgyad pa la dgongs pa can gyi mya ngan las 'das pa bkag pas/ nyan thos las khyad par 'phags par grub pa'i phyir/ spyod pa la zhugs pa'i byang sems min te/ sa dang por nyan rang gi spangs rtogs mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i phyir/ des na kun rdzob kyi sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang sems/ sems bskyed kyi skabs su bstan pa de yin par mngon te/ de so skye yin pas de las nyan rang gi shes rab khyad par 'phags sam snyam pa'i dogs pa dgag dgos pa'i phyir/ 'o na 'dir dgongs pa can gyi myang 'das de gang la bya zhe na/ theg pa che chung gnyis ka'i myang 'das min gyi/ re zhig gzhan don rgyun chad pa nye bar bzung nas dgongs pa can gyi myang 'das la bshad de/ sher phyin 'dir yang*/ dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po'i mdo tshad mar byas nas/ shā ri'i bu la sogs pa'i byang sems chen po rnams la mya ngan las 'das pa rnam par bzhag pa bzhin no// theg pa che chung gang gi'ang myang 'das min na/ myang 'das yin par 'gal lo zhe na/ bstan pa 'di la mya ngan las 'das pa mang por bzhag ste/ 'di ltar rtse mo thob pa rnams kyis ni dge rtsa chad pa mya ngan las 'das pa yin no// bzod pa thob pa rnams kyis ngan 'gro mya ngan las 'das pa yin no// rgyun du zhugs pa rnams kyis srid pa brgyad pa mya ngan las 'das pa yin no// 'o na 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad ni 'dus ma byas kyi rab tu phye ba'i phyir/ shes rab tha mi dad pa min nam snyam pas shes rab de khyad par med par zhus pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das rgyun du zhugs pa dang*/ lan gcig phyir 'ong ba dang phyir mi 'ong ba dang*/ dgra bcom pa dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi shes rab gang lags pa de thams cad ni/

dbye ba med pa dben pa/ ngo bo nyid med pa/ ma skyes pa/ stong pa lags kyi/ bcom ldan 'das/ dben pa/ ma skyes pa/ stong pa nyid la tha dad du byas pa ma mchis na/ ji ltar byang sems chen po yum la spyod pa'i shes rab nyin gcig bsgom pas/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shes rab zil gyis gnon pa lags zhes so// de'i lan ni/ byang chub sems dpa' ni bsam pa sems bskyed pa dang*/ sbyor ba pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang*/ ched du bya ba chos sku'i don du nye bar gnas pas dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang*/ rgyal rigs shing sa la chen po lta bu'i rigs la sogs pa dang*/ lha'i mtho ris thams cad dang*/ rgyun du zhugs pa las sogs pa dang*/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi shes rab kyang byang chub sems dpa' med na mi 'byung bar ston pa ni/ shā ri'i bu de ji snyam du sems/ byang sems chen po yum la spyod pa'i shes rab nyin gcig sgom pa rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la slob pa dang*/ bdag gi sems can thams cad kyi don byed pa dang*/ sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las 'da'o zhes 'bras bu gang gi don du nye bar gnas pa de'i don du/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shes rab nye bar gnas pa de'i don du nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi shes rab nye bar gnas sam/ shā ri'i bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de lta min no zhes gsungs so// 'di dag ni nyi khri snang ba dang*/ rnam 'grel las 'byung ba kho na ltar bris pa yin no// de nas shā ri'i bus bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ byang chub sems dpa' chen pos ji ltar brtson na yum la brtson zhes bgyi/ dris pa'i lan du/ gzugs stong pa nyid la brtson na brtson zhes brjod par zhes sogs kyi sdug bden la 'doms pa dang*/ gzugs skye ba dang 'gag pa dang*/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dang*/

rnam par byang ba'i chos can du yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo zhes sogs/ kun 'byung la 'doms pa dang*/ shā ri'i bu stong pa nyid ni mi skye mi 'gag kun nas nyon mongs pa ma yin/ rnam par byang ba ma yin/ 'grib pa ma yin/ zhes pa nas/ de ltar brtson na brtson zhes bya ba'i bar gyis 'gog bden la 'doms/ shā ri'i bu gzhan yang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la brtson zhes bya ba'am/ mi brtson zhes bya bar yang dag par rjes su ma mthong*/ zhes sogs lam bden la 'doms pa dang*/ shā ri'i bu gzhan yang byang sems chen po yum la spyod pa'i tshe gzugs la rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis sbyor bar mi byed de/ 'di la gzugs nyid yang dag par rjes su ma mthong ngo*// zhes sogs sangs rgyas la 'doms pa dang*/ gzugs dngos po yod ces bya bar mi sbyor/ dngos po med ces bya bar mi sbyor zhes chos la 'doms pa dang*/ de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang*/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yum la gnas pa 'dis gnas pa de gang nas shi 'phos nas 'dir skyes pa lags/ 'di nas shi 'phos nas gang du skye bar 'gyur zhes sogs kyis dge 'dun dkon mchog la 'doms pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das byang sems chen po'i lus dang yid kyi las kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa gang lags zhes pa la 'phros nas brtson 'grus gsum la 'doms pa dang*/ shā ri'i bu byang sems chen po'i sha'i mig gis dpag tshad brgya mthong ba yod do// zhes sogs kyis spyan lnga la 'doms pa dang*/ shā ri'i bu yum 'di la spyod pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po mngon par shes pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa thob ste/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam pa du ma rnams nyams su myong bar byed do// de ni sa chen po 'di yang rab tu g.yo bar byed do// zhes sogs kyis mngon shes drug la 'doms pa dang*/

de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi yum las brtsams ste/ ji ltar byang sems chen po rnams yum la nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ba med pa ltar khyod spobs par byos shig sogs kyis mthong lam la 'doms pa dang*/ rab 'byor 'dus ma byas kyi dbyings med par 'dus byas kyi dbyings gdags par mi nus zhes sogs nas/ shā ri'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i skyon zhes bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ mthun pa'i chos la sred pa'o zhes pa'i bar gyis sgom lam la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gsungs so// 'o na mthong lam la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag 'di/ rab 'byor gyis ston pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs nas dbang po rtul po nyan thos kyis kyang phyin ci ma log par 'chad nus pa'i don yin la/ rab 'byor kho nas ston pa ni bstan bya dang ston pa po nyon mongs pa med par skal ba mnyam par ston pa'i don no// brgyad stong pa las ni/ gdams ngag bcu po re re ltar gsungs pa med pas slob dpon gyis stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa las kha bskong bar mdzad do// gnyis pa mdo don bstan bcos su ji ltar bkral ba ni/ sgrub dang bden pa rnams dang ni// zhes gsungs te/ de yang gong du/ sher phyin la bslab par bya/ zhes gsung na/ sher phyin de nyid gang zhe na/ sgrub la gdams ngag ces gsungs/ de la ji ltar bslab/ bslab pas 'bras bu ci zhig 'byung zhe na/ dmigs pa bden pa bzhi la dmigs/ rten dkon mchog gsum la brten/ mi mthun phyogs sel byed brtson 'grus gsum rgyud la bskyed de/ sher phyin gyi sgrub pa de nyams su blangs na gzhan don sgrub byed spyan dang*/ mngon par shes pa dang*/ rang don bsgrub pa mthar phyin pa'i rgyu mthong lam dang*/ sgom lam 'byung zhing*/ 'di tsam kho nas nges legs don gnyer gyi skyes bu'i don thams cad phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir/

gdams ngag bcur grangs nges so// zhes ston pa'i dbang du byas nas/ de ltar na byang chub kyi sems des 'phangs pa'i chos kyi ngo bo nyid kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sgrub pa'i rnam pa gang yin pa mi dmigs pa dang*/ de'i dmigs pa gang yin pa bden pa bzhi dang*/ zhes sogs gsungs so// dgos pa'i sgo nas bcu po gnyis su 'dus te/ mdo las/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par gdams pa ste/ 'di ni rjes su bstan pa yin no zhes 'byung ba ltar/ sngar yod kyi yon tan sems bskyed mi nyams shing 'phel ba'i phyir gdams pa dang*/ sngar ma thob pa'i yon tan spyan dang mngon shes sogs thob pa'i phyir rjes su gdams pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bsgrub pa rang gi ngo bo la 'doms pa ste/ sems bskyed kyi ngo bo byang chub sems dpa' chen pos chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas sher phyin la bslab par bya'o// zhes bstan pa de nyid la mngon par zhen pa dgag pa'i phyir/ rten gyi gang zag byang sems dang*/ don du gnyer bya byang chub dang*/ de thob pa'i thabs sher phyin dang*/ de la spyod pa'i bya ba dang*/ byang chub kyi dmigs pa phung po sogs mi dmigs par bstan cing*/ de ltar nyams su blangs na sems bskyed kyi gdams pa de nyid mi nyams shing mthar phyin par 'gyur la/ de 'dra'i nyams len de nyan thos sogs dang thun mong min pa'i sgrub pa yin no// zhes bstan pa'i phyir ro// lhag ma rnams ni rjes su bstan pa'i gdams ngag ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ji ltar brtson na yum la brtson par bgyi/ zhes sogs kyis/ gdams pa'i don de nyid yon tan phyi ma bskyed pa'i thabs su nan tan gyis bsgrub dgos par bstan pa'i phyir ro// 'di yang 'phags pa'i dgongs par mngon no// gnyis pa rtogs dka' ba dge 'dun dkon mchog bye brag tu bshad pa la/

'brel btsal ba ni/ mdo las/ dge 'dun dkon mchog gi dbye ba lhug par gsungs pa ni 'dir tshigs bcad du sdebs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ dge 'dun dkon mchog gi dbye ba bde blag tu rtogs par bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir zhes ston pa ni/ dge 'dun dkon mchog gi skabs su bde blag tu rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ zhes sogs so// mdo las/ mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis kyi sgo nas bshad pa med kyang*/ bstan bcos su bstan bshad gnyis su mdzad pa yin no// 'brel pa can gyi dge 'dun dngos la/ bshad bya'i mdo dgod/ mdo'i don bstan bcos su ji ltar bsdus pa'i tshul dang*/ mtshon byed dpe'i dge 'dun gyi grangs nges par bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ shā ri'i bus dris pa'i lan du/ shā ri'i bu byang sems gang dag mi'i nang nas shi 'phos nas mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam pa nyid du skyes pa de ni/ phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems chen po ma gtogs pa dbang po rtul po yin no// de yum gyi rnal 'byor 'di la yang myur du 'jug par mi 'gyur/ de la ting nge 'dzin dang*/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyang mngon du mi 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan nam/ dga' ldan gyi lha'i rigs nas shi 'phos nas 'dir skyes pa de'i dbang po rnams rno bar 'gyur zhing*/ yum gyi rnal 'byor 'di la yang myur du snyoms par 'jug par 'gyur ro// zhes sogs le brgyad ma las nyi shu rtsa lnga'i mdo gsungs la/ 'dir phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems bkol ba ni/ dbang po rnon pa'i lam kho nas phyir mi ldog pa'i sa brgyad pa de thob pa'i phyir zhes nyi khri snang bar bshad do// gnyis pa la/ bzhed pa'i rnam grangs bkod pa dang*/ slob dpon gyi lugs brjod pa'o// dang po la 'phags seng*/ a bh+ya ka ra rnams byang sems 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dbye gzhir bzhed la/ de ni 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa ni/

lus can kun gyi skyabs yin no// zhes dang*/ mtshon byed dpe'i dbang du byas na mdzod dang mthun no// shān+ti pa sbyor lam yan chod kyi dbye gzhir 'dod cing*/ nges 'byed yan lag nas bzung ste/ zhes dang*/ mtshon byed dpe'i dbang du byas na mngon pa gong ma mthun no// dbye ngo la/ shān+ti pa dang*/ bud+dha shri rtsa ba'i tshig zin ltar 'chad cing*/ 'dre na re/ lhag dang bcas pa med pa dang*// mdo 'di nyid la zhugs pa dang*// mdo gzhan dag dang 'gal med phyir// dbye ba gzhung bzhin rigs pa yin// zhes gsung ngo*// 'phags pa'i dgongs pa lo ts+tsha ba chen pos blangs pa ltar na/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang sems sogs dbye gzhir mdzad nas/ rgyun zhugs dang phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong gsum la tsam po re/ dgra bcom zhugs pa ste bzhi kha skong*/ 'og min 'gro/ 'phar gsum srid rtse'i mthar thug 'gro rnams gcig tu bsdud cing*/ der ma zad/ phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong la zhugs pa la dad mos mthong thob gnyis bgrangs shing*/ rang sangs rgyas ci rigs par de dag tu'ang 'dus par bzhed/ 'dre chen pos 'phags pa'i dgongs pa blangs pa ltar na/ gzhan sngar bzhin la/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas tsam po mi bgrang bar brgyad pa bgrangs nas nyi shu mdzad/ tsam po kha skong mi dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ nyi khri snang bar rjes 'brang gnyis/ bcu drug pa la gnas pa'i dbang du byas pas/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas tsam po bsdus pa'i phyir te/ rjes 'brang gnyis chags bral sngon du ma song ba'i dbang du byas/ dad mos mthong thob gnyis chags bral sngon du song ba'i dbang du byas te gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes g.yag ṭīka las gsungs kyang nyi khri snang ba las ni rjes 'brang gnyis kyis 'dod pa'i nyon mongs drug pa dang*/ dgu pa spangs na chags bral sngon song gi phyir 'ong dang phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa dang*/ bcu drug pa'i tshe 'bras gnas su 'gyur zhing*/

de'i tshe dad mos mthong thob kyi ming 'dogs par bshad do// des na 'phags pa'i dgongs pa lo chen ltar mi 'gal la/ slob dpon snga ma rnams 'dre ltar 'chad do// a bh+ya ya'i gnad kyi zla 'od ltar na/ mthong lam skad cig ma bco lnga rjes 'brang gnyis/ bcu drug pa la rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas tsam po/ sa lnga pa la rigs nas rigs skye gnyis/ sa drug pa la phyir 'ong zhugs pa/ dad mos mthong thob gnyis gcig tu bgrang*/ sa bdun pa la bar chad gcig pa/ brgyad pa dgu pa la phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa dad mos mthong thob gnyis gcig tu bgrang*/ bcu pa la phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas la 'da' ba bzhi/ 'og min 'gro dbye gzhir byas nas/ 'phar ba gsum/ srid rtse 'gro dbye gzhir byas nas/ gzugs kyi chags bcom dang*/ mthong chos zhi/ lus mngon byed gsum/ bar chad med lam la/ dgra bcom zhugs pa dang*/ bse ru lta bu zhes bshad/ rat+na kirti ltar na/ dad mos mthong thob gnyis/ bar chad gcig pa/ 'da' ba bzhi/ 'phar ba gsum/ mthong chos bzhi/ lus mngon byed/ bse ru lta bu ste/ rtsa bas zin pa bco lnga/ shugs la rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas tsam po/ phyir 'ong zhugs pa dang gnas pa tsam po/ phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa/ dgra bcom zhugs pa ste lnga bstan/ dbang po rno rtul gnyis dad mos mthong thob gnyis kyi bye brag yin pas dbye bar mi bgrang*/ srid rtse'i mthar thug 'gro dang*/ gzugs kyi chags bcom ste/ mthong chos zhi dang*/ lus mngon byed kyi dbye gzhi yin pas mi bgrang*/ 'og min 'gro yang*/ 'phar gsum gyi dbye gzhi yin pas mi bgrang*/ shugs bstan lnga don gyis thob pas dbye bar bgrang*/ zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa slob dpon gyi dgongs pa gang yin btsal ba la/ mkhas pa'i bzhed pa bkod pa dang*/ rang gi blo la shar ba brjod pa'o// dang po la sher blo ltar/ srid rtse'i mthar thug 'gro dang*/ gzugs kyi chags bcom don gcig tu mdzad nas 'grel pa 'dir 'byung ba kho na ltar bzhed de/

bsdus don las/ 'bras bu dang po la ni rnam pa lnga'o// gnyis pa la ni rnam pa gsum mo// gsum pa la ni rnam pa bcu'o// bzhi pa la gcig nyid do// rang sangs rgyas kyang yin no// rtogs par sla ba nyid kyis dang po dang gnyis pa'i 'bras bu la gnas pa dang*/ 'bras bu bzhi pa la zhugs pa tshigs su bcad par ma brjod do// zhes gsungs kyang*/ chos kyi bshes gnyen ni/ rgyun zhugs zhugs pa la rjes 'brang gnyis/ 'bras gnas la rigs nas rigs skye gnyis/ phyir 'ong zhugs pa la dad mos mthong thob gnyis/ 'bras gnas la tsam po dang khyad par can gnyis/ phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa la gcig 'bras gnas la 'da' ba bzhi/ 'phar gsum srid rtse'i mthar thug 'gro dbye gzhir byas nas/ gzugs kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba dang*/ mthong ba'i chos la zhi ba lus kyis mngon du byed pa ste bcu/ dgra bcom zhugs pa rang sangs rgyas dang nyi shur bzhed de/ tshigs gsal las/ rgyun du zhugs pa bsdus pa bzhi'o// zhes sogs gsungs so// 'grel chen rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba las/ srid pa'i rtse mo'i mthar thug par 'gro ba ni/ gzugs kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba dang*/ mthong ba'i chos la zhi ba lus kyis mngon sum du byed pa rnam pa gnyis so// zhes gsung*/ rngog 'gyur las/ srid pa'i rtse mo'i mthar thug par 'gro ba ni gzugs kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba ste zhes gsungs shing*/ 'di la 'dre chen po na re/ de ltar rta ni glang po che yin la/ de la dbye na ra dang lug gnyis/ zhes brjod pa ltar ma 'brel lo// zhes 'bum phrag gsum pa la zhus pas/ paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhal snga nas/ nyan thos kyi dbang du byas na de ltar yin kyang*/ byang sems ni bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi ting nge 'dzin brgyad ka bsgom pas/ srid rtse'i mthar thug 'gro zhes bya la/ gzugs med kyi ting nge 'dzin snyoms par 'jog nus pas gzugs kyi chags bcom zhes kyang bya'o// zhes gsungs par grags so// grangs bgrang tshul mi mthun pa ci rigs su 'byung ba ni mdo'i dngos bstan dang*/

bstan bcos kyi tshig zin mi mthun pa ci rigs su 'byung bas gang rung bsgrib pa'i phyir mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad do// gnyis pa ni/ bdag gi blo la 'di ltar snang ste/ mtshon bya don gyi dge 'dun 'di dag bsdu na gnyis te/ zhugs pa dang*/ 'bras gnas gnyis/ dang po la/ brgyad pa dang*/ chags bral sngon song gi phyir 'ong zhugs pa dang*/ sngon song gi phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa ste/ gsum yod kyang*/ dad pa'i rjes 'brang dang*/ chos kyi rjes 'brang gnyis su 'dus pas/ dbang po rtul dang rnon po dag /ces pas ston no// gnyis pa tsam po dang khyad par can gnyis/ tsam po la rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas tsam po/ phyir 'ong 'bras gnas tsam po/ phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas tsam po dang gsum yod kyang*/ dang po gnyis ni/ dad mos dang*/ mthong thob las ming gzhan smos ma nus pas/ dad dang mthong thob ces pas bstan/ phyi ma ni/ bar dor 'da' ba sogs kyi ming gis bstan/ khyad par can la/ skye ba'i khyad par ming du smos pa dang*/ smos ma nus pa gnyis/ ma nus pa la phyir 'ongs zhugs pa/ phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa/ dgra bcom zhugs pa gsum yod kyang ming dad mos mthong thob gnyis su 'dus te/ dad dang mthong thob/ zhes ston/ skye ba'i khyad par ming du smos pa la/ 'dod par skye ba'i khyad par ming du smos pa dang*/ khams gong mar skye ba'i khyad par ming du smos pa gnyis ni/ rigs nas rigs zhes sogs kyis bstan no// mdor na/ dad dang mthong thob ni/ 'bras gnas mdor bstan yin la/ lhag ma rnams ni rgyas bshad do// 'dir legs bshad gser phreng mdzad pa po/ dbang po rtul dang rnon po dag /ces pas rkang grangs gsum 'don pa ni/ rnam dbye dang po'i gnyis tshig byin pas/ dag zhes smos pa ma mkhyen par zad do// yang*/ dad dang mthong thob ces pas/ chags bral sngon song gi 'bras gnas dge 'dun nyi shu'i rkang grangs bstan par bzhed pa 'phags pa'i dgongs pa yin zhes gsungs pa'ang min te/

nyi khri snang bar/ dad mos mthong thob gnyis/ phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa'i dbang du mdzad nas sbyar te gsung pa'i phyir ro// de ltar na 'dir byang sems kyi dge 'dun kho na dngos su bstan pa yin zhing*/ bstan tshul ni theg pa dman pa'i dge 'dun gyi ming gis btags nas bstan pa yin no// 'o na yum gyi mdor/ de 'dra'i tha snyad mi 'byung bas byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun la dman pa'i dge 'dun gyi ming gis 'dogs pa la ni/ shes byed med do zhes na/ 'phags seng gnyis kyis/ phyir mi ldog 'khor lo'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba nas brtsams te/ byang chub sems dpa' rang sangs rgyas kyi bar du gang zag gi rnam par gzhag pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis shin tu gsal bar gsungs pa yin pa'i phyir/ de dag las blta bar bya'i/ 'dir gzhung mangs kyi dogs te kho bo cag gis ma bkod de/ btags zin thag pas ci zhig bya// zhes gsungs kyang*/ 'di dag byang sems kyi dge 'dun la rjes grub tu sbyar ba'i ming yin par 'phags pa dang*/ mkhas pa chen po shān+ti pas gsungs shing*/ 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan spangs rtogs skye ba len tshul gyi cha 'ga' zhig 'dra ba'i phyir/ btags pa'i dgos pa/ dge 'dun dkon mchog tu yid ches par bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ dngos la gnod byed kyang byang sems yin pa'i phyir/ zhes shān+ti pas gsungs/ btags pa'i dgos pa nyi khri snang ba las/ nyan rang gi rigs can rnams rgyun du zhugs pa nas/ rang sangs rgyas kyi bar la dgod pa'i ched yin no// rang gis ma thob pa'i chos la gzhan ji ltar 'god nus snyam na/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyis shes pa dang spong ba ni/ byang sems chen po'i mi skye ba'i chos la bzod par 'dus pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs shing*/ phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i mdor ni/ 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan sogs 'di las gzhan du'ang gsungs so// gsum pa mtshon byed dpe'i dge 'dun gyi grangs nges la/

bdag gi blo la 'di ltar snang ste/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun mdor bsdu na/ spangs pa'i sgo nas bsdu ba dang*/ skye ba len tshul gyis bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ mthong spangs/ spangs ma spangs gnyis su nges/ ma spangs pa la sbyor lam stan gcig pa'i rtogs pa thob ma thob gnyis su nges/ ma thob pa la dpyad pa bor nas/ thob pa la 'dod pa la chags pa dang bral ma bral gnyis su nges/ dang po la/ chags bral sngon song gi phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa zhes bya la/ gnyis pa la/ 'dod nyon drug pa la chags pa dang bral ma bral gnyis su grangs nges/ dang po la chags bral sngon song gi phyir 'ong zhugs pa zhes bya/ gnyis pa la rgyun zhugs zhugs pa zhes bya/ mthong spangs spangs pa la/ khams gsum car la chags pa dang bral ma bral gnyis su nges/ bral ba la gcig car chags pa dang bral ba dang*/ rim gyis chags pa dang bral ba gnyis su nges/ dang po la spangs bya gcig car ba'i dgra bcom zhes bya/ gnyis pa la/ rim gyis ba'i dgra bcom zhes bya/ ma bral ba la/ 'dod pa la chags pa dang bral ma bral gnyis su grangs nges/ dang po la/ mthong lam gyi sngar bral ba dang*/ phyis bral ba gnyis su nges/ dang po la chags bral sngon song gi phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas zhes bya/ gnyis pa la rim gyis pa'i phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas zhes bya/ 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang ma bral ba la/ phal cher la 'dod chags dang bral ma bral gnyis su nges/ bral ba la mthong lam gyi sngar bral ba dang*/ phyis bral ba gnyis su nges/ dang po la/ chags bral sngon song gi phyir mi 'ong zhes bya/ gnyis pa la/ khams gong ma'i nyon mongs drug pa la/ chags pa dang bral ma bral gnyis su nges/ dang po ni/ spang bya gcig car ba'i rgyun zhugs su gtogs/ gnyis pa la/ 'bras bu rim gyis pa'i phyir 'ong 'bras gnas zhes bya/ phal cher la 'dod chags dang ma bral ba la khams gong ma'i nyon mongs spong ba la/ mngon du phyogs ma phyogs gnyis su nges/

dang po ni/ spang bya gcig car ba'i rgyun zhugs su gtogs pas dgra bcom zhugs pa yin no// gnyis pa la ni/ spang bya rim gyis pa'i rgyun zhugs zhes bya'o// gnyis pa skye ba len tshul gyi mdor bsdu ba la/ zhugs gnas kyi gang zag de dag kyang mdor bsdu na/ skye ba len pa'i rgyu dang ldan pa dang mi ldan pa gnyis su nges/ mi ldan pa ni dgra bcom pa'o// ldan pa la/ rgyu de tshe 'di la spong nus mi nus gnyis/ nus pa la/ bden pa mthong ba'i tshe 'di la spong nus pa dang*/ bden pa mthong ba'i rjes su blangs ba'i tshe 'di la spong ba gnyis su nges/ dang po la mthong chos zhi zhes bya/ gnyis pa la/ bden pa mthong rjes su 'dod par skye ba brgyud mar blangs pa dang*/ khams gong du skye ba brgyud mar blangs pa gnyis su nges/ dang po la ni/ 'dod par tshe yongs gyur gyi 'phags pa zhes bya'o// skye ba len pa'i rgyu tshe 'di la spong mi nus pa la/ 'dod par skye ba len nges pa dang*/ khams gong mar skye ba len nges pa gnyis/ dang po la/ skye srid bdun len nges pa dang*/ gcig len par nges pa gnyis su grangs nges/ dang po ni/ re ltar thogs na srid pa lan bdun pa yin la/ gnyis pa la/ rigs mthun gyi skye srid gcig kho na len nges pa dang*/ gnyis la sogs pa len nges pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshe gcig bar chad gcig pa yin/ gnyis pa la ni/ rigs nas rigs skye zhes bya'o// gnyis pa la/ gzugs khams su skyes ba'i rgyu dang ldan pa gzugs su nyer 'gro dang*/ gzugs med kho nar skye ba'i rgyu dang ldan pa gzugs med nyer 'gro gnyis/ dang po la/ gzugs med du'ang skye ba len mi len gnyis su kha tshon chod/ dang po ni/ srid rtse'i mthar thug 'gro yin/ gnyis pa la/ sngon du skye ba len mi len gnyis su nges/ mi len pa'i bar dor 'da' ba yin/ len pa la/ gcig kho na len pa dang*/ gnyis la sogs pa len pa gnyis/ dang po ni/

skyes nas 'da' ba yin/ gnyis pa la/ gnyis kho na len pa dang*/ gsum kho na len pa dang*/ bzhi la sogs pa len pa'o// de dag la ni/ 'phar ba dang*/ phyed du 'phar ba dang*/ gnas thams cad du 'chi 'pho ba zhes bya'o// ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo nas bsdu na/ rnam thar brgyad kyi ting nge 'dzin mngon du byed nus mi nus gnyis su 'dus shing*/ nus pa de la ni/ lus mngon byed ces bya/ mi nus pa ni/ de las gzhan rnams so// 'di ni mngon pa gong ma'i lugs so// mchims ṭīka chen mor/ mdzod 'grel gyi dgongs pa 'chad pa la/ gzugs su nyer 'gro'i phyir mi 'ong*/ khri dang nyis stong*/ dgu brgya dang drug cur bshad de/ de yang*/ bar dor 'da' ba dang*/ skyes nas 'da' ba dang*/ 'du byed dang bcas de 'da' ba dang*/ skyes nas 'da' ba/ 'du byed dang bcas te 'da' ba/ 'du byed med par 'da' ba/ gong 'pho ste/ lnga po re re la gnas kyi dbye ba bcu drug ste/ de re re la'ang rigs kyi dbye ba drug ste/ de re re yang dbang po'i dbye ba gsum re/ de re re la'ang chags bral gyi dbye ba 'ching ba mtha' dag dang ldan pa nas/ nyon mongs brgyad pa chags pa dang bral bar dgu dgu ste de ltar ro// gnyis pa thob bya sgrub pa'i 'bras bu la/ dang po snga phyi'i 'brel btsal ba la mdo'i 'brel ni/ sgom lam la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gi mdor/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i skyon zhes bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ mthun ba'i chos la srid pa'o// zhes pa la 'phros nas/ shā ri'i bus/ rab 'byor la/ mthun pa'i chos la sred pa gang yin zhes dris pa'i lan gyis nges 'byed yan lag gsungs so// bstan bcos kyi 'brel ni/ gong du gdams ngag gi 'bras bu mthong lam dang*/ sgom lam 'byung bar bstan pa de yang nges 'byed yan lag sngon du 'gro ba can yin no zhes ston pa ni/ las dang po pa de ltar gdams ngag thob pa la zhes sogs so// gnyis pa 'brel pa can gyi don dngos la/

bshad bya'i mdo dgod pa ni/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yum la spyod pa'i tshe/ gzugs mi rtag pa dang*/ sdug bsngal ba dang*/ stong pa dang*/ bdag med pa dang*/ smon pa med pa zhes bya bar mngon par zhen pa dang*/ lhag par gnas pa dang*/ kun shes pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i mthun pa'i chos la sred pa ste skyon yin no// zhes sogs mdo'i rim pa gcig la bstan bcos kyi mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis mdzad pa yin no// gnyis pa bstan bcos su ji ltar bkral ba la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa gnyis so// dang po la/ bod snga rabs pa rnams na re/ bstan bcos 'dir theg chen gyi lam lnga ka'ang*/ theg dman gyi lam lnga las khyad par 'phags par bsgrub pa'i gzhung re re yod pa las/ 'dis theg chen gyi sbyor lam de theg dman gyi sbyor lam las khyad zhugs par bsgrubs so// zhes gsungs pa ltar rigs so// de yang 'phags pa ltar na/ khyad chos bzhi'am drug gis khyad zhugs par 'dod/ slob dpon ni/ khyad chos lnga'i sgo nas khyad zhugs par bzhed/ de ltar bstan pa la dgos pa ci yod ce na/ theg chen gyi gdams ngag nyams su blangs pa la brten nas/ 'bras bu khyad par du 'phags pa 'di 'byung ngo zhes ston pas/ gdams ngag nyan pa'i byang sems spro ba bskyed pa'i ched yin no// 'di dang skabs 'og ma'i sbyor lam la khyad par med na zlos par 'gyur zhing*/ yod na ston dgos so zhe na/ nyi khri snang bar/ skabs dang por theg chen gyi nges 'byed khyad chos drug gis theg dman gyi nges 'byed las khyad zhugs par bstan/ skabs gnyis par/ dmigs pa dang rnam pa'i khyad par gnyis kyis bstan te/ dmigs pa gzugs sogs stong pa nyid la dmigs/ rnam pa gzugs sogs dang stong nyid dbyer med pa'i rnam pa can no// skabs bzhi par/ dmigs pa sems can dang*/

rnam pa mnyam pa nyid sogs kyi sgo nas bstan par bshad do// bsdus don sgron ma las ni/ lam shes nges 'byed nyan thos kyi// rnam kun nges 'byed kun rdzob kyi// 'dir ni don dam cha nas ni// bstan pas zlos skyon med do zhes// bud+dha shrī dzñā na 'dod// nges 'byed bden pa rtogs pa ste// de cha sdug bsngal chos shes bzod// de dang mthun pa mtshan nyid yin// sbyor lam mos spyod cha mthun ni// 'di yi ming gi rnam grangs yin// zhes kyang gsungs so// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa rnams ni thabs mkhas pa'i stobs kyis/ zhes pa 'di ni/ dmigs pa la 'phros pa'i don yin la/ de la'ang gser gling pa ltar na/ kun 'byung bden pa'i gnas skabs kha cig tu ni/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyur rtogs pa'i sgo nas sdug bsngal bden pa'i gnas skabs kha cig tu ni/ rang rgyu kun 'byung gi 'bras bur rtogs pa'i sgo nas/ 'gog bden gyi gnas skabs kha gcig tu ni/ chos thams cad 'gog pa'i ngo bor rtogs pa'i sgo nas/ lam bden gyi gnas skabs kha cig tu ni/ mkhyen gsum gyi chos la dmigs pa nyid kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas dmigs zhes bzhed/ sher 'byung blo gros ltar na/ kun 'byung gi bden pa la skabs kha cig tu/ rang rgyu kun 'byung las rang 'bras sdug bsngal 'byung ba rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid kyi rgyu'i sgo nas/ sdug bden la gnas skabs kha cig tu/ rang rgyud kun 'byung gi 'bras bur rtogs bzhin pa'i rang bzhin 'bras bu'i sgo nas/ lam bden la gnas skabs kha cig tu stong pa nyid 'gog bden gyi mtshan nyid can gyi ngo bo'i sgo nas/ 'gog bden la skabs kha cig tu ni/ lam bden de dang de nyid gzhan du brjod du med pa'i chos nyid kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas zhes bzhed/ chos shes ltar na/ theg pa gsum car gyi rtogs rigs tshang bar thob pa'i theg chen mthong lam gyi rgyu byed pa/

rgyu'i sgo nas 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi mngon sum pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ 'bras bu'i sgo nas/ chos dbyings kyi ngo bor gnas pa/ ngo bo nyid kyi sgo nas/ chos dbyings kyi rang bzhin de yang kun rdzob tu dmigs pa rnams kyi bye brag du mar rten 'brel gyi mthu'i che bas gnas pa/ chos dbyings kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas zhes bzhed/ lo chen gyi/ bzod pa 'bring gi gnas skabs kha cig tu rgyu'i sgo nas/ chos mchog chung ngu'i gnas skabs kha cig tu ni 'bras bu'i sgo nas/ bzod pa chung ngu'i gnas skabs kha cig tu ni ngo bo nyid kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas/ lhag ma dgu'i gnas skabs kha cig tu ni chos nyid kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas dmigs par bzhed/ bcom ldan ral gri na re/ rigs byin dang*/ sher blo'i bzhed pa mi 'thad de/ nyan thos las khyad par 'phags par ma bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ lam kho na la chos nyid kyis dmigs pa'i rgyu mtshan med pa'i phyir/ lo ts+tsha ba'i lugs kyang mi 'thad de/ rang gi blos bkod pa tsam yin gyi/ slob dpon gyi gzhung las bshad pa med pa'i phyir/ zhes bkag nas/ byang chub sems dpas gang cung zad dmigs pa'i yul la dmigs nas yid la byed pa ni bden pa gnyis las mi 'da' bas/ kun rdzob kyi rnam par yid la byed pa na/ rgyu 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas dmigs/ don dam pa'i rnam par yid la byed pa'i tshe ni/ chos nyid kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas dmigs so// gal te thams cad kyang chos kyi spros bral yin na/ rgyu sogs du mar 'gyur ba 'gal lo zhe na/ bden gnyis rtogs pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i stobs kyis zhes gsungs te/ 'di ltar rang bzhin gcig nyid la rnam 'gyur sna tshogs su 'gyur ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i thabs mkhas pa'i mthu'i che ba yin la/ sna tshogs pa yang spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin gcig nyid du 'gyur ba ni/ chos dbyings kyi che ba yin no// zhes gsungs te shin tu legs par snang zhing*/

slob dpon chos kyi bshes gnyen dang*/ rnam bshad kyi dgongs pa'ang 'di nyid yin no// bdag gi blo la 'di ltar snang ste/ gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ dmigs rnam rgyu gsum gyi khyad chos rgyas par bshad/ mtshungs ldan rtogs pa'i khyad chos rgyas par bshad/ yongs 'dzin dge bshes rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po la dmigs pa bshad pa dang*/ dmigs rnam gyi khyad par so sor phye ba'o// dang po la/ 'o na 'chad par 'gyur ba'i dmigs pa'i khyad par de zhes bshad pa de gang yin zhe na/ drod kyi gnas skabs kha cig tu ni/ rgyu kun nas nyon mongs kyi gzung ba rang bzhin med pa'i sgo nas/ rtse mo'i gnas skabs kha cig tu ni/ 'bras bu rnam byang gi gzung ba rang bzhin med pa'i sgo nas/ bzod pa'i gnas skabs kha cig tu ni ngo bo nyid gang zag rdzas yod kyi 'dzin pa rang bzhin med pa'i sgo nas/ chos mchog gi gnas skabs kha cig tu ni/ chos nyid btags yod kyi 'dzin pa rang bzhin med pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa'i sgo nas/ bden bzhin la ji ltar srid pa bzhin dmigs so// 'dir gang zag rdzas yod kyi 'dzin pa la ngo bo nyid ces bya ste/ ngo bo nyid kyis grub par 'dzin pa'i phyir/ btags yod kyi 'dzin pa la chos nyid ces bya ste/ ngo bos stong par 'dzin pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'o na bden stong med dgag kho na la dmigs pa yin nam zhe na/ bden stong sgyu ma lta bu la dmigs pas thabs la mkhas pa'i stobs kyis zhes gsungs par mngon no// 'o na dmigs tshul bzhi po der nges sam zhe na/ bud+dha shrī dang*/ lo chen ltar na/ snga ma nyan thos kyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin/ mi rtag pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa gzhan gyis kyang dmigs so// zhes pa'am/ yang na mngon zhen med pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa gzhan gyis/ zhes gsungs la/ ral gri na re/ snga ma mi 'thad de/ nyan thos las khyad zhugs par ma grub pa'i phyir dang*/ phyi ma'ang mi 'thad de/ 'og 'di nyid du 'chad pa'i phyir zhes bkag nas/

rang lugs/ dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir// zhes sogs nas 'chad pa'i rnam pa rnams kyis dmigs zhes gsungs/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/ de yang slob dpon gyi bzhed par mi rung ste/ rnam kun khyad par can gyi sbyor lam btags pa ba yin pa'i phyir zhes 'chad/ bdag gi blo la 'di ltar snang ste/ ji ltar srid pa bzhin dmigs na mi rtag sogs kyi sgo nas kyang dmigs dgos la/ de lta na nyan thos dang khyad par ci yod ce na/ dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur las/ de bzhin du zhes 'byung*/ phyi 'gyur las/ snga ma bzhin zhes 'byung bas/ rnam pa gzhan mi rtag sogs la dmigs pa'ang snga ma de bzhin du/ rgyu 'bras ngo bo chos nyid kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas dmigs so// zhes khong du chud par bya'o// 'o na rnam pa gzhan gyi dmigs tshul brjod dgos so zhe na/ mdor bsdus te zhes so// gal te rgyu 'bras ngo bo chos nyid kyi rnam pa sogs mi 'dra ba du ma'i dmigs tshul mi 'thad de/ chos mngon pa las/ mi rtag sogs las rnam pa gzhan ma bshad pa'i phyir zhe na/ theg pa gzhan la brten nas gcig shos sun 'byin mi nus so zhes ston pa ni/ de phyir zhes sogs so/ ṭī ka'i dgongs pa'o// yang na de phyir zhes gsungs pas/ grub don sbyar dgos te/ mngon pa dang*/ sher phyin las gsungs pa gnyis mi 'gal bar bstan pa na/ theg pa gzhan la brten nas/ gzhan sun 'byin mi nus par grub zhes ston pa'o// gser gling pa ni/ theg chen bkas bsgrub kyis gzhung du sbyor bar mdzad de rigs par snang ngo*// gnyis pa dmigs rnam gyi khyad par so sor dbye ba la/ 'brel btsal ba ni/ gong du rnam pa'i sgo nas ji ltar srid pa bzhin dmigs zhes bshad na/ de gnyis kyi khyad par gang yin zhe na/ de'i khyad par 'chad do zhes ston pa ni/ dmigs pa dang rnam pa'i khyad par ji lta bu zhe na/ zhes sogs so// 'dir dmigs pa rnams kyi khyad par la/

bye brag tu smra ba/ dmigs pa ni gzugs lta bu yul gyi khyad par la 'dod/ mdo sde pa/ rnam pa gtong byed kyi rgyu la/ dmigs pa dang*/ der snang ba rnam par 'dod/ sems tsam pa/ gzung cha la dmigs pa dang*/ 'dzin cha la rnam par 'dod/ 'dir ni/ dmigs pa ni yul gyi khyad par gang yang rung ba rnams yin la/ rnam pa ni/ der rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi khyad par te/ gzhi shes pa yi bye brag rnams// rnam pa zhes bya/ zhes dang*/ dmigs pa chos rnams thams cad de// zhes 'byung ba'i phyir ro// rtsa ba'i 'brel ni/ dmigs pa dang ni zhes sogs bshad na/ dmigs pa dang*/ rnam pa dang*/ rgyu dang*/ chung ngu*/ 'bring*/ chen po'i khyad par de gang zhe na/ bshad pa ni/ dmigs pa mi rtag la sogs pa/ zhes sogs so// gnyis pa 'brel pa can dngos la/ dngos dang*/ rtsod pa spong ba gnyis/ dang po la drod kyi dmigs rnam rgyu gsum/ rtse mo'i dmigs rnam rgyu gsum/ bzod pa'i dmigs rnam rgyu gsum/ chos mchog gi dmigs rnam rgyu gsum rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po la/ bshad bya'i mdo dgod/ mdo'i dngos don bsdus pa dang*/ shugs bstan ngos bzung ba'o// dang po ni/ sngar drangs pa dang 'brel chags su/ gzugs 'di spang bar bya'o// 'dis gzugs spang bar bya'o// 'gog pa 'di ltar mngon du bya'o// 'dis 'gog pa mngon du bya'o// lam 'di ltar bsgom par bya'o// 'dis lam bsgom par bya'o// zhes sogs kyi bden pa bzhi'i dbang du bya ste/ drod chung ngu'i dmigs rnam bstan/ 'di ltar zhes pa ni sdug bden la bzhir phye ba ltar phyi ma gsum la'ang bzhi bzhir phye ba'i don no// 'dis zhes pa ni/ kun 'byung spong*/ 'gog pa mngon du byed/ lam sgom pa'i tshogs su gyur pa'i byang chub kyi phyogs rnams so// zhes nyi khri snang bar bshad/ dag ldan las/ ngo bo nyid kyis shas cher 'dzin pa ni mngon par zhen pa'o// 'bring ni gnas pa'o// chung ngu ni kun shes pa ste/

de dag 'gog pa'i zhes bshad/ rang lugs ni de las ldog ste rnam bshad las 'byung ba ltar ro// yang mdo las/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang sangs rgyas kyi sa la slob par 'dod pas kyang yum 'di nyid mnyan par bya/ bzung bar bya/ tshul bzhin yid la bya'o// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ yum 'di las ni/ nyan thos kyi sa'am rang sangs rgyas kyi sa'am/ byang sems kyi sa'am sangs rgyas kyi sa gang la bslab par bya ba'i theg pa gsum po rnams rgya cher bstan to zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/ de'i don bstan bcos su/ dmigs pa mi rtag la sogs pa// bden pa'i rten can de yis ni// rnam pa mngon zhen la sogs 'gog /theg pa gsum car thob pa'i rgyu// zhes gsungs/ 'dir mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal snga nas/ chu 'bab pa lta bu dang*/ me 'bar ba lta bu'i bshad pa zhes tha snyad mdzad do// drod chung ngu'i skabs kyi/ dmigs pa rnam pa/ rgyu'i khyad par ston pa'i tshig rnams 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar zhing*/ 'og gi de ltar nges 'byed cha mthun ni/ chung dang 'bring dang chen po zhes pa yar blangs te 'chad par 'dzin pa ni slob dpon gyi bzhed pa dri ma med pa'o// 'dir sher 'byung blo gros kyis/ nyan thos kyi rnam pa mi rtag sogs ni 'dir drod chung ngu'i dmigs pa yin la/ de'i rnam pa mngon zhen 'gog pa sogs ni drod 'bring gi dmigs pa dang*/ de bzhin gzhan la'ang sbyar bar bya// zhes gsungs te/ 'di nyid 'phags pa'i dgongs par 'dug snyam mo// gsum pa shugs bstan ngos bzung ba ni/ de ltar dro bar gyur ba ni// chung dang 'bring dang chen po yin// zhes sbyar ro// 'di la nyi khri snang bar/ dro bar gyur pa zhes gyur pa smos pa ni/ chung dang 'bring dang chen po'i rigs shes par bya ba'i don nam/ yang na dbang po rtul po la sogs pa'i gang zag tha dad kyang 'di'i dmigs pa la sogs pa rnams kyi khyad par med par shes par bya ba'i don to// zhes gsungs zhing*/

slob dpon gyis kyang de ltar mdzad do// chung 'bring chen po'i dbye ba khyad chos su ji ltar 'gyur zhe na/ slob dpon snga ma rnams nyan thos kyi bzod chen dang chos mchog skad cig re re las med pas zhes 'chad la/ dar ṭīka pa/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa gong nas gong du goms par byed pa ni khyad chos bla na med pa'o// zhes gsung ba ni mi 'thad de/ de ltar shes pa chung 'bring chen po'i dbye ba bstan pa la ltos mi dgos pa'i phyir ro// des na bdag gi blo la 'di ltar shar te/ nyan thos kyi sbyor lam na ni dmigs pa bden pa pa dang*/ rnam pa mi rtag sogs bcu drug las gzhan med la/ theg chen la ni sbyor lam bcu gnyis po re re la/ sher 'byung blo gros kyis bshad pa ltar dmigs rnam mi 'dra ba'i khyad par re re ston pa'i phyir ro// snyam mo// gnyis pa rtse mo'i dmigs rnam la'ang*/ sngar ltar gsum las/ bshad bya'i mdo ni/ byang sems yum la spyod pa'i tshe/ gzugs nas rga shi'i bar la gnas par mi bya'o// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong ngo*// de bzhin du rga shi'i bar la sbyar ro// gnyis pa dngos bstan bstan bcos su ji ltar bsdus pa ni/ gzugs sogs mi gnas de dag ni// zhes sogs so// de'i don la 'phags pa ltar na/ rtse mo chung ngu'i dmigs rnam la/ bden bzhi so sor ma phye ba'i dmigs rnam dang*/ so sor phye ba'i dmigs rnam gnyis/ dang po ni/ rkang pa dang po gsum mo// gnyis pa la sdug bden gyi dbang du byas pa dang*/ bden pa gzhan gsum gyi dbang du byas pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de nas rkang pa gsum/ gnyis pa ni/ sogs khongs nas 'don no// de nas gnyis dang gnyis kyis/ 'bring dang chen po'i dmigs rnam ston no// zhes rnam bshad las gsungs te/ mkhan po'i gsung las/ 'phags pa'i dgongs pa 'di las gzhan du'ang gsungs so// slob dpon dang bud+dha shrī ltar na/

sh+lau ka dang pos chung ngu'i dmigs rnam/ sh+lau ka gnyis pas 'bring gi dmigs rnam/ rkang pa tha ma gnyis kyis chen po'i dmigs rnam bstan par bzhed do// rtse mo 'bring gi mdor/ gal te mtshan mar bzung bar gyur na/ kun tu rgyu 'phreng ba can 'di la dad par mi 'gyur ba zhig na/ kun tu rgyu 'phreng ba can thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'di la mos nas dad pas rjes su 'brang zhing phyogs pa'i ye shes kyis zhugs so// zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ 'grel chen las/ mtshan mar bzung na nyes pa ci yod ce na/ gal te/ mtshan mar bzung na de'i tshe kun tu rgyu 'phreng ba can rang gi bstan pa la mtshan mar bzung bas yun ring por thar pa ma mthong bas kun tu skyo bar gyur pa'o// 'di la zhes bya ba ni bstan pa 'di las so// dad pa ni mtshan ma med pa'i tshul mngon par yid ches pa thob pa yin par mi 'gyur te/ mtshan mar 'dzin pa mtshungs pa'i phyir ro// zhes dang*/ phyogs gcig pa ni/ gang zag la bdag med pa'i ye shes kyis zhugs so zhes dang*/ kun tu rgyu phreng ba can dper byas pa ni mu stegs pa dang 'brel bas ting nge 'dzin las langs pa ste lhag par mos pa'i stobs kyis de mngon sum du byas pa'i dbang po nyid du shes par bya ba'i don yin no// zhes dang*/ nyi snang las/ 'phreng ba can dper byas pa ni/ mu stegs pa dang 'brel bas log par rtog pa yin yang*/ rtogs pa'i stobs kho nas don de mngon du byas pa la dbang po nyid du shes par bya ba'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa ni khong du chud par bya'o// gsum pa shugs bstan ngos bzung ba ni/ de ltar rtse mor gyur pa ni// chung dang 'bring dang chen po yin// zhes so// 'di'i thad kyi nyi snang gi dgongs pa la 'di yod de/ drod rtse sogs la dmigs rnam mi 'dra ba'i khyad par mi 'thad de/ drod kyi mi rtag sogs la dmigs la/ drod las rtse mo yin zhing rtse mo'ang de nyid dang 'dra bar bshad pa min nam zhe na/

ha ra zhes pa'i ming gcig kyang don mi 'dra zhes pa'o// do shal dang gtsug lag khang mtshan nyid 'dra'am ci/ 'di 'jug pa gzhan kho na yin no zhes gsungs/ 'grel chung 'dir/ de'i phyir theg pa gzhan zhes sogs bshad do// don ni/ mdzod las/ rnam pa bcu drug dro ba las// rtse mo de yang de dang 'dra// zhes pa dang mi 'gal bar ston pa yin no// de ltar shes na 'grel pa 'dir 'byung ba'ang phyin ci ma log par khong du chud do// gsum pa bzod pa'i dmigs rnam rgyu gsum la'ang sngar ltar gsum las/ dang po ni/ gzugs ni gzugs kyi rang bzhin dang bral/ zhes pa nas/ yang dag pa'i mtha' ni yang dag pa'i mtha'i rang bzhin dang bral zhes sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ gzugs sogs ngo bo nyid med nyid// sogs so// gsum pa ni/ de ltar bzod par gyur pa ni// chung dang 'bring dang chen po yin// zhes so// bzhi pa chos mchog la/ bshad bya'am/ mdo ni/ shā ri'i bu rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid de yang dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi phyir/ gnyis su med de gnyis su byar med do// 'di ni byang sems chen po rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin chos thams cad skye ba med pa zhes bya ste/ zhes sogs so// dngos bstan bstan bcos su ji ltar bsdus pa ni/ ting 'dzin de yi byed pa nyid// ces so// gsum pa ni/ de ltar 'jig rten chos mchog ni// zhes so// nyi khri snang ba las/ yum gyi mdor/ de ni nges par 'byung bar 'gyur// mi 'bral bar 'gyur/ nye bar 'gyur/ mngon par shes pa dang ting nge 'dzin myur du thob par 'gyur zhes pa'i tshigs bzhi po des nges 'byed cha bzhi bstan pa yin no// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa chos can gyi chos su brjod pa chad pa'i rtsod pa spang ba la/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'grel pa dang bcas pa nas ji ltar bshad pa'i tshul/ sngon gyi dam pa rnams ji ltar bzhed pa'i tshul/ rang gi blo la shar ba brjod pa dang gsum/

dang po ni/ mdo las drod chung ngu'i dmigs rnam bden pa bzhi car gyi steng nas bshad/ lhag ma rnams kyi dmigs rnam khyad bzhi gzugs sogs kyi steng du/ khyad chos bden med bstan pa'i sgo nas bshad/ de bzhin du rgyu'i khyad par yang*/ drod chung ngu'i skabs nyid du gsungs kyi gzhan du ma gsungs shing*/ chung 'bring sogs kyi dbye ba ston pa'ang gsal bar mi snang la/ chos mchog gi skabs su ni thams cad kyang ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par du byas te bstan no// bstan bcos las kyang*/ drod chung ngu'i skabs su bden bzhi'i rten can du bshad cing*/ rgyu'i khyad par yang bshad/ lhag ma rnams ni gzugs sogs kyi rten can du bshad/ rgyu'i khyad par ma bshad/ chos mchog gi skabs su ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par can du bshad do// 'di la dogs pa spong ba'i yan lag tu slob dpon gyi gzhung 'dir/ dmigs pa mi rtag la sogs pa/ bden pa'i rten can zhes bya ba ma gtogs par zhes sogs gsungs la/ 'di'i chos can bden bzhi dang*/ chos dmigs rnams la byed par gser gleng pa dang bud+dha shrī/ sher blo gsum gyis bshad/ gzhan bshad srol shin tu mang bar 'dug ste/ myang ba'i ro tshor mi snang bas btang snyoms su bzhag go /rnam bshad kyi dgongs pa 'di yin te/ dmigs rnam phyi ma ston pa'i gzhung gis/ bden bzhi'i rten can du ma bstan no snyam na/ gzugs sogs 'du 'god bral bar ston pa'i rgyan gyi gzhung mdo dang bcas pa chos can/ gzugs sogs kyi 'du 'god dang bral ba zhes ma bstan kyang*/ 'du 'god dang bral ba gzugs sogs kyi khyad chos su ma bstan pa min te/ gzugs sogs 'du 'god dang bral bar dngos su bstan pa gang zhig de dngos su bstan pa na/ 'du 'god dang bral ba gzugs sogs kyi khyad chos su shugs la rtogs nus pa'i phyir te/ gzugs sogs 'du 'god dang bral zhes pa'i chos can gyi chos su ma brjod pa'i sgra dang*/

gzugs sogs kyi 'du 'god dang bral ba zhes pa'i chos can gyi chos su brjod pa'i sgra gnyis la/ sgras brjod tshul ma gtogs don ston tshul la khyad par med pa'i phyir/ dper na bum pa mi rtag ces brjod pa dang*/ bum pa'i mi rtag pa zhes brjod pa bzhin no// zhes lhag ma rnams la'ang de bzhin du sbyar te ston pa ni/ gzhung snga ma yin la/ 'o na dngos su bden pa'i chos zhes ston rigs te/ dmigs rnam dang po bzhin no zhe na/ de lta na sdeb sbyor nyams par 'gyur ba'i phyir zhes ston pa ni/ rnam pa gcig tu na zhes sogs so// 'o na dmigs pa dang rnam pa phyi ma rnams bden pa'i rten can du bstan mod/ yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ de'i rgyu mtshan 'chad pa'i dbang du byas nas/ mngon par zhen pa la sogs pa bkag pa dang*/ zhes sogs so// gsum pa rang gi 'dod pa logs shig tu brjod pa la/ dgos pa ni/ dmigs rnam dang po ston pa'i mdo dang bstan bcos su/ dmigs pa mi rtag sogs dang*/ rnam pa mngon zhen 'gog pa so sor bstan pa dang*/ rgyu'i khyad par bstan pa ltar/ phyi ma rnams su de ltar ma bstan par 'du 'god bral ba sogs/ rnam pa kho na bstan pas dmigs rnam so sor 'byed pa mi 'thad cing*/ rgyu dang*/ chung 'bring sogs kyang mi 'thad do zhe na/ lan la gzhung snga mas mdo la dogs pa spang ba dang*/ gzhung phyi mas bstan bcos la dogs pa spong ba gnyis/ dang po la ma rtogs par zhes pa ni/ dmigs rnam dang po la dogs pa'i gnas med pas dpyad pa bor zhes pa'i don no// dmigs pa dang rnam pa khyad par can gyi chos can dang chos brjod pas brjod par bya ba yin pa/ zhes pa ni/ mdo las/ dmigs rnam dang po 'chad pa ni/ gzugs mi rtag ces bya bar mngon par zhen pa dang*/ lhag par gnas pa dang*/ kun shes pa 'di ni byang sems chen po'i mthun pa'i chos la sred pa ste zhes dmigs pa khyad par can gyi chos can dang rnam pa khyad par can gyi chos su so sor phye ba ltar/

dmigs rnam gnyis pa'i skabs su'ang*/ 'di ni chos kyi 'du ba'o// 'di ni chos rnams kyi 'god pa'o// zhes bya bar mngon par zhen pa dang*/ lhag par gnas pa dang*/ kun shes pa 'di ni zhes sogs brjod rigs pa yin na'ang*/ zhes pa'i don no// dmigs pa dang rnam pa khyad par can gyi chos brjod pas/ thams cad du brjod pa ni zhes pa/ chos rnams kyi 'du ba dang*/ 'god pa mi dmigs/ yang dag par rjes su ma mthong*/ zhes drod 'bring gi dmigs pa ston pa na'ang*/ khyad par gyi chos kho na brjod cing*/ bcom ldan 'das chos rnams kyi 'du ba dang 'god pa ma dmigs/ yang dag par rjes su ma mthong na/ byang sems chen po zhes gang la ming du btags par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das rnam grangs 'dis kyang ming de yang gnas pa ma mchis/ zhes sogs drod 'bring gi rnam par ston pa na'ang khyad par gyi chos kho na brjod pa ni chos can zhes pa'i don no// drod chung ngu ltar dmigs pa khyad par can gyi chos can gyi sgo nas ma brjod kyang*/ drod 'bring gi dmigs rnam so sor dbye mi nus pa min te/ drod 'bring gi dmigs rnam gnyis ka khyad par gyi chos kyi sgo nas dngos su brjod pa na/ khyad chos de nyid khyad par can gyi chos su shugs la rtogs pa'i phyir/ bum pa mi rtag zhes brjod pa na bum pa khyad gzhi dang*/ mi rtag pa khyad chos su rtogs pa bzhin no// zhes ston pa ni/ khyad par gzhan spong ba dang mi spong ba ma gtogs par zhes sogs so// gnyis pa gzhung phyi mas bstan bcos la dogs pa spong ba ni/ 'o na mdo las dmigs rnam dang po bden bzhi'i rten can du dngos su gsungs/ lhag ma rnams la dngos su ma gsungs pa ltar/ bstan bcos su yang de kho na ltar bshad pas de ltar nges sam ce na/ zhes pa'am/ yang na/ dmigs pa dang rnam pa khyad par can gyi chos can dang chos brjod pas brjod par bya ba yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/ brjod par bya ba yin na rje btsun gyis mi brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/

rje btsun gyis ma brjod de/ dmigs rnam phyi ma rnams kyi tshigs bcad sbyar bde bar bya ba'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ rnam pa gcig tu na zhes sogs so// mdo dang bstan bcos gnyis las/ dmigs rnam dang po la dmigs pa mi rtag sogs dang*/ rnam pa mngon zhen 'gog pa sogs sbyar nas bshad pa ltar/ drod 'bring la'ang*/ dmigs pa 'du 'god bral ba dang*/ rnam pa mngon zhen 'gog pa sbyar dgos te/ 'du 'god sogs yang dag par rjes su ma mthong*/ don 'du 'god sogs la mngon zhen bkag pa sogs yin pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ mngon par zhen pa sogs bkag pa dang ldan pa dag zhes sogs so// de ni drod 'bring gi dmigs rnam sdug bsngal bden par rtogs pa'i tshul lo// sogs khongs nas bden pa lhag ma rnams dang sbyar dgos zhes pa'i don te/ gzugs 'di spang bar bya'o// 'dis gzugs spang bar bya'o// 'gog pa 'di mngon du bya'o zhes sogs sbyar dgos pa'i don no// drod chen po sogs la'ang de ltar sbyar bar gyis shig ces ston pa ni/ 'og ma dag la'ang de bzhin du shes par bya'o// zhes pa'o// mdor na gzhung snga mas yum gyi mdor/ drod 'bring man chad la dmigs pa chos can dang*/ rnam pa chos kyis ma brjod par dmigs rnam gnyis ka chos kyi sgo nas brjod pa la/ dmigs rnam so sor dbye mi dgos pa'i rtsod pa spangs/ phyi mas bstan bcos su drod 'bring man chad la bden bzhi'i rten can du dngos su ma bstan pa la rtsod pa spangs te/ bden bzhi'i rten can du don gyis bstan dgos pa'i sgrub byed bstan/ des na chos can gyi chos su brjod pa zhes bya'i/ chos can brjod pa 'chad pa med do// yang sher 'byung blo gros dang*/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i dgongs pa ltar na/ drod 'bring nas drod chen po'i bar gyi dmigs rnam ston pa'i gzhung gis bden bzhi'i rten can du dngos su ma bstan kyang don gyis bstan te/

nyan thos kyi drod sogs bzhi'i rnam pa de/ byang sems kyi drod chung ngu'i dmigs par 'gyur/ drod chung ngu'i rnam pa de 'bring gi dmigs par 'gyur/ 'bring gi rnam pa de drod chen po'i dmigs par 'gyur ba'i phyir zhes dang*/ de bzhin du rtse mo chung ngu'i dmigs pa gzugs sogs kyi rten can du bstan pa sogs sbyar ro// de ltar shes na/ drod 'bring man gyi dmigs rnam sgom kyang theg pa gsum car gyi rtogs rigs tshang bar thob pa'i theg chen mthong lam gyi rgyu mi byed par thal/ mdo dang bstan bcos gnyis ka las bden pa'i rten can du ma bstan pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ nyan rang gi rtogs rigs tshang ba'i theg chen mthong lam yin na/ bden bzhi'i steng gi mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i dogs pa'ang khegs par 'gyur te/ dmigs rnam lhag ma bden bzhi'i rten can du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// 'o na bstan bcos su sdebs sbyor gyi dbang gis drod 'bring man la rgyu'i khyad par ma bstan mod/ yum gyi mdor/ drod 'bring man la rgyu'i khyad par mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na snyam pa'i dogs pa de yang khegs par 'gyur ro// drod chung ngu'i rnam pa de nyid drod 'bring gi dmigs par 'gyur ba sogs yin pa'i phyir ro// des na dmigs rnam ston pa'i gzhung 'di dag la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ don bsdu ba gsum du gnas te/ dang po ni/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa rnams ni zhes ston te/ don ni/ drod chung ngu'i gnas skabs kha cig tu ste/ de'i dmigs pa'i skabs su/ rgyu kun 'byung dang*/ lam 'bras bu sdug bsngal dang*/ 'gog pa'i rnam pa mi rtag sogs bcu drug la dmigs/ yang drod chung ngu'i gnas skabs kha cig tu ste/ de'i rnam pa'i skabs su/ mngon zhen 'gog pa sogs chos can sna tshogs pa'i ngo bo nyid dang*/

chos nyid bden stong zung du 'brel ba'i rnam pas ji ltar srid pa bzhin dmigs la/ snga ma drod chung ngu'i dmigs rnam bzhin du/ rnam pa gzhan drod 'bring sogs kyis kyang rgyu 'bras ngo bo chos nyid kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas dmigs so// 'o na bstan bcos su de ltar mi ston pa ci zhe na/ mdor bsdus te rnam par bkrol ba tsam du brjod par 'dod pas rnam par ma spros so// ci ste/ ngo bo nyid dang*/ chos nyid kyi rnam pas dmigs pa mi 'thad de/ chos mngon pa nas ma bshad pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ nyes pa med de/ de'i phyir zhes ston no// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ nges 'byed cha bzhi ka'i skabs su/ rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas dmigs pa de gang yin zhe na/ zhes ston pa ni/ dmigs pa dang rnam pa'i khyad par ji lta bu zhe na/ zhes sogs so// gsum pa don bsdus pa ni bshad ma thag pa'o// gcig tu rtog pas brtags nas smras pa'i phyir// blo gsal rnams kyis 'jug pa'i sgo min zhes// 'ga' zhig bdag la smod pa'i skabs srid na// tshig phreng bu mo'i bzhin la cher chags pa'i// bshes gnyen 'ga' zhig rang la cha med kyang*// rigs mthun las kyis bsdus pa'i 'khor nang du// brtags zin brtags nas g.yo sgyu'i nga rgyal smra// de la'ang kho bo lhag par snying rje 'phel// zhes bya ba ni/ dub pa sel ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'o// gsum pa mtshungs ldan rtog pa'i khyad chos rgyas par bshad pa la/ snga phyi'i 'brel btsal ba dang*/ 'brel pa can gyi don dngos so// dang po la mdo'i 'brel dang*/ bstan bcos kyi 'brel lo// dang po ni/ ting 'dzin rnam par mi rtog pa zhes pa'i mdor/ rab 'byor gyis shā ri'i bu la/ rnam par rtog pa med par bshad pa na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rab 'byor la legs so zhes bya ba gnang ste/ shā ri'i bu de ltar na byang sems chen pos thams cad mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis slob pa yin no// shā ri'i bus bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba/

bcom ldan 'das de ltar slob pa'i byang sems chen po chos gang gang dang gang la slob pa lags zhes dris pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ rnam rtog bzhi po ldan rten pa// zhes bshad na/ ji ltar ldan pa'i tshul 'chad do zhes ston pa ni/ rnam par rtog pa bzhi dang ldan pa yang*/ zhes pa'o// 'di ldan pa'i don la/ bzhed pa'i rnam grangs bkod pa dang*/ 'phags seng gi bzhed pa ngos bzung ba'o// dang po la shān+ti pa dang*/ a bh+yas/ drod kyi kun nas nyon mongs kyi gzung rtog dgu srab mor byas shing ma spangs pa na/ de dag dang ldan pa yin/ rtse mos rnam byang gzung rtog dgu srab mor byas shing ma spangs pa na/ de dag dang ldan pa yin/ rtog pa snga ma dgu spong ngo*// de bzhin du bzod pa dang chos mchog gis rim pa bzhin/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang srab mor byed cing*/ ma spangs pas ldan/ rnam byang gzung rtog spong ngo*// zhes bzhed/ nyi khri gzhung 'grel las/ nyan thos kyis rtog pa ched du gnyer nas spong bas dman la/ byang sems kyis ched du gnyer nas mi spong ste/ rab 'bring tha ma gsum la/ tha ma rnam rtog gi rang bzhin la dpyad na ma grub pas spong mi dgos/ 'bring ni rang 'byung*/ rang zhi/ rab rnam rtog gzhan du brten te rnam rtog de nyid ye shes su shar bas so// zhes gsung*/ nyi khri snang ba las/ de la nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun par dang po dang*/ gnyis pa dag ni go rim bzhin du gzung ba'i rnam par rtog pa gnyis su 'gyur ba yin la/ gsum pa dang bzhi pa dag kyang 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa gnyis yin no// zhes gsungs pa la brten nas/ bod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams/ dgag rtog ngo bor ldan pa dang*/ sgrub rtog spang byar ldan pa'i bzhed tshul sogs mang du snang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ bdag gi blo la 'di ltar snang ste/ spang byar ldan zhes bya ba dang*/ nyon mongs byed du ldan zhes bya ba/ don la de ltar yin du chug kyang*/

cung zad yi ge'i don la ma zhugs te/ de ltar bshad na/ mi ldan pa'i don du bshad par 'gro ba'i phyir/ la la na re/ rnam rtog bzhi po spong rten pa// zhes pa yod zer ba brdzun gyi bshad pa ste/ spangs pa dang ldan pa'i skad dod a nan+ta dang*/ man+ta gtan 'gal yin pa'i phyir ldan tsam gyis rnam gzhag gsungs pa rnams dang shin tu 'gal ba'i phyir ro// des na ldan pa'i don ni mtshungs par ldan pa'o// 'o na gang dang gang mtshungs par ldan zhe na/ grangs bzhin du mtshungs par ldan te/ drod ni/ kun nas nyon mongs kyi gzung ba rang bzhin med pa la gsal snang dang por mched pa yin pas/ kun nas nyon mongs kyi gzung rtog dbang ldan du yod cing*/ lhag ma gsum mngon gyur dang mtshungs par ldan/ de bzhin du/ rtse mor/ kun nas nyon mongs kyi gzung rtog mngon gyur dngos su ldan pa 'gags pas 'dzin rtog gnyis mngon gyur dang dngos su ldan/ rnam byang gzung rtog dbang dang ldan/ bzod pa la rnam byang gzung rtog mngon gyur dngos su ldan pa 'gags pas/ btags 'dzin rtog pa mngon gyur dang*/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dbang dang ldan/ chos mchog la/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa mngon gyur du ldan pa 'gags pas/ btags 'dzin rtog pa dbang dang ldan/ mthong lam bar chad med la/ mthong spangs rtog pa mngon gyur bzhi 'gags pas mthong spangs rtog pa'i sa bon dang ldan no// mdor na sbyor lam bzhi po de/ rtog pa mngon gyur bzhi la rim pa bzhin du gnod pa byed bzhin pa yin pas/ sbyor lam bzhi po de mthong spangs rtog pa mngon gyur gsum dang*/ gnyis dang*/ gcig dang ldan zhing*/ tha ma ni mngon gyur gcig dang yang mi ldan no// thams cad kyang thams cad kyi dbang dang sa bon dang ldan pa la ni khyad par med do// 'di ni 'phags seng gi bzhed pa dri ma med pa yin te/ nyi khri snang bar/ go rim bzhin du zhes dang*/ don gsal 'dir/ grangs bzhin zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/

sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis/ nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa'i gnas skabs de dag ni rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pa'i phyir/ mthong bas spang bar bya ba gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa yin no// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// 'di ni rnam bshad kyi mthar thug gi dgongs pa yin pas gzhan du skad cig bsam par mi bya'o// gnyis pa 'brel pa can gyi don dngos la/ bshad bya'i mdo ni/ shā ri'i bus dris pa'i lan du/ shā ri'i bu chos 'di dag ni byis pa so so skye bos ji ltar mngon par chags par bya ba de lta bu'i rnam par yod pa min no// gsol pa bcom ldan 'das 'o na ji ltar mchis pa lags/ bka' stsal pa/ ji ltar med pa de ltar yod pa min pas/ de'i phyir med ces bya'o// zhes sogs so// mdo'i don bstan bcos kyis ji ltar bkrol ba ni/ gzhi dang de yi gnyen po yis// zhes sogs te/ nyi khri snang ba las/ de la gzung ba'i rnam par rtog pa dang po ni/ dngos po thams cad kho na yin la/ gnyis pa ni/ rnam par byang ba'i dngos po kho na yin te/ de ni gzung ba'i rnam par rtog pa 'di dag gi khyad par yin no// de ltar byas nas brjod pa/ gzung ba'i rnam par rtog pa dang po gang yin pa de ni gnyis pa'ang yin no// zhes bya ba ni tshig snga ma dang ldan pa'o// re zhig dang po de ni gnyis pa yin pa ni/ dper na gzung ba'i rnam par rtog pa dang por gyur pa dngos po thams cad pa bzhin no// gnyis pa kho na yin gyi/ dang po ma yin pa ni/ gzung ba'i rnam par rtog pa gnyis pa rnam par byang ba tsam la brten pa bzhin no// zhes gsungs shing rtog pa 'di dag mthong spangs rtog pa kho nar bzhed/ sgom spangs rtog pa 'chad pa na/ gang zag tu gdags pa dang*/ gdags pa'i rgyu la brten pa zhes gsungs shing*/ rdzas btags kyi tha snyad mi bzhed par mngon/ slob dpon gyis rtog pa 'di dag mthong sgom gnyis cha'i spang byar bzhed cing*/

gzung rtog la kun nas nyon mongs gzung rtog dang*/ rnam byang gzung rtog ces pa'i tha snyad mdzad nas/ gnyis po 'gal bar bzhed/ 'bum phrag gsum pa na re/ rnam byang la'ang*/ nyan thos kyi dang*/ byang sems kyi rnam byang gnyis su phye bas skabs lnga pa'i rtog pa rnams kyang 'dis bsdus pa yin no zhes bzhed/ bod phal che ba rtog pa'i ngo bo dgag rtog tu bzhed/ lo chen na re/ rdzas 'dzin sgrub rtog ni/ nyon sgrib yin pas 'dir rdzas 'dzin shes sgrib ni dgag rtog dang*/ gsum po bsgrub rtog tu bzhed/ dpal sangs rgyas ye shes/ gal te gnyis po nges 'byed bzhi dgag rtog dang*/ spang bya rtog pa bzhi bsgrub rtog tu bzhed/ rnam bshad kyi dgongs pa'ang 'di nyid du bzhed/ dgag rtog bzhi dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i stobs kyis bsgrub rtog bzhi spang byar ldan pa'i phyir/ de phyir rnam bshad las spang byar bshad pa dang*/ 'dir mtshungs ldan du bshad pa'ang gzhan du bsam par mi bya ste/ sbyor lam snga ma dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i rtog pa mngon gyur de phyi ma rnams dang 'dzin stangs 'gal ba'i phyir/ de lta na'ang*/ mngon gyur dbang ldan du gnas pa la ni gnod par nus pa min te/ mngon sum gyi yul can min pa'i phyir ro// 'grel chen las/ dang po rgyu ma lta bu'o zhes rnam par 'jog par byed pa mngon par brjod pa dang bcas pa ni de'i rjes su mthun pa yin gyi/ gnyen po nyid du gyur pa ni min no// zhes gsungs pas so// rnam bshad kyi dgongs pa/ yang na rnam rtog bzhi po ldan pa ni mthong lam ste/ sa bon dang ldan pa'i phyir ro// brten pa ni sbyor lam ste/ de ltar na theg pa chen po'i sbyor lam chos can/ theg dman gyi sbyor lam las rnam rtog ldan tshul gyi sgo nas khyad par 'phags te/ mthong spangs rtog pa'i sa bon kho na dang ldan pa'i mthong lam de ma thag 'dren nus pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i don te/

'dir gzhan ldan rnams spyod do// skabs lnga par rtog pa dbang ldan la dgongs nas 'jug pa gzung rtog dang*/ rdzas 'jig rtog pa 'gag pa dus mnyam/ btags 'dzin rtog pa dang*/ ldog pa gzung rtog 'gag pa dus mnyam par bshad do// spros pa lhag ma ni skabs lnga par 'chad do// gsum pa yongs 'dzin dge bshes rgyas par bshad pa la/ snga phyi'i 'brel btsal ba la/ mdo'i 'brel ni 'og nas 'byung la/ bstan bcos kyi 'brel ni/ yongs 'dzin rtog pa'i 'jug thogs su gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ khyod kyi stobs kyis rtogs pa bzhi po theg chen sbyor lam gyi khyad chos su go nus pa'i phyir/ de ltar bstan pa na rtog pa'i khyad chos gnyis kyi dbus su chud pa'i phyir/ mdor bstan du yongs 'dzin sngar gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ rgyu dang rnam rtog bzhi ldan pa// zhes bstan na/ yi ge lci yang gi sdebs sbyor zhig par 'gyur bas/ de mi 'byung ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni tshigs su bcad pa sbyar ba dang mthun par zhes sogs/ yang na rin chen bang mdzod las/ yongs 'dzin de'i stobs kyis nyon mongs pa byang chub kyi lam du sgyur ba'i phyir ces pa'i don du bshad/ 'brel pa can gyi don dngos la/ bshad bya'i mdo dgod pa ni/ btags 'dzin rtog pa'i skabs su/ gzugs nas stobs bcu'i bar gyi chos thams cad sgyu ma dang gzhan min par bstan pa la/ rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang sems chen po theg pa la gsar du zhugs pas bstan pa 'di thos na/ zhum zhing kun tu zhum pa la 'god de/ dngangs pa dang*/ kun tu skrag pa dang*/ kun tu skrag pas zin par mi 'gyur lags sam/ bka' stsal pa/ de thabs mi mkhas pa dang mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi lag tu song bar ma gyur na ni/ de zhum zhing kun tu zhum pa la sogs par mi 'gyur ro// zhes sogs dang*/ gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das gang dag gis yongs su bzung bas zhum pa la sogs par mi 'gyur ba'i byang sems chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen de gang lags/

bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor byang sems chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ gang de la gzugs mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal ba dang*/ bdag med pa dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ dben pa la sogs par ston cing*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma gtogs pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su bsngor mi 'jug pa'o// zhes sogs so// mdo don bstan bcos kyis ji ltar bkral ba ni/ sems mi 'gong ba nyid la sogs// zhes sogs te mdor bstan gyi yongs 'dzin de gang yin dris pa'i lan no// rtsa ba'i don 'grel pas bshad pa la/ grol sde gnyis/ mdo snga ma cig shos dang*/ sems mi 'gong ba nyid la sogs// de yi mi mthun phyogs bor ba// rnam pa kun tu yongs 'dzin yin// zhes pas nang thabs mkhas kyi yongs 'dzin bstan/ mdo phyi ma shos dang*/ ngo bo nyid med sogs ston byed// de yi mi mthun phyogs bor ba// rnam pa kun tu yongs 'dzin yin// zhes pas phyi dge bshes kyi yongs 'dzin bstan par bzhed do// nyi khri snang ba las/ thabs mkhas pa dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni byang chub sems dpa'i yongs 'dzin yin no// zhes gang gsungs pa de la/ thabs la mkhas pa'i dbang du mdzad nas/ zhes dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dbang du mdzad nas gsungs pa ni/ zhes bshad pas so// slob dpon ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen thabs la mkhas pa zhes gcig tu mdzad do// sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs ni/ 'dir yongs 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi dbang du byas pa min gyi/ byang sems kyi dbang du 'dzin par bzhed/ 'dir dar ṭīka pa/ sogs khongs nas gang zag gi bdag med ston par mdzad pa ni/ mdo ma gzigs par gsal lo// gsum pa 'jug bya bsgrub pa'i yan lag gi chos la/ bsgrub pa'i rten/ bsgrub pa'i dmigs pa/ bsgrub pa'i ched du bya ba/ sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo de dang bzhir nges te/ 'di dag las gang rung gcig ma tshang na'ang sgrub pa'i bya ba mi rdzogs pa'i phyir ro// dang po la snga phyi'i 'brel btsal ba dang*/

'brel pa can gyi don dngos gnyis so// dang po la/ mdo'i 'brel ni/ gong du byang chub sems dpa' zhes lan mang du gsungs pa las 'phros pa'o// bstan bcos kyi 'brel pa ni/ nges 'byed cha mthun gyi 'og tu sgrub pa'i rten du gyur pa'i rigs 'chad pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ nges 'byed sgrub pa la rag las/ sgrub pa yang sgrub pa'i rten la rag las pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa'i dbang du byas na/ sgrub pa dang ldan pa la zhes sogs so// gnyis pa 'brel pa can dngos la/ rten rigs kyi dbye ba dang*/ rigs la rtsod pa spang ba/ dang po la bshad bya'i mdo ni/ de nas rab 'byor gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba'i tshig gi don gang lags/ bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don ni tshig gi don med pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub la ni skye ba'am yod pa nyid yod pa'am dmigs pa min te/ de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'i tshig gi don ni tshig gi don med pa ste zhes sogs so// don ni nyi snang las/ brten par byang chub rdzas su med pa'i 'thad pas skye mched drug gi chos nyid kyi rigs ni byang chub sems dpa'i sgra 'jug pa'i rgyu yin gyi/ dngos por gyur pa'i tshig gi don ni ma yin no zhes bya bar bstan te/ zhes pa ltar ro// mdo de dag gi don 'chad pa ni/ rtogs pa yi ni chos drug dang*// zhes sogs te/ 'di la bzhed pa'i rnam grangs bkod pa dang*/ slob dpon gyi lugs brjod pa dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ nyi snang las/ sgrub pa'i rten brjod par bya ste/ rigs zhes bya ba'i don to// de ni sgrub pa'i chos kyi gnas skabs tha dad pa'i dbye bas rnam pa bcu gsum du 'gyur ro zhes rten bcu gsum gyi rnam gzhag mdzad cing*/ yum gyi mdor rtogs pa'i chos drug re re la dgu dgur phye ba yang rtog pa dgu'i dbye ba dang bstun pa yin la/

gnyen po rtogs pa'i chos drug gis mi mthun phyogs rtog pa dgu spong ba'i gnas skabs la/ gnyen po dang spong ba'i sgrub pa gnyis bzhag cing*/ mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i yul can gyi rnam par rtog pa gnyis kyang spangs pa'i gnas skabs la de dag de dag la yongs su gtugs pa bzhag de dag ni sa bdun pa man chad do// lhag ma bzhi ni sa brgyad pa dgu pa bcu pa sangs rgyas kyi sa bzhi la 'jog par mngon no// gser gleng pa/ bdun brgyad gnyis rtogs pa'i chos drug pa la sbyor/ chos kyi bshes gnyen ni/ dang po gnyis sbyor lam gyis bsdus/ lnga pa mthong lam gyis bsdus/ drug pa ni sgom pa'i lam gyis bsdus/ bdun pa dang dgu pa ni/ de dag nyid kyis bral ba dang*/ bral ba'i thob pa gnyis so// brgyad pa ni sa 'od byed pa nas sa drug pa'i bar ro// bcu pa ni/ sa bdun pa'o// bcu gcig pa ni/ sa mi g.yo ba nas chos kyi sprin gyi bar ro// bcu gnyis pa ni/ skye ba gcig gis thogs pa dang*/ srid pa tha ma pa'o// bcu gsum pa ni/ khyad par gyi lam rdo rje lta bu'o// zhes dang*/ gang dag tha mar bstan pa 'di sangs rgyas kyi sa la sbyor bar byed pa ni mi rigs te/ de lta na/ sngar smos pa'i byang sems rnam pa bcu gsum zhes pa ji ltar bgrang*/ zhes gsungs te/ 'di 'phags pa 'gog pa yin nam snyam bud+dha shrīs/ drug pa sa bdun pa man gyis sgom/ bdun pa brgyad pa dgu pa gsum/ sa brgyad pa dgu pa bcu pa gsum yang ngo*// bcu pa bcu gcig pa bcu gnyis pa gsum yang rim pa bzhin/ sa brgyad pa dgu pa bcu pa gsum gyi yon tan khyad par can no// bcu gsum pa ni sa bcu pa'i khyad par lam na yod par bzhed/ dpal mar me mdzad kyis/ sa mtshams chos drug gsal ba ste// bdun no chos drug re re la'ang*// yod pa nyid du dpyad na gnang*// dper na drod kyis bar chad med// gnyen po spong ba rnam grol na// yongs su gtugs pa bzhi po ni// khyad par lam na yod pa'o// chos drug gzhan la'ang de bzhin sbyar// zhes gsungs te shin tu legs par snang ngo*// gnyis pa slob dpon gyi bzhed pa la'ang*/

sher blo'i bsdus don las/ nges 'byed cha bzhi'i stobs kyis chos dbyings la ltas te/ sgom lam chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs par sbyangs nas gnyen pos mi mthun phyogs drungs 'byin par byed cing*/ rloms par mi byed do// rlom pa med bzhin du/ snying rje dang shes rab dag gis thun mong min pa'i chos thob pas theg pa gsum la sems can 'dul ba na sangs rgyas nyid thob par 'gyur te/ zhes gsung*/ rnam bshad las gsungs pa ni/ go rim/ grangs nges/ rten ngos bzung ba dang gsum/ dang po la rtogs pa'i chos drug ni/ sbyor lam bzhi dang*/ mthong lam dang*/ sa bdun pa man chad kyi sgom lam dang drug gnyen po sa brgyad pa'i bar chad med lam dang*/ spang pa sa brgyad pa'i nyon sgrib spangs pa'i rnam grol lam dang*/ de dag yongs su gtugs pas sa brgyad par shes sgrib spangs pa'i rnam grol lam dang*/ sa brgyad pa'i yon tan khyad par can/ shes rab snying brtser bcas pa dang*/ sa dgu pas bsdus pa slob ma thun mong min pa dang*/ sa bcu pas bsdus pa/ gzhan don go rim du byed pa dang*/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes kyis bsdus pa/ ye shes rtsol ba mi mnga' bar 'jug pa'i bar ro// sa brgyad pa kho na la spong ba'i sgrub pa sogs bzhi 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ bshad pa 'jug pa las/ sa brgyad pa la dri ma de dag rtsa bcas nye bar zhi gyur cing*// nyon mongs spangs shing sa gsum bla mar gyur kyang*// zhes dang*/ rgyan las/ yid dang 'dzin dang rnam par rtog /gyur phyir rnam par mi rtog pa// zhes dang*/ srid dang zhi bar mi rtog pa// zhes gsungs pa rnams sa brgyad pa kho na'i dbang du byas par snang ba'i phyir ro// 'ag ya go ri'i mdo las/ sa bdun pa man chad la shes pa'i lam dang*/ sa brgyad pa yan chad la spong ba'i lam du bshad/ mdo sde rgyan las/ bdun pa man la rtogs pa rgyas pa'i sa zhes bshad do// dar ṭīka pa/ rkun po phyir phyung ba dang*/

zhes pas/ bar chad med lam kho na'i sgrub pa bstan pa dang*/ bar chad med lam rdzogs par skyes pa dang*/ ngo skal gyi spang bya'i sa bon 'gags pa dus mnyam par bstan pa'i don du bzhed pa ni rim pa ltar mi rigs te/ gnyen po dang*/ spong ba gnyis la yum gyi mdo so sor gsungs pa ltar nyi snang du 'di gnyis so sor phye nas gsungs pa ma mkhyen pa'am mkhyen bzhin du 'gal bar smras pa gang rung du gsal ba'i phyir ro// yang khyed gnyen po bar chad med lam skye ba la mngon du phyogs pa dang*/ mi mthun phyogs kyi sa bon 'gags pa la mngon du phyogs pa gnyis la mdo so sor drang na/ bcu gsum gyis kha bskong ba mi 'thad de/ bcu gsum po 'di ni snga ma bas phyi ma skye ba rtogs pa'i go rim du slob dpon bzhed la/ gnyis po de dus mnyam pa'i phyir slob dpon de ltar bzhed de/ 'grel chen las/ de ltar rtogs pa'i go rim yin pa'i phyir 'di ni go rim yin no zhes gsungs pas so// yang khyed kyis gnyen po'i mdo 'dren pa na/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba na/ mun pa'i gnas med ces khyed rang gi rtog pas btags pa'i mdo bzos nas drangs pa'ang mkhyen dgos te/ mdo las ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba'i 'od la gnas med cing mi dmigs zhes 'byung bas so// de ltar yang nyi khri snang bar gzigs shig yang 'di gnyis gcig tu mdzad na ni/ bcu gsum gang yin ston dgos so// 'o na gzhung las/ dus mnyam zhes bshad pa ji ltar drangs zhe na/ khyed ltar na/ dpe don phyin ci log par song ste/ rkun po byung ba dang*/ sgo 'phar bcad pa dus mi mnyam pa'i phyir/ des dpe gnyis ni bar chad med lam dang*/ rnam grol lam so so'i dper smos pa yin gyi/ dus mnyam pa'i dper smos pa min pa/ dus mnyam pa zhes pa ni/ zhar la spang gnyen skye 'gag byed tshul smos pa yin no// yang dar ṭīka pa/ 'dir mthong sgom gnyis kyi bar chad med lam spyir 'dzin par bzhed pa ni gzhung la ma brtags pa ste/
