skabs don bor bar song ste/ sher phyin dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa nas bshad pa'i nyan thos kyi lam gyi dmigs rnam dang*/ mngon pa nas bshad pa gnyis don mi gcig bzhin du/ mngon pa nas bshad pa de 'dir khas blangs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun la/ snga phyi'i 'brel btsal ba dang*/ 'brel pa can dngos so// dang po la/ nyan rang gi rtogs rigs yar ldan du mngon sum du mthong zin rgyun ldan du sgom par byed pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam ni mi srid par skabs gsum pa nyid du 'chad par 'gyur la/ de'i rtogs rigs mngon sum du mthong ba'i mthong lam ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i shes par bya ba'i nyan thos kyi lam yin na de'i rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun de ston dgos so zhe na/ bshad pa zhes ston pa ni bden pa bzhi yongs su shes pa ni sogs so// gnyis pa la bshad bya'i mdo ni/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ kau shi ka legs par nyon la yid la zung shig dang*/ ji ltar byang sems chen po yum la gnas par bya ba dang*/ mi bya ba bdag gis bshad do// kau shi ka gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong ngo*// tshor ba dang*/ 'du shes dang*/ 'du byed rnams dang*/ rnam par shes pa ni rnam par shes pas stong ngo*// zhes pa nas/ sa bcu ma dmigs pa'i tshul gyis gnas par mi bya'o// zhes pa'i bar ro// de'i don ni/ 'phags pa nyan thos lam la ni// zhes sogs rtsa 'grel lo// don ni/ spyir theg chen sbyor lam gyi theg pa gsum char gyi rtogs rigs tshang bar thob pa'i theg chen mthong lam gyi rgyu byed pa las 'dir ni nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs mngon sum du mthong ba'i mthong lam gyi rgyu byed pa'i cha nas bshad cing*/ 'og tu rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs mngon sum du mthong ba'i mthong lam gyi rgyu byed pa'i cha nas bshad pa yin no// gnyis pa rang rgyal gyi lam gyis lam shes mtshon nas bstan pa la/ lam gyi khyad par byed chos dang*/

khyad gzhi lam gyi ngo bo gnyis/ dang po la 'brel ni/ shes par bya ba'i nyan rang gi lam gnyis kyi bar du rang rgyal gyi lam gyi khyad par byed chos 'chad rigs te/ de ma bshad na lam gnyis la khyad par med pas so sor 'chad mi rigs so// snyam pa'i log rtog skye srid pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ nyan thos kyi lam gyi 'jug thogs su zhes sogs so// dngos la/ bshad bya'i mdo ni/ de nas 'khor de rnams las lha'i bu kha cig 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ gang gnod sbyin rnams kyis gnod sbyin rnams kyi skad dang*/ tshig dang*/ smras pa dang*/ rab tu skad pa gang yin pa de dag ni smras par gyur na shes par rung gi gang 'phags pa rab 'byor yum 'chad pa dang*/ rab tu brjod pa dang*/ ston pa dang*/ nye bar ston pa de ni shes par mi rung ngo*// rab 'byor gyis lha'i bu de dag gi sems kyi rtog pa sems kyis shes nas smras pa/ lha'i bu dag 'di ltar yi ge gcig kyang ma brjod de/ gang ma brjod pa de thos par mi rung ngo*// gang ma thos pa de shes par mi rung ngo*// zhes gsung*/ de'i don bstan bcos su bsdus pa ni/ rang byung bdag nyid rtogs pa'i phyir// gzhan gyis bstan kyang mi dgos la// zhes gsungs/ lam bgrod tshul gyi khyad par yang gi sgras chos ston tshul gyi khyad par de bstan/ de nas lha'i bu dag 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ kye ma 'phags pa rab 'byor 'di ni yum gsal bar byed pa ste/ zab pa bas kyang shin tu zab par ston par byed/ phra ba bas kyang shin tu phra bar ston par byed/ ces pa'i don/ bse ru lta bu'i ye shes ni// zab pa nyid du mngon par brjod// ces gsungs te/ snga ma'i don bsdus pa'o// mdor na rab 'byor gyis yi ge gcig kyang ma brjod pa ni/ chos ston tshul gyi khyad par yin la/ ma brjod kyang*/ lha'i bu rnams la rtogs pa skyes pa ni lam bgrod tshul gyi khyad par shugs la ston pa ste/

rab 'byor rang gis kyang gzhan gyi brjod pa la ma ltos par yum don khong du chud par don gyis 'phangs pa'i phyir/ de'i phyir mdo las/ chos ston tshul gyi khyad par dngos su bstan pas/ gcig shos don gyis bstan/ bstan bcos su lam bgrod tshul gyi khyad par dngos su bstan/ gcig shos don gyis bstan de yang zhes pa mdo la bsnyeg pa'i tshig go /'dir khyad chos gnyis su bzhed pa ni slob dpon gyi lugs yin la/ 'phags pa ni/ 'dir mdo dang bstan bcos gnyis ka las/ chos ston tshul gyi khyad par kho na bstan cing*/ mdo gzhan las lam bgrod tshul gyi khyad par yang gsungs par 'chad/ gnyis pa rtsod pa spang ba la/ snga phyi'i 'brel btsal ba ni/ mdo las/ rab 'byor yum 'chad pa dang*/ yi ge gcig kyang ma brjod par bshad pa 'gal lo// zhes ston pa ni/ yang ji ltar sgra med par chos ston snyam pa'i/ zhes sogs so// bstan bcos kyi 'brel ni/ yang zhes pa'i nus pa la rtsod pa'o// slob dpon ltar na/ bse ru lta bu'i ye shes ni// zab pa nyid du mngon par brjod// ces pas/ chos ston tshul gyi khyad par ston pa la rtsod pa yin no// 'brel pa can dngos la/ 'di la yum gsum char na/ bshad bya'i mdo logs pa mi snang la/ slob dpon chos shes ni/ mdo'i yi ge gnyis zhes 'chad/ 'on kyang mdo snga ma nyid 'di'i yang bshad bya'i mdo yin no// bstan bcos su ji ltar bsdus pa ni/ sgra bcas kyi chos ston pa med kyang*/ gdul bya'i rgyud la rtogs pa skyed nus pa mi 'gal te/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis de ltar nus pa'i phyir/ dper na sangs rgyas bzhin/ zhes ston pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' 'di sangs rgyas su gyur nas/ zhes sogs rtsa 'grel gyis ston no// dpe sgrub pa ni/ rnam par ma brtags zhes sogs so// gnyis pa shes bya'i lam dngos la/ mdo'i 'brel ni gong du/ rab 'byor ni zab pa bas zab pa la 'jug ces pa la 'phros so// bstan bcos kyi 'brel ni/

khyad chos de dag dang ldan pa'i bse ru lta bu'i lam dngos te gang zhe na/ de ltar khyad zhugs pa brjod nas zhes sogs so// 'brel pa can dngos la bshad bya'i mdo ni rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ gzugs ni zab pa ma yin/ phra ba ma yin no// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gzugs kyi rang bzhin ni zab pa ma yin/ phra ba ma yin pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar la sbyar nas gsungs pas ni rang rgyal rnams gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pas khyad zhugs pa bstan/ yang mdo las de na gnas brtan rab 'byor la chos nyan pa ji lta bu zhig btsal bar bya snyam pa dang*/ zhes pa ste/ 'dzin rtog ma spangs par gzung rtog spong ba ji ltar 'thad snyam pa'o// lha'i bu bdag la chos mnyan pa ni/ sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ rmi lam lta bur btsal bar bya'o// zhes sogs te/ yul sgyu ma'i rta glang sogs la bden 'dzin sgro 'dogs chod kyang*/ yul can shes pa la bden 'dzin gyi sgro 'dogs ma chod pa dper byas pa'o// zhes kun mkhyen chos rje gsung ngo*// yang mdo las/ yum 'di len par byed pa su dag 'byung bar 'gyur/ zhes dris pa'i lan du/ phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems chen po rnams sam/ bden pa mthong ba'i gang zag gam/ dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa/ bsam pa yongs su rdzogs pa dag gam/ sngon gyi rgyal ba la bya ba byas pa dag gam/ sangs rgyas mang po la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa dag gam/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin pa dag len par 'gyur te/ zhes pas lam pa gang zag gi rten dang*/ lha rnams kyis mngon par gtor ba'i me tog 'di dag ni bdag gis sngon chad lha'i gnas na'ang yod par ma mthong ste/ 'di dag ni sprul pa'o// zhes pas chos nyid rigs kyi rten de bstan/ don ni/ byang sems kyi rgyud la yar ldan du thob pa'i rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs de'i rten gyi gang zag ni/ tshogs lam pa/ sbyor lam pa/ mthong lam pa gsum yin no// zhes pa'i don no// 'o na sgom lam pa ci'i phyir ma bstan zhe na/

rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs sgom par byed pa'i byang sems kyi sgom lam med pa'i phyir ro// yang sprul pa'i me tog la rang bzhin med kyang kun rdzob tu yul dus so sor nges pa bzhin du/ dngos por gyur pa'i rten med kyang kun rdzob tu yul dus so sor nges pa bzhin du/ dngos por gyur pa'i rten med kyang kun rdzob tu rtogs pa'i rten so sor nges zhes pa'i don no// de dag gi don bstan bcos su bsdus pa ni/ g.yag ṭīka ltar na/ lam shes nyid kyi tshul la ni// 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dag gi /rnam pa mi dmigs sgo nas ni// gzung don rtog pa spong phyir dang*// 'dzin pa mi spong phyir dang ni// zhes sbyar bar bshad de/ 'grel chen dang mthun no// de ltar byas na shes bya'i lam gyi rnam gzhag khyad par gsum ldan gyi sgo nas bshad pa dang*/ lam de mi dmigs par bsgom pa'i lam shes gnyis bshad do// de skad du yang 'grel chen las/ ji skad bshad pa'i nyan thos kyi bden pa bzhi'i rnam pa mi dmigs par sgom pas/ dngos po ji lta ba bzhin du rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dang rjes su mthun par byang chub sems dpas yongs su shes par bya ba yin no// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun la/ snga phyi'i 'brel ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i rang rgyal gyi lam gyi rtogs rigs mngon sum du mthong ba'i theg chen gyi mthong lam gyi rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun yod dam med/ yod na bshad dgos so zhe na/ de yod par ston pa ni/ nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa thob na ji skad bshad pa'i lam skye bas/ zhes so// 'brel pa can dngos la/ mdo ni/ kye ma gnas brtan rab 'byor ni btags pa dang yang mi 'gal la/ chos nyid kyang ston pa ni shes rab zab mo dang ldan no// zhes sogs so// de dag gi don bsdus pa ni/ btags pa'i chos nyid mi 'gal bar// sogs so/ don ni/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam la theg pa gsum char gyi rtogs rigs mngon sum du mthong ba'i theg chen mthong lam gyi rgyu byed pa'i nus pa'i cha gsum las/

'dir ni rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs mngon sum du mthong ba'i mthong lam gyi rgyu byed pa'i cha nas bshad do// 'dir yul can lam shes kyi rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun ston pa ni min te/ mtshams sbyar la dpags pas shes so// grol sde gnyis ltar na/ 'di yang*/ 'phags pa rang rgyal lam la ni// zhes ston nas/ gzhung gong 'og gnyis kas theg chen sbyor lam nyan rang gi sbyor lam las/ dmigs rnam gyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags par bsgrub par bzhed do// yang 'dir bshad pa/ theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun yin na 'grel chen du skabs dang por kha 'phangs ga la dgos zhe na/ theg chen gyi rtogs rigs mngon sum du mthong ba'i mthong lam gyi rgyun sgom pa'i sgom lam 'chad par 'gyur ba ltar/ de'i rgyu sbyor lam yang 'chad dgos so zhe na/ 'grel chen las/ mthong lam de'i nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen par bshad pa las gzung bar bya'o zhes bshad/ de ltar na/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam la theg pa gsum gyi rtogs rigs kyi dbye bas cha gsum yod pa ltar de nyid lan gsum bshad pa yin no// gsum pa shes par bya ba'i byang sems kyi lam la/ mdo'i 'brel ni/ brgya byin gyis smras pa/ yum gang las btsal bar bya zhes pa ste/ don ni/ gsar du lhags pa'i 'khor rnams la rnam mkhyen gyi rtogs pa skyed dgos zhes pa'i don no// bstan bcos kyi 'brel ni/ lus rnam gzhag tu/ 'di dang gzhan pa'i yon tan gyi// phan yon che ba mthong ba'i lam// zhes bstan pa de gang zhe na/ de 'chad do zhes ston pa ni/ rang sangs kyi lam gyi 'jug thogs su/ zhes so// 'brel pa can dngos la/ mdo ni/ shā ri'i bus smras pa/ kau shi ka yum 'di ni rab 'byor gyi le'u las btsal bar bya'o// de nas brgya byin gyis smras pa/ rab 'byor shā ri'i bu 'di skad du yum ni rab 'byor gyi le'u las btsal bar bya'o zhes zer na/

de khyed kyi mthu'am byin gyis brlabs pa yin/ rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ 'di ni bdag gi mthu dang byin gyis rlabs ma yin no// 'o na su'i mthu/ de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu dang byin gyis brlabs so// zhes pa nas/ gang las btsal bar bya zhes zer ba ni/ gzugs las kyang btsal bar mi bya/ zhes sogs so// don ni/ rnam mkhyen ni/ sngar rab 'byor gyi le'ur bshad zin pas slar bshad na/ 'khor snga ma rnams/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos zlos pa gsungs so zhes dogs par 'gyur bas/ rab 'byor la rgyu'i chos tsam zhig dris shig ces sgo ba'o// de ltar dris pa na/ rab 'byor gyis kyang sngar bshad pa de dag las rgyu'i chos tsam zhig drangs nas bshad pa'o// bshad pa'i tshul ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kho na'i mthu dang byin gyis rlabs kyis sher phyin rtogs dgos na/ gzhan rnams kyi yul du gyur pa'i lam ni/ rab 'byor gyi le'u las ma bstan nam snyam pa la/ gzugs kyi de bzhin nyid la'ang de bzhin gshegs pa mi dmigs/ de bzhin gshegs pa la'ang gzugs kyi de bzhin nyid mi dmigs zhes sogs kyis shes bzod/ skad cig ma bcu drug bshad cing*/ de lta bu'i rgyu lam shes nyams su blangs pa las 'bras bu rnam mkhyen skye bar 'gyur ro// zhes pa'i don no// gnyis pa mdo'i don bstan bcos su ji ltar bsdus pa ni/ mdo'i rim pa gcig la bstan bshad gnyis su mdzad nas 'chad pa la/ ye shes mdor bstan/ rnam pa rgyas par bshad/ gzhan gyi log rtog dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ bden dang*/ zhes so// tshe 'di'i yon tan phyir mi ldog pa dang*/ tshe rab gzhan gyi yon tan skye ba snga phyi shes pa'i shes rab ces kha che gzhon nu dpal smra/ 'grel chen las ni/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi bsrung ba la sogs pa tshe 'di'i yon tan zhes bshad do// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ mdo las/ tshig lhug par gsungs pa rnams bstan bcos su tshigs su bcad par bsdus pa ni/

de bzhin nyid dang zhes sogs so// 'dir slob dpon gyi dgongs pa 'di ltar mngon te/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos nyid mngon du mthong ba la skad cig ma gcig yin te/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos dbyings cha shas med pa la cha gnyis mi srid pa'i phyir/ de tsam gyis sdug bsngal chos bzod kyi dus su/ mthong spangs ma lus par spangs dgos pa min te/ mthong ba tsam gyis sgro 'dogs sel mi nus pa'i phyir/ 'khrul pas nges par mi byed pas// sgrub pa rab tu 'jug pa yin// zhes pa ltar ro// dar ṭīka mdzad pa/ 'phags pa'i mngon sum la snang ba ma nges pa mi srid de/ blo gros chen pos mthong nyid las// rnam pa thams cad nges par byed// ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro// zhes bya ba dpyad dgos te/ don ni/ 'phags pa'i mngon sum thams cad rang las nges kyi tshad mar ston pa yin gyi/ mngon sum nges pa'i bdag nyid du ston pa min pa'i phyir ro// bden pa mngon par rtogs pa la ni skad cig ma bcu drug yin te/ bden bzhi'i chos nyid la sgro 'dogs sel nus kyi tshad ma bcu drug mnyam gzhag tu rim can du thob pa'i phyir/ tshad ma de dang de skyes pa na/ de'i ngo skal gyi mthong spang spong nus pa yin gyi/ nges shes de dang de mngon du 'gyur dgos pa min no// de ltar na mthong ba la skad cig gcig yin la/ bden pa mngon par rtogs pa la skad cig ma bcu drug yin par 'gyur ro// de lta na'ang phyi ma rnams mthong lam min par mi 'gyur te/ sdug bsngal la chos bzod kyi dus su rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos nyid tsam la nges pa rang stobs kyis 'dren nus su mthong la/ chos bzod phyi ma gsum gyi dus su/ bden pa lhag ma gsum dang 'brel ba'i chos nyid la nges pa 'dren nus kyi tshul du gsar du mthong ba'i phyir/ de ltar yin kyang thug med du mi 'gyur te/ bden pa bzhi las ma gtogs pa'i shes bya med pa'i phyir ro// des na chos bzod bzhi ni/

bar chad med lam gyi ngo bor skye la/ lhag ma bcu gnyis ni rnam grol lam gyi ngo bor skye/ de dag kyang rim can kho nar skye ba yin te/ 'grel chen du de'i rjes la/ zhes bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ dge 'dun nyi shu dang*/ dang po bco lnga la gnas pa/ rgyun zhugs zhugs par bshad pa'i phyir ro// bzod pa brgyad bar chad med lam dang*/ shes pa brgyad rnam grol lam du 'dod pa ni nyan thos pa'i lugs yin gyi/ 'dir min te/ bar chad med pa'i lam gyi rnam pa kun nas nyon mongs pa dang mi ldan pa'i mtshan nyid bzhi'o// zhes nges par bzung ba'i phyir ro// yang 'grel chen du/ rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa dang*/ shes pa brgyad po la mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bshad pas/ mthong lam mnyam gzhag la snang med kyi khyab par 'dod pa'ang bsal ba yin no// zhar la 'ongs pas chog go /gsum pa la khas blangs brjod pa dang*/ de dgag pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyan gyi 'grel byed kha cig na re/ sbyor mthong sgom gsum ston pa'i mdo dang*/ bstan bcos kyis rtogs pa'i ngo bo tsam bstan pa yin gyi/ bsgom bya'i rnam pa ma bstan no// zhes zer ro// zhes ston pa'i dbang du byas pas/ kha cig ni/ zhes sogs so// de dgag pa rigs pas dgag lung gis dgag dang po la chos kyi bshes gnyen ltar na/ mdo gzhung de dag chos can/ mnyam gzhag tu bsgom pa'i rim pa dang*/ rjes thob tu yid la bya ba'i rim pa sogs ma bstan par thal/ gser gling pa ltar na/ rgyu sgom pa'i rim pa dang*/ 'bras bu rab kyi mthar phyin pa cung zad kyang ma bstan par thal/ rnam pa ma bstan pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa cung zad kyang ma bstan par thal lo// zhes ston pa ni/ gzhan dag na re/ zhes sogs so// gnyis pa lung gis dgag pa ni/ gzhan yang*/ dmigs pa dang ni/ zhes sogs so// 'di yang gtso bor mdo la dogs pa spong ba yin te/ 'grel chen las/ rnam pa ma bstan na mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan dang 'gal bar 'gyur ro// zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro// 'di ni lam rkyang pa brjod byar 'dod pa 'gog pa yin no// 'o na 'dir shes bya'i lam tsam zhig bstan nas yul can lam shes tshig gis zin par mi bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/

snga ma gnyis ni shes mthong gis bltas nas 'da' bar bya ba'i lam yin no// zhes bstan pa'i phyir/ shes par bya zhes gsungs shing de'i rigs rgyun goms par byed pa'i sgom lam ma bstan/ 'dir ni mngon du bya ba'i lam du bstan pas/ de mi dmigs par shes pa'ang don gyis grub pa'i phyir te/ ma shes par mngon du bya ba m-i srid pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir/ 'grel chen las/ sbyor lam skabs dang por kha 'phangs pa'i don ni phal cher bshad zin la/ slar yang bsdus te bshad na/ lam shes snga ma gnyis su nyan thos dang*/ rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs la don spyi'i tshul gyis gsal snang thob pa'i sbyor lam 'chad dgos te/ nyan thos lam 'di shes par bya// zhes dang*/ yang dag bsdus par shes par bya// zhes theg chen gyi mthong lam du nyan rang gi rtogs rigs mngon sum du mthong na/ de dang nyan rang dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa la khyad par med dam snyam pa la/ khyad par yod de/ de'i rgyu sbyor lam gnyis la khyad par grub pa'i phyir/ zhes ston dgos la/ 'dir ni de lta bu'i dogs pa med pas bstan mi dgos shing*/ rgyu sbyor lam med pa'ang min te/ sngar skabs dang por bshad pa nyid yin pa'i phyir/ 'o na theg chen gyi mthong lam yang bshad zin pa min nam zhe na/ zin mod de lta na'ang gsar du lhags pa'i 'khor rnams la rgyu'i chos tsam zhig drangs nas bshad pa yin no// zhes pa'i don du bshad/ de 'dra'i dogs pa dgag pa yang skabs don du mi 'gyur ba min te/ nyi snang las/ skabs dang por nges 'byed cha mthun bshad pa na/ nyan rang gi sbyor lam las khyad chos drug gis khyad par 'phags par bstan pa dang*/ skabs gnyis par nges 'byed cha mthun bshad pa nyan rang gi sbyor lam las dmigs rnam gnyis kyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags par bstan pa yin zhes gsungs pas so// de ltar na/ dgos pa mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis/ ldog pa so sor phye nas bshad kyi/

ngo bo mi 'dra ba ni min no// zhes rtogs so// gnyis pa bshad ma thag pa'i mthong lam de la gnas nas mngon du bya ba yin no// zhes shes par bya ba'i phyir/ de'i rigs rgyun goms par byed pa'i sgom lam ston pa la gnyis te/ sgom lam gyi byed pa dang*/ byed pa can gyi sgom lam mo// dang po la snga phyi'i 'brel ni/ sgom lam gyi thog mar de'i byed pa 'chad rigs te/ tshig nyung ba dang*/ 'bras bu la spro ba bskyed pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ mthong ba'i lam gyis zhes sogs so// 'brel pa can dngos la/ mdo ni/ brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ yum 'di ni byang sems chen po rnams dul ba dang*/ nga rgyal ma mchis pa'i slad du nye bar gnas pa ngo mtshar che'o// zhes sogs so// de'i don bsdus pa ni/ kun nas zhi dang thams cad la// zhes sogs so// slob dpon gyis 'di lam gnyis ka'i byed par bzhed de/ shān+ti pa dang*/ a bh+ya zag med sgom pa'i lam kho na'i byed par bzhed/ lo chen gyis byed pa dang po zag bcas sgom lam gyi byed pa/ gnyis pa sgrub pa sgom lam gyi/ gsum pa rnam dag sgom lam gyi/ tha ma gsum thun mong gi byed pa yin no zhes gsung ngo*// bod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams na re/ mthong lam phan yon dang bcas te bshad pas byed pa shugs la grub/ sgom lam byed pa dang bcas te bshad pas phan yon shugs la grub/ ces gsungs so// gnyis pa byed pa can gyi sgom lam la dbye ba bstan te mtshams sbyar/ so so'i rang bzhin phye ste bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ byed pa'i 'og tu sgom pa'i lam ste/ zhes sogs so// 'dir 'phags seng gis/ zag bcas sgom lam dang*/ zag med sgom lam gyi rnam gzhag mdzad/ shān+ti pa/ 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgom lam zhes 'chad/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ dag pa 'jig rten pa dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa zhes 'chad/ mnyal zhig snang bcas dang snang med sgom lam zhes gsung*/

rnam bshad las/ rjes thob dag pa 'jig rten pa dang*/ mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i rang bzhin zhes gsung ste/ don mi gcig pa cher mi snang ngo*// de gnyis kyi khyad par de gang la bya zhe na/ 'bum phrag gsum pa na re/ sa bdun pa man gyi sgom lam rnams zag bcas/ brgyad pa dgu pa'i sgom lam bsgrub pa/ rnam dag ni sgom lam gyi 'bras bu/ dkyus ma'i sgom lam ni rnam kun tu 'chad par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// bcom ldan rigs ral/ sa bdun pa man chad kyi mos bsngo yid rang gsum rnam par rtog pa dang bcas/ sa brgyad pa yan chad kyi ni mos bsngo yid rang gsum yang zag med yin te/ de dang bral ba'i phyir/ zhes bzhed/ snga rabs pa phal cher/ gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi snang ba yod med la bzhed/ rnam bshad las ni/ sgom lam rjes thob rnams mtha' dag la zag bcas zhes bya ste/ gzung 'dzin tha dad pa can gyi shes sgrib dang bcas pa'i phyir/ mnyam gzhag rnams la ni zag med ces bya ste/ de dang bral ba'i phyir ro// dar ṭīka pa/ sgra don 'dres 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang bcas ma bcas la 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ sa brgyad pa yan chad na de med pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la/ spyi'i mtshams sbyor/ so so'i don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de'i phyir sgom pa'i lam zag pa dang bcas pa/ mos pa dang bsngo ba rjes su yi rang ba/ zhes bya ba rnams kyi nang nas zhes pa'o// gsum po rim par ston pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ sher 'byung blo gros dang*/ kha che gzhon nu dpal gyis zag bcas sgom lam la sbyor dngos rjes gsum yod pas zhes bzhed/ rnam bshad las dge rtsa bsog pa dang*/ mi zad pa dang*/ spel bar byed pa gsum yod pas zhes bzhed do// gnyis pa ni/ mos bsngo yi rang gsum las/ dang po la/ dngos dang phan yon gnyis/ dang po la mdo ni/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la las/ yum 'di bris shing glegs bam du chud par bya ste/

bcangs la de la lha'i me tog dang*/ zhes pa nas/ gang la las/ de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i sku gdung mchod rten du rtsal te/ de la me tog la sogs pas mchod pa byas na bsod nams kyi phung po gang 'phel zhus pa'i lan du/ snga ma 'phel bar gsungs so// de dag gi don bsdus pa ni/ mos pa rang gi don dang ni// zhes sogs so// 'dir/ thabs dang mi dmigs pa dag gis// shes rab pha rol phyin la mos// zhes sbyor ro// zhes mkhan chen rin po che gsung ngo*// 'dir mos pa'i ngo bo la shān+ti pa'i dag ldan las/ mos pa dang ni dwang ba dang 'dun pa ste yid ches pa dang 'dod pa'i mtshan nyid do// zhes bzhed/ tshigs gsal las/ ngo bo ni nges par byas nas dngos po la de kho na ltar 'dzin pa'o zhes bzhed/ de la dbye na gsum las/ 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gser gling pa ltar na/ rang snod du rung ba dang*/ gzhan snod du rung ba dang*/ rang gzhan gnyis ka snod du rung ba'i don du yum la dmigs te mos pa bsgom pa gsum yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so// kha che ltar na/ rang don mos pa ni chos sku dang*/ gzhan don mos pa sprul sku dang*/ gnyis don mos pa ni longs sku thob par byed pa'i rgyu yin pas gsum du bzhag go /zhes bzhed/ mos pa gsum po gnas skabs gang du bsgom zhe na/ a bh+ya rang don mos pa drod/ gnyis don mos pa rtse mo/ gzhan don mos pa bzod par bsgom/ lo chen gyis/ rang don mos pa so skye/ gnyis don mos pa sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar/ gzhan don mos pa dag pa sa gsum pa la bzhag go /kha che ba/ gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa bzhi pa rnams la bzhed/ bi ma la mi tras sher snying gi rgya cher 'grel las/ so so skye bo'i sbyor ba'i lam ni mos pas spyod pa'o// de la mos pas spyod pa gsum ni/ rang gi don dang*/ rang dang gzhan gyi don dang*/ rang gzhan gyi don re re la'ang*/ so sor chung ngu la sogs pa'i dbye bas/

rnam pa dgu dgu'o zhes bshad/ spyir mos bsngo yid rang tsam so so skye bo'i gnas skabs na yod la/ 'dir ni sgom lam kho na'i dbang du byas pa yin pas/ 'di ltar 'thad de/ rang don mos pa ni ma dag sa bdun gyi rjes thob kyis bsdus te/ nyon yid ma spangs pas nga rgyal phra mo 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis don mos pa ni sa brgyad pa dang dgu pas bsdus te/ nyon yid gnas gyur pas/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i phyir/ gzhan don mos pa ni sa bcu pas bsdus te/ gzhan don byed tshul sangs rgyas dang mnyam pa'i phyir ro// de skad du yang 'grel chen las/ bdag tu nga rgyal ba'i sa 'og ma zad pa nyid kyi dang po kho na rang gyi don gyi mos pa zhes dang*/ rang dang gzhan mnyam pa nyid kyis rang dang gzhan gyi don gyi mos pa zhes dang*/ 'dir ni gzhan don lhur len pa'o// zhes pa'i don no// jo bo rjes/ sa bzhi sa bdun sa bcu yi// rab tu mos pa gsum po ni// zhes gsungs shing*/ mkhan chen rin po che yang de ltar bzhed do// rtsa ba'i don 'grel pas 'chad pa la/ dge ba'i chos zhes pa/ gser gling pa/ sems bskyed sogs la bzhed/ ar gyis/ bstod bkur bsngags pa gsum la bzhed par snang*/ bzad pa/ bsod nams nyer bdun la bzhed/ rnam bshad las don gsum la bshad/ 'dir sgom pa'i lam gyi dbang du byas/ la las mngon du mi byed ces pa'i don no// 'bum phrag gsum pa/ mngon du byed pa ni gnyis te/ chos nyid mngon du byed pa dang*/ chos sku mngon du byed pa gnyis las/ 'di sgom pa'i lam gyi dbang du byas pas/ dang por chos sku mngon du mi byed ces 'chad/ su ga ta shrī/ 'di 'jig rten chos mchog man gyi sgom lam gyi dbang du byas pas/ chos nyid dang por mngon du mi byed ces 'chad/ ral gri sogs kha cig mos bsngo yi rang gsum so so skye bo'i gnas skabs nas yod kyang*/ 'dir sgom pa'i lam gyi dbang du byas pa'i yin zhes 'chad/

rang lugs ni rnam bshad ltar ro// 'dir mos pa nyi shu rtsa bdun du phye ba ni mi mthun phyogs la mos pa nyi shu rtsa bdun yod pa'i dbye bas so// zhes sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams bzhed/ gnyis pa phan yon la 'brel ni/ mos pa'i 'og tu phan yon bshad rigs te/ spro ba bskyed pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ de sgom pa'i byang chub sems dpa' zhes sogs so// 'brel pa can dngos la/ mdo ni/ la las yum 'di glegs bam du bgyis te mchod pa la sogs dang*/ la las yum 'di glegs bam du bgyis te gzhan la sbyin pa dang*/ la las gzhan gyi drung du song ste/ yum don bzhin bstan pa byed na snga ma snga ma bas phyi ma phyi ma bsod nams lhag par gsungs so// de dag gi don bsdus pa ni/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa la// zhes sogs so// 'dir bstod bkur bsngags pa'i khyad par ni/ yon tan brjod pa chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po ste/ dag ldan las/ dgu mtshan dang po la ni bstod pa chung ngu ste/ yang dag pa'i yon tan brjod pa'o// de nyid kyi gnyis pa la ni/ bkur ba ste 'bring ngo*// de nyid kyi gsum pa la ni/ bsngags pa ste chen po'o// zhes dang*/ grags cha las kyang*/ bstod pa ni bstod pa tsam mo// bkur ba ni 'bring du bstod pa'o// bsngags pa ni cher bstod pa'o// zhes so// ngo bo la 'phags pa shān+ti pa rnams ngag gi rang bzhin la bzhed/ chos kyi bshes gnyen/ 'di dag ni ngag snyan pa'i ngo bstod kyi rang bzhin ni min te/ log par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de la thugs dges pas gnas pa kho na bstod pa yin zhes/ thugs dgyes pa'i cha la bzhed/ bcom ldan ral gri na re/ bstod pa la sogs pa 'di dag ni/ don yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin pa'i thugs dges pa'i cha yin gyi gcam bu sgra'i ngo bo ni min no// zhes pa'i don gyi ji lta ba bzhin brjod pa'i sgra yin gyi gcam bu ste don la mi gnas pa brjod pa min/

zhes pa'i don min te/ yum gyi mdor bstod pa'i sgra nyi shu rtsa bdun mi snang ba'i phyir/ dga' ba byed cing zhes dang*/ rtog pa'i mtshan nyid can zhes pa'i gzhung dang 'gal ba'i phyir dang*/ de dag sgra'i ngo bor 'dod pa rig byed pa'i lugs yin pa'i phyir te/ rig byed pas/ yi ge oṃ ldan phyed dang bzhi// tshad du byas pa snyan par brjod// 'di ni bstod pa smra ba dang*// sgra'i tshangs pa'ang 'di nyid de// bkur la de ltar brjod par bya// yi ge dang ldan tshad sngon bzhin// snyan smra snyan tshig rig byed do// de ni bsngags par 'dod pa'o// zhes bshad pa ltar ro// zhes bzhed/ rnam bshad las ni/ 'di dag de bzhin gshegs pa thugs dgyes pa'i cha sogs la 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ de ni gzhan gyis mi rtogs pas spro ba skye ba'i rgyur mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ zhes gsung*/ gsum pa bsngo ba la/ 'brel ni/ mos pa'i 'og tu bsngo ba 'chad rigs te/ mos pa bsags pa'i dge rtsa byang chub tu bsngo dgos pa'i phyir ro// zhes ston pa ni/ de ltar mos pa la bsngo ba 'byung bas/ zhes sogs so// 'brel ba can dngos la/ bshad bya'i mdo ni/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pas smras pa/ rab 'byor byang sems chen po'i rjes su yid rang ba dang ldan pa'i bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po gang yin pa sems can thams cad dang thun mong du bya ste/ de yang mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis bla med byang chub tu bsngo ba gang yin pa dang*/ zhes pa nas/ bsngo ba 'di ni rab/ dam pa/ phul/ gtso bo dang*/ mchog dang*/ zhes sogs so// de'i don bsdus pa ni/ yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can/ zhes sogs te/ 'di la yang*/ thabs dang mi dmigs pa dag gis// zhes sbyar/ de'i don 'grel pas 'chad pa la/ sher 'byung blo gros ltar na/ snga ma bcu gnyis ni rnam pa yin/ phyi ma bcu gnyis ni dmigs pa yin no// 'bum phrag gsum pa ltar na/

snga ma bcu gnyis ni mtshon bya yin la/ phyi ma bcu gnyis ni mtshan nyid yin par bzhed/ chos shes snga ma ming dang*/ phyi ma don du byas nas 'chad/ bcu gnyis pa 'di yang blo dman pa rnams la phan gdags par bya ba'i phyir bcu gnyis su phye ba yin la/ shes rab rno ba rnams kyis brnyas pa zlog par bya ba'i phyir/ shin tu ma phye ba yin no// zhes 'grel pa las bshad/ 'di yang bsngo tshul gyi ldog pas phye ba yin gyi/ mos pa ltar grangs nges pa ni min no// zhes jo bo sogs phal cher bzhed/ gsum pa rjes su yid rang la/ 'brel ni rdzogs byang du bsngos pa'i dge rtsa de yang yi rang gis mngon par spel dgos pa'i phyir/ bsngo ba'i 'og tu yi rang 'chad ces ston pa ni/ de ltar legs par bsngos pa'i dngos po/ zhes sogs so// dngos la mdo ni/ de nas rab 'byor gyis gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang gi rjes su yi rang ba dang ldan pa'i yongs su bsngo ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad gcig tu bsdus shing sdom ste/ gzhal nas rjes su yi rang ba'i rab kyi rjes su yi rang na/ zhes sogs so// de dag gi don bsdus pa ni/ thabs dang mi dmigs pa dag gis/ zhes sogs so// slar yang mos bsngo yi rang gsum gyi don bsdus nas mjug bsdu ba ni/ de la bsdus pa'i don ni zhes sogs so// mkhan chen rin po ches/ bsngo ba dang yi rang gnyis la'ang*/ bstod bkur bsngags gsum sbyar bar bya zhing*/ mos bsngo yi rangs gsum rtog par 'dod pas ni gzhung tsam yang ma mthong bar zad do// zhes sogs so// rjes su yi rang gis bsod nams mnyam par thob pa'i don la/ snga rabs rnams blo mnyam na bsod nams mnyam/ blo mtho na bsod nams che ba thob/ blo dma' na bsod nams chung bar thob ces gsungs/ bcom ldan ral gri ni/ 'di mi 'thad de/ blo mnyam po kho na'i bsod nams thob tshul ston pa min pa'i phyir/

des na 'di yin te/ rjes su yi rang ma byas na rang gi dge rtsa la 'gyod pa dang*/ gzhan gyi dge rtsa la phrag dog skye bar 'gyur la/ de la sems mi mnyam pa zhes bya la/ 'dir de byas pas rang gzhan gyi bsod nams kyi bya ba la sems mnyam pa nyid thob ste/ mi mnyam pa'i rnam 'gyur zhi bar 'gyur ro// zhes bshad/ rang lugs ni/ yi rang ba po dang*/ yi rang ba'i yul gnyis kas bsod nams de byas pa tsam du mnyam zhes pa'i don te/ dper na/ dge slong lha sbyin gyi tshul khrims bsrung*/ khyim pa lha sbyin gyis de la rjes su yi rangs bsgom pa na/ khyim pa lha sbyin gyis tshul khrims bsrung ba'i bsod nams gtan ma thob pa min te/ khyim pa dang dge slong gnyis kas tshul khrims de la brten pa'i bsod nams thob par mnyam pa'i phyir zhes pa'i don no// gnyis pa zag med sgom lam la/ dbye ba bstan te mtshams sbyar/ so so'i rang bzhin phye ste bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rje btsun gyis/ dman dang mchog tu gnas phyir dang*// zhes 'byung ba ltar/ sgom lam gnyis po de dman mchog gi go rim du byas nas 'chad ces ston pa ni/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i 'og tu zhes sogs so// 'o na gnyis po'i khyad par gang la bya zhe na/ 'bum phrag gsum pa/ spangs pa dang*/ rtogs pa la bzhed/ lo ts+tsha ba chen po mnyam gzhag dang rjes thob la bzhed/ ar gyis/ bar chad med lam dang rnam grol lam la bzhed/ mkhas pa phal mo che 'di'i rjes su 'brang*/ mkhan chen rin po che/ gnyis pa ltos sa gcig la ltos nas gzhi mthun mi srid la/ ltos sa tha dad la ltos nas gzhi mthun srid ces bzhed/ dar ṭīka pa/ rtogs pa mthar thug gi lag rjes 'jog byed dang*/ spangs pa mthar thug gi lag rjes 'jog byed ces bzhed/ gnyis pa la bsgrub pa sgom lam dang rnam dag sgom lam gnyis/ dang po la 'brel ni/ dang po yon tan mngon par bsgrub pa'i sgom lam 'chad de/ rnam grol lam gyi sngon du bar chad med lam gyi rtogs pa 'gro dgos pa'i phyir/

zhes ston pa ni/ de'i phyir dang por mngon par sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid kyis sgom pa'i lam zhes so// 'brel pa can dngos la/ bshad bya'i mdo ni/ shā ri'i bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das yum 'di ni snang bar bgyid pa'o// yum 'di ni phyag bgyi bar 'os pa ste yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs so// de'i don bsdus pa ni/ de yi ngo bo nyid mchog nyid// ces so// gnyis pa rnam dag sgom lam la/ rgyu dang rgyu min gyi dbye ba/ 'bras bu rnam gzhag dngos so// dang po la mdo ni/ shā ri'i bus gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das/ byang sems chen po gang yum 'di la mos par gyur pa de gang nas shi 'phos na 'dir mchis pa lags/ zhes sogs so// de'i don bsdus pa ni/ sangs rgyas rten dang sbyin sogs dang*// zhes so// 'o na ci sgrub pa sgom lam la'ang rgyu dang rgyu min gyi rab dbye 'di dag dgos pa min nam/ ci'i phyir rnam dag sgom lam kho na la bshad ce na/ bden mod kyi skabs gnyis pa 'dir bstan pa'i thob bya'i gtso bo ni 'bras bu shin tu rnam dag yin la/ de'i nye bar len pa'i rgyu ni sgrub pa sgom lam mam/ sgom lam bar chad med lam de nyid yin na/ de'i lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen ni gang yin snyam pa'i dogs pa sel ba'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ de'i 'og tu zhes sogs so// yang na mthun rkyen tshang bar bstan pas ni/ sgrub pa sgom lam gyi rgyu'i ldog cha nas bstan/ 'gal rkyen spang bar bstan pas ni/ rnam dag sgom lam gyi rgyu'i cha nas bstan zhes 'chad na legs sam snyam/ bdud kyi thibs kyis non pa dang zhes pa/ mdo sde dran pa nyer gzhag las/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdag po bdud sdig can la/ chung ma pad+ma'i phreng ba can zhes bya ba yod de/ de'i spyi bo na dregs par byed pa dang*/ rmongs par byed pa dang*/ kun tu rmongs par byed pa dang*/ brgyal bar byed pa dang*/ sems med par byed pa zhes bya ba'i me tog gi mda' lnga yod pa de gang la phog pa de ni 'dod chags la sogs pa'i dug lnga 'bar bar 'gyur ro// zhes bshad pa ltar ro// gnyis pa 'bras bu rnam dag dngos la/

spyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po la/ mdo ni/ rab 'byor gzugs rnam par dag pa gang yin pa de ni 'bras bu rnam par dag pa nyid do// 'bras bu rnam par dag pa gang yin pa de ni yum rnam par dag pa'o// yum rnam par dag pa gang yin pa de ni gzugs rnam par dag pa ste/ de ltar na gzugs rnam par dag pa dang*/ yum rnam par dag pa dang*/ 'bras bu rnam par dag pa gang yin pa 'di la gnyis su med de gnyis su byar med so so ma yin tha mi dad do// zhes so// don ni/ dharma shrī stong phrag brgya pa'i bshad pa las/ gzugs la sogs pa ni dag par bya ba'o// yum ni dag par byed pa'o// 'bras bu ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la sogs pa'o// gnyis su med pa ni dngos po'o// gnyis su byar med pa ni blo yis so// so so ma yin pa ni spyi'i mtshan nyid do// mdor na chos thams cad kyi spyi dang*/ rang gi mtshan nyid las grol ba ni rnam par dag pa'o// rnam dag ni/ rnam bcad ni dgag tu med pa'o// yongs gcod sgrub tu med pa ni/ chos nyid kyi don la dgag rgyu med pa zhes bya'o// zhes gsung*/ gnod 'joms las/ 'bras bu rnam par dag pa ste rnam par grol ba'o// yum rnam par dag pa ste chos sku'o// chos kyi sku rnam dag pa gang yin pa de nyid gzugs kyi rnam par dag pa'o// gzugs rnam par dag pa gang yin pa de ni/ de bzhin nyid ces bya ba'i tha tshig go /des ni de bzhin nyid dang*/ rnam par grol ba dang*/ chos sku ni mngon par tha mi dad de gcig ces bya'o// zhes gsung*/ nyi khri snang ba las/ gnyis su med pa'i don ni gzung ba dang*/ 'dzin pa gnyis su med pa'i phyir ro// gnyis su byar med ces bya ba ni/ ldem po dgongs pa la sogs pas gnyis su byar mi nus pa'i phyir/ dbyer med bcad du med ces bya ba la/ dbye ba ni mtshan nyid sna tshogs pa nyid do// bcad pa ni so so tha dad par yan lag tha dad byed pa'o// zhes gsungs so// mdo'i don bstan bcos su ji ltar bsdus pa ni/

'bras bu dag pa zhes so// 'dir dgongs pa ni/ 'bras bu ni rnam grol lam mo// sher phyin ni/ bsgrub pa sgom lam mo// dag bya ni gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar la mngon par zhen pa'i dri ma'o// mdor na sa gnyis pa'i mnyam gzhag rnam grol lta bu gcig chos can/ khyod rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa na/ khyod kyi yul gzugs sogs dri ma de nyid kyis rnam par dag pa yin te/ khyod gnyis dag bya'i dri ma gcig yin pa'i phyir/ dper na/ bu gcig shi ba na/ pha ma gnyis kyi bu shi ba bzhin no// de yang go slar byas na/ bum pa la bden 'dzin can gyi gang zag gcig gis bum pa la dmigs nas bden grub kyi rnam par 'char ba na/ yul bum pa de rang bden 'dzin can gyi gang zag de'i rgyud kyis rang la bden par 'dzin pa'i dri ma des ma dag pa yin te/ rang 'dzin gyi shes pa de la bden grub kyi rnam pa btad pa'i phyir/ gang zag des rang rgyud kyi bum pa bden 'dzin gyi blo de spangs na/ yul bum pa de yang*/ rang bden par 'dzin pa'i dri mas dag pa yin te/ rang 'dzin gyi shes pa de la bden med kyi rnam pa btod par byed pa'i phyir ro// zhes ston pa'i dbang du byas nas/ 'phags pa'i gang zag gi dge sbyong gi tshul zhes so// de ltar na 'dis ni dri ma yul gyi gnas tshul la ma zhugs par bsgrubs te/ 'bras bu rnam dag dngos po stobs zhugs kyi rigs pas bsgrubs pa yin no// gnyis pa bye brag tu bshad pa la/ 'phags gzhi rnam dag gi dbye ba/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag shin tu bar bsgrub pa/ sgrub byed la klan ka spang ba'o// dang po la 'brel ni/ rnam dag rigs pa'i sgo nas sgrub pa de nyid bshad dgos so zhe na/ bshad pa zhes ston pa ni/ rnam par dag pa spyir brjod nas zhes so// dngos la mdo ni/ rab 'byor gzhan yang bdag rnam par dag pa gang yin pa de ni/

gzugs rnam par dag pa/ gzugs rnam par dag pa gang yin pa de ni bdag rnam par dag pa zhes sogs so// byed pa'i skyes bu bcu gnyis po dang*/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar sbyar nas gsungs pa dang*/ ma rig pa rnam par dag pas 'du byed rnam par dag pa sogs dang*/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rnam par dag pas tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnam par dag pa sogs dang*/ mtha' las rgal ba dang*/ mtha' las shin tu song ba'o// zhes sogs kyi don bsdus te ston pa ni/ nyon mongs shes bya'i lam gsum sgrib/ nyams phyir slob ma bse ru dag sogs so// 'di la/ nyon mongs nyams phyir nyan thos dag /shes bya nyams phyir bse ru dag /lam gsum nyams phyir byang sems dag /sangs rgyas rnam kun shin tu ba// zhes sbyar ro// gnyis pa sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag shin du bar sgrub pa la/ snga phyi'i 'brel ni/ nyon mongs shes bya lam gsum gyis// zhes par/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag shin tu ba dang*/ nyan rang dang byang sems kyi rnam dag shin du ba min par bshad nas/ de'i sgrub byed gang zhe na/ zhes ston pa ni/ lam shes pa nyid kyi skabs su rnam par dag pa smos pa'i zhar la zhes sogs so// 'brel pa can dngos la mdo ni/ rab 'byor gzhan yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnam par dag pa gang yin pa de gzugs rnam par dag pa/ gzugs rnam par dag pa gang yin pa de rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rnam par dag pa/ zhes sogs kyis gnyen po dgu dang*/ shā ri'i bus gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das/ rnam par dag pa ni 'dod pa dang*/ gzugs dang*/ gzugs med pa'i khams su skye ba ma lags so// zhes mi mthun phyogs khams gsum gyi dri ma rnams 'phangs so// de'i don bsdus pa ni/ sa dgu la ni zhes sogs te/ don ni/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag de shin du ba yin te/ theg chen gyi sgom lam de dri ma mtha' dag gi gnyen po yin pa'i phyir/

nyan rang gi rnam dag de shin tu med de/ nyan rang gi sgom lam spang bya nyi tshe ba tsam gyis gnyen po yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i don no// 'dir a bh+ya ka ra ni/ 'dod khams kyi sgom spang dgu po de/ sa gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i bar du spong zhing*/ sgom spangs su gyur pa'i gzugs dang*/ gzugs med pa'i nyon mongs bdun bcu rtsa gnyis yod pa las/ bdun bcu rtsa gcig ni sa bcu pa'i khyad par gyi lam gyis spong la/ lhag ma gcig po de sangs rgyas kyi sas spong ngo*// zhes gnad kyi zla zer las bshad/ 'o na 'dir sgom lam sa dgu la brten par bshad na/ mdzod las/ 'dod pa'i khams dang srid rtse na// byang chub yan lag spang zhes bshad// ces 'byung ba min nam zhe na/ de ni nyan thos thabs la mi mkhas pa'i dbang du byas la/ 'dir byang sems thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par ro// zhes slob dpon 'di bzhed pa ltar legs la/ 'bum phrag gsum pa/ 'dir khams gsum sa dgu ni/ gnyen po'i rten ni zag med sa dgu kho na yin no// yum gyi mdor/ 'dod pa'i khams smos pa ni/ yum de la gnas pa med par ston pa yin gyi/ sa dgu'i phyogs gcig ngos 'dzin pa ni min no// zhes bzhed/ gnyis pa sgrub byed la klan ka spang ba la/ 'brel ni/ sgom lam bar chad med lam ji skad bshad ma thag pa de chos can/ khams gsum gyi sgom spangs mtha' dag gi gnyen po yin te/ khams gsum gyi gzung 'dzin rang bzhin med par mnyam nyid du rtogs zin sgom pa'i slob lam mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa sa dgu la ni/ zhes pa'i rtags bsgrub tu 'chad ces mtshams sbyar ba ni/ ji ltar shin tu yin zhe na// zhes pa'o// 'brel pa can dngos la/ 'phags pa ltar na/ khams gsum pa yi rnam pa can// 'jal dang gzhal bya mnyam pa nyid// de la klan ka spang ba yi// lam ni gnyen po nyid du 'dod// ces ston nas rkang pa snga ma gnyis kyis/ shā ri'i bus gsol pa/ rnam par dag pa ni 'dod pa dang*/

gzugs dang gzugs med pa'i khams su mi skye'o// bka' stsal pa/ khams gsum rang bzhin gyis mi skye ba'i phyir/ zhes sogs kyi don bshad nas/ yul mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pas khams gsum gyi gnyen po byed tshul de bstan/ rkang pa phyi ma gnyis ni de ltar bstan pa la rtsod pa spangs pa ste/ klan ka ni/ shā ri'i bus gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das sher phyin 'di rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la sman par mi bgyid/ gnod par mi bgyid/ ces gsungs so// don ni/ gal te yul yul can gnyis su yod na/ gnyen po chung ngu'i chung ngus mi mthun phyogs chen po'i chen po spong ba sogs 'thad pa las/ de med pa'i phyir mi 'thad do// de 'dod na/ tshogs la 'bad pa skyed pa don med par thal/ de yang 'dod na/ 'gog bden thob pa dang*/ lam bden mngon par rtogs pa don med par thal lo// zhes ston pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das yum rnam par dag pa ni chos 'ga' yongs su 'dzin par mi bgyid lags so// zhes dang*/ bcom ldan 'das gnyis rnam par dag pa la ni thob pa'i mngon par rtogs pa med do// zhes so// lan ni bka' stsal pa/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro// zhes so// don ni/ don dam par 'dod de chos kyi dbyings la phan gnod byar med pa'i phyir/ kun rdzob tu khyab pa ma grub ste/ kun rdzob tu yul yul can rang bzhin med par shes pa nyid gnyen po yin pa'i phyir/ zhes ston par gsungs so// slob dpon ltar na/ bsal bya klan ka sel byed kyi lan/ klan ka bsal bas grub pa'i don no// dang po ni/ de la gnyen po ni chen po'i chen po la sogs pa mi mthun phyogs ni chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pa mi rigs so// zhes pa'o// lan ni/ gos la chags pa'i dri ma phra mo bsal ba la zhes so// gsum pa ni/ sgom pa'i lam shin tu ba ji skad bstan pa de zhes so// de ltar na 'gal rkyen nga rgyal sogs spangs pa'i rten gyi gang zag des mthun rkyen byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/

rigs can gnyis kyi rtogs rigs yar ldan du skyed nas de dag mi dmigs par sgom pas phan yon chen po dang ldan pa'i mthong lam rgyud la skyes shing*/ de'i rgyun mnyam gzhag tu sgom pa'i sgrub pa sgom lam dang*/ rjes thob tu mos bsngo yi rang gsum gyis bsod nams kyi tshogs dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags te/ nyon mongs mi spong ba'i rgyu las sems can gyi don bsgrub nas mthar thug gi 'bras bu shin tu rnam dag 'byung ngo zhes ston pa ni skabs gnyis pa spyi'i 'grel lo// zhes mi pham bstan pa'i nyi ma sangs rgyas dpal gsung ngo*// de ltar byas na lung gi snye ma las/ yan lag lngar bcas ngo bo gang zag dang*// gzung dang de bzhin 'dzin bral theg gsum lam// mthong don zag bcas zag med kyis bsgom pas// shin tu dag par 'gyur tshul legs par bshad// ces 'byung ba ltar/ lam shes 'di ni de 'drar bshad// ces gang gsungs pa de legs par bshad zin to// 'dir smras pa/ rigs can gsum gyi lam gyi rtogs rigs tsam// yar ldan skyes pa lam shes yin no zhes// lam dang lam shes so sor mi 'byed pa// de yang gsum pa'i skabs dang zlos mthong nas// nyan rang gnyis kyi lam dang rjes mthun pa// rgyud la skyed cing de don mi dmigs par// legs par rtogs byed mthong sgom rim pa yis// lam shes ston pa ma pham rgyal ba'i gzhung*// gsum pa skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba ni/ skabs ni mtha' gnyis rnam dag gi skabs yin la/ gnyis pa zhes pa ni/ dang po la ltos pa'am/ yang na sngar rab 'byor gyi le'ur bshad pa de nyid/ slar yang rab 'byor gyis gnyis par bshad ces pa'i don te/ nyi khri snang ba las/ yum gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid nye bar bzung nas/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las brtsams te spobs par byos shig ces bya bas skabs yongs su rdzogs par ston par byed pa yin no// zhes gsungs te/

don ni/ rnam mkhyen rgyu lam shes dang bcas pa rab 'byor la ston cig par bka' bsgo ba de le'u gnyis pa 'dis yongs su rdzogs so// zhes bya bar 'gyur ro// //srid pa'i rgya mtsho ring nas legs rgal kyang*// zhi ba'i gnas su yud tsam mi zhugs la// phyi nang chos kyi de nyid ston mkhas pa'i// spyan ras gzigs dbang de la snying nas 'dud// gsum pa blang dor bya ba'i yan lag gzhi shes la/ 'brel dgod pas mtshams sbyar/ mtshon byed kyi chos rgyas par bshad/ skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ theg pa chen por rigs nges pa'i dbang du byas na/ rgyu lam shes kyi 'og tu blang dor bya ba'i yan lag gzhi shes 'chad dgos te/ gzhi mi mthun phyogs dang*/ gnyen po'i rab dbye ma lus pa legs par shes pa med par mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ dman par rigs nges pa'i dbang du byas na/ gzhi shes kyi rtogs pa sngon du ma song bar lam shes kyi rtogs pa mi skye ba'i phyir zhes ston pa ni/ gzhi thams cad yongs su shes pa med par lam legs par zhes so// 'dir gtso bor ni snga ma ltar yin te/ de ltar kun shes nyid lugs la// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa'ang skabs 'dir med pa min te/ lam shes kyi mdor/ de dag kyang bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na rjes su yi rang bar bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// slob dpon chos kyi bshes gnyen ni/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi thams cad yongs su shes pa med par gnyen po'i phyogs kyi lam legs par shes pa med pas/ zhes bzhed/ dhi ra ba la/ gzhi shes dang lam shes rgyu 'bras yin pas zhes bzhed/ 'bre chen po/ gzhi shes pa lam gyi gor shes pa med na/ lam shes pa rnam mkhyen gyi thun mong min pa'i rgyur shes pa med pas/ zhes bzhed/ ar na re/ sa bdun pa man chad kyi gzhi shes pa med par/ sa brgyad pa man chad kyi lam shes pa med pas zhes bzhed/

zhang tshe spong na re/ khyab byed gzhi thams cad shes pa med par khyab bya lam thams cad shes pa med pas zhes bzhed/ legs bshad gser 'phreng ba/ skyes bu 'bring gi lam sngon du ma song bar skyes bu chen po'i lam mi skye bas zhes bzhed/ bcom ldan ral gri na re/ sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las/ byis pa dbang po zhan zhing le lo can// theg pa gnyis la nan tan mi byed na// theg pa chen po'i 'khor lo ldan mi 'gyur// de ni rgya chen theg chen snod ma yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ theg pa 'og ma gnyis ma shes pa theg chen gyi lam mi shes pas/ zhes bzhed/ dar ṭīka pa/ gser phreng ltar bzhed pa ni nang 'gal te/ rgyan gyis ched du bya ba'i gdul bya nyan rang med par khas blangs pa'i phyir dang*/ so so skye bo la gzhi shes med par khas blangs pa dang*/ theg chen du rigs nges pa'i gang zag gis/ lam shes kyi snga rol tu gzhi shes kyi rtogs pa skye mi srid par khas blangs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa mtshon byed kyi chos rgyas par bshad pa la/ spyi'i 'brel dang*/ so so'i 'brel lo// dang po la/ 'o na skabs gnyis par gzugs mi rtag par yid la bya'o// zhes sogs kyi mi rtag pa sogs bcu drug rtogs pa'i lam bshad pas/ gzhi shes pa yang bshad zin pa min nam zhe na/ bden mod kyi/ 'on kyang skabs gnyis par ni mi dmigs pa bsgom pa'i yul du bstan la/ 'dir ni mi rtag par yid la bya'o zhes sogs kyis 'phangs pa'i gzhi ma lus pa yongs su shes pa'i don du ston pa yin no// zhes pa'i don du 'grel chen dang*/ lo ts+tsha ba chen pos gsungs pa ltar yin no// des na skabs gnyis par nyan rang gi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi shes byar don gyi 'phangs pa'i gzhi shes de nyid/ 'dir mi mthun phyogs dang*/ gnyen po'i sgo nas 'chad pa la chos dgu yod pa/ gnyis su 'dus te/ rten gyi gang zag nyan thos sogs dang thun mong ba'i sher phyin spyir bshad/

byang sems kyi thun mong min pa'i gzhi shes bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ khyad par gyi gzhi ngos bzung ba dang*/ de'i steng du khyad par gyi chos la dogs pa bcad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sngar mtha' gnyis rnam dag gi le'ur bshad pa'i lam shes de yang*/ shes pas srid pa la mi gnas pa dang*/ snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa gcig min par bstan nas/ de'i shugs la nyan rang gi sher phyin srid zhi gang rung gi mtha' la gnas par ston no// gnyis pa la nye ring so sor phye ba dang*/ de gnyis spang gnyen du bstan pa'o// dang po la/ 'o na de lta bu'i sher phyin gnyis po de/ skabs dang por bstan pa'i 'bras bu rnam mkhyen de la nye ring gi khyad par yod dam med ce na/ nye ring gang gi khyad par ston pa ni/ thabs ma yin pas ring ba dang*/ thabs kyis mi ring bar bstan pa rnams so// gnyis pa nye ring gnyis spang gnyen du sbyar ba ni/ nyan rang gi gzhi shes mtshan mar dmigs pa yin na/ yul gang la dmigs/ de nyid phyis 'bras yum la nye ba'i thabs ji ltar bya zhe na/ nyan rang gi gzhi shes ni gzhi lam 'bras gsum la mtshan mar 'dzin pa dang lhan cig tu 'jug pa'i phyir/ mi mthun phyogs dang bcas pa yin la/ byang sems kyi gzhi shes ni/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i phyir/ de'i gnyen po'i phyogs yin no zhes ston pa rnams so// gnyis pa thun mong min pa'i gzhi shes la/ de ltar na nye ba'i gzhi shes la 'jug pa'i sbyor ba de ci/ nye ba'i gzhi shes rang gi ngo bo gang zhe na/ sbyor ba'i lam dang mthong lam bstan to// de ltar na skabs gsum pa 'dir gzhi mi mthun phyogs dang*/ dbyig gnyen po rab dbye dngos su bstan nas/ de shes pa'i gzhi shes mtshon pa'i tshul gyis bstan no// 'o na mthong lam dngos su bstan pa min nam zhe na/ bstan mod/ lam shes kyi sngon du 'gro ba'i gzhi shes brjod pa de/ mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i rab dbye phyin ci ma log par shes pa'i ye shes de nyid yin te/

skabs gsum pa logs su bstan pa'i dgos pa dang*/ de nyid bde blag du rtogs pa de yin pa'i phyir ro// des na skabs 'dir bstan pa'i gzhi shes la/ mi mthun phyogs dang*/ gnyen po'i rab dbye shes pa'i gzhi shes dang*/ gzhi bden stong spros bral mngon sum du rtogs pa'i gzhi shes gnyis yod par shes par bya'o// 'di ni 'phags pa'i dgongs pa gtso bor byas so// gnyis pa so so'i 'brel la/ 'jug yul gzhi shes/ 'jug pa sbyor ba/ zhugs 'bras mthong lam/ mkhyen gsum 'jug bsdu ba'o// dang po la skabs gnyis par bstan pa'i sher phyin dang*/ de las ldog pa'i sher phyin ngos bzung*/ de rnam mkhyen la nye ring gi khyad par du bstan/ ring ba'i sher phyin mi mthun phyogs su bstan cing*/ nye ba'i sher phyin gnyen po'i phyogs su bstan pa dang gsum mo// dang po la 'brel ni/ sngar mtha' gnyis rnam dag gi le'ur bshad pa'i sher phyin de mtha' gnyis kyis rnam par dag pa'i tshul ji lta bu snyam pa la/ sngar mtha' gnyis rnam dag gi le'u bshad pa de nyid las brtsams te/ yod pa khyad par can gyi le'u gsungs pa yin no// 'brel pa can dngos la/ mdo ni/ rab 'byor gyis gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi yum ni/ tshu rol dang pha rol gyi mtha' la ma lags/ gnyis ka'i bar na mi dmigs so// bka' stsal pa/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro// gsol pa bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du mi dmigs/ bka' stsal pa/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid kyi phyir ro// zhes gsungs/ de'i don bsdus pa ni/ tshu rol pha rol mtha' la min// zhes so// 'dir 'phags pas ni/ dngos bstan byang sems kyi sher phyin kho na 'chad/ slob dpon gyis 'dir mdo dang bstan bcos kyi srid zhi la gnas pa'i gzhi shes shugs la 'phangs par bzhed do// de bzhin du/ 'jug pa sbyor ba dang*/ zhugs 'bras mthong lam gyi skabs su'ang*/

nyan rang gi sbyor mthong shugs la bstan pa bzhed do// des na slob dpon gyi lugs 'di la/ srid zhi la mi gnas pa dang gnas pa'i sher phyin ngos bzung nas/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du shes pa dang*/ mi shes pa'i phyir zhes bkod nas/ 'bras yum la nye ring du sgrub pa ni/ dus gsum pa'i chos rnams zhes sogs dang*/ kun shes pa nyid kyi skabs las zlog ste bstan pas zhes so// gnyis pa la nye ring gi rgyu mtshan la rtsod pa bkod de/ snga phyi'i 'brel btsal ba ni/ nyan rang gi gzhi shes chos can/ dus gsum mnyam nyid du ma rtogs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'bras yum la ring ba min par thal/ der rtogs pa'i phyir te/ rten 'brel rtogs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ klu grub kyi gzhung las/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba gang*// de nyid khyod ni stong par bzhed// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ lugs las zhes so// 'brel pa can dngos kyi lan 'debs pa la/ mdo ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu'am/ bu mo thabs mi mkhas pas yum 'di dmigs pa'i tshul gyis shes par bgyi na/ yum 'di 'dor bar 'gyur/ ring du byed par 'gyur/ ces dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po chags pa dang*/ ma chags pa ma mchis par yum 'di legs par bshad pa dang*/ legs par mthar phyung ba'i bar ni ngo mtshar che'o zhes gsung*/ de'i don bsdus pa ni/ de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas// zhes so// don ni/ nyan rang gi gzhi shes chos can/ rten 'brel gyi don rtogs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ dus gsum mnyam nyid shes pa min par thal/ rten 'brel gyi don ma rtogs pa'i phyir te/ rten 'brel la mtshan mar bzung ba'i phyir/ zhes ston pa na/ sgyu ma mkhan gyi zhes sogs so// des na gzhung 'dis/ tshu rol pha rol mtha' la min// zhes pa'i shugs bstan la rtsod pa spangs te/ grub pa'i don 'chad pa yin no// zhes ston pa ni/ thabs ma yin pas ni/

zhes sogs so// gsum pa mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i khyad par la/ 'brel ni/ de'i phyir nyan rang gi bsgrub pa de/ 'bras bu rnam mkhyen bsgrub pa'i mi mthun phyogs dang bcas pa yin no// zhes ston pa ni/ de ltar nyan thos la sogs pa'i zhes sogs so// mdo'i 'brel ni/ gong gi nye ba'i gzhi shes kyi mdo drangs ma thag pa la 'phros pa'o// 'brel pa can dngos la mdo ni shā ri'i bus rab 'byor la smras pa/ byang sems chen po yum la spyod pa'i tshe chags pa ni gang*/ chags pa med pa ni gang zhes sogs so// dris pa'i lan gyi mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i rab dbye gsungs so// de dag gi don ston pa la/ lta spyod la mtshan 'dzin gyi spang gnyen dang*/ 'bras bu la mtshan 'dzin gyi spang gnyen gnyis/ dang po la spang bya mi mthun phyogs dang*/ spong byed kyi gnyen po rim par 'chad pa'i dbang du byas nas/ gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid dang*// zhes sogs so// sbyin la sogs la ngar 'dzin med// ces sogs gsungs so// gnyis pa la'ang*/ spangs bya ni/ rgyal la sogs la chags pa phra// zhes pa'o// de mi mthun phyogs yin par bsgrub pa ni/ chos kyi lam ni rang bzhin gyis// dben pa'i phyir na de zab nyid// ces so// zab pa bsgrub pa ni/ mthong ba la sogs bkag pa yis// de ni rtogs pa dka' bar bshad// ces so// rtogs dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ gzugs la sogs par mi shes phyir// de ni bsam mi khyab par 'dod// ces so// de spong byed kyi gnyen po ston pa ni/ chos rnams rang bzhin gcig par ni// shes pas chags pa spong ba yin// zhes so// gnyis pa de dag shes pa'i gzhi shes bsdus te bstan pa ni/ de ltar kun shes nyid lugs la// zhes pa ste/ 'di la mdo logs pa med do// de dag ni rnam bshad kyi dgongs pa yin no// bdag gi blo la 'di ltar snang ste/ de ni bsam mi khyab par 'dod yan gyis gzhi mi mthun phyogs dang*/

gnyen po rab dbye de nyid gtso bor bstan gyi/ gzhi shes kyi ldog pa nas bstan pa med la/ de ltar kun shes zhes pas de shes pa'i gzhi shes kyi bstan tshul mdo na dngos su med kyang*/ rje btsun gyi mdo'i sbas don dngos su bkod pa'o// de yang 'di ltar/ skabs gnyis par bstan pa'i lam sher phyin de mtha' gnyis kyis rnam par dag tshul ston pa la/ de chos can/ mtha' gnyis kyis rnam par dag pa yin te/ shes rab kyis 'khor ba la sred pa spangs shing*/ snying rjes sems can la sred pa'i phyir/ ci ste mtha' gnyis kyis rnam par dag kyang dbus na gnas so snyam na min te/ de gnyis kyi bar na gnas bya med pa'i phyir/ zhes stonapa ni// tshu rol pha rol mtha' la min// de dag bar na mi gnas pa// zhes pa'o// 'khor 'das bar gsum la mi gnas pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor de chos can/ 'bras bu rnam mkhyen gyi thun mong min pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i sher phyin yin te/ dus gsum rang bzhin med par mnyam nyid du rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ dus rnams mnyam pa nyid shes phyir// shes rab pha rol phyin par 'dod// ces pa'o// ci ste mtha' gnyis gang rung la gnas pa'i sher phyin de yang*/ 'bras bu rnam mkhyen gyi thun mong min pa'i rgyu min pa ci zhe na/ min te/ de la ring ba'i phyir te/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum la mtshan mar dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i phyir dang*/ gcig shos ni de las bzlog pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ de ni mtshan mar dmigs sgo nas// zhes so// mtshan mar dmigs pa dang bcas na/ rnam mkhyen la ring bar ma zad/ mtshan 'dzin de rnam mkhyen gyi rgyu thun mong min pa rgyud la skyed pa'i gegs yin no// zhes ston pa gzugs sogs dang*/ rtags la sogs la zhes so// 'o na gegs de gnyen pos ji ltar spangs zhe na/ sbyin la sogs la zhes dang*/ chos rnams zhes so// 'o na gnyen po des spang bya de spong nus pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/

nus te/ de yul gyi gnas tshul la zhugs pa'i phyir te/ gnyen po de'i 'dzin stangs dang*/ yul gyi gnas tshul mthun pa'i phyir te/ yul gyi gnas tshul ni 'di yin no zhes ston pa ni/ chos kyi lam ni zhes sogs rkang pa drug go /de'i phyir srid zhi la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes dang*/ gnas pa'i gzhi shes dang*/ mi mthun phyogs dang*/ gnyen po'i phyogs kyi gzhi shes zhes bod snga rabs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams tha snyad mdzad mod/ mdo dang 'phags seng gi gzhung dang*/ rtsa ba dang*/ rgya 'grel rnams na de'i tha snyad mdzad pa gcig kyang med do// mdor na de yan chad du gzhi mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i rab dbye'am/ lo chen bzhed pa ltar/ gtso bo'i sher phyin dang*/ gzugs brnyan gyi sher phyin gyi dbye ba bstan nas/ de'i rnam par dbye ba khong du chud pa de so so skye bo dang 'phags pa gang la yod kyang rung*/ rgyu lam shes kyi sngon du 'gro ba'i gzhi shes zhes ming du btags pa de nyid yin zhing*/ spyod pa khyad par can gyi le'u logs su gsungs pa'i dgos pa'ang de kho na yin no// zhes ston pa ni/ de ltar zhes sogs so// de ltar byas na 'grel chen las/ mi rtag pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa 'phangs pa rnams kyi zhes pa'i don yang mi rtag pa sogs bcu drug gi sgo nas mtshan mar dmigs pa dang*/ rang bzhin med par rtogs pa ste/ ji skad bshad pa rnams yin no// de ltar rab dbye de khong du chud nas/ gnyen po'i phyogs la ji ltar 'jug ce na/ 'jug pa sbyor ba ston te/ 'di la dngos dang*/ mnyam nyid gnyis/ dang po la mdo ni/ gzugs la mi spyod na yum la spyod do// zhes sogs so// de bsdud pa ni/ gzugs sogs de mi rtag sogs dang*// zhes pa ste/ don ni gzhi'i gnas lugs la zhen spyod mngon gyur ba bkag nas sgom na/ ji skad bshad pa'i gzhi'i gnas lugs mthong bar 'gyur ro// zhes ston no// bcu po la yang 'phags pas/

dang po bzhi la/ zhen spyod bkag pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ phyi ma drug la sbyor ba tsam gyis tha snyad mdzad cing*/ de yang dang po bzhi ni/ yul gyis phye ba yin la/ mi 'gyur byed po med nyid dang*/ bya dka' rnam gsum sbyor ba ni/ rnam par phye ba dang*/ phyi ma gsum ni 'bras bu dang*/ phan yon dang*/ shes bya rtogs pa'i shes pa ste/ gsum rim pa bzhin ston par bzhed/ slob dpon ni/ spyod pa bkag pa bar gyi gsal byed yin zhing*/ snga ma bzhi rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba dang*/ phyi ma drug gnas skabs kyi sbyor bar bzhed/ 'di yang sbyor lam kho nar ma nges te/ slob dpon gyi skabs gsum par nges 'byed ma bstan par bshad pa dang*/ sbyor ba'i lam zhes pa/ rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam gyi snga rol tshun chad du rjes su 'gro ba'i phyir ro// des na 'di ni ji srid gzhi la mtshan mar 'dzin pa de srid du sgom dgos so// zhes chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i dpal gyis gsung ngo*// jo bo chen po rjes ni/ sbyor ba rnam bcur bstan kyang ni// grangs dang go rim nges pa med// sbyor yul bzhi yin sbyor ba dngos// gsum yin gnyis 'bras gcig dpe zhes// de skad sdud par byed pa yod// mthong lam na yod kha cig zer// sgom lam sbyor ba zer ba'ang yod// la la sbyor lam na yod de// sbyor lam ma bstan gsungs pa ni// bzhi ru ma bstan pa la dgongs// zhes phyi ma 'di rang lugs su bzhed/ de ltar bstan pa'i shugs la nyan rang gi gzhi shes sbyor ba zhen spyod mngon gyur ba dang bcas pa yin no// zhes ston pa ni/ shugs kyis ni nyan thos la sogs pa yi ni/ zhes so// gnyis pa mnyam pa nyid la/ 'brel ni/ mnyam pa nyid kyi sgo nas zhes so// dngos la bshad bya'i mdo ni/ nyi khri snang ba las/ gzugs rloms sems su mi byed/ gzugs kyis rlom sems su mi byed/ gzugs bdag gi zhes rloms sems su mi byed/

gzugs la rlom sems su mi byed// ces gsung*/ de bsdud pa ni/ gzugs la sogs la rlom med pa// zhes so// 'dir rnam pa bzhi gang la bya zhe na/ 'phags pa dang*/ shān+ti pa ni/ mdo las gsungs pa bzhi po de'o// slob dpon ni/ gzugs kyi ngo bo dang*/ mtshan ma dang*/ spros pa dang*/ rtog pa rnams so// 'di la sher blo na re/ sbyor ba bcu po re re la'ang*/ mnyam nyid bzhi bzhir yod ces gsungs te/ legs par gda'o// gsum pa zhugs 'bras mthong lam la/ 'brel ni mnyam nyid kyi 'og tu mthong lam 'chad rigs te/ gzhi'i gnas tshul mngon sum du mthong ba la/ gzhi phung khams skye mched la rlom pa rnam bzhi bkag pa sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ sbyor ba'i mnyam pa nyid so sor rtogs nas/ zhes so// 'brel pa can dngos la/ mdor bstan pa dang rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mdo ni rgyal po chen po bzhi dang*/ brgya byin dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ gnas gtsang ma'i bar gyi lha rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi mthus/ sangs rgyas stong gis ming 'di nyid dang*/ yi ge 'di nyid dang*/ rab 'byor zhes pa'i dge slong kho nas yum yongs su zhu ba byas shing ston par byed pa dang*/ lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin yum 'di nyid yongs su zhu bar byed cing chos ston par byed pa sems kyis mthong bar gyur to// zhes sogs mdo'i rim pa gcig la/ bstan bcos su mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis mdzad pa yin no// 'di'i don/ 'phags seng gnyis kyis/ mthong lam skad cig ma bcu drug las gzhan med par shes par bya ba'i dpang por sangs rgyas stong smos par bzhed/ shān+ti pa dang*/ a bh+ya sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gzhi shes kyi mthong lam bstan par mnyam pa shes pa'i ched yin zhes gsung ngo*// rgyas par bshad pa la 'grel pa'i 'brel ni/ bden pa'i rnam pa gang yin zhe na/ zhes pa'o// mdo'i 'brel ni/ lam shes kyi mdor/

gzugs mi rtag par yid la bya'o// zhes bshad na/ nyan thos ltar mi rtag pa sogs su mtshan mar dmigs pa'i sgo nas yid la bya'am zhe na/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' chen po byams pa bla na med pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgyas nas/ gzugs rtag ces bya ba'am/ mi rtag ces bya bar chos ston par mi 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// bstan bcos kyi 'brel ni/ gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid dang*// zhes/ mi rtag sogs su dmigs pa gzhi'i gnas tshul phyin ci ma log tu zhugs par bshad na/ rtag sogs su dmigs pa gnyen po yin nam zhe na/ min te rtag mi rtag gi spros pa sogs sgro 'dogs so gnyis dang bral ba can gyi mthong ba'i lam ni/ gzhi'i gnas lugs mngon sum du mthong ba'i gzhi shes yin no zhes ston pa ni/ gzugs rtag ma yin mi rtag min// zhes sogs so// 'grel pa las/ dngos bstan byang sems kyi mthong lam/ shugs bstan nyan rang gi mthong lam/ zhar la sgom lam mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan dang gsum rim pa ltar 'chad do// 'dir slob dpon gyi dgongs pa/ skabs gsum pa 'dir byang sems kyi sher phyin 'jug pa sbyor bar zhugs 'bras mthong lam gsum dngos su bstan nas/ dman pa'i sher phyin/ 'jug pa sbyor ba/ zhugs 'bras mthong lam rnams shugs la bstan pas/ theg pa che chung gnyis ka'i gzhi shes bstan la/ tshul ni sher phyin go zlog pa'i sgo nas bstan/ sbyor ba rjes su 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ mthong lam ldog pa'i sgo nas bstan/ zhes bzhed cing*/ byang sems kyi sbyor lam skabs dang por bshad zin pa'i phyir ma bshad/ nyan thos kyi sbyor lam yang*/ de'i shugs la gsal ba'i phyir 'dir ma bshad/ nyan thos kyi sgom lam yang ji ltar mthong ba'i don de nyid sgom pa yin pa'i phyir ma bshad/ ces bzhed/ bsdus don sgron ma las/ gzhi shes gnyis ka bstan kyang ni// blang bya gtso bor bstan zhes pa// slob dpon chen po seng bzang gsung*// dor bya gtso bor bstan pa ni// slob dpon bud+dha shrī gsung*// zhes dang*/

sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi nyan rang gzhi shes gtso bor bstan par bzhed/ ces gsungs so// gsum pa sgom lam mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan la/ ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul dang*/ dgongs pa dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ nyi snang las/ yang ci'i don gyis lam shes pa nyid bzhin du thams cad shes pa nyid la sgom pa'i lam/ logs shig par med ce na/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi phun sum tshogs pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i shes pa dang mthong bas ltas nas 'da'o zhes gsungs pas na/ 'di ni gzhan gtso bor byed pa yin no// gzhan yang rgyun du zhugs pa nas rang sangs rgyas kyi bar gyi shes pa dang spong ba gang yin pa de ni mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bzod pa yin no// bzod pa gang zhe na/ sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i bzod pa'o// 'di gang las shes ce na/ lam gzhan khyad par yod pa yin na/ rigs dang dbang po dang*/ tshogs khyad zhugs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// byang chub sems dpa'i bzod pa'i byed par gzhan rnams kyi rtogs pa'i byed pa ma lus par 'dus par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ de dag gi shes pa dang spangs pa gang yin pa de/ de'i bzod pa yin gyi rtogs pa'i tshad 'di tsam yin no// zhes bya ba ni rnam grangs gzhan yin no zhes gsung*/ 'grel chen las nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi phun sum tshogs pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i shes pa dang mthong bas bltas nas 'da' bar bya'o// zhes pas mngon du bya ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ma bstan no// zhes gsungs/ 'dir ni/ nyan thos kyi lam ni byang chub sems dpas yongs su shes par bya ba yin gyi/ mngon du bya ba min pas/ sgom pa'i lam ni ma bstan to// zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa la/ gzhung 'di gang la 'phros na/ sngon gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen phal che ba ni/ mthong lam bshad zin pa'i rjes thogs su nyan thos kyi sgom lam byang sems la mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/

de'i rgyu mtshan du 'chad/ dar ṭīka pa/ byang sems 'phags pas mngon du bya ba'i lam shes de la mthong sgom gnyis yod pa bzhin/ shes par bya ba'i gzhi shes de la'ang*/ mthong lam bsgom lam gnyis ci'i phyir mi ston snyam pa'i dogs pa gcod pa'o zhes gsung*/ gser 'phreng mdzad pa po ni/ nyan rang gi mthong lam shugs la mtshon pa'i phyir du byang sems kyi mthong lam bstan pa ltar/ nyan rang gi sgom lam shugs la mtshon pa'i phyir/ byang sems kyi sgom lam mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ de'i lan du bzhed/ rnam bshad kyi dgongs pa ni 'di yin no// gzugs rtag ma yin mi rtag min// zhes pa'i skabs su/ nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs mngon du mthong ba'i theg chen gyi mthong lam bstan pa'i rjes su/ rtogs rigs de rgyun ldan du sgom par byed pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ de'i lan du gzhung 'di gsungs pa yin no// des na 'dir/ sgom lam mi ston pa dang*/ nyan rang gi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi shes bya'i lam bstan pa'i mjug thogs su sgom lam ma bstan pa don gcig cing*/ mdo las nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi shes byar bstan pa'i byang sems kyi mthong lam de dang*/ 'di'i sgro 'dogs gnyis dang bral ba'i rnam pa can gyi theg chen gyi mthong lam de don gcig pa yin no// ci ste don mi gcig ste/ snga ma mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi rnam pa can yin pas/ byang sems 'phags pas shes mthong gis bltas nas 'da' bar bya ba kho na yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ni mi shes pas kun nas blangs pa'i ngag yin te/ chos mngon pa sangs rgyas kyi bkar 'dod cing*/ sher phyin bkar mi 'dod pa dag gi ngor/ mngon pa nas bshad pa dang*/ don gcig par 'phags seng gis sbyar ba tsam ma gtogs/ sher phyin nas nyan rang gi rtogs rigs bshad pa rnams/ mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi grangs nges can du bshad pa gcig kyang med pa'i phyir dang*/

khyad par nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi shes bya'i lam ni rnam thar sgo gsum sogs nyi shu rtsa drug gi rnam pa can du bshad pa'i phyir/ de dag kyang shes mthong gis bltas nas 'da' byar khas len nam/ des sgro 'dogs gnyis dang bral ba'i rnam pa can gyis mthong lam ngo bo gcig pa 'di nyid la mi rtag sogs mngon du rtogs pa'i cha dang*/ rtogs pa de nyid kyang mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i cha gnyis ldog pas phye ba las/ snga ma skabs gsum par gzhi shes kyi cha nas bstan cing*/ phyi ma skabs gnyis par lam shes kyi ldog par bstan no// de ltar gzhung don mdor bsdu na/ skabs gnyis par rang ming gis bstan pa'i theg chen mthong lam chos can/ khyod kyi rigs rgyun goms par byed pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam yum gyi mdor gsungs pa la rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod lam gsum mi dmigs par shes pa'i cha nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam yin pa'i phyir/ skabs gsum par bstan pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ khyod kyi rigs rgyun sgom par byed pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam yum gyi mdor mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs mngon sum du mthong ba'i cha nas bstan pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam yin pa'i phyir ro// khyab ste/ nyan thos kyi lam gyi rtogs rigs ni gzhan don du shes par bya ba yin gyi mngon du bya ba min pa'i phyir ro// nyi khri snang ba'i rnam grangs phyi ma'i don ni/ nyan rang gi rtogs rigs sgom pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam bstan mi dgos te/ nyan rang gi spangs rtogs kyi rigs thams cad theg chen gyi mthong lam nas rdzogs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i don no// mkhyen gsum gyi mjug bsdu ba la/ 'brel ni/ mdo las/ mkhyen gsum gyi don bsdu ba'i mdo tshig tshan pa gsum gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ sngar le'u gsum du gsungs pa'i sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa mtha' dag bsdus pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir ram/

yang na mkhyen gsum gyi mngon par rtogs pa brgyad ka bsdus pa'i phyir/ mkhyen gsum la 'jug bsdud mdzad do// zhes ston pa ni/ de ltar rgyas par bstan nas/ zhes sogs so// dngos la bshad bya'i mdo ni/ rab 'byor yum 'di ni chos gang yang thob par byed pa min/ mi thob par byed pa min/ ston/ mi ston/ ster ba dang*/ 'phrog pa/ bskyed pa dang*/ 'gag pa/ chad pa dang*/ rtag pa/ don gcig don sna tshogs/ 'ong bar byed pa ma yin/ 'gro bar byed pa ma yin sogs kyis gzhi shes kyi don bsdus te/ log zla dang bcas pa'i rnam par rtog pa bkag nas bstan pa'i phyir ro// rab 'byor yum 'di ni 'don pa'i khams las shin tu 'da' bar byed pa'am/ gnas par byed pa ma yin/ gzugs dang*/ gzugs med pa dang*/ mya ngan 'das pa'i dbyings la gnas par byed pa ma yin/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar gyi chos rnams ster bar byed pa'am/ 'phrog par byed pa ma yin zhes sogs kyis lam shes kyi don bsdus te/ mi mthun pa dang gnyen po'i phyogs kyi rnam par rtog pa bkag nas bstan pa'i phyir/ rab 'byor yum 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ster bar byed pa ma yin 'phrog par byed pa ma yin pa de bzhin du/ so so skye bo dang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams ster bar byed pa ma yin 'phrog par byed pa ma yin/ zhes sogs kyis rnam mkhyen gyi don bsdus pa yin te/ rang dang gzhan gyi don bsdus pa rnam pa thams cad rtogs pa dang*/ bshad pa'i chos de dag gi rgyu de yin par brjod pa'i phyir/ zhes nyi khri snang ba las bshad/ don bsdu'i go rim 'di ni rgyas bshad kyi go rim las zlog ste bshad la/ de yang grol sde gnyis dang*/ le brgyad ma dang*/ dga' dag ldan rnams kyi dgongs pa yin no// 'grel chen gnad kyi zla 'od/ snying po mchog rnams las yan lag rgyas bshad kyi go rim dang mthun par mdzad cing*/

'dir yang de bzhin mdzad pa ni/ yum bsdus pa dang mthun par mdzad pa yin la/ snga ma rnams ni nyi khri dang mthun par mdzad par snang ngo*// rtsa bar 'di zhes pa gsum gsungs pa ni/ mdo las yum 'di ni zhes lan gsum gsungs pa de nyid 'dzin pa yin la/ 'grel chen par le'u gsum gyis zhes byed tshig 'byung ba ni ma dag pa ste/ rtsa bar/ 'dis ni zhes gsungs pa med pa'i phyir dang*/ 'phags seng gnyis kyis rdzogs par ston byed/ don bsdu'i mdo tshigs gsum la bshad pa'i phyir ro// 'on kyang paṇa chen bud+dha shrī ni/ rdzogs par ston byed le'u gsum la'ang 'chad do// de ltar na lung gi snye ma las/ shes rab snying brtses srid zhir mi gnas shing*// thabs dang thabs min spang gnyen dbye ba'i don// legs rtogs dmigs med sbyor bas goms pa'i 'bras// mthong lam bcas pas gzhi shes legs par bshad// ces 'byung ba ltar/ de 'dra kun shes nyid du 'dod// ces gang gsungs pa de legs par bshad zin to// 'dir smras pa/ gzhi shes skabs 'dir gzhi yi chos tsam zhig /thun mong bstan pas lam la 'jug pa'i tshul// gang zag 'bring gi lam du bstan pa la// gzhi tsam brjod byar bsdus pa'i nyes mthong nas// mtha' gnyis rnam par dag pa'i sher phyin de// rnam mkhyen bskrun byed thun mong min pa'i rgyur// legs par bshad nas ring ba'i lam yang ni// nye bar 'jug mkhas ma pham rgyal ba'i gzhung*// skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba ni/ gzhi shes gtan la 'bebs pa/ spyod pa khyad par can gyi le'u ste gsum pa'o// 'dir mkhyen pa gsum gyi mngon par rtogs pa brgyad bsdus pa'i phyir/ mkhyen gsum la mjug bsdu mdzad pa na/ mngon par rtogs pa lhag ma rnams la'ang mdzad par 'gyur bas logs su ma mdzad do// zhes chos bshes dang bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa gsung ngo*// //gzhi yi dus su skye med gsum la mkhas// lam gyi dus su sbyor bzhi nyams su blangs// 'bras bu'i dus su chos sku mngon gyur pa'i// ma pham byams pa'i zhabs rdul spyi bor zhog

/gnyis pa nyams su len pa'i thabs sbyor ba bzhi la/ dbang du byed pa rgyu 'bras/ brtan pa rgyu 'bras gnyis/ dang po la dbang thob phyir du sgom pa rnam kun gyi sbyor ba/ dbang thob tshul gyis sgom pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba gnyis/ dang po la/ 'brel dgod pas mtshams sbyar/ mngon rtogs kyi rang bzhin rgyas par bshad/ skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni mkhyen gsum bshad zin pa'i 'og tu rnam rdzogs sbyor ba 'chad rigs te/ skye med gsum thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa'i don de/ rnam rdzogs sbyor bas dang por sgom dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum yongs su shes pa ni zhes sogs so// 'o na 'di bstan pa don med par 'gyur te/ sngar bstan pa de nyid sgom pas chog pa'i phyir zhe na/ sngar ni yul skye med gsum so sor gtan la phab pas yul can mkhyen gsum spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs la/ 'dir ni so so'i dmigs rnam bsdus te ston pa'i phyir zhes ston pa ni/ yang rnam pa dang*/ zhes sogs so// de skad du yang 'grel chen las/ yang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum dang*/ rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa'i khyad par gang zhe na/ kha cig na re/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum ni ji skad bshad pa'i rnam pas rnam pa'i yul so sor nges pa yin la/ rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa ni rnam pa ma lus pa'i yul can yin no// zhes 'dod do// gzhan dag ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum ni mtshan nyid du rnam par bzhag la/ rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa ni/ sbyor ba pa yin no// zhes zer ro// la la ni rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa ni/ mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i rab tu dbye bas phye ba yin la/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum ni/ rang bzhin gyis zhi ba'i rnam pa nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de lta bu ma yin no// zhes 'dod/

zhes gsungs la/ 'grel pa 'dir ni/ gsum ka'ang mi 'gal bar bshad pa'i phyir ro// dar ṭīka pa/ thos bsam dang nyams len gyi gzhung mtshams so sor 'byed pa ni/ gzhung lugs chen po rnams nub pa'i rkyen no// zhes gsungs pa ni sun 'byin 'brel med yin te/ dngos brgyad tsam gyi bshad tshul dang*/ chos so so'i bshad tshul gcig tu 'dres snang ba'i phyir te/ sems bskyed sogs chos sum cu mtshon pa'i mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis gtan la 'bebs zhes smras kyi/ skabs dang po gsum gyi nyams len mi ston zhes su zhig gis smras/ yang sbyor ba bzhis/ skye med gsum thos bsam gyis gtan la phab ste nyams su len zhes smras kyi/ skabs bar pa bzhir thos bsam mi byed ces su zhig gis smras/ gzhan du na snga rabs byon zin pa'i mkhas pa de dag 'jig rten rgyang 'phan pa bas kyang blun par 'gyur te/ skabs lhag ma bzhi la thos bsam dngos su byed bzhin du/ thos bsam bya rgyu min par khas blangs pa'i phyir ro// gzhan yang khyed ltar na gzhung lugs chen po rnams la thog mar thos bsam byas nas nyams su len pa'am/ 'on te ma byas par nyams su len/ dang po ltar na de ltar byed pa de gzhung lugs nub pa'i rkyen du thal/ thos bsam dang nyams len gyi gzhung mtshams so sor bcad pa'i phyir/ ci ste ma smras so zhe na/ kho bo cag gis ji ltar smras/ rnam pa kun tu mtshungs so// gnyis pa mngon rtogs kyi rigs rgyas par bshad pa la/ spyi'i 'brel dang*/ so so'i 'brel gnyis/ dang po la/ a bh+ya ka ras/ rnam pa kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa ni/ rnam mkhyen yin la/ rgyu sbyor ba la/ der btags pa yin par bzhed/ 'di yang chos bcu gcig gi sgo nas bshad pa re shig gnyis su 'dus te/ yul skye med gsum/ yul can mkhyen gsum gyi rnam par bsdus nas sgom pa'i rnam rdzogs sbyor ba ngos bzung ba dang*/ de rgyud la ji ltar skyes pa'i rim pa gnyis/

dang po la/ mtshan gzhi mkhyen gsum sbyor ba ming gi sgo nas bshad pa dang*/ mtshan nyid/ dgu bcu rtsa gcig gi sgo nas de'i don bstan pa'o// dang po la/ sbyor ba dngos dang*/ sbyor ba'i khyad chos gnyis/ dang po la/ sgom bya rnam pa ngos bzung ba dang*/ de gang zag gi rgyud la skyes pa de sbyor bar bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ rnam pa brgya bdun rtsa gsum ste/ de yang 'dir bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i sgom bya rnam pa ni/ spyir shes rnam kho na yin te/ ye shes kyi bye brag tu gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyad par byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa kho na yin te/ 'di'i sgom pa po rten gyi gang zag byang sems kho na yin pa'i phyir/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'i gnyen po nyid du zhes sogs su/ nyan rang gi rgyud la yod pa lta bur bshad pa ni/ rtogs rigs kyi rten so sor nges pa'i rnam pa bsal ba'i dper brjod yin te/ dper na/ slob ma byang chub sems dpa' dang zhes bshad pa bzhin no// de lta na'ang skabs 'dir/ don rnam dngos su ma bstan pa ni min te/ gzhi shes dang lam shes kyi rnam pa ston pa'i mdor/ shes rnam dang don rnam gnyis ka dngos su bstan pa'i phyir te/ bcom ldan 'das yum 'di ni ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o// zhes sogs dang*/ yum 'di ni 'dod chags dang bral ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o// zhes sogs/ rab 'byor gyi zhus pa rnams kyis shes rnam dang*/ bka' stsal pa/ nam mkha' ltar med pa'i phyir zhes sogs dang*/ bka' stsal pa/ 'dod chags dmigs su med pa'i phyir ro// zhes sogs kyis don rnam dngos su bstan/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i mdor/ rab 'byor dang bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa gnyis kas kyang don rnams dngos su bstan pa'i phyir ro// bstan bcos las kyang mdor bstan gyis shes rnam dngos su bstan cing*/ rgyas bshad du/ dngos su don rnam bstan nas shes rnam mtshon te bstan no// zhes ma pham bstan pa'i nyi ma sangs rgyas dpal gsung ngo*// mdor na skye med gsum rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi khyad par de sgom bya shes rnam yin zhes ston/

gnyis pa la rten gyi gang zag spyir ngos bzung ba dang*/ khyad par can gyi sgom pa sbyor bar bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ spyir skye med gsum nyan pa'i snod dang*/ khyad par rnam pa brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum sgom pa'i snod gnyis kyis ston te/ bcas shes pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ sbyor ba nyi shus ston/ gnyis pa khyad chos la sgom pa po spro ba bskyed pa'i yan lag yon tan blang bar bstan pa dang*/ rtogs pa bogs dbyung ba'i yan lag sbyor ba sgom pa la bar du gcod pa'i skyon dor byar bstan pa gnyis/ de gnyis kyang go rim de ltar ston dgos te/ yon tan ma mthong na sbyor ba sgom pa la mi 'jug cing*/ sbyor ba mi sgom pa la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ sbyor ba zhes pa'i ming gi tha snyad tsam shes kyang*/ de'i ngo bo khong du ma chud pas ston dgos so// mtshon bya dang*/ mtshan nyid gnyis kyi sgo nas ston te/ ming don gyi 'brel pa shes pa'i ched yin no// mtshan gzhi dang mtshan nyid gnyis kyang go rim de ltar ston dgos te/ thog mar mtshan gzhi'i steng du mtshon bya'i tha snyad la dpyod pa zhugs nas phyis mtshan nyid 'dri ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa rgyud la ji ltar skyes pa'i rim pa la/ sbyor ba tsam skyes pa'i rim pa dang*/ sku gsum 'phrin las dang bcas pa so sor nges pa'i sbyor ba khyad par can ji ltar skyes pa'i rim pa'o// dang po la/ sbyor ba dang por skyes pa'i gnas skabs dang*/ skyes nas yon tan gyi khyad par ci zhig thob pa gnyis/ dang po la/ sangs rgya ba la ring du thogs pa'i sbyor ba dang por skyes pa'i gnas skabs dang*/ lung bstan thob pa'i sbyor ba dang por skyes pa'i gnas skabs gnyis rim pa ltar thar pa cha mthun dang*/ nges 'byed cha mthun gnyis kyis ston no// de las yon tan gyi khyad par ci zhig thob pa ni/ slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs so// gnyis pa ni/

de ltar rnam rdzogs sbyor ba spyir sgom pas/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par nges pa na/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyu so sor nges pa sgom pa la 'jug pas/ sku gsum so sor nges pa'i rgyu la 'jug pa dang*/ phrin las kyi rgyu la 'jug pa gnyis/ dang po la chos sku'i rgyu srid zhi mnyam nyid/ gzugs sku'i rgyu zhing dag pa gnyis te/ gsum po rim par ston no// rgyu gsum pa rim par ston dgos te/ 'bras bu chos sku las gzugs sku'i snang ba 'byung zhing*/ des phrin las mdzad pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa so so'i 'brel la/ sbyor ba la 'jug tshul gtan la phab pa dang*/ sbyor ba skyes pa'i go rim gnyis/ dang po la/ bsgom bya rnam pa/ sgom pa po gang zag yul can sbyor ba'i dbye ba/ sbyor ba'i sngon 'gro'i chos/ nye rgyu thar pa cha mthun/ dang po la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad/ don bsdu ba'o// dang po la/ mdo'i 'brel ni/ mkhyen gsum gyi mjug bsdu la 'phros nas/ rab 'byor gyis gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das yum 'di ni ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o// zhes so// bstan bcos kyi 'brel ni/ rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa dang*// zhes bstan pa de/ rnam pa sbyor bar bcas rnams dang*// zhes sogs kyi bshad pa las/ rnam pa de'i mtshan nyid gang*/ dbye ba ni du zhig ce na/ gzhi shes pa yi bye brag rnams zhes so// 'dir btsun pa rnam grol sdes/ dmigs pa'i khyad par bzung ba la// rnam pa zhes ni bya bar brjod// ces so// kha che'i 'bum ṭīka las/ gzhi shes pa yi khyad par gyis// rnam pa zhes bya'i mtshan nyid do// zhes so// gser gling pa/ gzhi dang ye shes rnam pa rnams// rnam pa zhes bya'i mtshan nyid de// zhes ston nas/ gzhi ni skabs dang po gsum du gsungs pa'i gnyen po ma lus pa yin la/ ye shes ni de la dmigs par byed pa'i sems kyi khyad par ro// de rnams kyi rnam pa gang yin pa de ni snang ba'o// zhes bzhed/
