shān+ti pa/ gzhi ye shes bye brag rnams// zhes 'don/ 'grel chen las/ gzhi ni mi rtag sogs rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag rnams rnam pa nyid du rnam par bzhag pa ni mtshan nyid de/ slob dpon chos kyi bshes gnyen ni// rtsa bar/ gzhi dang ye shes rnam pa rnams// zhes dang*/ 'grel par/ dmigs pa dang*/ ye shes dang*/ rnam pa rnams zhes ston nas/ gzhi mi rtag sogs rtogs pa'i theg chen gyis mkhyen pa de gzhi shes kyi rnam pa/ mi rtag sogs sgro 'dogs so gnyis dang bral bar rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi ye shes de lam shes kyi rnam pa/ chos thams cad kyi rnam pa ma lus pa mngon du rtogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa de rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin zhes gsung ngo*// mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/ 'dir phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad ni gzhi yin te/ rtag sogs su sgro 'dogs pa dang*/ mi rtag la sogs pa'i rten pa'i phyir/ de rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi bye brag rnams shes rnam zhes bya'i mtshan nyid de mtshan gzhi yin pas/ 'dir bstan shes rnam la mtshan gzhi med pa'i skyon med do// shugs la/ bden pa bzhi'i khyad par rnams// don rnam zhes bya'i mtshan nyid de// zhes 'don no// zhes bzhed pa rnams kyi dgongs pa ni/ rkang pa dang po gnyis kyis ngo bo mdor bstan/ tha ma gnyis kyis dbye ba mdor bstan/ de la gzhi ni/ gzhi lam rnam pa gsum mo// shes pa ni rtogs pa'o// bye brag ni/ sdug bden mi rtag par rtogs pa lta bu khyad par rnams te/ brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum mo// de ltar gsal ba'i dbye ba mtha' las 'das kyang*/ rigs kyis bsdu na gsum du 'dus te gzhi'i dus su thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa'i mkhyen pa gsum po de nyid nyams su len pa'i rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ kun mkhyen nyid ni rnam gsum phyir// zhes so// mdor na/ sdug bsngal mi rtag pa sogs rtogs pa'i ye shes brgya dang bdun cu rtsa gsum ni chos can/

gnyen po shes rnam kyi mtshan gzhi yin te/ bden bzhi'i gnas tshul dang mthun par zhugs pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ bden bzhi'i steng du rtag sogs sgro 'dogs brgya dang bdun cu rtsa gsum chos can/ mi mthun phyogs kyi shes rnam yin te/ bden pa bzhi la log par zhugs pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ rtag pa la sogs par 'dzin pa mi mthun phyogs kyi gnyen po'i chos nyid ces so// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa rgyas par bshad/ lam shes kyi rnam pa rgyas par bshad/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po la/ 'brel ni/ rnam gsum zhes bstan pa de gang zhe na/ bshad pa zhes ston pa ni/ rnam pa rnams spyir bstan pa zhes so// dang po la mdo ni/ bcom ldan 'das yum 'di ni ma mchis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o// zhes pa nas/ yum 'di ni mi g.yo ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o// zhes sogs nyer bdun gsungs pa rnams so// de bsdud pa ni med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung ste/ zhes so// de'i don 'grel pas 'chad pa la/ bden pa dang po gsum gyi rnam pa bshad pa dang*/ lam bden gyi rnam pa bshad pa'o// dang po la/ mngon pa nas gsungs pa'i rnam pa dang*/ sher phyin nas gsungs pa mi mthun no snyam pa dgag pa'i phyir/ mngon pa nas gsungs pa dang sbyar nas 'chad pa ni/ med pa dang*/ mi skye ba dang*/ dben pa dang nas mi rtag pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dag yin no zhes pa'i bar ro// gnyis pa lam bden gyi rnam pa la/ rten lam gyi dbye ba/ lam so so'i dbye ba/ grangs kyi sgo nas don bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gzhi shes kyis bsdus pa'i lam bden gyi rnam pa chos can/ gsum yod de/ nyan rang ma phye ba'i nyon sgrib kyi gnyen por lam zag med gcig shes sgrib gzung rtog gi gnyen por rang rgyal gyi lam zag bcas zag med gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa shes sgrib kyi gnyen por bstan pa mi rigs te/

gzhi shes ni nyon sgrib kyi gnyen por gnas pa'i phyir zhe na/ skyon med de/ gzhi shes kyis rang rgyal gyi mngon rtogs kyang bsdus pa'i phyir yang na gzhi shes shes sgrib bzung rtog gi gnyen por yang gnas pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'i gnyen po nyid du zhes sogs so// 'phags seng bud+dha shrīs lam dang po mthong sgom ma byed par spyir gsung*/ gnyis pa sgom lam dang*/ gsum pa mthong lam du gsal bar gsungs te/ nyi snang dang 'grel chen shes rab sgrol ma rnams las/ shes bya'i sgrib pa'i gnyen po'i lam ni rnam pa gnyis te/ sgom pa'i lam zag pa dang bcas pa dang*/ mthong ba'i lam zag pa med pa'o// grangs bzhin du sgom pa dang mthong ba'i lam gyis bdag nyid ces bshad pa'i phyir ro// sher 'byung blo gros kyis/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyis/ nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa ma spangs pa nyid du mtshungs pa'i phyir/ zhes lam dang po nyan rang ma phye bar bshad/ lam gsum pa mthong lam du bzhed/ chos shes/ lam dang po/ nyan rang la ma phye ba dang*/ phyi ma gnyis ka rang rgyal gyi sgom lam du bzhed de/ tshigs gsal las/ thams cad shes pa'i skabs su nyan thos kyi rnam pa bcu drug smos pa ni/ de dag gi mthong ba dang bsgom pa'i lam gyi mtshan nyid/ rang sangs rgyas kyi rnam pa bco lnga smos pa ni de dag gi mtshan nyid ces so// rnam bshad kyi dgongs pa'ang 'di nyid do// gser gling pa lam dang po nyan thos su 'chad/ shān+ti pa dang*/ rat+na kirti 'dir nyan rang dang*/ mthong sgom dbye ba mi mdzad do// 'dir lo ts+tsha ba chen po'i zhal snga nas/ slob dpon seng bzang gzhi shes kyi nyan rang gi mngon rtogs bsdus par 'chad pa ni skabs su ma bab ste/ 'di gzhi shes kyi rnam pa 'chad pa'i skabs yin la/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa gzhi shes su bsdus pa la dgos pa med cing*/ sdud mi nus pa'i phyir/

sdug kun gyi don rnam pa brgyad po yang gzhi shes su bsdud dgos par ha cang thal lo// ci ste/ 'dir yul can gzhi shes ston par 'dod na/ skabs don bor bar 'gyur te/ lam bden gyi rnam pa ma bstan pa'i phyir ro// des na lam gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i skabs 'phags pa gsum gyi shes sgrib kyi gnyen po bstan par 'phags pa bzhed pa ltar yin/ zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa la/ nyon sgrib kyi gnyen po zag med bzhi mngon pa nas gsung pa dang sbyar nas 'chad pa ni/ de la dang po la byed pa po zhes so// shes sgrib gzung rtog gi gnyen por sgom lam zag bcas lnga 'chad pa ni/ gnyis pa la zhes so// shes sgrib gzung rtog gi gnyen po sgom lam zag med 'chad pa ni/ gsum pa la zhes sogs so// don bsdu ba ni/ de ltar zhes sogs so// 'di dag gi skabs su/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa dang po bcu drug la/ sher phyin las gsungs pa'i chos kyi bdag med pa'i rnam pa bcu drug ni byang sems kyi yin la/ mngon pa nas bshad pa'i gang zag gi bdag med pa'i rnam pa bcu drug ni/ nyan rang gi yin no// lam phyi ma bcu gcig gi skabs su/ rnam bshad las/ rang rgyal gzung ba'ang lam gyi rnam gzhag so sor nges pa'i rten ngos bzung ba yin gyi/ 'di'i bsgom bya shes rnam ni/ byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa kho na 'dzin dgos te/ don bsdu las/ de la thams cad shes pa nyid kyi rnam pa nyid rnam pa ni/ nyan thos dang byang chub sems pa'i bye brag gis/ zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa lam gnyis kyi rnam pa la/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa bshad zin pa'i 'og tu lam shes kyi rnam pa 'chad de/ nyon sgrib dang shes sgrib gzung rtog gi gnyen po sgom rjes su/ shes sgrib 'dzin rtog gi gnyen por chos kyi bdag med bsgom pa'i phyir zhes ston pa ni/ de'i 'og tu zhes sogs so// sngar mkhyen gsum bstan pa'i go rim dang mi mthun pa ni/

'dir rgyud la skye ba'i rim pa'i dbang du byas pa'am/ yang na 'di mkhyen gsum gyi don bsdus la 'phros pa yin pas de'i go rim ltar bshad do// 'brel pa can dngos la/ mdo ni rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das yum 'di ni 'dod chags dang bral ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o// zhes pa nas yum 'di ni dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o// zhes pa'i bar gsungs so// de bsdud pa ni/ rgyu dang lam dang sdug bsngal dang*// zhes sogs so// 'di la snga phyi'i rigs pas/ 'dod chags dang bral ba nas bzung ste ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'i bar zhes sbyar ro// zhes gzhung sbyor las gsungs so// 'grel pas 'chad pa la/ go rim la mi mthun pa spangs te/ mdor bstan pa ni/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dang*/ zhes so// rgyas par bshad pa la/ 'bum phrag gsum pa'i zhal nas/ kun 'byung spang bya yin pas/ spang gnyen gyi sgo nas bstan/ lam rgyud la brten bya yin pas dam bca' dang 'thad pa'i sgo nas bstan/ sdug bsngal shes bya yin pas/ rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas bstan/ 'gog bden mngon du bya rgyu yin pas/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi sgo nas bstan/ zhes gsungs pa ltar bshad pa la/ 'dir bshad pa'i lam shes kyi rnam pa so drug po mngon pa nas bshad pa dang mi mthun pas/ bden bzhi'i chos min no snyam pa bsal ba'i phyir/ mngon pa nas gsungs pa dang sbyar nas 'chad pa ni/ de la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i dang*/ zhes sogs so// nges 'byin la 'thad pa mi ston pa ni/ gdul bya nye ba'i bsam pa la ltos pa yin la/ sdug bden la rang spyi'i khyad par ni/ snga ma bzhi gang zag gi bsam pas rang mtshan du zhen pa dang*/ lnga pa dang gang zag gi bsam pas spyi mtshan du zhen pa tsam yin gyi/ khyab che chung gi khyad par med ces slob dpon gyis gsungs so// ar gyis/ dang po bzhi gang zag gi bdag med kyi rnam pa dang*/

gnyis pa chos kyi bdag med kyi rnam pa yin no// zhes gsungs/ stong bdag med gnyis bden pa gzhan gyi'ang rnam pa yin mod/ sdug bden kho na'i rnam par ston pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ 'bum phrag gsum pa'i zhal nas/ mi rtag sdug bsngal gnyis de'i khyad chos su shes pa'i ched yin te/ bdag gi ba dang ngo bor gyur pa'i bdag yod na/ de gnyis de'i khyad chos su mi 'grub pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs/ 'phags pa thogs med ltar na/ sdug bden la phyin ci log bzhir sgro 'dogs pa yod pas de'i gnyen por bzhi po bstan/ phyin ci log bzhi las bzlog pa'i gegs sred pa bzhi yod pas kun 'byung la bzhi bstan/ de bzhi 'gog dgos pas 'gog bden la bzhi bstan/ de 'gags pa'i 'gog pa bzhi mngon du byed dgos pas/ lam la bzhi bstan zhes mngon pa kun las btus las gsungs so// 'gog bden gyi rnam pa bcu drug po mngon pa nas gsungs pa bzhi dang sbyar na bzhir 'dus te/ dngos po'i dri ma 'gog pa gsum 'gog pa dang sbyar/ mngon zhen gyi dri ma 'gog pa brgyad zhi ba dang sbyar/ byed pa po'i rtog pas dben pa gcig gya nom dang sbyar/ 'khrul pa'i dri ma bsal ba bzhi nges 'byung dang sbyar ba rnams so// 'dir stong nyid bcu drug ni/ 'gog pa sogs kyi ngo bo yin la/ de dag rtogs pa'i ye shes rnams ni 'gog pa sogs kyi rnam par 'gyur ro// stong nyid bcu drug po thams cad dag pa gnyis ldan yin te/ stong pa nyid ces pas rang bzhin rnam dag dang*/ mngon par zhen pa dgag pas zhes pa glo bur rnam dag gi don ston pa'i phyir/ de'i don yang mig sogs gdod ma nas rang gi ngo bo bden grub kyis stong pa dang*/ phyi nang sogs su mngon par zhen pa'i dri ma bar chad med lam gyi bkag pa de dang bral bas rab tu phye ba'i stong nyid yin pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu dag pa gzugs la sogs// zhes pa'i don no// nges 'byung la ji ltar nges 'byung dang*/

gang nges 'byung gnyis las/ gnyis po'i khyad par la dang po ni/ slob lam na yod la/ phyi ma ni mya ngan las 'das pa yin no// zhes ma pham bstan pa'i nyi ma sangs rgyas dpal gsung ngo*// nges par 'byung ba'i rnam pa kho na ngo bo nyid dgag pas/ zhes pa'i don ni/ nges 'byung gnyis kyi nang nas gang nges 'byung kho na/ dngos por zhen pa gsum/ btags pa la mngon par zhen pa brgyad/ byed pa po la zhen pa gcig 'khrul pa gsum ste/ zhen pa bco lnga bsal ba'i nges 'byung bden pa ba yod dam snyam pa'i dri ma bkag pas rab tu phye ba'i stong nyid yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i don no// skabs 'dir snga rabs pa rnams/ bden pa dang po gsum gyi shes rnam gyi yul ni/ lam min pas lam shes su mi rung la/ de dag gi shes rnam yul du byed pa nyid lam shes bzung ngo*// zhes gsung la/ rnam bshad las ni/ bden pa dang po gsum rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi rigs rgyun nyams su myong ba'i ldog pa nas lam shes su bstan pa yin no// zhes gsung la/ ral gri ni/ rang rig la lam shes pa mi rung ngo*// zhes kyang gsungs so// gsum pa rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam rgyas par bshad pa la/ snga phyi'i 'brel ni/ de'i 'og tu zhes sogs so// 'di la mkhan chen rin po ches/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa rnams yongs su shes pa ni/ dbang du bya ba'i phyir rnam par sgom par byed pa rnam pa brgya dang bcu po kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa zhes sbyar ro// 'brel pa can dngos la/ bshad bya'i mdo ni/ bcom ldan 'das yum 'di ni dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o// zhes pa nas chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa'i bar ro// de bsdud pa ni/ gzhung sbyor ltar na/ dran pa nyer gzhag nas bzung ste/ sangs rgyas rnam pa'i mthar thug par// rnam kun mkhyen pa'i bye brag rnams// rnam pa zhes bya mtshan nyid de// lam gyi bden pa'i rjes mthun par// zhes so don ni/

sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud kyi rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa chos can/ brgya dang bcur yod de/ slob ma nyan thos la yod pa'i lam bden dang rjes su mthun par gzhi shes kyi rnam pa so bdun phye/ byang sems la yod pa'i lam bden dang rjes su mthun par lam shes kyi rnam pa so bzhi phye/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam bden gyi dbye bas rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa so dgur phye ba'i phyir zhes pa ste/ chos shes kyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam pa brgya dang bcu ni/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes chen po gcig pu pa de'i mtshan nyid do// zhes pa ltar ro// gsum du 'byed pa mi 'thad de/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa kho na ston pa'i skabs yin pa'i phyir/ zhe na skyon med par ston pa ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad bsdus pa'i phyir zhes pa'o// 'dir sangs rgyas kyi rgyud la yod pa kho na bzung na rten gyi gang zag so sor nges par bshad pa mi 'thad do zhe na/ skyon med de 'phags pa thams cad kyi rtogs rigs yar ldan du 'dus par rtogs pa'i ched yin no// 'o na dngos po la yongs su rtog pa'i lam zhes dang*/ dro ba dang rtse mo'i ngo bo nyid ces sogs slob lam kho na bshad pa min nam zhe na/ de yang dang por dmigs rnam sgom tshul sogs kyi rgyud la ji ltar bskyed pa'i rim pa'i sgo nas ma bstan na/ de'i rigs rgyun yar ldan du thob pa ngos bzung bar mi nus pa'i phyir ro// des na 'di'i bstan bya'i gtso bo ni rnam mkhyen kho na yin la/ dngos su bstan pa/ nyan rang dang byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa rnams yin zhes brjod pa legs so// skabs 'dir sher 'byung blo gros kyis/ 'di ltar gsungs te/ rnam mkhyen gyis lam shes dang*/ gzhi shes gnyis bsdus na/ de gnyis logs su bstan pa don med cing sngar logs su bstan kyang phyis bsdus te bshad pa yin na/

sngar rnam mkhyen gcig pur bstan rigs par thal zhe na/ gzhi lam rtogs pa yod pa tsam gyis rnam pa thams cad rtogs pa yod pa min/ rnam pa thams cad rtogs pa yod na/ de gnyis rtogs pa yod pas/ rnam mkhyen gyis gnyis po bsdus par 'thad cing*/ sngar gnyis po logs su bstan pa don med pa min te/ rnam pa rnams phan tshun bsdus pa min pa'i phyir/ rnam mkhyen gcig pu logs su bstan par yang mi nus te/ gzhi lam gnyis la gnas pa'i rnam pa rnams kho na rnam mkhyen gyi rtogs bya yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i don du bshad/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pas/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa nyer bdun dang so bdun zlos so zhe na/ min te/ sngar bden pa bzhi ka'i sgo nas bstan/ 'dir lam bden gcig pu'i sgo nas bstan pa'i phyir/ de lta na yang lam bden gyi bco lnga dang mi zlos te/ gong du mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas bstan/ 'dir mtshan gzhi'i sgo nas bshad pa'i phyir/ lam shes la'ang de bzhin no zhes gsungs te/ legs par bshad pa'i gter ro// de dag rgyas par bshad pa la/ slob pa'i byang phyogs so bdun gyis/ gzhi shes las phyi ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa mtshon te bshad pa dang*/ gnyen po'i lam so drug gis lam shes las phye ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa mtshon te bshad pa/ gnyen po'i lam so drug gis lam shes las phye ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa mtshon te bshad pa/ thun mong min pa'i yon tan gyi sgo nas rnam mkhyen dngos su bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po sde tshan bdun gyi sgo nas 'chad la/ dngos po la yongs su rtog pa'i lam la sogs pa bdun ni/ dang por thob pa'i gnas skabs kyi ming ngo*// zhes blo gros seng ges theg gsum gsal byed du bshad do// sde tshan bdun du phye ba ni/ spyir btang la dang por thob pa'i sa mtshams kyi dbang du byas pa yin te/ mdzod las/ sde tshan bdun ni go rim bzhin// las ni dang po pa dag dang*// nges 'byed cha mthun rnams dang ni// sgom dang mthong la rab tu phye// zhes bshad la/

mdo sde pa yan chad tshogs lam chung ngu 'bring chen po gsum dang*/ drod rtse gnyis dang*/ bzod mchog gnyis dang*/ mthong lam dang sgom lam la rim par 'jog par mngon pa kun las btus sogs las bshad la/ mthong lam yang 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi ngo bor mi bzhed do// thub dgongs su/ mthong ba'i lam gyi skad cig dang po la ni dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag med de/ de tshe sngar de bzhin nyid mthong ba med pa'i phyir/ zhes bshad/ mdo sde'i rgyan las ni/ so bdun po thams cad sa dang po nas thob par bshad de/ rgyal sras byang chub phyogs mthun pa// rnam pa sna tshogs thams cad ni// rtag tu mthong ba'i lam nyid dang*// lhan cig tu ni thob par 'dod// ces gsungs so// de ltar so bdun po 'di dngos bstan byang sems/ shugs bstan nyan rang*/ bstan bya'i gtso bo sangs rgyas la/ zhes snga rabs pa rnams 'chad do// gnyis pa byang sems dang thun mong ba'i yon tan so bzhis lam shes las phye ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa mtshon te bshad pa la/ gnyen po'i lam so drug po gsum du bsdud de/ lhag mthong khyad par can rnam thar sgo gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin/ zhi gnas khyad par can rnam thar brgyad dang snyoms 'jug dgu'i ting nge 'dzin/ zung du 'brel ba spong ba'i lam dang*/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam rnams so// go rim la/ byang phyogs so bdun ni rgyud la bskyed pa'i rim pa yin la/ 'di dag ni bshad pa'i go rim mo// gsum pa thun mong min pa'i yon tan gyi sgo nas rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa bshad pa la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad/ don bsdu ba gsum/ dang po ni/ stobs so dgu ni chos can/ byang phyogs dang 'dra bar thun mong ma yin te/ rgyun mtha' man chad du rigs 'dra mtshan nyid pa sngon du ma song ba'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan yin pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rnam pa ni zhes sogs so// 'dir thun mong min pa'i gcig pu kho na ste/

zhes 'byung ba la brten nas snga rabs pa rnams thun mong ba'i rnam pa dang*/ thun mong min pa'i rnam pa gnyis kyi tha snyad mdzad pa de'i don no// snga ma rnams 'di ltar bzhed de/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud kyi so bdun po la nyan thos dang thun mong zhes bya ste/ spyir nyan thos kyi rgyud la so bdun po mtshan nyid pa yod pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud kyi rnam thar sgo gsum sogs bzhi la/ byang sems dang thun mong ba zhes bya ste/ de dag mtshan nyid pa byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud la yod pa'i phyir/ lhag ma so dgu po la thun mong min pa zhes bya ste/ 'phags pa 'og ma la de dag mtshan nyid pa med pa'i phyir/ sa dgu par so sor yang dag par rig pa bzhi bshad pa ni mtshan nyid pa min te/ 'dri ba kun gyi lan 'debs pa med pa'i phyir ro zhes bzhed/ bdag gi blo la 'di ltar snang ste/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud kyi rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa brgya dang bcu po de la thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i gnyis su 'jog pa ni yi ge'i don min te/ 'o na ci zhe na/ rtsa bar/ 'phags pa bzhi'i lam bden dang rjes su mthun par rnam mkhyen la gsum du phye zhes bstan pa la/ 'phags pa bzhi'i lam gyi bden pa rang gang zhe na/ thun mong ba'i lam bden dang*/ thun mong min pa'i lam bden dngos su ston pa yin no// thun mong ba'i skabs dngos su bstan pa rnams rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa min pa'i phyir/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa la thun mong ba dang thun mong min pa gnyis su 'byed pa ni skabs las 'chol zhing*/ thun mong ba'i yon 'di dag gis mtshon nas bstan pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa rnams ni sangs rgyas kho na'i thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i phyir/ 'phags chung 'og ma su zhig dang thun mong bar 'gyur snyam du rtogs so// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ brten pa yon tan gyi dbye ba dang*/ rten ye shes kyi rang bzhin gnyis/

dang po la nus pa'i yon tan dang*/ bag tsha ba med pa'i yon tan/ chos ston pa'i yon tan/ rnam par dag pa'i yon tan no// dang po ni stobs bcu ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ thabs dang skyabs dang dag pa dang*// theg chen nges par 'byung ba la// sems can rnams ni rab bslu ba'i// bdud 'joms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsung*/ gnyis pa ni/ mi 'jig pa bzhi ste/ rang gzhan don du ye shes dang*// spang ba nges 'byung gegs mdzad la// ston mdzad mu stegs gzhan dag gis// mi brdzi khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa ltar ro// gsum pa ni/ so so yang dag rig pa bzhi ste/ rten dang brten pa bshad bya dang*// gsung dang mkhyen pa 'chad byed la// blo gros rtag thogs mi mnga' ba'i// legs ston khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa ltar ro// bzhi pa ni ma 'dres pa bco brgyad de/ spyod pa dang ni rtogs pa dang*// ye shes dang ni phrin las kyis// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas kun gyi// bla ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes 'byung ba ltar ro// go rim ni/ phyi ma phyi ma rnams/ snga ma snga ma la brten pa lta bur blos zhen pa'i phyir/ rim par ston/ rten ye shes kyi rang bzhin la gsum ste/ 'dir de bzhin nyid ni yul can ye shes la bya dgos te/ mdo las pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgras gsungs pa'i phyir ro// 'on kyang chos shes ni chos nyid la bzhed par snang ste tshig gsal las/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bshad pa'i de bzhin nyid de ni mya ngan las 'das pa yin te/ mya ngan las 'das pa gang zhe na/ de bzhin nyid rnam par dag pa'o// zhes bshad do// zhes gsung*/ rang byung gi rnam pa dang*/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam pa la khyad par ci yod ce na/ chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis/ de bzhin nyid la dmigs te rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob pa na/ dngos po rnams la dbang sgyur ba'i mthu'i sgo nas ni rang byung du bzhag la/ de nyid kyis sna tshogs par ma 'dres par mkhyen pa'i sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi rnam par bzhag ces gsungs so// nyi snang las/

rnam pa'i dbye ba gang yin pa stobs sogs dang*/ de rnams kyi ngo bo nyid gang yin pa de bzhin nyid dang*/ de rnams las mnga' sgyur ba gang yin pa rang 'byung dang*/ ched du bya ba gang yin pa sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam par bshad do// gsum pa don bsdu ba la gzhung 'di dag dhi ra ba la/ rnam pa ma lus pa'i yul can du 'dod/ su ga ta shrī/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i don bsdu bar 'chad la/ dang po ltar yi ge'i don la zhugs pas/ ngo bo'i sgo nas so so'i don bsdu ba dang*/ grangs kyi sgo nas thun mong gi don bsdu ba gnyis/ dang po la/ med pa'i rnam pa sogs nyer bdun gyi don bsdu ba ni/ de la zhes sogs te/ don ni/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa lngar bshad pa dag las/ mngon pa nas gsungs pa'i mi rtag sogs bcu drug gi rnam pa can nyan thos kyi rgyud la yod pa rnams ni zag med yin te/ rang don du nyon sgrib kyi gnyen por mnyam gzhag tu bsgom par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir rang rgyal gyi rgyud la yod pa ni/ gzhung las ma bshad pa ltar mi bzung ste/ sngar zag bcas yod par bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro// sher phyin las gsungs pa'i chos kyi bdag med kyi rnam pa can byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa nyer bdun ni zag bcas zhes bya ste/ rjes thob tu shes par bya ba'i rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa rnam bshad kyi dgongs pa'o// yang na nyan thos kyi rgyud la yod pa ni zag med ces bya ste/ nyon mongs ched du gnyer nas spong ba'i gnyen po'i rigs su gnas pa'i phyir/ byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa rnams ni zag bcas zhes bya ste/ rang don du nyon mongs kyi gnyen por mi sgom pa'i gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir byang sems kyi gzhi shes kyi mi rtag sogs bcu drug dang*/ chos kyi bdag nyid gcig char rtogs pa mi 'gal te/ byang sems kyi dbang du byas te/ mngon pa nas gsungs pa dang*/ sher phyin nas gsungs pa don gcig par bshad pa'i phyir ro// rgyu dang lam dang zhes sogs kyi don bsdu ba ni/

lam shes pa nyid kyi rnam pa ni zhes so// dran pa nyer gzhag nas bzung ste/ zhes pa'i don bsdu ba ni/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi lam gyi rnam pa ni zhes sogs/ de'i don ni/ nyan thos dang byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa'i so bdun dang so bzhi po yang rnam mkhyen gyi rnam par bzung ngam zhe na/ min no// zhes ston pa'o// 'o na slob lam na rnam pa brgya bdun bcu rtsa gsum sgom pa med par 'gyur la/ de lta na rnam rdzogs sbyor ba med par thal lo zhe na/ nyes pa med de/ rnam pa brgya bdun bcu rtsa gsum po kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa ni sangs rgyas yin la/ slob lam na yod pa ni de'i sbyor ba ste/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba zhes bya'o// grangs kyi sgo nas thun mong gi don bsdu ba ni/ rnam pa rnams zhes sogs bya'o// skabs 'dir nyi snang 'grel chen gnyis la/ bcu drug las gzhan dri med kyi// rnam pa yod min zhes gang bshad pa de ni nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa tsam gyi gnyen po'i rnam pas phye ba la dgongs pa yin pas de dang 'di la 'gal ba med do// zhes sogs/ gnyis pa sgom pa po gang zag la/ rnam pa'i 'og tu gang zag 'chad rigs te/ ji skad bshad pa'i rnam pa de sbyor bas ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul brjod dgos pas/ de yang sgom pa po ma bstan par brjod mi nus pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni sbyor ba khyad par can dag gis rnam pa rnams sgom dgos na/ zhes sogs so// 'brel pa can dngos la/ mdo ni/ de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ yum 'di rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang gi rna lam du grags par gyur pa de dag kyang sngon gyi rgyal ba la bsnyen bkur byas pa'o// dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa'o// dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung ba yin no zhes so// de bsdud pa ni/ sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas// zhes sogs te/

sh+lau ka dang pos nyan pa'i snod dang*/ phyi mas bsam byung gi 'dzin pa dang*/ sgom byung gi tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'i snod de bstan no// gsum pa yul can sbyor ba'i dbye ba la/ 'brel ni/ sgom pa po'i gang zag des rnam pa rnams bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor de la sbyor ba zhes ming gis 'dogs so zhes ston pa ni/ de ltar sbyor ba po bstan nas zhes so// dngos la mdo ni/ brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang sems chen po yum la gnas par 'gyur ba lags zhes sogs zhus pa la/ kau shi ka 'di la byang sems chen pos yum la spyod pa'i tshe/ gzugs la mi gnas te/ gang gi tshe gzugs la mi gnas pa de'i tshe gzugs la rnal 'byor du byed pa yin no// zhes sogs/ de bsdud pa ni/ gzugs la sogs la mi gnas phyir// zhes sogs so// 'di bud+dha shrī/ rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba lnga/ gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba bco lnga zhes bzhed/ 'bre chen po/ dang po lnga rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba yin te/ gnas skabs thams cad du khyab par 'jug pa'i phyir/ bar pa bcu bzhi ni/ gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba yin te/ las dang po pa nas sa bcu pa'i gnas skabs de dang de dag tu sbyor ba'i phyir/ tha ma ni de dag grub par byed pa thabs kyi sbyor ba yin te/ sa mtshams kyis nges par byas nas brtson pa mi gtong ba'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ bcom ldan ral gri ni/ mi gnas pa'i sbyor ba ni rang bzhin yin la/ gzhan rnams ni de'i gnas skabs la btags pa yin no// ji ltar na/ bzhi po de nyid yul gyi sgo nas lnga/ gang zag gi sgo nas brgyad/ yum gyi rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'i sgo nas bzhi/ 'bras bu'i sgo nas gnyis/ dus kyi sgo nas gcig yin no zhes bzhed/ rnam bshad chen mo las/ yul bzung ba dang 'dzin pa la zhen pa bkag pa'i dbye bas dang po gnyis/ gzhi lam rnam pa'i chos nyid rtogs tshul gyi dbye bas gsum/

'bras bu thob tshul las tshegs chen yun rings rtogs pa yon tan gyi dbye bas bdun yul la 'phros pa'i gcod tshul gyi dbye bas bzhi/ phrin las kyi dbye bas gcig sbyor ba mthar thug pa'i gnas skabs gcig tha ma la sa mtshams kyi sbyor ba zhes gsung*/ nyi khri snang ba las/ zab pa'i sbyor ba sogs gsum la mkhyen gsum gyis sbyor ba zhes gsung zhing*/ chung dang 'bring dang chen po'i dbye bas zab mo mngon par byang chub pa dang*/ thun mong min par byang chub pa dang*/ bla na med par mngon par byang chub pa'i dbang du byas par gsungs so// shān+ti pa'i dag ldan ltar na/ zab pa sogs gsum la'ang sbyor ba snga ma gnyis sbyar te/ rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba brgyad du bzhed/ sa mtshams la/ sher blo/ dang po lnga sbyor ba'i lam dang*/ de nas gcig mthong lam/ sgom lam chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pa'i rim pas dgu dang*/ khyad par gyi lam la gsum dang*/ bar chad med pa'i lam la gnyis te/ de ltar lam lngas sbyor ba nyi shu rdzogs pa yin no// zhes bzhed/ kha che gzhon du dpal/ de la lnga ni tshogs lam gyis bsdus la/ bco lnga ni sbyor lam nas sa bcu pa'i bar gyis bsdus par bzhed/ chos kyi bshes gnyen ni/ nyi shu po thams cad sbyor lam kho nar bzhed/ rnam bshad las bud+dha shrī'i bzhed pa ltar/ dang po lnga ni tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar/ tshegs chen yun ring rtogs pa sbyor lam/ de nas bzhi drod sogs bzhi la/ nye ba ni mthong lam nas/ myur ba ni sa gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar/ de nas lnga ni sa brgyad pa nas/ de nas gnyis ni sa dgu pa nas bcu pa/ sa mtshams kyi sbyor ba ni sa bdun man chad la bzhed/ nyi khri snang ba las/ sbyor ba nyi shu po 'di dag gi go rim ni rigs pa'i tshul nyid yin te/ chos thams cad la mngon par ma zhen par gnas pa dang*/ de la mi sbyor ba ni de dag gi zab pa dang*/ gting dpag dka' ba dang tshad med pa rtogs par 'gyur ro// sbyor ba ma yin pa byed pa nyid kyis ni las dang po pa tshegs chen pos thos pa dang*/

de las gzhan pa ni bde blag tu lung bstan pa dang*/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob nas nges par 'byung ba dang*/ mi 'bral bar 'gyur ba dang*/ mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa la nye bar gyur pa dang*/ smyur du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par 'gyur ro// de nas ni gzhan gyi don byed cing*/ 'phel ba dang 'grib pa med pa dang*/ chos sam chos ma yin pa la sogs pa'i 'du shes thams cad dang bral bas rnam par mi rtog pa dang*/ 'bras bu rin po che sbyin pas mchog tu rnam par dag pa'i mthar thug pa thob pa ni/ sngon nyid du lo'i bar du mngon par brtson pas sems kyi rgyu yongs su sbyangs pa yin no/ zhes gsungs so// dpal sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis ni/ nyi shu po bcur bsdus nas bshad de/ sbyor ba med pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ lung bstan nas nye ba dang*/ myur ba'i bar drug dang*/ 'phel 'grib med pa dang*/ chos dang chos ma yin pa so sor mi mthong ba dang*/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i sbyor ba bcur bsdus nas bshad do// bzhi pa sbyor ba'i sngon 'gro'i chos la/ blang bar bya ba yon tan/ dor bar bya ba skyon/ shes par bya ba mtshan nyid/ dang po la 'brel ni/ yon tan mthong ba sngon du btang nas bsgom dgos pas so// gzhon nu dpal gyis sbyor ba phyin ci ma log par sgom pa las yon tan 'byung bas so// zhes bshad/ dang po la mdo ni/ shā ri'i bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das su'i mthus byang sems chen po yum zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang*/ bstan pa dang*/ bcang ba dang*/ klog pa dang*/ kha don du bgyid pa dang*/ tshul bzhin yid la bgyi ba dang*/ sgom pa la bdud sdig can gyis bar chad bgyi bar mi nus pa lags/ bka' stsal pa sangs rgyas kyi mthu yi nus pa yin no// zhes gsungs/ de bsdud pa ni/ bdud kyi mthu bcom la sogs pa// zhes sogs so// chos shes kyis/ yon tan ni/ las dang po pa'i sa nas thob mod kyi/ legs par 'byor ba ni/

drod yan chad la sbyar bar bya zhes gsungs/ kha che gzhon nu dpal/ sa bcu dang*/ nges 'byed bzhi la yon tan bcu bzhi sbyar te 'chad/ 'grel par nyi shu rtsa brgyad bshad pas bcu bzhi ji ltar yin zhe na/ grangs bzhin du sbyar bas bcu bzhi yin par bshad la/ de la gser gling pa dang*/ ar/ snga ma rnams 'bras bu'i yon tan dang*/ phyi ma rnams rgyu'i yon tan yin zhes bzhed/ kha cig snga ma sbyor ba'i yon tan dang*/ phyi ma gang zag gi yon tan yin par 'dod/ 'di la ral gri na re/ yon tan nyi shu rtsa brgyad du thal ba dang*/ mngon du gzigs pa dang*/ ye shes kyi gzigs pa sogs la rgyu 'bras kyi khyad par kun mkhyen gyis kyang mi rnyed pa'i phyir/ des na 'phags pa grol sde la sogs pa yum bshad thabs kyi yan lag lnga gsung ba las ming gi rnam grangs kyi sgo nas bshad pa yin no// zhes bzhed/ rang lugs ni/ 'grel chen las/ phyi ma rnams snga ma rnams kyi sgrub byed du sbyar ba'i sde bshad/ nyi snang las ni/ snga ma rnams kho na bshad kyi phyi ma rnams bshad pa med do// yul dpyad pa dang zhes pa'i mdor/ yum 'di de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las 'das nas lho phyogs kyi rgyud du dar bar 'gyur/ de nas yul rta nir dar bar 'gyur ro zhes gsung*/ 'grel chen las/ rta ni zhes bya ba ni shar phyogs kyi yul lo// byang phyogs kyi yul thams cad du ma yin te/ 'on kyang byang gi phyogs char de rgya yul la sogs pa'i phyir/ zhes bshad/ gnyis pa dor bar bya ba skyon la 'brel ni/ sbyor ba sgom pas yon tan de dag bskyed pa la skyon gang zhig spang dgos zhe na/ bar chad byed pa'i skyon 'chad do// zhes ston pa ni/ da'i 'og tu zhes so// 'brel pa can dngos la/ bsal bya skyon dang*/ sel byed gnyen po gnyis/ dang po la mdo ni/ de nas rab 'byor gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo gang bla med byang chub la yang dag par gnas pa dang*/

phyin drug legs par spyod par gyur pa dang*/ sems can yongs su smin par byed par gyur pa de dag gi yon tan yongs su brjod pa ni 'di dag lags na/ rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo de dag la bar du gcod pa ci lta bu zhig 'byung bar 'gyur ba lags/ bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor byang sems chen po yum la spyod pa'i tshe/ tshegs chen pos pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byed pa ste/ zhes sogs so// de bsdud pa ni/ skyon ni bcu tshan zhes so// bsdu na/ rang la brten pa nyi shu/ mthun rkyen ma tshang ba nyer gsum/ gzhan la brten pa'i 'gal rkyen gsum/ zhes pa'am/ yang na/ ral gri bzhed pa ltar/ zhugs pa mthar phyin pa'i 'gal rkyen nyi shu/ ma zhugs pa 'jug par byed pa'i 'gal rkyen nyer gsum/ slar yang zhugs pa mthar phyin pa'i gegs gsum mo// yul la sogs pa dang*/ zhes pa'i mdo'i 'grel chen las/ yul ni mnyam dka' ma ka la sogs pas so// grong ni khyim gcig la sogs pa'o// grong khyer ni zo'i bye brag bco brgyad yod pa'i gnas so// grong rdal ni tshong pa mang po yod pa'i gnas la sogs pa'o// ljongs ni rigs bzhi yod pa'i sa phyogs so// yul 'khor ni rtsam pa la sogs pa'i yul 'khor chen po rnams so// la gcan 'phrang btsas kyi gnas so// bi shi la ni yo byad kyi khyad par ro// shi pi ka ni khyogs la sogs pa'o// la gcan gyi cho lo lta ba ni/ la gcan gyi gnas su ug shud la sogs pa rtse ba la blta ba'o// zhes bshad do// gnyis pa sel byed gnyen po ni/ de bas na sher phyin zab mo 'di 'dri ba dang*/ lung 'bog pa dang*/ kun chub par byed pa dang*/ tshul bzhin yid la byed pa la bdud las kyis mi tshugs par bya ba'i phyir/ rgyu bzhi la 'bad par bya dgos te/ de dang ldan pa la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bsrung ba dang*/ skyab pa dang*/

sba bar mdzad pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa shes par bya ba mtshan nyid la/ snga phyi'i 'brel ni/ skyon yon la blang dor gyi sgo nas sbyor ba sgom pa la/ mtshan nyid shes pa sngon du 'gro dgos te/ sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid ma shes par ming shes pa tsam gyis/ nyams su len par mi nus pa'i phyir/ dper na lto ldir ba mi shes par bum pa zhes pa'i ming tsam shes pas/ bum pa'i blang dor la mi 'jug pa bzhin no// zhes ston pa ni/ go rim bzhin du yon tan dang*/ skyon blang ba dang*/ dor bas zhes sogs so// 'brel pa can dngos la/ spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa dang*/ so so'i rnam par bzhag pa gnyis so// dang po la/ snga rabs mkhas pa'i lugs mi nyams pa'i bzhed pa'i rnam grangs spyir bkod pa dang*/ rang gang gi rjes su 'brang ba'i lugs de mtha' chod par brjod pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ kha che gzhon nu dpal na re/ sbyor ba khyad par can rgyud la skyes par mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas shes dgos pas mtshan nyid dgu rtsa gcig bstan no// de la shes mtshan ni phyogs chos/ byed mtshan ni mthun pa'i phyogs/ khyad par gyi mtshan nyid ni mi mthun phyogs las ldog pa'i tshul/ ngo bo nyid ni rtags kyis mtshon par bya ba'o// de yang rang rgyud la gtan la 'bebs pa'i tshe/ mkhyen gsum chos can/ gzhan rgyud gtan la 'bebs pa'i tshe/ skyes bu chos can no zhes zer/ bud+dha shrī/ 'dis sbyor ba rnams de bzhin gshegs pa skyed par mtshon par byed pas na mtshan nyid/ zhes zer/ 'brom ston pa na re/ rnal 'byor pa'i rgyud chos can/ mnyam gzhag tu mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba sgom shing rgyud la skyes pa'ang yin te/ rjes kyi dus su shes pa dang byed pa dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa 'bras bu'i gtan tshigs so// gtan tshigs des dpags pa'i sbyor ba de chos can/ nyan rang gi sbyor ba las khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ khyad chos bcu drug dang ldan pa'i phyir/

zhes pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba chos can/ dben pa bzhi'i ngo bo nyid yin te/ gzhi shes kyi byed pa gsum dang ldan pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du lam shes dang*/ rnam mkhyen la sbyar nas rang bzhin gyi gtan tshigs so zhes zer/ 'bre chen po na re/ rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba lnga tshan bzhi/ sangs rgyas skyed byed du mtshon/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs kyi mkhyen gsum gyi rtogs pa skyed byed yin pa des mi ldan pa rnam par bcad pa yin no// yang mtshan gzhi rang kho na/ de skyed byed du mtshon/ khyad par bcu drug dang ldan pa des gzhan dang ldan pa rnam par gcod/ yang mtshan gzhi sangs rgyas kyi phrin las skyed byed du mtshon/ sangs rgyas sa'i byed pa bcu gcig skyed byed du gnas pa zhes zer/ yang 'dul dkar sogs/ bar gyi mkhas pa phal mo che/ sangs rgyas sa'i shes pa bcu drug phrag gsum chos can/ sbyor ba'i shes mtshan yin te/ rang rgyud mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba rang skyed byed du mtshon par byed pa'i rang don rtogs pa phun tshogs yin pa'i phyir/ khyad par bcu drug ni/ sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yin te/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba theg dman gyi sbyor ba las khyad par 'phags par mtshon nus kyi rtogs pa khyad par can yin pa'i phyir/ byed pa bcu gcig ni sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yin te/ rang rgyud mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba rang skyed byed du mtshon par byed pa'i gzhan don 'phrin las phun tshogs yin pa'i phyir/ ngo bo nyid bcu drug ni/ sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid yin te/ mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba rnams shes khyad byed pa gsum gyis mtshon par bye ba'i gzhi lta bur mtshon byed kyi rtogs pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes zer/ lo ts+tsha ba chen po dpal go mi 'chi med kyi bzhed pa 'di ltar 'chad de/ mtshan nyid dang*/ mtshon byed dang*/ mtshan gzhi dang*/ mtshon pa ste bzhi'i sgo nas shes par bya la/

de yang dper na/ tsha zhing bsreg pa mtshan nyid/ me'i tha snyad bya rung mtshon bya/ rtsa las byung ba'i me mtshan gzhi/ mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum yongs su dpyod byed kyi tshad ma de la mtshon pa zhes bya la/ de bzhin du 'dir yang sbyor ba nyi shu po mtshan gzhi yin la/ de yang chos sku'i sgrub byed thun mong min pa yin pas/ gzhi shes kyi cha min zhing*/ slob pa'i gnas skabs yin pas rnam mkhyen gyi cha yang min la/ lam shes dngos dang rjes mthun pa'i cha gang yang rung ba yin no// lam shes kho na'i cha yin yang*/ mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba gsum du phye ba ni/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa la dmigs pa'i yul gyi sgo nas phye ba yin te/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa stong bdag med la dmigs pa gnas pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ gzhi shes kyis 'gog pa'i rnam pa bzhi dang*/ lam gyi bco lnga ste bcu dgu la dmigs pa rnal 'byor bkag pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa mi rtag sdug bsngal gnyis dang*/ kun 'byung gi bzhi ste drug la dmigs pa zab pa'i sbyor ba yin la/ de gsum gnas skabs kyi dbye ba tshegs chen yun ring rtogs pa sogs brgyad dang*/ de gsum sgom pa rdzogs pa 'phel 'grib med pa sogs bzhi dang*/ de gsum gyi 'bras bu/ 'bras bu rin chen sbyin pa dang*/ rnam par dag pa gnyis dang*/ de gsum gyi dus sa mtshams kyi sbyor ba dang bco brgyad la gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba zhes bya/ yang lam shes kyi rnam pa'i stong bdag med gnyis dang*/ ngo bo nyid med pa'i cha gsum la dmigs pa gnas pa bkag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ lam gyi bdun dang*/ 'gog pa'i bcu drug ste nyer gsum la dmigs pa rnal 'byor bkag pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ mi rtag sdug bsngal gnyis/ kun 'byung gi bzhi ste drug dang*/ ngo bo nyid med pa'i cha gcig la dmigs pa gting dpag dka' ba'i sbyor ba ste/ de la yang snga ma ltar bco brgyad du phye ba lam shes kyi sbyor ba dang*/

rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pas bsdus pa'i chos can gyi rnam pa brgya dang gnyis yod pa dang*/ stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi bar chad med pa'i lam dang*/ de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa'i cha gcig dang bcas pa la dmigs pa gnas pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ chos can gyi rnam pa brgya dang gnyis po'i chos nyid mtshan ma med pa dang*/ 'gog lam gnyis kyi bar chad med pa'i lam ste gsum dang*/ de bzhin nyid kyi cha gcig la dmigs pa rnal 'byor bkag pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ chos can gyi rnam pa brgya dang gnyis po'i smon pa med pa'i rnam pa dang*/ sdug bden gyi bar chad med lam gyi cha gcig dang*/ kun 'byung gi bar chad med lam dang*/ de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa'i cha gcig la dmigs pa tshad med pa'i sbyor ba ste/ de gsum la sngar ltar dbye ba bco brgyad ni/ rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba'o// mtshon bya ni/ khyad mtshan dang byed mtshan gyis rnam rdzogs sbyor bar mtshon pa min gyi/ chos sku'i rgyu mthun mong min par mtshon pa yin la/ de yang ngo bo nyid mtshan bcu drug gis ston pa yin no// sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ chos sku'i rgyu thun mong min pa'i sbyor bar mtshon pa la/ rang don phun tshogs sgrub byed khyad par gyi mtshan nyid dang*/ gzhan don phrin las phun tshogs sgrub byed byed pa'i mtshan nyid kyi tshogs pas mtshon pa yin la/ de la dbye na/ khyad mtshan bcu drug dang*/ byed mtshan bcu gcig go /mtshan nyid dang mtshan gzhi'i steng du nges byed kyi blo ni mtshon pa zhes bya la/ de yang sbyor ba la zhugs pa'i snga rol gyi thos bsam gyi shes rab dang*/ sbyor ba'i rjes kyi shes pa ci rigs su yod la/ des sbyor ba nyi shu mtshan gzhir byas/ khyad par dang byed pa'i mtshan nyid rgyu mtshan du bkod nas/ 'di ni chos sku'i rgyu thun mong min pa'i sbyor ba'o// zhes mtshon pa yin no// mtshon pa de yang*/ gzhi shes dang rnam mkhyen gyi cha min gyi/

lam shes rjes mthun pa'i cha yin no// de nyid kyang shes pa bcu drug phrag gsum gyis 'phangs nas ston pa yin gyi/ de dag mtshon pa ye shes dngos min te/ mtshon pa ye shes kyis ni khyad mtshan la dmigs la/ shes pa bcu drug phrag gsum gyis de la mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro// des na yul gyis yul can mtshon nas bstan pa yin no// mtshon pa ye shes kyis sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid gnyis dang*/ shes pa'i rnam pa bcu drug phrag gsum la dmigs pa yin no// zhes gsung ste/ legs par bshad pa'i cha shas dpag tu med pa yod do// bcom ldan rigs pa'i ral gris/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi me tog las/ mtshon cha ni rtog pas sgro btags pa'i cha yin gyi/ mtshan gzhi dang mtshan nyid gnyis las logs su grub pa med pas mtshan gzhi ni mtshan nyid dang ldan no// zhes mtshan nyid dgu bcu rtsa gcig gis mtshan gzhi rang dang ldan par mtshon pa yin no// des na 'di ltar/ mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba mtshan gzhi/ shes bya ma lus pa'i yul can du mtshon pa la shes pa'i rnam pa bcu drug phrag gsum dang ldan pa mtshan nyid do// re re gzhi lam rnam pa'i yul can du'ang mtshon no// yang lam shes dang rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba mtshan gzhi/ gzhi shes sbyor ba las khyad par 'phags par mtshon pa la khyad par gyi chos bcu drug dang ldan pa mtshan nyid do// mdzad pa 'phrin las dang ldan par mtshon pa la byed pa bcu gcig gi mtshan nyid dang*/ mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba kun rdzob tu ngo bo nyid dang ldan par mtshon pa la/ dben pa la sogs pa'i ngo bo nyid bcu drug dang ldan pa mtshan nyid do// zhes bzhed do// gnyis pa rang gang gi rjes su 'brang ba'i rang lugs bzhag pa la/ spyir bshad pa dang*/ skabs kyi don bshad pa dang*/ de nyid gzhung gi dgongs par sbyar ba'o// dang po la/ mtshan nyid kyi skad dod/ lak+ṣa ra/ zhes pa mtshon par bya bas mtshan nyid de/ me dang chu shes bya la sogs pa ming gi tha snyad rnams so// 'di la rang gi mtshan nyid dang spyi'i mtshan nyid gnyis las/

dang po ni/ yul dus rang bzhin ma 'dres par gnas pa'i dngos po rnams te/ rnam nges las/ de ni thun mong pa'i ngo bo ste/ rang gi mtshan nyid do// zhes bshad/ gnyis pa ni/ yul dus thun mong du rjes su 'gro ba shes bya lta bu ste/ rnam 'grel las/ don gyi ngo bo nyid yin spyi// kun la ngo bo mtshungs phyir dang*// zhes bshad pa ltar ro// lak+ṣa ṇa/ zhes sbyar na/ mtshon par byed pas mtshan nyid de/ 'di la'ang thun mong min par mtshon byed rang gi mtshan nyid dang*/ thun mong du mtshon byed spyi'i mtshan nyid dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ sher phyin las/ gzugs rung gzugs kyi mtshan nyid nas/ shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid du gsungs pa'i bar dang*/ mngon pa nas tsha ba me'i mtshan nyid du gsungs pa sogs rnams te/ 'di la ma khyab khyab ches mi srid gsum gyi skyon dang bral ba dgos te/ rang gi tha snyad bya rung de thun mong min par mtshon byed yin pa'i phyir/ 'di la dgongs nas rigs gter las/ ma khyab khyab ches mi srid gsum// mtshan nyid kyi ni spyi skyon yin// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/ bde bar gshegs pas 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid mi rtag pa dang*/ zag bcas sdug bsngal bar gsungs pa lta bu ste/ 'di la ma khyab pa sogs skyon min no// de'i phyir mtshan nyid kyi sgra las bya ba byed po gsum la 'jug par byed de/ de yang 'di ltar mtshon par byed do// gang mtshon par byed na/ mtshon bya me lta bu de'o// gang gis na/ mtshan nyid tsha zhing sreg pa lta bu des so// mtshon pa'i bya ba gang zhe na/ ming don gyi 'brel pa khong du chud pa ste/ mtshan gzhi tsan+dan gyi tsha zhing sreg pa lta bu de'i don du'o// de skad du yang*/ slob dpon chos mchog gis/ bya byed du 'jog pa la/ rang nyid bya ba'i las dang ldan pa/ byed pa po gzhan gyi dbang du gyur pa dang*/ gtso bor gyur pa'i bsgrub bya la nye bar sbyor ba ste/

bya byed kyi chos gsum tshang dgos par bshad pa ltar ro// las la'ang gnyis te/ gang la mtshon par bya ba'i gzhi dang*/ gang mtshon pa'i dang gnyis te/ de ltar na mtshan nyid kyi sgra yangs par byas nas/ mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum dang*/ mtshon pa 'brel pa nges byed kyi tshad ma ste/ sgra dog pa'i dbang du byas na/ byed pa po kho na la 'jug ste/ gang gis mtshon te mtshan nyid du/ shes bya zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum gyi rnam par bzhag pa 'di yang*/ rtog ge pa kho nas btags pa min te/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis sems can la// phan gdags phyir na mtshan gzhi dang*// mtshan nyid dang ni mtshon pa dag /rab tu dbye bas yang dag bshad// ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa skabs su bab pa'i don la/ gzhung gis ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul dang*/ chos gsum so sor ngos bzung nas ji ltar mtshon pa'i tshul/ mtshan nyid gsum gsungs pa'i dgos pa so sor bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid ston pa'i gzhung 'di dag gis/ mtshan mtshon gnyis ka bstan la/ sgras ston pa'i tshe/ gnyis ka la mtshan nyid kyi sgra gsungs te/ mtshan nyid bzhi par bzhed pa yin/ zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro// de ltar gnyis kyi nang nas/ 'dir mtshan nyid bstan pa de thun mong min par mtshon byed rang gis mtshan nyid yin la/ mtshon bya ngo bo nyid bcu drug bstan pa de yang*/ thun mong min par mtshon par bya ba rang gi ngo bo kho na bstan te/ 'dis sbyor ba rnams mtshon par byed pas zhes dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyis sbyor ba dag mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bzhin du mtshon pas zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro// mdo las shes pa bcu drug phrag gsum dang*/ byed pa rnams la ci rigs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i mngon rtogs su bshad kyang*/ 'dir mtshan nyid du bzung ba ni byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa kho na yin te/ rdzas tha dad pa mtshan mtshon du mi rung ba'i phyir dang*/

mdo las de bzhin gshegs pa'i mngon rtogs su bshad kyang*/ sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid du ma bshad/ bstan bcos las/ sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid du gsungs kyang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mngon rtogs su bshad pa'i phyir ro// de lta na mdo dang bstan bcos mi mthun par yang mi 'gyur te/ mdo las de bzhin gshegs pa'i mngon rtogs su bshad pa de bstan bcos su rgyu'i sgo nas bstan te/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid du bshad pa na/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba la rang don rtogs pa dang*/ gzhan don 'phrin las phun tshogs bskyed pa'i nus pa yod par shes nus la/ de ltar shes pa de mdo'i sbas don yin pa'i phyir ro// de ltar byas na 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i mtshan nyid yin na shes khyad byed pa gsum gang rung yin dgos la/ ngo bo nyid bcu drug po gang rung yin na mtshon bya yin dgos so// mtshan nyid 'chad pa na mtshon bya ston pa skabs su ma bab bo zhes kyang brjod par mi bya ste/ ming don gyi 'brel pa ston dgos pa'i phyir ro// shes mtshan la sogs pa 'di rnams kyang theg chen sbyor ba'i shes pa sogs mtshon byar byas nas de'i mtshan nyid 'jog pa min gyi/ 'o na ci zhe na/ theg chen sbyor ba'i shes pa'i cha yang yin/ theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid kyang yin pa nas/ theg chen sbyor ba'i ngo bo yang yin/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'ang yin pas/ ngo bo nyid mtshan du 'jog pa'i bar ro// gzhung gis dngos su bstan pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor bdun bcu rtsa lnga po kho na mtshan nyid du 'gyur gyi/ shes mtshan sogs mtshan nyid du 'gyur ba min te/ mtshon bya yin pa'i phyir/ dper na dngos po'i mtshan nyid de/ dngos po'i mtshan nyid du mi 'gyur ba bzhin no// theg chen sbyor ba'i shes mtshan sogs gsum po yin na theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yin mi dgos pa'ang min te/ dngos po'i mtshan nyid bzhin no// 'o na mtshon bya theg chen gyi sbyor ba gcig la/

mtshan nyid shes khyad byed pa gsum 'jog na mtshan nyid gnyis kyi 'jog na ni mtshon bya de yang gnyis su 'gyur/ zhes pa'i skyon ji ltar spong zhe na/ de ni mtshan nyid la khyab che chung yod pa la dgongs pa yin la/ 'dir ni gsum po ldog pa tha dad pa kho nar zad kyi/ ngo bo gcig pa'i phyir ro// dper na/ byas mi rtag ngo bo gcig kyang*/ rgyu rkyen las skyes pa'i cha las byas pa dang*/ skad cig gi 'jig pa'i cha la mi rtag par brjod pa bzhin no// ngo bo gcig kyang ldog pa'i gnas so sor bstan pa ni/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i dgos pa mi 'dra ba mtshon pa'i ched do// re re la'ang du mar phye ba ni/ gdul bya nye ba la dgongs pa tsam yin gyi dgos pa dang*/ dngos po'i grangs nges gnyis ka yod pa min la/ gsum du bstan pa la ni dngos po dang*/ dgos pa gnyis ka la brten nas grangs nges te/ dngos po la gsum po 'di las mang mi dgos shing nyung ba'am med na mi 'du ba'i phyir te/ gsum po ya bral na/ theg chen lam gyi lus ma tshang bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ mang yang mi dgos te/ gsum po 'di tsam gyi theg chen gyis rnal 'byor ma lus pa mtshon nus pa'i phyir/ ngo bo gcig kyang gang rung gcig bstan pas chog pa min te/ rigs mi mthun tsam zhig shes mtshan bstan pas sel nus kyang*/ log rtog sel ba la ltos pa'i dgos pa'i khyad par mi 'dra ba dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba ni gzhi lam rnam pa'i gnas lugs tsam rtogs pas/ rang don rtogs pa mthar thug tsam skyed nus kyang nyan rang ltar/ gzhan don phrin las phun tshogs skyed pa'i nus pa med dam snyam pa dang*/ don gnyis mthar thug bskyed pa'i nus pa de yang nyan rang dang thun mong pa yin nam snyam pa'i dogs pa dgag dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ chos gsum so sor ngos bzung ba dang*/ mtshon pa'i tshul lo// dang po la/ mtshan nyid/ mtshon bya/ mtshan gzhi dang gsum/

dang po la/ shes pa/ khyad par/ byed pa gsum ste/ 'dis mtshon par byed pa'i phyir ro// dang po ni/ yul gzhi lam rnam gsum gang rung rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor/ 'di la mtshon bya mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba gsum du phye bas mtshan nyid la yul bzhi bsdus pa chos rnams shes pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ lam gyi de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ 'bras bu bsdus pa'i chos la dmigs pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor te gsum/ re re la'ang bcu drug bcu drug tu phye la/ de'i tshe mtshon bya'ang bcu drug tu 'byed pa ni min no// gnyis pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab sogs chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor/ 'di'i mtshan gzhi la/ lam shes kyi sbyor ba dang*/ rnam mkhyen sbyor ba gnyis su gsungs kyang*/ mtshon bya la gnyis su phye nas mtshan nyid la'ang gnyis su phye ste gsungs pa ni med do// de la'ang bcu drug go /gsum pa ni/ rang gi gdul bya la phan pa bsgrub pa'i mdzad pa dang ldan pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor 'di la/ mtshon bya mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba gsum du phye nas/ mtshan nyid la'ang gzhi shes sbyor ba'i byed pa gsum dang*/ lam shes sbyor ba'i byed pa bdun dang*/ rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i byed pa gcig ste gsum du phye'o// gnyis pa la mtshon bya ni/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba tsam ste/ lus rnam gzhag tu sbyor ba zhes dang*/ ngo bo nyid gang mtshon bya zhes bstan pa de'o// 'di la'ang mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba'i ngo bo gsum phye nas gsum mo// ngo bo nyid bcu drug bshad pa ni/ byed las dang dmigs rnam sogs kyi ci rigs par phye ba tsam yin gyi/ mtshon bya bcu drug tu 'gyur ba ni min no// dar ṭīka pa lam sher phyin gyi rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid ston par bzhed pa ni/ rje btsun gyis gsungs pa'i mtshan mtshon gyi rnam gzhag bor nas ma gsungs pa'i tha snyad rang gi blos sgro btags nas bzhag pa yin la/

gal te theg chen gyi sbyor ba dang*/ lam sher phyin gyi rnal 'byor don gcig pas/ de'i mtshan nyid ston pa yin na ni/ byas pa'i mtshan nyid dris pa na/ mi rtag pa'i bstan na ma 'brel bar mi 'gyur ba sogs ha cang thal lo// yang nyan rang gi sbyor ba las khyad par du 'phags pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor ba dang*/ gzhan don sgrub pa'i byed las khyad par can dang ldan pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor ba mtshon byar bzhed pa'ang yi ge'i don la ma zhugs ste/ mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba tsam mtshon byar gsungs kyi khyad chos de dag gi khyad par du byas pa'i sbyor ba mtshon byar gsungs pa zur tsam yang med pa'i phyir dang*/ de dag mtshan nyid gsungs pa'i dgos pa yin gyi/ mtshon bya'i zur min pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa mtshan gzhi ni/ gong du bstan pa'i sbyor ba nyi shu po rnams te/ de yang rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba lngar 'dus shing*/ de yang zab pa'i sbyor ba sogs gsum po la mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba'i tha snyad 'phags pas gsungs pa ltar/ gsum po mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba gsum gyi mtshan gzhir bzhag go /gnyis pa ji ltar mtshon pa'i tshul ni/ rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba lnga'am/ nyi shu po mtshan gzhi/ theg chen gyi sbyor bar mtshon/ gzhi lam rnam gsum gang rung gi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor yin pa/ zhes dang*/ bsam mi khyab pa sogs kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor zhes dang*/ gdul bya la phan pa bsgrub pa'i byed pa dang ldan byang sems kyi rnal 'byor zhes pa'o// so sor mtshon na/ zab pa'i sbyor ba mtshan gzhi/ gzhi shes sbyor bar mtshon/ phung sogs gzhi'i chos la dmigs pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ phan bde skyob gsum gang rung gi mdzad pa bsgrub pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor yin pa/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba la/ khyad mtshan mi 'chad pa ni/ theg chen gyi mthong lam du gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs dang*/

gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs dang*/ 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs gsum mo// ngo bo gcig cing ldog pa tha dad pa'i tshul gyis tshang ba las/ dang po la gzhi shes sbyor ba dang*/ phyi ma la lam shes sbyor ba dang*/ rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba'i tha snyad byas shing*/ dang po la khyad mtshan ma bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs min pa'i phyir te/ shes mthong gis bltas nas 'da' bar bya ba'i mngon rtogs kyi rigs yin pa'i phyir/ snyam du rtogs so// yang gting dpag dka' ba'i sbyor ba mtshan gzhi/ lam shes kyi sbyor bar mtshon lam gyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor yin pa dang*/ skyabs sogs byed pa bdun dang ldan pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor dang*/ lam shes sbyor ba mtshan gzhi/ theg dman gyi sbyor ba las khyad zhugs par mtshon/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa sogs chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor yin pa zhes pa ste/ tshad med pa'i sbyor ba la'ang de bzhin du sbyar ro// khyad mtshan gyi mtshon tshul la/ bye brag gi sbyor ba 'god pa'i tshe lam shes kyi sbyor ba dang*/ rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor bar mtshon pa'i tshul mi 'god de/ lam shes pa nyid la sogs pa gnyis ni khyad par gyi lam yin par khyad zhugs so// zhes mtshan nyid gzhan gnyis dang mtshon tshul mi 'dra bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ spyir mtshon pa'i tshe/ theg chen gyi sbyor bar mtshon dgos te/ byed par bsgrub pas 'dis sbyor ba rnams mtshon par byed pas shes pa dang*/ khyad par dang*/ byed pa dang*/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa dgos pa ni/ shes mtshan gsungs pas rigs mi mthun tsam bsal te/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba la rang don rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa bskyed pa'i nus pa yod par go nus/ khyad mtshan bstan pas theg chen gyi sbyor ba theg dman gyi sbyor ba las khyad par du 'phags par go nus/

byed mtshan bstan pas theg chen sbyor ba la gzhan don phrin las phun tshogs skyed pa'i nus pa yon par go nus so// ngo bo nyid mtshan bstan pas/ mtshan nyid de gsum gang la bstan pa'i mtshon bya theg chen sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid du rtogs so// yang na khyad mtshan gyis rigs mi mthun spangs shing*/ gzhan gnyis kyis log rtog spangs so// kha cig ṭī ka'i dgongs par byas nas/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba dang rang don rtogs pa phun tshogs dang*/ gzhan don 'phrin las phun tshogs dang*/ theg dman gyi sbyor ba las khyad par du 'phags par mtshon nus pa ste/ shes mtshan/ khyad mtshan/ byed mtshan gsum gyi mtshan nyid du 'jog pa ni/ khyad mtshan gyi bye brag sbyor la rung tsam yin yang*/ gzhan rnams ni tshig don gang la'ang ma zhugs pas btang snyoms su bya bar rigs so// des na 'di ltar bya ste/ theg chen sbyor ba rang gi mtshan gzhi'i steng du thun mong min par mtshon nus de/ theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid de gang zhig khyod theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid du bzhag pa la brten nas/ theg chen gyi rang don rtogs pa phun tshogs skyed pa'i thun mong min pa'i rgyur go nus de/ theg chen sbyor ba'i shes mtshan gyi mtshan nyid yin pa sogs su shes par bya zhing*/ theg chen sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid mtshan zhes pa/ don theg chen sbyor ba nyid yin pas mtshan nyid bshad zin la/ 'on kyang de'i tha snyad kyi mtshan nyid ni/ shes khyad byed pa gsum gyis rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba lnga'i steng du mtshon par bya ba'i theg chen sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid mtshan gyi mtshan nyid/ kha cig mtshan gzhi lta bur mtshon pas na/ zhes pa'i 'gyur la brten nas ngo bo nyid bcu drug po mtshan gzhir bzhag nas/ rnam rdzogs sbyor bar mtshon pa yin zer ba la ni/ mtshon mi nus pa dang*/ mtshon bya nyi tshe ba nyid du 'gyur ba'i nyes pa sogs mtha' yas so// des na rnam rdzogs sbyor ba mtshan gzhir bzhag nas/

sbyor ba tsam du mtshon pa la/ 'phags seng gi 'grel par shin tu gsal bas/ de'i phyir/ mtshan nyid kyi sa mtshams kyang*/ tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod par grub bo// gsum pa de nyid gzhung gi dgongs par sbyar ba ni/ gong du ji skad bshad pa de dag rtog pas rang dgar btags pa min gyi/ rgya gar mkhas pa'i lugs las 'byung ba yin pas/ 'grel chen las/ byed par bsgrub pas 'dis sbyor ba mtshon par byed pa yin pa'i phyir/ shes pa dang*/ khyad par dang*/ ngo bo nyid dang*/ las su sgrub pas de rnams mtshon par bya ba yin pas/ zhes dang*/ dag ldan las/ gang gis mtshon de mtshan nyid du// shes bya de yang shes pa dang*// khyad par byed dang rnam gsum ste// mtshon bya ngo bo nyid gang yang*// zhes dang*/ de bzhin du/ snying po mchog grags pa'i cha/ shes rab sgron ma thams cad las/ dang po gsum mtshan nyid dang*/ ngo bo nyid mtshon byar gsung byed sgrub dang las sgrub kyi tha snyad ni/ slob dpon 'di'i gzhung las 'byung gi 'phags pas gsung pa med cing*/ 'grel byed gzhan rnams ni slob dpon ltar 'chad do// tshigs gsal las ni 'di ltar gsungs te/ mtshan nyid ces bya ba ni rang gi mtshan nyid dang*/ rnam par dbye ba'i mtshan nyid do// rnam par dbye ba'i mtshan nyid ni bum pa la sogs pa dag la dung ma yin pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa dngos po gcig tu yang ldog pa'i dbang gis dpag tu med par brjod pa ste/ zhes pa nas/ rang gi mtshan nyid ni/ rang gi thun mong min pa'i yan lag me la sogs pa'i tsha ba la sogs pa 'jig rten rnams na rigs pas ma bcom pa'i tshe/ gzhan la mi ltos par don byed par snang ba'i dngos po rags pa rnams so// 'dir ni rang gi mtshan nyid bzung ngo*// de yang mtshon par byed pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ shes pa dang khyad par byed pa rnams te/ de la shes pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi tha dad pa gsum char yang*/

rgyal ba'i yum 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa skyed pa'o// zhes bya ba la sogs pa shes par byed pa'o// gal te de ltar thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum char gyi rgyal ba'i yum gyi bdag nyid che ba shes par byed par 'gyur ba kho nas chog pas lam shes pas ci zhig bya snyam pa la/ shes par byed pa mtshungs su zin kyang de dag gi khyad par ni 'di dang 'di lta bu'o// zhes ston par byed pa ni khyad par gyi mtshan nyid do// khyad par gyi mtshan nyid des don ci zhig byed snyam pa la byed pa'i mtshan nyid do// ngo bo nyid mtshon par byed pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid de gsum gyi rang bzhin khong du chud par byed pa la gtso bor ma gyur pa'i rang bzhin du zad do// zhes gsungs pa 'di las shes khyad byed pa gsum thun mong min par mtshon par byed pa rang gi mtshan nyid dang*/ ngo bo nyid de'i mtshon bya dang*/ sbyor ba gsum char gyis shes phyin gyi che ba'i yon tan shes par byed pa tsam yin na/ gang rung gcig gis chog go snyam pa la khyad mtshan bstan par gsungs so// de ltar na mtshan nyid kyi go rim ni/ mtshan mtshon gyi 'brel pa ston pa la/ thog mar 'jog byed nges par byas/ de'i rjes su rnam par bzhag bya la rtogs pa bskyed dgos pas/ byed sgrub dang las bsgrub rim par bstan no// byed sgrub kyi dbang du byas pa'i mtshan nyid la'ang rang don rtogs pa mthar thug gi rgyur go byed dang*/ gzhan don phrin las phun tshogs kyi rgyur go byed gnyis yod pa rim par bstan te/ 'bras bu'i dus su rtogs pa mthar thug mngon du byas nas/ de las gzhan don 'phrin las phun tshogs 'byung ba'i phyir/ dang po la'ang go byed dngos dang*/ de'i khyad par gyi chos gnyis rim par ston/ gnyis pa so so'i rnam gzhag la/ mdo la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad kyi rim pa gnyis su med kyang*/ bstan bcos su/ mdor bstan/

rgyas par bshad/ don bsdu ba gsum de ltar mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ yum de ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams skyed par byed pa'o// zhes sogs dgu dgu rtsa gcig gis theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid ston pa mi gsal bas brda 'phrod pa'i ched du'o// dang po ni/ lus rnam gzhag tu mtshan nyid ces bstan pa de gang zhe na/ theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid chos can/ khyod kyi sgra yangs par byas nas/ byed bsgrub las bsgrub gnyis su yod de/ mtshan nyid dang mtshon bya gnyis su yod pa'i phyir chos can/ khyod kyi sgra dog par byas na/ de lta bu gnyis su yod pa min te/ de'i tshe yod yin na/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i shes mtshan khyad mtshan byed mtshan gsum po gang rung yin dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ gang gis mtshon te/ zhes sogs rtsa 'grel lo// rgyas par bshad pa la bzhi las/ dang po shes mtshan la gsum du phye ste/ mtshon bya sbyor ba de la gsum yod pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ de la shes pa'i mtshan nyid/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi dbye bas zhes so// gsum po rim par bstan te/ gzhi'i chos la dmigs pa med par/ lam gyi gnas lugs sgom par mi 'byung zhing*/ de med par rnam pa'i gnas lugs rtogs pa mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro// dang po la/ mdo ni rab 'byor gyis gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das yum 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa bskyed pa'o// 'jig rten 'di ston par byed pa'o// zhes bka' stsal na/ yum ji ltar bskyed/ 'jig rten 'di ston pa ji ltar bgyid/ 'jig rten na ni de bzhin gshegs pa ji tsam bzhugs bka' stsal pa/ yum 'dis de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu bskyed pa'o// mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang*/ zhes sogs so// mdo'i don ji ltar bsdus pa ni/ mdo tshig bcu drug po ni chos can/ gzhi shes kyi shes mtshan bstan te/ gzhi'i gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes bcu drug gis dngos su mtshon nas/

gzhi'i chos la dmigs pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor bcu drug 'phangs nas bstan pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba dang*/ zhes sogs so// don ni/ gzhi shes sbyor ba las de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung bar rtogs pa sogs gzhi'i chos la dmigs pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor bcu drug po gang rung chos can/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yin te/ theg chen gyi zab pa'i sbyor ba/ gzhi shes kyi sbyor bar mtshon nus yin pa'i phyir/ de 'dra bcu drug po theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid du bzhag pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba des rang 'bras sangs rgyas sa'i gzhi shes kyi rtogs pa mthar thug bskyed pa'i nus pa bde blag tu rtogs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'og ma gnyis la'ang sbyar bar bya'o// gnyis pa lam shes kyi shes mtshan la/ mdo ni/ 'dod pa dang gzugs na spyod pa'i lha'i bu dag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das yum gyi mtshan nyid ji lta bu lags/ bka' stsal pa/ yum zab mo 'di'i mtshan nyid ni stong pa nyid do// mtshan ma med pa'o// smon pa med pa'o// zhes sogs so// de bsdud pa ni/ mdo tshan pa bcu drug po chos can/ lam shes sbyor ba'i shes mtshan bshad de/ lam gyi gnas lugs mngon du rtogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bcu drug gis dngos su mtshon nas lam gyi chos nyid rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor bcu drug 'phangs pa'i phyir zhes ston pa ni/ stong nyid mtshan ma med bcas dang*// zhes sogs so// gsum pa la mdo ni/ rab 'byor la bka' stsal pa/ de ci'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa rnams yum gyi chos 'di la brten cing gnas so// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams yum 'di la rim gror mdzad do nas/ bkur stir mdzad do// de ci'i phyir zhe na/

sangs rgyas rnams ni 'di las 'byung ba'i phyir ro// zhes gsungs/ de'i don sdud pa ni/ de 'dra'i mdo tshan pa bcu drug pa chos can/ rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i shes mtshan bstan pa yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba sogs gzhi'i chos dang*/ yum stong pa nyid la sogs pa'i lam gyi chos te/ gzhi lam gnyis kyi steng gi rnam pa'i gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa des mtshon nas/ rnam pa'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor bcu drug 'phangs pa'i phyir zhes ston pa ni/ de ni nyid kyi chos brten nas// zhes sogs so// mdor na shes pa bcu drug phrag gsum po 'di/ mdo las de bzhin gshegs pa'i mngon rtogs su bshad de/ mdor de ltar de bzhin gshegs pas chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bstan bcos kyi dngos bstan la/ theg pa che chung so sor ma phye bar mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba tsam gyi mtshan nyid du gsungs te/ de ltar bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa dgus spyi'i ngo bo nyid du brjod nas/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// bstan bya'i gtso bo ni theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid de/ khyad mtshan gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa khyad mtshan la/ 'brel ni/ chos kyi bshes gnyen gyi bzhed pa ltar/ gong du bshad pa'i shes mtshan bcu drug phrag gsum char gyis/ sher phyin gyi shes pa kho na shes pa la khyad par med pa'i phyir dang*/ khyad par gzhan yang ma bstan pas/ mtshon bya sbyor ba gsum po la'ang khyad par med par 'gyur zhing*/ de lta na gang rung gcig gis chog go snyam pa'i dogs pa dgag pa'i phyir khyad mtshan bcu drug gsungs so zhes ston pa ni/ de ltar bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa dgus/ zhes sogs so// don ni/ sngar shes mtshan ston pa'i gzhung gis/ de la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum la dgongs nas/

'phags pa'i gang zag rnam pa gsum gyi dbang du mdzad de/ go rim bzhin du/ phyogs gcig tu 'jug pa dang*/ phyed du byed pa'i 'jug pa dang*/ mngon sum byed pa'i 'jug pa'i dbang du byas nas shes pa yum yin par shes par bya'o zhes gsungs so// de ltar byas na dngos bstan la shes mtshan gyis/ theg pa chen chung ma phye bar bstan/ khyad mtshan gyis phye ste bstan/ byed mtshan gyis theg chen sbyor ba kho na'i byed pa bstan par mtshams sbyar las gsal bar shes so// 'brel pa can dngos la/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa/ gzhi shes la khyad mtshan mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan no// dang po la mdo ni/ rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das yum 'di ni bya ba chen pos nye bar gnas so// yum 'di ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid dang*/ mnyam pa nyid ma mchis pa dang*/ gzhal du ma mchis pa sogs kyi nye bar gnas so// zhes sogs mdo'i rim pa gcig nyid la/ bstan bshad gnyis su mdzad do// de bsdud pa ni/ de 'dra'i mdo tshan pa bcu drug chos can/ theg chen sbyor ba'i khyad par gyi mtshan nyid bstan pa yin te/ shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug dngos su bstan pa'i shugs kyis/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba theg dman sbyor ba las khyad zhugs par 'phangs pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ bsam mi khyab sogs khyad par gyis// zhes sogs so// 'o na khyad chos bcu drug po de gang zhe na/ bsam mi khyab dang mi mnyam dang*// zhes sogs so// don ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa sogs chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor bcu drug po des theg chen sbyor ba mi ldan rnam gcod kyi mtshon pa'i tshul dang*/ gzhan ldan rnam gcod kyis mtshon pa'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po theg chen sbyor ba mtshon byar 'jog cing*/ gnyis pa la theg chen sbyor ba mtshan gzhir 'jog pa yin no// gsum pa gzhi shes sbyor ba la khyad mtshan mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan la/

mkhan chen rin po ches/ slob dpon gzhi shes sbyor ba la/ khyad mtshan mi bzhed pa ni/ rigs pas mi 'thad de/ 'o na gzhi shes sbyor ba la shes mtshan dang*/ byed mtshan yang med par 'gyur te/ khyad mtshan med pa'i phyir khyab ste/ de gsum ngo bo gcig pa'i phyir/ ci ste byang sems kyi gzhi shes sbyor ba de gnyis su 'dus pas/ ma bshad do snyam na ni/ lam shes sbyor ba kho na'i khyad mtshan 'chad rigs pa'am/ byang sems kyi gzhi shes sbyor ba la shes mtshan dang*/ byed mtshan yang 'chad mi rigs par thal lo// yang gzhi shes sbyor ba tsam la/ khyad mtshan bshad na/ nyan rang la'ang gzhi shes sbyor ba yod pas/ khyad mtshan yod dam snyam pa'i log rtog skye bar 'gyur bas de dgag pa'i ched do// snyam na ni/ de lta na 'dir bstan gyi shes mtshan dang*/ byed mtshan yang nyan rang la yod dam snyam pa'i log rtog skye srid par thal lo// zhes gsungs so// ar byang chub ye shes na re/ shes mtshan gyis ni/ mkhyen gsum sbyor ba mi ldan rnam gcod kyis mtshon pa yin la/ khyad mtshan gyis ni gzhan ldan rnam gcod kyis mtshon pas/ gzhi shes sbyor ba la khyad mtshan ma bshad ces gsungs shing*/ rnam bshad las/ de ltar gsungs te/ dgongs pa ni/ khyad mtshan gyi mtshon tshul dang*/ shes byed gnyis kyi mtshon tshul mi 'dra ste/ khyad mtshan gyis ni/ gang gi lam ni gzhan dag las// khyad du 'phags pas khyad par lam// zhes dang*/ 'grel par/ khyad par gyi lam yin par khyad zhugs so// zhes gsungs pas/ nyan thos kyi lam las khyad du 'phags pa mtshon par gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhi shes sbyor ba'i rang ldog mtshan gzhir bzhag nas/ theg dman gyi sbyor ba las khyad zhugs par mtshon mi nus pa'i phyir/ shes mtshan sogs la mi mtshungs te/ de gnyis kyi skabs su ji lta ba bzhin du thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyi sbyor ba dag mtshon pas/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba mtshon byar byas nas mtshon par gsungs pa'i phyir/

snyam du rtogs so// yang bdag gi blo la 'di ltar snang ste/ theg chen sbyor ba khyad chos de dag gi sgo nas theg dman sbyor ba las khyad zhugs pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ de'i phyir de dag gi ni ji skad bshad pa'i khyad par dang bral ba'i mngon par zhen pa sogs/ zhes sogs gsungs/ gzhung de theg dman gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba la khyad mtshan med par grub cing*/ des theg chen gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba la'ang khyad mtshan mi 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan don gyis bshad de/ gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba ni/ gtso bor theg dman gyi rigs can rjes su bzung ba'i don du shes par bya ba'i rtogs rigs yin la/ des chos kyi bdag med ma rtogs pa'ang min mod kyi/ de gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i ldog pa nas ma bstan pa'i phyir ro// chos kyi bshes gnyen ni/ lam shes sbyor ba kho na la khyad mtshan bzhed do// gsum pa byed mtshan la/ 'brel ni/ theg dman gyi sbyor ba las khyad zhugs par bstan pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i byed pa gang zhe na/ de 'chad do zhes ston pa ni/ khyad par gyi mtshan nyid kyis rnam par bcad pa rnams kyi byed pa gang yin zhe na/ zhes so// mdo ni/ rab 'byor byang sems chen po rnams 'jig rten gyi phan pa dang*/ skyob pa dang*/ skyabs su gyur pa dang*/ gnas dang*/ dpung gnyen dang*/ gling dang*/ yongs su 'dren pa dang*/ thugs brtse ba dang*/ mgon dang*/ rten du gyur par rigs par bya'o zhes gsungs/ de bsdud pa ni/ phan dang bde dang zhes sogs so// bcu gcig po 'di la nyi khri le'u brgyad ma dang*/ brgyad stong par/ dang po gnyis byang sems kyi mdzad pa dang*/ phyi ma dgu sangs rgyas kyi mdzad par gsungs/ 'bum dang*/ nyi khri le mangs su/ dang po lnga byang sems dang*/ phyi ma drug sangs rgyas kyi mdzad par bshad/ khri brgyad stong par/ dang po drug sangs rgyas dang*/ phyi ma lnga byang sems la bshad/ shes rab khri par/

thams cad byang sems la bshad pas/ thams cad byang sems dang*/ sangs rgyas gnyis ka la yod pa mi 'gal la/ 'dir mtshan nyid du bzung ba ni/ byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa kho na bzung ngo*// zhes rnam bshad las gsungs so// bzhi pa ngo bo nyid mtshan la/ mdo ni/ rab 'byor byang sems chen po de dag ni/ 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug rnam par bsal bas rnam par dben pa'i rang bzhin du 'gyur ro// zhes sogs so// de bsdud pa ni/ nyon mongs rtag dang mtshan ma dang*// zhes sogs so// grangs kyi sgo nas don bsdu ba ni/ de ltar na spyir gcig tu sdom na ni mtshan nyid dgu bcu rtsa gcig tu 'gyur ro// zhes pa'o// 'o na shes rnam brgya bdun bcu rtsa gsum bstan pa dang*/ 'dir mtshan nyid dgu bcu rtsa gcig bstan pa la khyad par ci yod ce na/ sngar ni sgom bya'i ldog pa nas bstan/ 'dir ni sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i cha nas bstan no// zhes bcom ldan ral gri gsung ngo*// bzhi pa nyer rgyu thar pa cha mthun la snga phyi'i 'brel ni/ mtshan nyid kyi 'og tu thar pa cha mthun bstan te/ thar pa cha mthun gyi dge rtsa rgyud la skyes pa'i gang zag kho nas ji skad bshad pa'i sbyor ba'i sgro 'dogs gcod par byed pa'i phyir zhes ston pa ni/ thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa'i zhes sogs so// 'brel pa can dngos la/ mdo ni/ shā ri'i bu 'di la byang sems chen po thog ma sems bskyed pa nas bzung ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems dang ma bral bar sbyin pa gtong*/ zhes pa nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar sgom zhing*/ mtshan mar mi byed do// zhes gsungs/ de bsdud pa ni/ mtshan med rab tu sbyin la sogs// zhes so// 'dir sbyin sogs rang rgyud la bskyed par mkhas zhes pa ni thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs legs par chod de/ sa bon nus ldan du yod pa'i don no// dar ṭīka pa/ bskal pa grangs med gsum nas sangs rgya ba'i lam gyis 'go rtsom pa dang*/

theg pa chen po'i lam du zhugs pa dang*/ theg chen thar pa cha mthun rgyud la skyes pa rnams don gcig par 'dod pa ni mi rigs te/ mdo sde dkon mchog sprin las/ bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gyi thog ma gang nas rtsom zhe na/ thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa tsam gyis min te/ tshogs kyi lam nas so// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// yang dag bsgrub la mkhas zhes bstan pa de nyid 'chad pa la/ mdo ni/ de yang yum dang thabs la mkhas pa dang ma bral bar dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ de rnams kyi tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin dang*/ shes rab dang*/ rnam par grol ba dang*/ rnam par grol ba'i ye shes gzigs pa'i phung po de thams cad yid la sems kyang mtshan mar mi byed zhes sogs so// de bsdud pa ni/ sangs rgyas sogs dmigs dad pa dang*/ zhes sogs so// 'di la ji ltar mkhas pa'i tshul dang*/ mkhas pa de la dbang po'i khyad par rnam par bzhag pa'o// dang po ni/ dad pa dang zhes sogs so// gnyis pa la/ dad sogs chen po byang sems dang*/ 'bring rang rgyal dang*/ chung ngu nyan thos gsum las/ dang po la dbang po rno rtul gnyis las/ rnon pos rdzogs byang rtogs par sla ba dang*/ rtul pos rtogs dka' bar ston pa'i dbang du byas nas/ de lta mod kyi zhes sogs so// shugs la dad sogs chung 'bring gi byang chub rtogs tshul 'chad pa ni/ shugs kyis na zhes sogs so// de'i dgongs pa ni/ sngar byang sems kyi sbyor mthong dngos su bstan nas/ nyan thos kyi sbyor mthong shugs la ston pa'i rim pas/ 'dir theg chen gyi thar cha dngos su bstan nas nyan rang gi thar cha shugs la ston pa yin no// zhes kun mkhyen chos kyi rje gsung ngo*// 'bre chen po/ theg chen du rigs nges pa dbang rnon/ theg dman du rigs nges pa dbang rtul/ ma nges pa dbang 'bring yin la/ rtsa bar rno rtul gnyis dngos su bstan nas shugs la dbang 'bring 'phangs par bzhed/

ar gyis/ theg chen dang*/ rang rgyal dang*/ nyan thos kyi rigs can gyi byang sems gsum du mdzad nas/ gsum ka da lta theg chen gyi thar cha la gnas par mtshungs kyang*/ snga mas byang chub rtogs bla la/ phyi ma la rtul po'i sgras gsungs nas/ rtogs dka' bar dngos su bstan nas/ de'i shugs kyis phyi ma gnyis theg chen gyi lam nas log ste/ rang rgyal gyi rigs can gyi rang rgyal gyi byang chub dang*/ nyan thos kyi rigs can nyan thos kyi byang chub thob par 'phangs so// zhes bzhed/ ral gri sogs dbang po rtul po nyan rang la bzhed do// gnyis pa/ sbyor ba skyes pa'i sgom rim la/ sbyor ba skyes pa'i gnas skabs/ rten phyir mi ldog pa'i gang zag bsgom bya sbyor ba'i ngo bo dang gsum/ zhes rnam bshad las gsungs la/ thar pa cha mthun yang*/ sgom rim la sbyar na legs zhes bdag gi bla ma gsung ngo*// dang po la snga phyi'i 'brel ni/ thar pa cha mthun las nges 'byed cha mthun 'byung ba'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa zhes so// 'brel pa can dngos la/ mdo ni de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na med pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'byung bar ji ltar 'tshal bar bgyi/ bkal stsal pa/ sems can rnams kyi drung du sems mnyam pa nyid kyis gnas par bya/ zhes so// de'i don bsdud pa ni/ dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir// zhes so// sbyor ba dang po gsum gyi skabs su sbyor mthong ston pa na 'dir zhes 'byung ba ni/ mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor mthong las khyad par du byas pa'i ched yin te/ sngar ni yul skye med gsum rtogs pa'i ldog pa nas bstan la/ 'dir ni yul can mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa la 'jug pa'i ldog pa nas bstan pa'i phyir ro// mthar gyi sbyor ba'i skabs su rtsa bar ma smos kyang*/

'grel pas/ 'dir zhes kha bskang nas bshad do// zhes chos kyi rje thams cad mkhyen pa gsung ngo*// sems can thams cad yin par bsngags// zhes pas thams cad kyi dmigs pa bstan la/ de dag nyid la sems mnyam sogs// rnam pa dang ni bcur bshad do// zhes pas drod kyi rnam pa bstan/ bdag nyid sdig pa las ldog cing*// de dag la ni 'god pa dang*// bsngags pa brjod dang mthun pa nyid// ces pas rtse mo chung ngu'i rnam pa bstan/ 'bring gi rnam pa ni/ sogs pa'i sgras bsdus pa/ nang stong sogs la gnas pa gzhan// de dag la ni 'god pa dang*// bsngags pa brjod dang mthun pa nyid// ces pas/ rtse mo chen po'i rnam pa bstan/ bzod pa chung ngu ni/ rang nyid bden shes la gnas gzhan// de dag la ni 'god pa dang*// bsngags pa brjod dang mthun pa nyid// ces so// 'bring gi rnam pa ni/ gzhung sogs ched du gnas pas gzhan// de dag la ni 'god pa dang*// bsngags pa brjod dang mthun pa nyid// ces so// chen po'i rnam pa ni/ byang sems skyon med la gnas gzhan// de dag la ni 'god pa dang*// bsngags pa brjod dang mthun pa nyid// ces so// chos mchog la'ang*/ sems can smin sogs gnas pas gzhan// de dag la ni 'god pa dang*// bsngags pa brjod dang mthun pa nyid// ces dang*/ bdag nyid mngon shes bskyed la gnas// zhes sogs dang*/ bdag nyid rnam mkhyen bskyed la gnas// zhes sogs sbyor ro// gzhung gi sbyor tshul 'di ltar ma dgongs pa la brten nas/ bod snga rabs pa mang po slob dpon gyi lugs 'di/ gang la sbyor ba'i yul ngos ma bzung*/ sogs sgra 'chol par bshad/ shes kyi 'brel pa 'chad/ bden pa dmigs par bshad pa nor zhes 'chad pa yod do// rnam pa dang lam dang gzhi thams cad rnam par bsgom pa'i dbye bas/ zhes pa'i gzhung 'di gang la 'phros pa yin zhe na/ gzhung gi rang gzhung du bzhed pa dang gzhan gzhung du bzhed pa'i lugs dang*/

rang gi blo la shar ba brjod pa'o// dang po la/ bod snga rabs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen phal che ba rnams ni/ skabs dang po drug tu sbyor mthong sgom gsum lan drug bstan pa zlos par 'gyur ro zhe na/ skyon med de/ skabs dang po gsum gyi lam gsum mtshan nyid pa yin la/ sbyor ba dang po gsum gyi skabs su bstan pa'i lam gsum gyi ming can de lam gsum btags pa ba yin pa'i phyir/ de yang ji ltar zhe na/ 'di la'ang kha cig na re/ dag pa sa gsum gyi ye shes chung ngu 'bring chen po gsum la/ rim pa bzhin sbyor mthong bsgom gsum gyi ming gis btags zhes zer ro// 'ga' zhig na re/ sa gsum gyi ye shes chung ngu gsum la/ rnam kun dang*/ 'bring gsum la rtse sbyor dang*/ chen po gsum la mthar gyis sbyor ba'i skabs kyi lam gsum gyi ming gis bstan zhes zer ro// yang gzhan dag na re/ sa brgyad pa'i ye shes gsum la rnam kun dang*/ dgu pa dang*/ bcu pa thob ma thag pa dang*/ sa bcu pa'i dkyil stod kyi ye shes gsum la rtse sbyor dang*/ bcu pa'i dkyil smad gsum du byas pa la/ mthar gyi sbyor mthong sgom gsum gyi ming gis btags nas bstan pa yin no zhes gsung ngo*// yang mkhan chen rin po che/ lam gsum mtshan nyid pa 'phags pa'i lugs dang*/ btags pa ba slob dpon gyi lugs yin yang*/ slob dpon gyi lugs 'di rigs pas 'thad do// zhes gsungs/ yang kha cig na re/ sbyor ba dang po gsum gyi lam gsum la'ang*/ mtshan nyid pa dang btags pa ba gnyis gnyis su yod pa yin la/ btags pa ba rnams ni sa brgyad pa'i ye shes chung ngu 'bring sogs la 'dogs pa yin no// rnam pa thams cad du btags pa ba kho na yin na/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i skabs su sbyor lam pa dang*/ mthong lam pa phyir mi ldog tu sgrub pa'i btags ma bstan par 'gyur ba dang*/ sgom lam gyi dbye ba grangs nges sogs kyang sa brgyad pa kho na'i dbang du byas par 'gyur ba sogs ha cang thal lo// rnam pa thams cad du mtshan nyid pa yin na'ang*/

bsdud 'grel sogs dang 'gal bar 'gyur zhes zer ro// dar ṭīka pa/ gzhung 'di mngon par rtogs pa dang po drug gi go rim log par rtog pa 'gog pa yin te/ skabs dang por sbyor mthong sgom gsum bstan pa de/ rgyu 'bras kyi gtso bo mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen de tshogs sbyor gyi gnas skabs 'ba' zhig tu sgom pa'i cig car skye ba yin nam snyam pa'i dogs pa dgag pa'i ched la sogs pa yin no// de ltar na slob dpon gyi bsdud 'grel du/ lam rkyang pa ba'i lugs de rang lugs su mdzad pa ltar snang yang*/ 'grel pa 'dir/ dgag pa dmigs phug ste mdzad pa yin no// zhes bzhed/ 'di ni re zhig 'thad par mthong ma ste/ snying po dril na/ lam rkyang pa'i 'dod pa 'gog pa'i ched du skabs dang po drug tu sbyor mthong sgom gsum lan drug tu gsungs so// zhes par song bas mi rigs te/ lam rkyang pa'i 'dod tshul ni/ rje btsun gyi rjes su 'jug pa'i srol 'byed gcig yin gyi/ rje btsun gyis de phyogs sngar byas nas/ 'gog pa min pa'i phyir dang*/ gzhan yang log rtog de ldog pa kho na'i ched du sbyor mthong sgom gsum lan drug bstan pa yin na/ lam shes sogs su sgom lam ston mi dgos par 'gyur te/ lam shes sogs sgom lam gyi skabs su mi sgom par 'dod pa min pa'i phyir ro// zhes te/ lam rkyang pa'i 'dod tshul mi 'thad par thal/ skabs dang po drug tu sbyor mthong sgom gsum lan drug tu bstan pas mngon par rtogs pa dang po drug sbyor mthong sgom pa gsum char gyi gnas skabs su sgom par rtogs nus pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i don no zhe na/ lam gsum gyi gnas skabs su rgyu 'bras gtso bo'i rnam mkhyen sgom pa'i don ci/ sems bskyed sogs mtshon byed kyi chos bcu sgom pa'am/ de dag mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rnam mkhyen mtshan nyid pa gcig sgom par rtogs pa yin/
