dri ma chos can/ don dam par skye 'gag med de/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid yin pa'i phyir ram/ yang chos can bden par med de/ bden pa'i gcig dang du bral yin pa'i phyir ram/ yang chos can/ don dam par mi skye ste/ bdag las kyang ma yin zhes sogs so// ston pa ni/ nyon mongs pa'i shes bya'i sgrib pa'i dri ma skyes pa dang*/ zhes sogs so// 'grel pa na 'dir sogs sgra yod cing*/ 'grel bshad byed pa gnyis kyis sogs khong nas gzugs sku gnyis 'don par bshad pa ni legs te/ rje btsun gyis sku gsum ka byang chub chen por gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes kun mkhyen chos kyi rje gsung ngo*// lo ts+tsha ba grags rgyal/ 'dir rgya dpe la sogs kyi skad dod med cing*/ 'grel na'ang sogs sgra med la/ mthong lam gyi nyer len gyi 'bras bu 'chad pa'i skabs su/ gzugs sku 'chad pa ma 'brel lo zhes bzhed/ bcom ldan ral gri ni/ ye shes gzugs su snang ba'i phyir/ gzugs sku gnyis kyang ye shes yin la/ de ltar na mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ba spu'i bu ga las kyang*/ shes bya thams cad gzigs par gsungs pa'ang 'thad par 'gyur ro// zhes bzhed/ gnyis pa dngos smra'i 'dod tshul dgag pa la/ phyogs snga brjod pa ni/ gser gling pa ltar na/ nang gi mu stegs rnams na re/ zad med skye med ces pa mi 'thad de/ nyon mongs pa skyes zin gnyen pos bcom pa de/ zad pa med pa ba yin la/ gnyen pos phyis mi skye ba'i chos can du byas pa de mi skye ba bden pa ba yin zhing*/ de ltar shes pa'i ye shes de byang chub chen por 'jog go zhes ston pa ni/ gang dag dngos po 'jig pa'i bsam pas zhes sogs so// chos kyi bshes gnyen ltar na nyan thos pa gang dag chos thams cad chos kyi dbyings su ma rtogs pas zad pa dang mi skye ba la/ zad pa dang mi skye'o snyam pa'i shes pa skye la/ rnal 'byor spyod pa ba rnams ni/

chu khams gser dang nam mkha' rnams// dag pa bzhin du dag par 'dod// ces dag pa'i gzhi yongs grub don dam pa'i dngos por khas len no// lan la/ dngos stobs rigs pas dgag khas blangs nang 'gal gyi dgag pa gnyis las/ dang po la snga 'brel ni/ de lta bu'i shes pa de chos can/ byang chub chen por mi rung ste/ log shes yin pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ gang gi phyir de lta yin pa de'i phyir/ de lta bu'i shes pa de/ zhes sbrel lo// rtsa ba la/ shān+ti pa ltar na/ theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ zad pa bden pa ba dang*/ mi skye ba bden pa ba gsar du ci zhig thob ste/ thob pa byar med par thal/ chos rnams yin lugs la rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa'i phyir/ de'i rang bzhin te ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ slob dpon ltar na dri ma don dam zad pa dang*/ mi skye ba chos can/ khyod rtogs pa'i blo de byang chub chen po min par thal/ khyod med pa'i phyir/ de bsgrub pa ni/ dri ma chos can/ don dam par skye 'gag med de/ de bzhin nyid kyi ngo bo'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ don dam par dri ma chos can/ mthong lam gyis gsar du zad par byar med par thal/ ma skyes pa'i phyir/ chos can/ mthong lam gyis gsar du mi skye ba'i chos can du byas pa min par thal/ gdod ma nas mi skye ba'i chos can yin pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ skyes pa dang ma skyes pa dag go rim bzhin du zhes sogs so// gnyis pa la/ 'brel ni/ dri ma bden par med pa de lta min par yod na khas blangs nang 'gal lo// zhes ston pa ni/ de lta min te zhes sogs so// dngos kyi don la rtsa 'grel gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas chos can/ khyod kyis bden 'dzin spangs pa mi 'thad par thal/ bden 'dzin yul gyi gnas lugs la zhugs pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ gzhan gyi chos rnams kyang yod la/ zhes sogs so// 'grel pa la/ bden med 'dod pa'i phyogs la shes sgrib spong ba 'thad par bstan/

bden grub smra ba'i phyogs la mi 'thad par bstan/ bden grub khas len pa dang*/ byang chen khas len pa nang 'gal du bstan pa'o// dang po la'ang mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal snga nas/ skye 'jig byed pa'i rtags kyis phyi rol pas btags pa'i bden dngos mi 'thad par sgrub ste/ bdag med du gtan la dbab/ lhan cig dmigs nges kyi rtags kyi nyan thos sde gnyis kyi btags pa'i bden dngos mi 'thad par bsgrubs te sems tsam du gtan la phab/ gzung ba med pa'i rtags kyis rnam pa bden pas brtags pa'i bden dngos mi 'thad par bsgrubs te/ gzung 'dzin gnyis med du gtan la phab/ rten 'brel gyi rtags kyis rnam brdzun pas btags pa'i bden dngos mi 'thad par bsgrubs te/ mtha' bral du gtan la dbab pa'o// rnam bshad ltar na/ bdag med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa sogs rnal 'byor gyi sa bzhis so// 'di yang gdul bya bstan pa la rim gyis 'jug pa'i tshul ston pa yin te/ thog mar phyi rol pa'i lta ba las zlog nas/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i snod du rung bar bya ba'i phyir/ gang zag la bdag med pa'i don sgom par byed cing*/ chos kyi bdag med la'ang phra rags kyi rim pas/ phyi rol gyi don bden med du bsgrub pa dang*/ der snang gi rnam pa bden med du sgrub pa dang*/ gnyis med kyi shes pa bden med du bsgrub par byed do// 'o na dngos smra ba la khas blangs nang 'gal ston pa'i skabs su/ rnal 'byor gyi sa bzhi ston pa ji ltar 'brel zhe na/ bden grub khas len pa la dri ma spong ba mi 'thad na/ chos thams cad bden med khas len pa la dri ma spong ba'i rim pa ji ltar 'thad snyam pa la/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa yid la byed pa'i tshul dang snying po'i don yid la byed pa'i rim pa gnyis kyi sgo nas ston pa las/ dang po ni/ rje btsun gyi gzhung gis gtso bor ston pa la/ gnyis pa ni/

klu grub kyi gzhung las gsal bar ston pa yin mod/ gnyis po'ang ldog pas phye ba yin gyi/ rdzas tha dad pa ni med pa'i phyir/ rje btsun gyi gzhung las kyang snying po'i don sgom pa'i rim pa ma bstan pa ni min no zhes shes par bya ba'i phyir/ 'dir mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan las gsungs pa'i snying po'i don sgom tshul ston pa yin te/ chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis/ de la skye ba dang 'jig pa stong pa'i phyir zhes bya ba la sogs pa snying po'i don sgom pa'i rim pa yid la bya ba 'di ni dbu ma'i bstan bcos las gsal bas 'dir bdag gis mi bsam mo zhes dang*/ snying po'i don sgom pa'i dbang du byas te slob dpon gyi zhal snga nas/ rtse mo'i mngon par rtogs pa'i skabs su de la skye ba dang 'jig pas stong pa'i phyir/ zhes bya ba la sogs gsungs so// zhes bshad cing*/ rtogs dka'i snang ba las/ nang gi mu stegs pa rnams kyis byang chub pa'i thabs thabs min pa nyid du bstan pa'i skabs su/ thams cad du 'gro ba'i bdag med pa bstan pa ni byang chub ji lta bu yin pa/ bla ma'i man ngag mdor bsdus te bstan pas/ 'jug pa'i sgo nas tshig le'ur byas pa las ma smos pa'i don shugs kyis 'phangs pa bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ de la skye ba dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa smos pa yin te/ zhes gsal bar gsungs pas/ dbu ma pa la nyes pa de mi 'jug par bstan pa yin no// de la rnal 'byor gyi sa dang pos/ skabs gsum par bstan pa'i snying po'i snying po'i don bsgom tshul dang*/ lhag ma rnams skabs gnyis par bstan pa'i snying po'i don sgom tshul bstan no// gzhung 'dis ni dar ṭīka mdzad pa/ bstan bcos 'di'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya theg pa chen po dbu ma pa 'ba' zhig tu 'dod pa'ang bsal te/ rnal 'byor gyis sa dang po gsum bsgom pa'i bstan bcos 'di'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya des bden dngos 'dod pa'i phyir te/

yang dag par yod pa'i ngo bo yin no snyam du nges par byas nas/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// des na 'dis ni/ bstan bcos 'di'i gdul bya bstan pa la rim gyis 'jug pa'i tshul bstan pa yin no// de yang 'di ltar/ nyer len gyi phung po chos can/ rtag cing rang dbang can min te/ skye 'jig byed pa'i phyir/ nyan thos tshogs lam pas skye 'jig can gyi rtags las nyer len gyi phung po bdag med du rtogs nas sgom pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin spang bar bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni de la skye ba dang*/ zhes sogs so// sngon por snang ba dang*/ sngon snang gi shes pa chos can/ snang ba ltar rdzas gzhan min te/ lhan cig dmigs nges yin pa'i phyir/ sems tsam pa'i drod rtse gang rung la gnas pa'i sbyor lam pas lhan cig dmigs nges kyi rtags kyis de gnyis rdzas gzhan min par rtogs nas sgom pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ shes sgrib gzung rtog spang bar bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ sngon po dang de'i blo dag lhan cig dmigs par nges pa'i phyir/ zhes sogs so// phyi rol don du snang ba'i rnam pa 'di chos can/ shes pa'i rdzas su mi bden te/ sna tshogs su snang zhing snang ba ltar med pa'i phyir/ sems tsam pa'i bzod mchog gang rung la gnas pa'i sbyor lam pas gzung ba phyi rol gyi don med pa'i rtags kyis/ der snang ba'i rnam pa sems su mi bden par rtogs nas sgom pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ phyi rol don du snang ba'i gzung rnam shes pa'i rdzas su bden par 'dzin pa dgag pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ gzung ba med pa zhes sogs so// gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi rang rig rang gsal chos can/ bden par med de/ rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir/ byang sems mthong lam pas rten 'brel gyi rtags kyis shes pa bden med du rtogs nas sgom pa chos can/

dgos pa yod de/ shes sgrib kyi sa bon spangs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ de yang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i phyir// zhes sogs so// 'dir chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ sems tsam pa'i lta ba la gong 'og gi khyad par med par bzhed la/ bu ṭīka las/ 'dzin pa bden smra'i rang rgyal dang*// gzung 'dzin gnyis med don dam du// 'dod pa'i sems tsam grub pa'i mtha'// mtshungs par rtog pa'i mkhas pa mtshar// zhes gsungs la/ 'di ni gsal byed pa'i bzhad gad do// zhes legs bshad gser 'phreng mdzad pa po gsung ngo*// rnal 'byor gyi sa bzhi po 'di ni chos nyid ngo bo las mi g.yo bar thams cad la snang ba zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo las gsungs te/ 'di ltar/ 'khor phal cher las kha cig ni/ chos thams cad ji ltar snang ba bzhin yod pa'i chos ston to snyam ste de la nges par 'dzin cing rtog par byed do// zhes dang*/ kha cig gis ni/ chos thams cad sems tsam las ma gtogs pa gzhan med pa'i chos ston to snyam ste de la nges par 'dzin cing rtog par byed do// zhes dang*/ kha cig gis ni sems nyid kyang ma skyes par/ bdag la chos ston to snyam ste/ de la nges par 'dzin cing rtog par byed do// zhes dang*/ kha cig gis ni/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa/ ngo bo nyid kyis mi gnas pa/ sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/ rtag pa dang*/ mi rtag pa'i yul las 'das pa/ thog ma med pa'i dus nas spros pa rnam par dag pa'i chos ston to snyam ste nges par 'dzin cing rtog par byed do// zhes gdul bya so so'i dbang du byas te gsungs la/ lang kar gshegs pa dang*/ ka ma la shi la'i sgom rim dang*/ slob dpon gyis ni 'di dag gang zag gcig gi rim par sgom pa'i dbang du byas te gsungs so// 'di la dar ṭīka snying po'i rgyan mdzad pa na re/ rnal 'byor sa bzhir byas nas de la lta ba gong 'og gi khyad par 'byed pa mi 'thad de/

sngon po sngor snang dbang shes las rdzas tha dad yin pa khegs nas sngor snang dbang shes sngon po las rdzas tha dad pa'i gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan ma khegs pa'i gang zag gi rim pa mi 'thad la/ rnal 'byor gyi sa gnyis pas nang shes pa la ltos pa'i gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan dgag dgos pa'ang min te/ de'ang rigs pa snga mas khegs pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel las/ der yang rtsad pa mtshungs phyir te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ sems tsam gyi lta ba ni lhan cig dmigs nges kyi rtags la brten nas ma lus par rtogs nus la/ de ni rnal 'byor gyi sa gnyis pas bstan cing*/ de las gong na dbu ma'i lta ba ma gtogs gzhan su yang med pa'i phyir/ 'dir rim pa gnyis bstan pa ltar snang ba ni/ rim pa gnyis pa'i rjes thob tu yid la byed tshul bstan pa yin no// des na mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'dir/ lta ba la ltos pa'i rim pa gsum kho na bstan te/ chung ngu la gang zag gi bdag med thun mong ba rtogs pa dang*/ 'bring po la gzung 'dzin rdzas tha dad kyis stong par rtogs pa dang*/ chen po la rnam shes bden med du rtogs pa'o// 'dir ni de lta bu'i rnal 'byor gyi sa gsum kho na bstan pa yin no// zhes 'chad do// 'di mi 'thad par rtogs pa la rnam bcad kyi sgo nas gnod byed dang*/ yongs gcod kyi sgo nas sgrub byed dgod pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ lta ba la ltos pa'i theg pa'i rim pa gsum ston pa'ang mi 'thad par thal/ theg pa gsum ka rnam shes bden med rtogs pa'i lta ba la gong 'og gi khyad par med pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum car zhal gyis bzhes te/ 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad 'dus ma byas kyis rab tu phye ba'i chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa la khyad par med par 'dod pa'i phyir ro// ci ste chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i nyan rang yod par khas blangs kyi/ thams cad kyi rtogs par khas blangs pa med do zhe na/ de las mi rigs pa gzhan ci zhig yod/

khyod ltar na 'phags pa'i gang zag la la 'dus ma byas kyis rab tu phye bar song zhing*/ gzhan yang rang sangs rgyas dang*/ sems tsam pa gnyis kyi lta ba la khyad par med pa'ang min par thal/ rnam shes bden med rtogs pa'i rang sangs rgyas yod pa'i phyir/ gsum car min nam/ gzhan yang snga phyi gnyis la mnyam rjes kyi rigs pa so sor 'byed pa'ang mi 'thad par thal/ sngon po sngor snang dbang shes las rdzas gzhan yin pa khegs pa mnyam gzhag gi rtogs tshul dang*/ gcig shos de las rdzas gzhan du rtogs pa rjes kyi yid la byed tshul yin pa'i rim pa mi 'thad la/ rjes thob tu nang shes pa la ltos pa'i gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan dgag dgos pa'ang min pa'i phyir/ gsum car gyi 'phreng ba zhal gyis bzhes/ gzhan yang rnam bden brdzun gnyis la lta ba gong 'og gi khyad par med par thal/ lhan cig dmigs nges kyi rtags la brten nas sems tsam gyi lta ba ma lus pa gtan la phebs pa'i phyir/ shin tu'ang 'dod do zhe na/ khyad par srid pa rnam bden brdzun gnyis la khyad par med cing*/ khyad par mi srid pa thal rang gi lta ba la khyad par 'dod pa ni/ gsal bar dbang phyug spyod pa yin// zhes bya'o// gzhan yang rnal 'byor gyis gnyis pa'i skabs su sngon po bden med du gtan la phebs sam ma phebs/ dang po ltar/ shes pa'ang bden med du rtogs par thal/ sngon po bden med du rtogs pa'i phyir/ gsum car khas blangs/ gnyis pa ltar na/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes 'ba' zhig 'di zhes/ gzhan ldan rnam gcod kyi sgra gsungs pa la nus pa ci zhig yod de ci yang med par thal/ sngon po dang gnyis med kyi ye shes gnyis ka bden med du ma rtogs pa la khyad par med pa'i phyir/ ci ste nyes pa de khyed rang la'ang mtshungs so snyam na/ ma yin te/ kho bo cag ni phyi rol gyi don dang*/ sngo sogs la yod med kyi khyad par khas mi len cing*/ len na'ang tshad mas grub pa gcig bden med du rtogs na/

gzhan thams cad bden med du rtogs par khas mi len pa'i phyir/ ci ste khyed ltar nges par khas len dgos na/ nyan rang 'phags pa chos can/ chos kyi bdag med rdzogs par rtogs par thal/ chos can tshad mas grub pa gcig bden med du rtogs pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba'i grub mtha' thams cad ma 'gyel lam/ yang rnal 'byor gyi sa gzhan la rjes kyi yid la byed tshul mi ston par/ gnyis pa kho na la rjes kyi yid la byed tshul ston dgos pa yang ci zhig yin dri bar bya'o// yang dar ṭīka pa sgyu ma lta bu'i bdag nyid du snang ba'i blo zhes pas/ mnyam gzhag sgyu ma lta bur ston pa yin zhes gsungs pa ni/ snang ba zhes pa'i tshig zur la nus pa ma thon cing*/ de yang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ sgyu ma bzhin du ngo bo nyid med do zhes pa dang zlos pas mi 'thad do// shin tu spros pa de tsam gyis chog go /gnyis pa ni/ rnal 'byor sa bzhi'i rim pa so sor kho nar nges par byed dgos te/ dbus mthar/ dmigs pa la ni brten nas su// mi dmigs par ni rab tu skye// mi dmigs pa la brten nas su// mi dmigs pa ni rab tu skye// zhes dang mdo sde'i rgyan las/ sems las gzhan med par ni blos rig nas// de nas sems kyang med pa nyid du rtogs// blo dang ldan pas gnyis po med rig nas// de mi ldan pa'i chos kyi dbyings la gnas// zhes dang*/ sum cu pa'i rab tu byed pa las/ nam zhig shes pas dmigs pa rnams// mi dmigs na ni de yi tshe// rnam par rig pa tsam la gnas// gzung ba med pas de 'dzin med// de ni sems med mi dmigs pa// 'jig rten 'das pa'i ye shes de// gnas kyang gzhan du gyur pa de// gnas ngan len gnyis spangs pa'o// zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa rnams kyis sems tsam pa'i lta ba gcig la rim pa gnyis kho na gsal bar bstan pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la/ dngos smra ba ltar/

yul yul can bden par yod na/ gnyen po bar chad med lam chos can/ khyod sgom pas spangs bya la gnod pa cung zad kyang mi byed par thal/ khyod bskyed du med cing dri ma 'gags par byar med pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' bzhin no// zhes ston pa ni/ de lta ma yin te/ dus thams cad du nam mkha' rdzas med tsam gyi ngo bo zhes sogs so*// ci ste bden par khas blangs kyi rtag par khas ma blangs so zhe na/ mi rtag par grub na stong par grub ste/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ gang zhig rnam shes skad cig ma// de yi de ni rtag ma yin// mi rtag pa yi sems nyid ni// stong pa nyid dang 'gal mi 'gyur// mdor na sangs rgyas rnams kyi sems// mi rtag nyid du bzhed gyur na// de dag sems de stong nyid du// ci'i phyir na bzhed mi 'gyur// zhes 'byung ba ltar ro// gsum pa ni dri ma bden par khas len pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dri ma spangs par brtsom pa de chos can/ rje btsun gyis bzhad gad bya bar rigs te/ gzhi gcig la nang 'gal khas len pa'i dam 'cha' yin pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis zhes sogs so// ji ltar 'gal na/ rtsa she las/ rang bzhin gzhan du 'gyur ba ni// nam yang 'thad pa ma yin no// zhes 'byung ba ltar ro// gsum pa 'brel ni/ de ltar dngos por smra ba dang*/ dbu ma pa'i lugs gnyis las/ thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyis dbu ma pa'i lugs 'di kho na khas blang bar bya'o// zhes ston pa ni/ de ltar zhes sogs so// rtsa ba la/ gzhi shes bya'i gnas tshul bstan pa ni/ rten 'brel sna tshogs pa 'di chos can/ snang la rang bzhin med pa yin te/ snang ba'i cha bsal bar byar med/ bden grub kyi cha bzhag par byar med pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni rkang pa dang po gnyis so// de la sgro 'dogs ji ltar gcod pa ni yang dag par snang la rang bzhin med pa de chos can/ khyod la yang dag par ram/ khyod rang gi gnas tshul dang mthun par blta bar bya ste/

de ltar ma bltas na mngon zhen las grol bar mi 'thad pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ rkang pa gsum pa'o// de las 'bras bu ci 'byung ba ni/ yang dag pa yul gyi gnas tshul de chos can/ khyod la bltas pa don dang bcas te/ khyod mthong na shes sgrib las grol bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni rkang pa bzhi pa'o// 'dir bdag gi blo la 'di ltar snang ste/ gong du 'gal rkyen rtog pa rnams spangs/ mthun rkyen lhan cig byed pa gsum po rgyud la brten nas 'bras bu byang chub chen po 'byung bar bstan pa la/ 'gal rkyen spong zhing*/ lhan cig byed rkyen grogs su tshol ba'i nyer len gyi rgyu de gang zhe na/ bden med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mthong lam bar chad med lam de yin no// zhes ston pa la/ bden grub yul gyi gnas tshul min pa dang*/ bden stong yul gyi gnas tshul du bstan nas de gsar du rtogs pa'i blo de mthong lam rtse sbyor du ston pa la/ yum gyi mdo las ma zin pa'i sh+lau ka gsum po 'di gsungs so// de yang*/ 'gog pa med pa'i rang bzhin la// zhes par/ gnyen po mthong lam bden stong yin par bstan// gzhan gyis zhes par/ spang bya dri ma bden stong du bstan/ 'di la zhes pas/ gnyen po bden stong des spangs bya bden stong de ji ltar 'joms pa'i rim pa de ston/ de yang yum gyi mdo nas ji ltar gsungs pa dang sbyor nas ston pa ni/ sbyin pa la sogs re re ni// zhes pa'o// mdor na gzhung 'di yum gyi mdor dngos su bstan pa'i stong nyid kyi rim pa ngos bzung nas/ de ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul gsal bar ston te/ de yang 'di ltar/ skabs dang po gsum du ji ltar bstan pa'i skye med kyi rim pa de ngos 'dzin pa ni/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid ces pa'o// skabs bar pa bzhir bstan pa de dang skye med kyi rim pa ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul ngos 'dzin pa ni/

la yang dag lta/ zhes pa'o// skabs brgyad par bstan pa'i skye med rtogs pa'i rtogs pa mthar thug de ngos 'dzin pa ni/ yang dag mthong nas rnam par grol// ces pa'o// gzhung bzhi'i 'di gsum gyi mdo ni/ dus kyi dbang gis mdo'i yi ge nyams par shes par bya'o// zhes gsungs la/ kho bo cag gis ni/ sher phyin gyi mdo tsam gyis dngos bstan gyi stong nyid kyi rim pa ji ltar sgom tshul ston pa yin cing*/ gzhung phyi ma 'dis sngar bshad pa ltar/ chos 'phags kyi le'u'i don ston par gsal lo// gnyis pa rnal ma mthong lam rtse sbyor la/ bar chad med lam dang*/ khyad par gyi lam gnyis/ dang po 'brel ni/ ji skad bshad pa'i bden stong rtogs pa'i mthong lam de gang zhe na/ zhes ston pa ni/ de ltar zhes sogs so// 'brel pa can dngos la/ mdo ni/ byang sems chen po sbyin pa gtong zhing rnam mkhyen du bsngo ba'i tshe sems can rnams la byams pa'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las nye bar gnas par gyur te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag kyang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas su mi bsngo'o// sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas nas bla med byang chub tu bsngo ste/ de ji ltar gang gis bsngo ba dang*/ gang bsngo ba dang*/ gang du bsngo ba'i 'du shes gsum mi 'jug pa de ltar yongs su bsngo'o// zhes so// de bsdud pa ni/ sbyin pa la sogs re re ni// zhes sogs so// skad cig ma gcig la sbyin sogs re re'i nang du drug drug tshang bar bsdus nas sgom pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod chos can/ mthong lam rtse sbyor yin te/ mthong spangs rtog pa'i sa bon la dngos su gnod byed kyis bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir zhes ston pa ni/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de dag ces so// 'dir sum cu rtsa drug can skyes pa zhes pa/

mkhas pa phal mo che ni/ sbyin sogs drug tshan drug la bzhed/ der 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan/ bcom ldan ral gri ni/ rtog pa drug gi dbye bas bzhed de/ 'dir zhes pas/ chos kyi bshes gnyen ni/ skabs snga ma rnams su bstan pa'i mthong lam gyis rtog pa 'di snyed bde blag tu spong mi nus/ skabs 'og mar/ rtog pa 'di dag spong ba'i 'bad pa mi dgos pas/ zhes bzhed/ 'o na skabs lnga par mthong spang shes sgrib kyi spong tshul bstan nas nyon sgrib kyi spong tshul ma bstan pas/ mthong lam bar chad med lam gyi nyon mongs pa gtan mi spong ba yin nam zhe na/ min te zhes ston pa ni/ de skyes pa na zhes sogs so// gzhung 'dis rnam par rtog pa spangs pa na/ rnam par rtog pa'i sa bon spangs par ston pa ni min te 'di'i thad kyi 'grel chen las/ rnam par rtog pa skyed par byed pa'i bag chags kyi rnam par rtog pa brgya rtsa brgyad spang ba/ zhes gsungs pas so// blun pos bkur bar 'os pa'i mkhas pa la la/ rnam bshad kyi dgongs pa/ mthong spangs rtogs pa spangs na/ de'i sa bon spangs pas khyab par 'dod pa ni gzhung 'di'i rnam bshad las bkag ste/ mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod rdzogs par skyes pa na/ mthong spangs rtog pa brgya rtsa brgyad spangs par bstan pa'i phyir ro// mdor na/ gzhung 'dis/ mthong spangs shes sgrib spangs pa na mthong spangs nyon sgrib kyang spong bar bstan kyang*/ nyon mongs kyi bag chags nyon sgrib tu khas len dgos pa'ang min te/ nyon mongs pa'i bag chags spangs pa na nyon sgrib spangs pa rigs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa khyad par gyi lam la 'brel ni/ mthong lam bar chad med lam gyi mthong spangs rtog pa brgya rtsa brgyad spangs pa de tsam gyis spang bya spong ba'i bya ba yongs su rdzogs sam zhe na min te/ mthong lam gyi rtogs pa'i rigs rgyun de nyid sgom lam gyi gnas skabs su yang dang yang du sgom par byed dgos pa'i phyir/

zhes ston pa ni/ de la dbang du bya ba'i phyir/ zhes sogs so// dngos la/ mdo ni/ seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug cing*/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas nas rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i yan lag bcu gnyis la lugs dang mthun pa dang mi mthun par rtog go /zhes so// de bsdud pa ni/ de nas seng ge rnam bsgyings pa'i// zhes sogs so// 'di sgom lam gyi skabs yin kyang*/ 'phags seng gis mthong lam gyi sde tshan du bsdud pa ni/ sa dang por sgom pa la dgongs shing*/ de yang 'phags pa ltar na sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings dang por bsgoms nas/ de'i rjes su sa gnyis par thod rgal gyi ting nge 'dzin nam/ sgom lam bar chad med lam dngos de 'byung ba'i phyir/ sgom lam rtse sbyor mtshan nyid pa de ston pa ni/ 'gog dang bcas pa'i zhes sogs so// slob dpon ltar na/ de nas seng ge rnam bsgyings pa'i/ zhes bstan pa de gang zhe na/ de ngos 'dzin pa la 'gog dang bcas pa'i zhes sogs so// gsum pa sgom lam rtse sbyor la/ gnyen po sgom lam rtse sbyor/ spangs bya rtog pa/ rten pa yon tan no// dang po la snga phyi'i 'brel ni/ mthong spangs rtog pa rnams ni mthong lam gyi snga rol du mgo mnon pa'i phyir/ rtog pa sngar bstan nas gnyen po phyis bstan la/ sgom spangs rtog pa spong ba'i sbyor ba nyer bsdogs ni/ sgom lam kho na yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir rtog pa'i snga rol du gnyen po ston nam zhes ston pa ni/ de ltar mthong ba'i lam brjod nas// zhes sogs so// dngos la// slob dpon ltar na/ sbyor ba nyer bsdogs dang*/ 'jug pa bar chad med lam gnyis/ dang po la/ mdo ni/ seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i ting nge 'dzin gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang sems chen po/ 'dod pas dben pa'i sdig to mi dge ba'i chos kyis dben pa'am/ bsam gtan dang po nas 'gog pa'i bar nye bar bsgrub pa ste gnas so// de 'gog pa las langs nas srid rtse nas bsam gtan dang po'i bar nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so// zhes so// de bsdud pa ni/

'gog dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgur// rnam pa gnyis su song 'ongs nas// zhes pa'o// gnyis pa la/ chung 'bring chen po gsum las/ mdo ni/ rab 'byor byang sems chen po'i ting nge 'dzin thod rgal de gang zhe na/ 'di la byang sems chen po bsam gtan dang po la snyoms par 'jug pa nas/ de bzhin du 'gog pa'i bar snyoms par 'jug go /zhes dang*/ de las langs nas bsam gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrub ste gnas so// de nas 'gog pa la'o// de nas bsam gtan gnyis pa la'o// de nas 'gog pa la'o// de nas gsum pa la'o// bzhi pa la'o// 'gog pa la'o// nam mkha' la'o// 'gog pa la'o// rnam shes la'o// 'gog pa la'o// ci yang med pa la'o// 'gog pa la'o// 'du shes med 'du shes med min la'o// 'gog pa la'o// de las langs nas 'du shes med min la snyoms par 'jug go /zhes dang*/ de las langs nas 'dod pa na spyod pa'i mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems mngon du byed do// de las 'gog pa la snyoms par 'jug go zhes sogs nas/ bsam gtan dang po'i rjes su mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems mngon du byed pa'i bar ro// de bsdud pa la/ dngos gzhi thod rgal chung ngu ni sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings kyi yar 'gro bstan pas go sla ba'i phyir rtsa bas ma bsdus shing*/ 'grel par yang mi 'chad la/ 'bring po ni/ rtsa bar ma bsdus kyang*/ 'grel par kha bskang ste 'chad do// 'dir dar ṭīka pa seng ge rnam bsgyings kyi rjes la/ gang yang bar du ma bcug pa'i yar song ste/ dkyus sa bstan pa tsam yin gyi/ thod rgal dngos gzhi min par bzhed pa ni/ mdo las/ thod rgal gyi dngos gzhir gsungs pa dang 'gal zhing*/ dkyus sa sbyor ba'i dus su bstan pa des mi 'grub na thug pa med par thal ba'i phyir ro// de'i phyir thod rgal gyi sgra bshad du med kyang*/ thod rgal yin pa mi 'gal te/ dper na 'phar gsum bzhin no// slob dpon gyis sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings gzhung 'dis bsdus par bzhed pa ni/

'phags pas sbyor dngos gnyis kyi mdo lhan cig drangs pas 'khrul par zad la/ 'phags pa'i dgongs pa la'ang sbyor ba gzhung snga mas bstan no// des na bstan bcos rtsa ba'i dgongs pa ni/ shān+ti pas bzhed pa ltar/ sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings ni/ gzhung snga mas bstan zin la/ 'dir ni dngos gzhi thod rgal kho na bstan pa legs so// zhes kun mkhyen chos kyi rje gsung ngo*// de yang shān+ti pa 'di ltar bzhed de/ dag ldan ltar na/ 'gog dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgur// rnam pa gnyis su song zhes pas/ dngos gzhi chung 'bring gnyis bstan/ 'ongs nas/ zhes pas srid rtse'i nud chung bstan/ lhag ma rnams kyis chen po bstan no// snying po mchog ltar na/ rnam pa bcu gnyis su song ba ni/ snga ma ltar yin la/ 'ongs pa ni/ mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu la 'dod sems re spel nas lugs mi mthun du 'ongs pa'o// thub dgongs dang*/ nyi khri le'u brgyad ma'ang 'di ltar bzhed la/ de dag ni stong phrag brgya pa dang*/ nyi shu lnga pa'i lugs yin la/ srid rtse la nud chung ni khri brgyad stong pa kho na'i lugs so// 'dod sems ni/ tshigs gsal las/ sems can dmyal ba sogs ji ltar gnas pa rnams sgyu ma tsam du dran pa'i rjes thob ste/ yul 'dod pa la dmigs pas na 'dod pa na spyod pa'am/ 'dod par gtogs pa'o zhes gsungs/ gser gling pa/ 'dod pa ni dmyal ba sogs 'dod pa'i khams so// der gtogs pa ni skye bas thob pa'i shes pa'o// rnam par shes pa mnyam par ma bzhag pa ni rnam par rtog pa'o// mtshams bzung ba ni 'dod pa khams pa'i skye bo rnams las 'tshang rgya ba nyid yin pa'i phyir/ nye bar bzung zhing rnam par bzhag ces dang*/ 'dod khams pa'i rnam par rtog pas rnam par g.yengs pa'i sems nas nye bar bzung bar byas nas gzugs khams su gtogs pa'i sems kyis bsam gtan dang po mngon du byas zhes 'dod sems mtshan nyid pa la bshad kyang*/

chos bshes ltar legs so// zhes ma pham bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sangs rgyas dpal gyis gsung ngo*// mdor na sa dang po'i sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings sgom lam gyis bsdus pa de chos can/ sgom lam gyi dngos gzhi'i thod rgal gyi sbyor ba yin te/ sgom spang rtog pa mgo mnon pa'i sbyor ba'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ sa gnyis pa'i thod rgal gyi ting nge 'dzin de chos can/ sgom lam la 'jug pa bar chad med lam yin te/ sgom spangs rtog pa'i sa bon dngos su 'joms nus kyi/ bsdus sgom rab tu gyur ba'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i don no// gnyis pa spang bya rtog pa la bzhi las/ dang po la/ mdo ni gsol pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas chos 'di dag mdo dang rgyas par bstan no// zhes so// de bsdud pa ni/ mdor bsdus zhes sogs so// mdor na/ 'jug pa gzung rtog lhan skyes dgu chos can/ sgom lam rtse sbyor gyi spangs bya yin te/ sgom lam sbyor ba nyer bsdogs kyi gzhom bya yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'o// gnyis pa la/ mdo ni/ rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ yum la yun ring po ji srid cig dpyad na yum la spyad par 'gyur/ bka' stsal pa/ sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ snying po byang chub la 'dug gi bar du yum la spyad par bya'o// zhes so// de bsdud pa la/ ldog pa gzung rtog lhan skyes dgu chos can/ sgom lam la 'jug pa bar chad med lam gyi spangs bya yin te/ de'i gzhom bya yin pa'i phyir zhes ston pa ni/ gnyis pa sems dang sems byung rnams// zhes so// gsum pa la mdo ni/ bcom ldan 'das/ bdag dang*/ sems can dang*/ srog dang*/ gang zag gi khams ji lta bu lags zhes so// de bsdud pa la/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa lhan skyes dgu chos can/ sgom lam rtse sbyor gyis spangs bya yin te/ sgom lam sbyor ba nyer bsdogs kyi gzhom bya yin pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/

sems can btags pa'i spyod yul dang*// zhes sogs so// bzhi pa la/ mdo ni/ rab 'byor tha snyad ni ming dang mtshan ma'am mngon par zhen pa ma yin no// rab 'byor ming la tha snyad du bya ba ma yin zhing*/ mtshan ma dang mngon par zhen pa la tha snyad du byed pa ma yin no zhes so// de bsdud pa ni/ sems can btags dang de rgyu yi// zhes sogs te rgyas par bshad pa ji ltar dgu yin zhe na/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas thams cad shes pa nyid gsungs pa dang*/ lam gyi rnam par shes pa nyid gsungs pa dang*/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang gsungs na/ de gsum la khyad par ci zhig mchis/ zhes sogs so// de bsdud pa ni/ rtags 'dzin rtog pa lhan skyes dgu chos can/ sgom lam rtse sbyor gyi spang bya yin te/ sgom lam 'jug pa bar chad med lam gyis gzhom bya yin pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ bdag nyid ji bzhin kun mkhyen ni// zhes so// mdo las/ gnyen po dngos su bstan/ rtog pa mtshon nas gsungs la/ bstan bcos su rtog pa dngos su bstan nas gnyen po bzhi yang shugs la rtogs par bya'o// zhes ston pa ni/ sgom pa'i lam gyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnam pa bzhi po de spangs pa nyid du zhes sogs so// gsum pa rten yon tan la 'brel ni/ sgom lam rtse sbyor gyi sgom spangs rnam par rtog pa rnams spangs pa na/ yon tan gyi rigs thams cad yar ldan du 'byung ba'i phyir/ brten pa yon tan 'chad ces ston pa ni/ snga ma bzhin du zhes sogs so// sgom spangs rtog pa spang pa la/ de'i sa bon spangs pas khyab pa rnam bshad kyi dgongs pa yin na 'dir sgom lam chen po'i chen po la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ sgom spangs kyi sa bon ma lus par spangs par thal/ sgom spangs rtog pa brgya rtsa brgyad spangs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i nyes pa rnam bshad kyi zhal gyis bzhes par 'gyur bas mi rigs so// 'brel pa can dngos la bshad bya'i mdo ni/

rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na skyes bu la la zhig ljang bu bskyed par 'dod la/ dus dus su chu bran cing sdong bu de rim gyis yal ga dang*/ lo ma dang*/ me tog dang*/ 'bras bu phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba dang*/ ljang bu de'i lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bu la longs spyod pa de bzhin du/ byang sems chen po rnams kyang sems can gyi don gyi phyir/ rim gyis pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod cing*/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par byed do// lo ma dang*/ me tog dang*/ 'bras bu ltar sems can thams cad nye bar 'tsho bar 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs/ de bsdud pa ni/ yams nad 'di rnams zad nas ni// zhes sogs so// 'dir yams nad ni ji skad bshad pa'i rtog pa rnams te/ 'tshe bar byed pa der rtogs pa'o// de skad du yang 'dul ba lung las/ byi ba ne tsho cha ga pa// ha cang char ches char chung dang*// rgyal po ngan par gyur pa ste// drug po de la yams zhes gsungs so// zad pa ni spangs pa ste/ bar chad med lam rdzogs par skyes pa dang spang bya mngon gyur spangs pa dus mnyam pa'i phyir ro// de'i phyir gegs byed pa med pas yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad brten par brjod do// de ltar na'ang*/ sangs rgyas su thal ba min te/ gdags pa las gsungs pa ltar/ rgya mtsho chen po chu bo bzhin 'bab pa'am/ phal po che las 'byung ba ltar/ rgya mtsho chen po 'dzam bu gling nas chu klung stong phrag phyed dang gsum dang*/ nub nas stong phrag lnga dang*/ byang nas stong phrag bcu dang*/ shar nas stong phrag brgyad 'bab pa ltar/ yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad mngon du 'ongs pa'i rnam pas brten pa'i phyir ro// bzhi pa bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor la/ 'phags pa ltar na/ gnyen po bar chad med rtse rgyud la brten bsal bya log bsgrub rnams spangs na/ rnam mkhyen skad cig dang po'i ye shes 'byung ngo zhes ston pa la/

gsung tshan gsum gsungs so// slob dpon ltar na/ dngos dang dmigs rnam mi mthun phyogs so// dang po la 'brel ni/ sgom spangs rtog pa chen po'i chen po spong ba'i gnyen po sgom lam rtse sbyor las/ gnas ngan len gyi dri ma spong ba'i bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor 'byung ba'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ sgom pa'i lam gyi rjes la zhes sogs so// dngos la mdo ni/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can thams cad/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems pa'i skyon med pa la bkod pa'i bsod nams dper mdzad nas/ de bas bsod nams ches mang bar bstan pa'i shugs la gsungs so// de ngo sbyor ni/ stong gsum zhes sogs so// gnyis pa la 'brel ni/ mdor/ bsod nams mang po dang ldan pas mtshon pa'i bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi dmigs rnam ston dgos so zhe na/ zhes ston pa ni/ de'i dmigs pa la sogs pa ji lta bu zhes sogs so// 'phags pa ltar na/ de ma thag sgras rnam mkhyen de gang zhe na/ de ni rnam pa kun mkhyen nyid// rnam mkhyen de'i rkyen gzhan rnams gang zhe na/ 'di yi dmigs pa dngos med de// zhes so// gnyis pa la mdo ni/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi dngos po ji lta bu zhig mchis/ dmigs pa dang*/ dbang sgyur ba dang*/ rnam pa dang*/ mtshan nyid ji lta bu zhig mchis/ bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi dmigs pa ni dngos po med pa'o// bdag po ni dran pa'o// rnam pa ni zhi ba'o// mtshan nyid ni mtshan nyid med pa yin te/ rab 'byor 'di ni dmigs pa dang dbang sgyur ba dang*/ rnam pa dang*/ mtshan nyid do// zhes gsungs/ de bsdud pa ni/ 'di yi dmigs pa dngos med de// dran pa bdag po'i rkyen dang ni// zhi nyid rnam pa yin par bzhed// ces so// 'dir bden pa bkag tsam gyi med dgag dmigs par ston pa ni min te/

'phags seng gis/ dngos po med pa ni yang dag pa'i kun rdzob yin par brjod la/ de kho na nyid kyi rang bzhin sgrib pa de rim gyis sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa nyid rnam par dag pa yin no// zhes gsungs pas so// zhi ba ni/ gnyen pos dri ma bcom pa'i zhi ba min gyi/ rang bzhin gyis zhi ba yin par nyi khri snang bar bshad do// mdor na bden stong sgyu ma lta bu'i snang ba chos can/ bar chad med rtse'i dmigs rkyen yin te/ bar chad med rtse de khyod la dmigs te zhi ba'i rnam pa can du skyes pa'i phyir/ rgyun mtha' man gyi mkhyen gsum gyi dmigs rnam ma brjed pa'i dran pa chos can/ de'i bdag rkyen yin te/ de rang dbang du skyed byed yin pa'i phyir/ de ma thag rkyen ni/ shugs la ston no// 'phags pa ltar na rnam mkhyen chos can/ rang rgyu rkyen gsum las skyes te/ bshad ma thag pa'i rkyen gnyis dang bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor de khyod kyi de ma thag rkyen yin pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa bsal bya log sgrub la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad/ don bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ dmigs rnam gyi tshul 'di la chos can/ rgol ba brgyud mar 'byung ste/ gting dpag dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ klan ka snga ma'i lan btab pa la/ klan ka phyi ma gzhan yang 'byung ba'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ 'di la ni zhes sogs rtsa 'grel lo// gnyis pa la 'brel ni/ blo'i zhes sogs so// dngos la/ mdo ni/ rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'ba' zhig dngos po ma mchis pa lags sam/ 'on te gzugs kyang dngos po ma mchis pa lags/ zhes sogs so// log par rtog pa bcu drug dang*/ des kun nas bslangs pa'i rtsod ngag bcu drug gsungs so// de bsdud pa ni/ dmigs pa mtha' dang zhes sogs so// don ni/ bden gnyis 'gal bar 'dzin pa'i log rtog gam/ des kun nas bslangs pa'i rtsod ngag gang rung chos can/

bsal bya log bsgrub yin te/ bden gnyis rnam 'byed kyi shes rab sam/ des kun nas bslangs pa'i bden gnyis rnam 'byed kyi rigs dag gang rung gi bsal bya yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i don no// bsal bya de dag gang zhe na/ dper na/ bden pa'i dngos por med pa dang*/ dmigs pa 'thad pa 'gal snyam pa ni log rtog yin la/ rnam mkhyen gyi dmigs pa mi 'thad par thal/ don dam par 'dus byas dang*/ 'dus ma byas kyi khams dag dngos po med pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni klan ka'o// zhes sogs lhag ma rnams la'ang sbyar ro// 'di dag la rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis rten can zhes bya ste/ rnam mkhyen gyi yul la log par rtog pa las 'phros pa'i phyir ro// de la lan ji ltar 'debs zhe na/ gser gling pa bcu pa la bden pa gnyis ka'i lan 'debs/ bcu gnyis pa la yang dag kun rdzob dang log pa'i kun rdzob kyi lan 'debs/ dang po gsum pa bzhi pa lnga pa drug pa ma gtogs pa rnams la kun rdzob kyi lan 'debs/ de rnams la don dam gyi lan 'debs par bzhed na'ang*/ don dam sgo can gyi klan ka la kun rdzob kyi sgo nas lan 'debs/ kun rdzob sgo can gyi klan ka la don dam gyi sgo nas lan 'debs dgos te/ de ltar btab na bden gnyis zung 'brel du khong du chud par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ de bas na kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i sgo can gyi zhes so// mdor na klan ka 'di dag snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma 'phros par gsungs so// don bsdu ba ni/ rgyun mtha'i snga logs kyi byang sems chos can/ 'gal rkyen log rtog bsal dgos te/ de bsal/ mthun rkyen dmigs rnam rgyu la brten na/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor dang*/ de las de dang dmigs rnam mtshungs pa'i rnam mkhyen dngos su skye ba'i phyir zhes ston pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes sogs so// de ltar na/ lung gi snye ma las/ gang gi dang por sbyor lam de nas ni// rtog pa 'joms byed mthong lam sgom lam dang*// log rtog bsal nas bar chad med lam gyis// rtog pa lhun grub rtse mo'i sbyor ba sgom// zhes gsungs pa ltar/

de'i rtags dang rnam 'phel dang*// zhes sogs gang gsungs pa de legs par bshad zin to// 'dir smras pa/ gzung 'dzin rang bzhin med pa'i lta ba la// gong 'og rim pa so sor yod min zhes// rnal 'byor sa bzhi 'gog pa'i chos tshul la// chu shing bzhin du snying po med mthong nas// skye med gsum la thos bsam goms pa'i blo// rnal 'byor sa bzhi dbang du gyur pa na// gzung 'dzin chos la zhen pa kun spangs te/ rtse mor son mkhas ma pham rgyal ba'i gzhung*// gsum pa skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba ni/ bslab pa yongs su dag pa'i le'u sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa gsal bar ston pa/ rtse sbyor gyi skabs te lnga pa'o// //nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa las// rnam grol chos kun mkhyen pa'i gter// bar du gcod pa'i chos rnams las// skyob mdzad lhag pa'i lha la 'dud// gnyis pa brtan pa rgyu 'bras la gnyis las/ dang po brtan pa thob pa'i phyir du sgom pa mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba la/ 'brel dgod pas mtshams sbyar/ mngon rtogs kyi rang bzhin rgyas par bshad/ skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ rtse sbyor gyi 'og tu mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba 'chad rigs te/ mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis shes pa'i don la/ dbang du byed pa rgyu 'bras kyi rim pas sgom pa las/ brtan pa rgyu 'bras kyi rim pas sgom pa 'byung ba'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ rtse mo'i mngon par rtogs pa thob pa so so ba dang*/ zhes sogs so// chos bshes ltar na/ so so ba ni bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du chos so so ba rjes thob tu ji ltar rtogs pa rnams yin la/ bsdus pa ni/ mnyam gzhag tu chos nyid rtogs pa'i rim pa'o// zhes bzhed/ gser gling pa ni/ so so ba lugs las ldog pa mkhyen gsum/ bsdus pa lugs las 'byung ba rnam kun rtse sbyor la bzhed cing*/ 'di rang lugs kyang yin la/ de ltar na slob dpon gyi lugs la/

'dir rnam pa brgya bdun bcu rtsa gsum po nyid sgom par bzhed do// gnyis pa mngon rtogs kyi rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa la/ mdo ni/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' chen po sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i phyir/ bdag med rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'jug ste/ mthar gyis bya ba dang*/ mthar gyis bslabs pa dang*/ mthar gyis bsgrubs pa gang la bslabs pas/ sngon gyi byang sems chen po rnams bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas par 'gyur ba de ltar/ mthar gyis bya ba dang*/ bslab pa dang*/ sgrub pa tsam mo zhes gsungs/ de'i don/ nyi snang las/ bgyi ba smos pa ni sems bskyed pa bzung ba'i don du'o// bslab pa smos pa ni/ nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa shes pa'i don du'o// bsgrub pa smos pa ni/ mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam shes pa'i don du'o// gsum smos pa ni/ mngon par rtogs pa'i mthar gyis pa shes pa'i don yin no// zhes gsungs pas/ tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar du bzhed/ slob dpon gyis sbyor mthong sgom gsum la rim par bzhed cing*/ rtse sbyor rjes thogs nas rgyun mtha'i snga logs par bzhed/ mdo de dag bsdud pa ni/ sbyin pa shes rab bar dag dang*// zhes sogs so// 'di la spyi'i 'brel ni/ bcu gsum po bsdu na gnyis te/ spyod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ lta ba phun sum tshogs pa gnyis/ dang po la/ sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ bsam pa phun sum tshogs gnyis/ dang po ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug ste/ 'di ni lam gyi dngos gzhi yin no// gnyis pa la/ lam gyi rjes su dran pa dang*/ lam gyi gzhi dran pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa ste/ 'dis dkon mchog mngon par rtogs pas lam nyams su len pa na lha'i bu'i bdud kyis mi tshugs pa yin no// gnyis pa la/ lam gyi dngos dran pa dang*/ de nyams su len pa'i dbang po dran pa gnyis/

dang po ni/ tshul khrims dang gtong ba rjes su dran pa gnyis te/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du// yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten legs par gsungs// zhes dang*/ thub pas dang por sbyin pa'i gtam mdzad do// zhes 'byung ba ltar/ 'di gnyis ni yon tan mtha' dag bskyed pa'i sa gzhi lta bu yin no// gnyis pa ni/ lha rjes su dran pa ste/ sbyin pas dge ba sgrub pa dang*/ tshul khrims kyis mi mthun phyogs spongs pa gnyis ka la'ang lha dpang por bzhag ste bsgrubs na rnam par dag par 'gyur pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa lta ba ni/ dngos med ngo bo nyid du rtogs pa ste/ rjes thob kyi spyod pa de dag kyang mnyam gzhag tu mi rtog ye shes kyis zin dgos pa'i phyir ro// 'o na so so ba dang*/ bsdus pa nyid du rtogs pa'i don rnams shes/ rnam kun rtse sbyor gyi don rnams sgom byar bshad pa min nam zhe na/ yin mod dngos med ngo bo nyid du rtogs pa dang don gcig ste/ de dag tu skye med gsum sgom par bshad pa'i phyir ro// 'o na tshul khrims dang gtong ba rjes su dran pa dang*/ phar phyin dang po gnyis zlos shing*/ lha dang dkon mchog rjes dran zlos so zhe na/ a ti shas/ sbyin dang tshul khrims gnyis dang ni// gtong dang tshul khrims dran pa yang*// dngos dang 'bras bu'i cha nas su// bstan pas zlos skyon med pa yin// lha dang dkon mchog dpang po dang*// rten tshul yin pas zlos pa med// ces gsungs so// gser gling pa phar phyin bcu dang*/ dkon mchog gsum ste bcu gsum du 'chad/ rin chen sgron ma nas/ phar phyin drug kho na la bshad nas/ dngos po drug tu 'dod/ 'di nyes par bshad pa kho na min te/ drug po 'dis ma bsdus pa'i 'di'i nyams len med pa'i phyir/ so so'i don la/ rnam kun rtse sbyor gyi skabs su/ sbyin dang tshul khrims sogs spyod pas// zhes dang*/ sbyin pa la sogs re rer ni// zhes bshad par ma zad/

brtan pa rgyu 'bras kyi skabs su'ang phyin drug dgos te/ 'dis sa bcu rdzogs par byed pa'i phyir// zhes ston pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa bzhi ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i nang du 'dus pa'i phyir/ zhes sogs so// 'di ji ltar 'dus she na/ dbus mtha' las ni/ mi zad pa dang rtag 'jug dang*// nges dang longs spyod smin par byed// ces gsungs/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis/ drug po re re'i nang du'ang bzhi ka 'dus te/ de ltar sbyin pa btang nas yid rang ba ni thabs so// de rdzogs par byed pa'i smon lam 'debs pa ni smon lam mo// mi mthun phyogs 'joms par byed pa ni stobs so// de'i rnam pa la mkhas pa ni ye shes so// zhes bshad/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug po de yang*/ bsam pa rjes dran drug gis zin par byed dgos pa las/ mdo las dran pa nyer bzhag sogs dang*/ byang chub yan lag bdun dang*/ 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyis mtshon nas bstan pa'i lam gsum don dam par dran pa med cing*/ kun rdzob tu rjes su dran pa ni sangs rgyas rjes dran no// zhes ston pa ni/ dran pa zhes sogs so// rgyu lam dran pas/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas dran par mi 'gyur ba min te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ sngon lam 'di dag goms pa las 'khrungs pa yin no// dran pa ni/ sangs rgyas dran pa'i mchog tu gyur pa ste/ rnam 'grel las/ gyur pa nyid gsungs de yi phyir// sgrub byed la ltos tshad yin rig /zhes bshad pa ltar ro// yang na thams cad chos sku'i 'phrin las yin pa'i phyir/ las byed pa por rjes su dran pa'o// zhes snga ma dag 'chad do// des na/ dngos por mngon par zhen na ni dran par mi 'gyur te/ rdo rje gcod pa las/ gang dag nga la gzugs su mthong*// gang dag nga la sgrar shes pa// log pa'i lam du zhugs pa ste// skye bo de yis nga mi mthong*// sangs rgyas rnams ni chos kyi sku// 'dren pa rnams ni chos nyid lta// chos nyid shes par bya min pas// de ni rnam par shes mi nus// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// de bzhin du/

dge sogs gsum dang*/ tshul khrims dang*/ gtong ba dang*/ 'phags pa ltar na/ lhar skyes pa'i 'phags pa don dam par dran pa med cing*/ kun rdzob tu mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas dran pa'o// 'dir lha dran pa ni/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi la sogs pa'i lha rnams las dge ba las byung bar yid la byed pa ste/ rnam rtog dge ba las byung ba'i dge ba'i 'bras bu lha rnams te/ rab tu dwang ba'i las kyis ni// mdzes pa'i lha rnams mngon par grub// ces 'byung ba ltar ro// chos bshes ltar na/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la sogs lhag pa'i lha rnams dran par byas la/ des byang chub tu bskul ba sogs 'byung ste/ dam chos pad+ma dkar po las/ spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po yid la dran pa yis// ngan song sdug bsngal dbul ba'i sdug bsngal dang*// na ba'i sdug bsngal tsha ba'i sdug bsngal dang*// kun las thar pa spyan ras gzigs kyis gsungs// zhes 'byung ba ltar ro// nam mkha' mdzod kyis zhus pa las ni/ 'di ltar gsungs te/ chos ni 'dod chags bral zhing rang bzhin dben// zhi zhing rab zhi rtag tu mtshan ma med// gang zhig dmigs pa thams cad bral gyur pa// de 'dir chos ni rjes su dran pa yin// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun shin tu 'dus ma byas// stong pa mtshan med smon pa rnam par grol// de las sems dang dran pa 'jug pa med// de ni dge 'dun rjes su dran pa yin// phung po yongs su btang ba thams cad stong*// mnyam dang dngos po thams cad legs par 'dor// bsnyems pa med cing rtog dang rnam rtog dag /'di ni gtong ba legs par rjes su dran// tshul khrims zag pa med cing 'dus ma byas// lus dang ngag dang yid kyis 'jug pa med// 'byung ba med cing srid gsum gnas pa med// de ni tshul khrims rjes su dran pa yin// lha gang dag cing dri med nyams nga med// dga' ldan gnas pa dbang bskur thob gyur pa// sems can dag pa de dag 'di dran cing*// bdag kyang myur du de 'drar 'gyur snyam sems// zhes gsungs so// 'phags pa ltar na/

phung po lnga dang*/ mtshan sum cu so gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dang*/ tshul khrims kyi phung po sogs dang*/ stobs bcu la sogs pa dang*/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang*/ rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes te bdun po don dam par dran pa med cing kun rdzob kyi rjes su dran pa ste bdun ni/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa yin la/ de yang tshogs lam/ sbyor lam bzhi/ mthong sgom gnyis te bdun la rim pa ltar bzhed de/ mdo dang mthun par snang ngo*// de ltar na lung gi snye ma las/ skabs gsum la brten lha rnams dpang por bzhag /tshul khrims gtong ba gzhir bzung phar phyin drug /dngos med ngo bo nyid du rtogs pa'i don// ris sgom brtan byed go rim sbyor ba bsgom// zhes 'byung ba ltar/ rnam gsum rnam bcu zhes 'byung ba de legs par bshad zin to// 'dir smras pa/ dngos brgyad lam gyi 'gros dang mtshon byed chos// so so'i lam gyi 'gro tshul ma phyed par// mngon rtogs brgyad la thos bsam bsgom pa yis// rnam dbyer med ces cha med byung rgyal smra// skye med gsum la thos bsam bsgom pa'i blo// legs par brtan byed mthar gyis sbyor ba yis// bcu gsum chos dang brgya dang bdun cu gsum// zung 'brel sgom pa ma pham rgyal ba'i gzhung*// gsum pa ni/ rim gyis 'jug pa la bslab pa'i le'u'i sbas don gsal bar ston pa mthar gyis pa'i skabs te drug pa'o// //ma rmongs rtsom pa'i legs bshad kyi// brgya byin gzhu yi ri mo ni// kun dga'i dpal du 'dri mkhas pas// dbyangs can lha mo'i dpal gyis skyong*// bzhi pa brtan pa thob nas cig char du sgom pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba la 'brel dgod pas mtshams sbyar ba dang*/ mngon rtogs kyi rang bzhin rgyas par bshad/ skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ mthar gyis sbyor ba'i 'og tu skad cig ma'i sbyor ba bstan/

rnam pa brgya bdun bcu rtsa gsum la brtan pa thob phyir du sgom pa las/ de nyid blo skad cig ma gcig gis/ dus skad cig gcig la sgom pa'i sbyor ba 'byung ba'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ mthar gyis pa'i mngon par rtogs pa rnam par sgom pa ni/ zhes sogs so// gnyis pa la spyi'i 'brel ni/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba yang gnyis su 'dus te/ rtogs bya yul gyi sgo nas bzhag pa dang*/ rtogs byed blo'i sgo nas bzhag pa gnyis/ dang po la/ rnam par smin pa min pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba dang*/ rnam par smin pa'i skad cig sbyor gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyun mthar thob pa'i rnam par smin pa min pa'i zag med kyi rtogs rigs gcig mngon sum du byas pa na skad cig ma gnyis par/ de'i bsdu bya sbyin pa nas dpe byad bzang po'i bar mngon du byed par nus te/ dngos rgyu dngos 'bras bsdud par 'thad do// gnyis pa ni/ rnam par smin pa'i zag med kyi chos gcig mngon du byas pa na/ de dang rigs mthun pa thams cad mngon du byed pa ste/ bsdu byed mngon du byas pa na bsdu bya mngon du byas par 'thad do// 'di la bud+dha shrī ltar na/ sa bdun pa man gyi zag med kyi chos rnams ni rnam par smin pa ma yin pa/ sa brgyad pa yan chad la rnam par smin pa yin par bshad cing*/ de'i rigs mtha' rgyun mthar thob pa de bzang ngo*// chos kyi bshes gnyen ltar na/ mthong lam ma skyes gong gi gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i chos ji snyed pa ni rnam par smin pa min pa/ chos de'i chos nyid ni zag med do// 'phags pas rtogs pa ni rnam par smin pa yin la/ de yang rnam pa gsum ste/ sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar la 'jig rten las 'das par rnam par smin pa dang*/ sa brgyad pa nas bcu pa'i bar la mtshan ma med par rnam par smin pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sa la bsam gyis mi khyab cing lhun gyis grub par rnam par smin pa ste/

de dag tu chos thams cad gnas skabs snga ma las mi 'dra bar smin pas na/ rnam par smin pa'o// zhes bzhed/ gnyis pa la/ ye shes skad cig ma gcig gis 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams mtshan nyid med par shes pa dang*/ gzung 'dzin gnyis med du shes pa gnyis so// 'grel chen du/ skad cig sbyor bzhi 'bras bu 'dod pa'i lugs dang*/ ngo bo gcig la ldog pas phye bar 'dod pa'i lugs gnyis gsungs/ lo ts+tsha ba chen po/ mdo sde rgyan nas/ 'bras bu dam pa 'di bzhi ni// sa bzhi po la yang dag brten// zhes gsungs pa la brten nas/ bzhi po rim pa ltar/ sa bdun pa yan chad la rim par 'chad/ bud+dha shrī yang de ltar bzhed do// shes rab sgron ma las/ skad cig ma gcig po dngos po so sor nges par 'dzin pa'i phyin ci log bral ba'i ngo bo sa bdun par yongs su son par gyur pa'i bar gyi sbyin pa la sogs pa nas zhes gsungs so// shān+ti pa dang*/ a bh+ya ya ni/ sa brgyad pa yan chad la bzhed de/ gnas skabs de ni sa brgyad pa nas so// zhes bshad pas so// gnyis pa so so'i 'brel la bzhi las/ dang po la dngos dang mtshon byed kyi dpe gnyis/ dang po la/ mdo ni/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' chen po yum la de ltar spyod pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug nas dpe byad bzang po rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed do// zhes sogs so// de bsdud pa ni/ sbyin pa la sogs re re ni// zhes sogs so// 'brel pa la/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes chos can/ rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i zag med kyi chos gcig mngon du byas pa na/ de'i bsdu bya thams cad mngon du byed nus te/ de ltar byed nus pa'i 'gal rkyen bden gnyis 'gal bar 'dzin pa'i phyin ci log gi rtog pa dang bral ba gang zhig bsdu byed gcig gis bsdu bya mang po bsdus pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ lugs las chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo zhes sogs so// 'di la brten nas chos gcig bden med du rtogs par bzhed pa'ang min te/

tshig gsal las rang sangs rgyas 'di dag gi ni/ 'jig rten rnams 'jig rten pa dang chags pa'i dbang gis rtogs par sla ba dang*/ sems kyi 'jig rten pa'i yang lus ni rab tu 'jig pas bdag med par rtogs zhes dang*/ 'dzin pa'i ngo bo phung po lhag ma bzhi ni min te/ 'khor ba rnams su rgyun rab tu bstan pas bdag med ces de dag gi ye shes mi 'jug go /zhes chos can so so la bden med rtogs dka' sla'i khyad par gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa dpe ni/ gcig gis mang po bsdus pa'i 'jig rten gyi dpe 'chad pa ni/ ji ltar skyes bu zhes sogs te/ 'di la mdo mi snang ngo*// gnyis pa rnam par smin pa'i skad cig sbyor la/ mdo ni/ de rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i sbyin pa dang*/ tshul khrims dang*/ bzod pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ shes rab dang*/ mngon par shes pa rnams dang*/ byang chub kyi lam des lam gyi rnam par shes pa nyid la spyod cing*/ chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par thob nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rjes su thob ste/ zhes sogs so// de bsdud pa ni gang gi tshe zhes so// gsum pa mtshan nyid med pa'i skad cig sbyor la/ mdo ni/ rab 'byor gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar chos thams cad dbyer ma mchis shing*/ mtshan ma ma mchis pa rang gi mtshan nyid kyi stong pa lags na ji ltar pha rol tu phyin pa drug rdzogs par 'gyur/ zhes sogs so// de bsdud pa ni/ chos kun rmi lam 'drar gnas nas// zhes sogs so// bzhi pa gnyis su med pa'i skad cig sbyor la/ mdo ni/ rab 'byor 'di la byang sems chen po yum la spyod pa'i tshe/ rmi lam mi mthong*/ rmi lam mthong ba mi mthong*/ zhes sogs so// de bsdud pa ni/ rmi lam dang ni de mthong nyid ces so// sbyor ba bzhi la sgom tshul gyi khyad par ji lta bu yod ce na/ chos bshes kyi/ dbang du byed pa rgyu 'bras kyi skabs su rnam pa re re'ang yun ring du sgom pa yin la/

mthar gyis pa'i skabs su/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgya myur du 'bigs pa'i dpes sgom/ skad cig sbyor gyi skabs su/ sbyin sogs re re yang thob zin gyi yon tan thams cad kyi rtogs rigs dang ldan par bskyed nus pas/ zag med kyi chos gcig gi nang du gzhan rnams yon tan gyi tshul du 'dus pa'i sgo nas sgom/ zhes bshad pa ltar legs so// de ltar na lung gi snye ma las/ rtogs bya rnam smin rnam smin min pa'i chos// rtogs tshul mtshan nyid med dang gnyis min par// rtogs dus bya rdzogs skad cig gcig nyid la// rtogs pa mthar thug mkhyen gsum sbyor ba sgom// zhes bshad pa ltar/ skad cig ma// gcig gis mngon rdzogs byang chub pa// zhes 'byung ba de legs par bshad zin to// 'dir smras pa/ skad cig gnyis par chos kun byang chub pa'i// skad cig gcig pa'i ye shes ngo bo gcig /grangs med gsum pa'i snga rol yod do zhes// chen po'i gsung la'ang nges pa ma mthong bas// mtshan nyid bral zhing gzung 'dzin med pa'i blo// skad cig gcig gis zag pa med pa'i chos// skad cig gcig gis rtogs pa'i pha rol na// chos sku mngon gyur ma pham rgyal ba'i gzhung*// gsum pa ni/ bslab pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i le'u'i sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa gsal bar ston pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'i skabs te bdun pa'o// //kun mkhyen nyid gsum rgya mtsho'i dpal// mngon rtogs rnam bzhi srid pa'i rjes// bsrubs pa las 'thon 'phrin las kyi// 'od stong 'gyed mdzad de la 'dud// gsum pa 'bras bu chos kyi sku la/ 'brel bkod pas mtshams sbyar/ mngon rtogs kyi rang bzhin rgyas par bshad/ skabs kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba'o// dang po la mdo'i 'brel ni/ yum bsdus pa las/ rab 'byor gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' chen pos g.yo dang sgyu thams cad rnam par spangs pas rjes su rig par byed pa dang*/

rnam par dpyod pa dang*/ 'jug pa dang*/ rtog par byed pa dang*/ 'jal ba dang*/ nye bar rtog par byed pa dang*/ sgom par gyur pa de'i tshe/ yon tan thams cad dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bla na med pa yongs su rdzogs pa rnyed dka' bar mi 'gyur ro zhes gsungs/ de'i don 'grel chen las/ snga ma brgyad mngon par rtogs pa brgyad dang sbyar zhing*/ phyi ma gsum/ chos sku/ longs sku/ sprul sku gsum gyi yon tan dang sbyar te bshad/ bstan bcos kyi 'brel ni/ skad cig ma gcig pa'i mngon par rtogs pa byang chub pa/ zhes sogs so// de ni/ gzhi lam rnam gsum thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa'i don/ sbyor bas nyams su blangs pa las/ 'bras bu chos sku 'byung ba yin no// zhes ston pa yin no// gnyis pa la/ spyi'i 'brel dang*/ so so'i 'brel lo// dang po la/ bzhi po bsdu na gnyis te/ rten sku dang*/ mdzad pa 'phrin las so// dang po la/ chos nyid kyi sku dang*/ chos can gyi sku gnyis/ dang po ni/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku'o// gnyis pa la/ ye shes kyi sku dang gzugs kyi sku gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtogs pa ye shes chos kyi sku'o// gnyis pa la/ rnam smin gyi sku dang*/ gzugs kyi sku gnyis/ dang po ni/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ sprul pa'i sku'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'phrin las nyi shu rtsa bdun no// de dag kyang snga ma snga ma las phyi ma 'byung ba'i phyir rim par bstan no// gnyis pa so so'i 'brel la/ sku dang 'phrin las so// dang po la/ 'phags pa ltar na sku gsum ste/ gsum po rang bzhin mdor bstan pa dang*/ yon tan rgyas par bshad gnyis gnyis kyis ston par bzhed do// slob dpon ltar na/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku la sogs pa dbye bas rnam pa bzhi yin pas/ dang po la/ mdo ni/ rab 'byor gzhan yang zag pa med pa'i chos rmi lam lta bu dngos po dang mi ldan pa/ dngos po med pa'i rang bzhin can/

rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa/ rnam pa thams cad yongs su dag par gyur pa/ de dag thams cad kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa'i mtshan nyid gcig pu 'di lta ste/ mtshan nyid med pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin par rig par bya ste/ zhes so// de bsdud pa ni/ thub pa'i ngo bo nyid zhes sogs so// de 'grel pas 'chad pa la/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i rang bzhin/ de ji ltar thob pa'i tshul/ sku lhag ma gsum tha dad du bzhag pa'i dgos pa'o// dang po la zag med kyi ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig sgrib pa bral ba'i chos nyid de chos can/ sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid kyi sku yin te/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi de bzhin nyid yin pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ thub pa sangs rgyas zhes sogs so// gnyis pa la de chos can/ yongs gcod du rgyu rkyen gyis ma bskyed kyang*/ brtan med pa'am thams cad la khyad par med par yod pa min te/ rnam bcad du/ rang gi chos can ye shes dri ma dang bral ba kho na las khyod 'jog pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ bcos ma ma yin pa'i don gyis zhes sogs so// gsum pa la/ 'o na ngo bo nyid kyi sku yongs gcod kyi sgo nas bzhag tu med na/ sku log par mi 'thad do zhe na/ sku lhag ma gsum chos can/ don dam par ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang tha mi dad de/ de khyod kyi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa yod de/ gser gling pas/ rigs pa'i bstan bcos kyi lugs las zhes bshad kyang*/ brgyad stong don bsdu'i 'grel pa dkon mchog 'bangs kyis mdzad par/ blo'i nor can dag gi lugs las/ stong nyid ces bya shes pa las// gzhan ni 'ga' yang yod min te// gang phyir dben pa dben gyur las// tha mi dad pa nyid du 'dod// de ltar min na gnyis stong pa// rnam shes yin par thal 'gyur zhing*// gnyis med pa las ldog pa ni// gnyis kyi bdag tu thal bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zhes ston pa ni/

sku lhag ma gsum po chos nyid kyi ngo bo nyid kyis/ tha mi dad par rnam par bzhag go /zhes pa'o// 'on kyang*/ tha snyad sku logs par bzhag ste/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ don dam pa'i sku dang*/ lhag ma gsum kun rdzob pa'i sku yin pa'i phyir/ de gsum yang chos can/ tha dad par rnam par bzhag ste/ snang tshul so so la ltos nas so sor bzhag pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ yang dag pa'i kun rdzob tu// zhes pa'o// 'dir ngo bo nyid kyi sku ni don dam par yul yul can gyi mtha' bral la ltos nas bzhag pa yin pas/ yul yul can gyi spros pa ni rnam par ma bzhag go /'dir jo bo chen po rjes/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku sangs rgyas kyi sku ru rnam par bzhag pa'i tshul/ mdo sde thar pa chen po nas gsungs par bshad la/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas ni/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud las gsungs par bzhed de/ de yang 'di ltar/ gsang ba'i bdag po 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i sems so bcu gnyis min zhing*/ rtog pa dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad 'bral mod kyi/ 'on kyang sems can gyi khams ma lus pa rnams 'gro ba dang 'ong ba la sogs pa thams cad byed de/ de 'di la ni dog pa med do// de bzhin rnam par mi rtog pa'i// thams cad mkhyen pa gnas med 'di// 'gro ba rnams kyi phyi dang nang*// thams cad nges pa nyid du bsgrub// ces gsungs so// gnyis pa chos sku la/ chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin yon tan gyi khyad par/ rtsod pa spang ba'o// dang po la 'brel ni/ 'phags pa ltar na/ zag pa med pa'i chos gang dag /ces bshad pa de gang zhe na/ zhes so// slob dpon ltar na/ chos nyid kyi sku de'i chos can ye shes de nyid kyi sku gang zhe na 'chad do// zhes ston pa ni/ de ltar zhes so// 'brel pa can dngos la bshad bya'i mdo ni/ rab 'byor gyis gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das zag pa med pa'i chos de dag thams cad kyang gang lags/

bka' stsal pa/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang*/ tshad med pa bzhi dang*/ rnam par thar pa brgyad zhes sogs so// de bsdud pa la/ chos can dang chos nyid kyi sku tha dad du bshad par bstan/ tha dad du ma bstan par 'dod pa dgag de las rtsod pa spang ba'o// dang po ni/ byang chub phyogs mthun tshad med dang*// zhes sogs rtsa 'grel lo// dang po ni/ byang chub phyogs mthun tshad med dang*// zhes sogs chos can/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku las sku logs pa gcig bstan te/ chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin te/ zhes sde tshan nyer gcig po chos skur bstan pa ni gang zhig de ngo bo nyid kyi sku min pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni byang chub kyi phyogs la sogs pa spros pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid/ ces sogs so// gnyis pa la/ khas blangs brjod pa dang*/ de sun 'byin pa gnyis/ dang po la dngos dang*/ nyes pa spang ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'phags pa grol sde ni zag pa med pa'i chos zhes pa chos nyid la mi 'dod par chos can ye shes la sgra ji bzhin par khas blangs nas/ ye shes de'i chos nyid dag pa gnyis ldan de chos nyid kyi sku yin la/ chos can ye shes ngos 'dzin pa ni/ byang chub phyogs mthun zhes sogs yin no// zhes ston pa ni/ gzhan dag ni zhes sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ gzhung phyi mas chos nyid kyi sku kho na rgyas par 'chad pa yin na/ chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin// zhes gsungs pa de ji ltar grang zhe na/ bden mod kyi/ dharmā ta kā ya/ zhes brjod rgyu yin kyang*/ sdebs sbyor gyi dbang gis ta phyis nas nyid mi mngon par byas pa yin te/ gzhan du sgra ji bzhin par khas blangs na ngo bo nyid kyi don bkag par 'gyur ba dang*/ ngo bo nyid de 'dus byas su thal ba'i nyes pa yod de/ zhes ston pa ni/ de nyid kyang zhes sogs so// gnyis pa de sun 'byin pa la/ sangs rgyas sa'i gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sgyu ma lta bu chos can/

ji ltar bsdus te med par thal/ yod na ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang*/ tha dad du bzhag dgos pa las/ de ltar ma bzhag pa'i phyir/ phyi ma khas blangs te/ chos nyid sku zhes brjod pa yin/ zhes brjod rgyu yin par khas blangs pas de dag kyang ngo bo nyid kyi sku tha mi dad du khas blangs pa'i phyir/ 'dod par mi nus te/ de gdon mi za bar khas len dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ gzhan dag na re zhes sogs so// gser gling pa ltar na/ 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i sems dang*/ sems las byung ba rnams chos can/ 'gro ba'i don mdzad par thal/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang rang bzhin dbyer med yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad/ chos kyi bshes gnyen ltar na/ gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi ye shes 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa rnams med par 'gyur te/ de yod na ngo bo nyid kyi sku med par 'gyur ba'i phyir zhes 'chad/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ltar na/ khyad par gsum ldan gyis sangs rgyas sa'i ye shes rnams chos can/ ji ltar sku gsum gyis bsdus te ma bsdus par thal/ gsum po gang gis kyang ma bsdus pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas blangs/ ci ste ngo bo nyid kyi skus bsdus te/ zag pa med pa'i dbyings su ro gcig pa'i phyir/ ce na/ 'o na longs sprul gnyis kyang der 'dus par thal bas/ sku gsum du grangs nges pa nyams so// zhes bzhed/ rnam bshad ltar/ de chos can/ sangs rgyas kyi sas ma bsdus par thal/ bsdus na sangs rgyas kyi sku yin dgos pa las/ ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sku gsum gang yang min pa'i phyir// zhes pa'o// 'grel chen ltar na/ de chos can/ byang chub kyi phyogs mthun/ zhes pa'i gzhung gis ma bsdus par thal/ chos nyid kyi sku min pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas blangs/ ci ste/ chos nyid kyi sku min kyang*/ gzhung des bsdus pa mi 'gal te/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba gang*// de nyid khyod ni stong par bzhed// ces bya ba'i tshul gyis/

chos nyid kyi sku bstan pas chos can gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku yang bstan pa yin no zhe na/ de ltar na longs sprul gnyis kyang gzhung der bstan par thal/ rigs pa mtshungs pa'i phyir/ zhes bshad do// gsum pa rtsod pa spang ba ni/ sku gsum du 'dod pa na re/ byang chub phyogs mthun zhes sogs kyi chos sku bstan pa mi rigs te/ rigs na lus rnam gzhag tu/ ngo bo nyid dang longs sku gnyis kyi bar du rtogs yes chos sku'i lus rnam gzhag 'byung rigs pa las mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ 'og gi chos sku zhes pa'ang lus mdor bstan dang sbyor ba'i tshig yin gyi/ lus logs pa ston pa min pa'i phyir/ dper na/ thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid ces dang*/ lam shes nyid ni zhes dang*/ de 'dra kun shes nyid du 'dod// ces sogs bzhin no// rnam pa bzhi zhes pa yang 'phrin las dang bzhi yin no// zhes ston pa ni/ kha cig na re/ zhes so// de'i lan la/ nyes pa snga ma de med par thal/ tshig bcad sbyor bde ba dang*/ der ma zad dgos pa khyad par can gzhan la ltos nas/ rtogs pa chos sku'i lus de tha mar gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsungs pa chos can dgos pa yod de/ mdzad pa thams cad rtogs yes chos sku'i mdzad par rtogs pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ gzhan dag na re/ sogs so// de ltar na rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa dang*/ de nyid bsdus pa sogs nas sku bzhir bshad pa rnams kyang 'di'i gnod byed min par ma zad/ sgrub byed kho nar 'gyur ro// zhes ston pa ni/ de'i phyir zhes sogs so// gnyis pa yon tan gyi khyad par la/ nyon mongs med pa'i khyad par dang*/ smon nas mkhyen pa'i khyad par ro// 'di gnyis rim pa ltar 'chad pa ni/ nyan thos nyon mongs med pa'i lta// zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas smon nas zhes sogs so// 'di ni mdo sde'i rgyan nas/ sems can rnams ni thams cad kyi// nyon mongs ma lus thams cad 'dul// nyon mongs 'joms mdzad nyon mongs la// brtser bcas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/

lhun gyis grub cing chags mi mnga'// thogs pa mi mnga' rtag par ni// mnyam par bzhag cing 'dri kun gyi// lan ldon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gsum pa rtsod pa spang ba la/ chos sku rtag pa la rtsod pa spang ba dang*/ khyab rtog gnyis ka la rtsod pa spang ba'o// dang po la/ rtsod lan gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtag gnas dang zhes pa la 'phros nas/ chos kyi sku chos can/ rtag tu sems can la snang ba'i sgo nas don mdzad rigs par thal/ rtag tu thugs rje chen po'i ngo bo nyid la bzhugs pa'i phyir te/ skye la thugs rje chen po dang*// zhes smras pa'i phyir snyam na/ zhes ston pa ni/ rtag tu zhes sogs so// lan la skal ldan la snang ba'i dpe dang*/ skal med la mi snang ba'i dpe gnyis/ dang po ni/ bcom ldan 'das chos can/ skal ldan gyi gdul bya 'ga' zhig la snang ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de la snang ba'i rgyu tshang ba'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ rgyu ni yongs su smin gyur nas// zhes sogs so// gnyis pa ni/ gzhung snga ma de'i shugs la/ lha yi rgyal pos zhes pa thob ste/ mdo sde rgyan las ji ltar chu yi snod chag na// zla ba'i gzugs brnyan mi snang ngo*// de bzhin sems can dman pa la// sangs rgyas gzugs kyang mi snang ngo*// zhes bshad pa ltar ro// sangs rgyas phal po cher/ klu rnams kho nas char 'bebs par bshad/ 'dul ba lung las/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha rnams kyis gos rgya mtshor bcug ste sprugs pas char 'bebs par bshad/ gser gling pa brgya byin la 'chad/ 'di'i thad kyi nyi khri snang bar/ 'dir smras pa zhes 'byung zhing*/ 'di la 'grel pa'ang ma mdzad pas/ gzhung sh+lau ka dang po dang*/ 'di dang 'og ma gnyis la brtag par bya'o// gnyis pa la/ rtsod lan gnyis las/ dang po ni/ nyi snang ltar na/ lha'i rgyal pos zhes pa mi 'thad de/ rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang*// de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang*// rigs yod phyir na lus can kun// rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can// zhes thams cad la khyab pa dang*/

ngo bo med phyir 'jig rten mgon po rtag /ces/ rtag par bshad pa'i phyir/ ce na/ de mi 'gal bar ston pa ni/ de ltar zhes sogs so// de skad du yang nyi snang las/ de ltar dgongs pa 'dis sangs rgyas thams cad du song ba dang*/ rtag pa yin par bshad pas bstan bcos dang 'gal ba med do// zhes gsungs so// slob dpon ltar na/ rtag gnas dang zhes pa mi 'thad par ston pa ni/ ye shes chos sku chos can/ khyab pa min par thal/ rnal 'byor pa so so'i rgyud la yod pa'i phyir rtag pa min par thal/ skad cig ma yin pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ ye shes kyi bdag nyid can gyi zhes sogs so// lan la/ de chos can/ sems ldan thams cad kyi rgyud la khyod yod pa min yang*/ khyab pa zhes brjod de/ 'phrin las 'jug rung du de sems can yod pa'i phyir/ chos can/ skad cig ma yin yang*/ rtag pa zhes brjod de/ rigs 'dra rgyun chad mi srid par 'jug pa'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ de ltar zhes so// gzhung 'di gsum la yum gyi mdo med do// gnyis pa longs spyod rdzogs sku la/ rang bzhin mdor bstan pa dang*/ yon tan rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la 'brel ni/ ye shes chos sku de nyid kyi thog mar longs sku'i snang ba bskyed pas de 'chad do// zhes ston pa ni/ de ltar sku gnyis pa bstan nas zhes so// dngos la mdo ni/ rab 'byor gzhan yang yum 'di la bslabs shing chos de dag thob nas/ bla med byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ste/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcus brgyan pa byang sems chen po rnams la bstan nas/ theg pa chen po'i chos kyi longs spyod bla na med pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba dang*/ tshim pa dang*/ rab tu dga' ba ston par mdzad par 'gyur ro// zhes so// de bsdud pa ni/ mtshan ni zhes sogs so// don ni/ 'og min kho nar bzhugs pa'i rnam par snang mdzad gangs chen mtsho chos can/

longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin te/ nges pa lnga ldan gyi gzugs sku mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ zhes snga ma rnams bzhed/ nges pa lnga ldan gyi tha snyad rgya 'grel rnams las gsal por bshad pa med la/ 'on kyang bsdus don sgron ma las/ nges pa bzhi ste 'khor dang ni// gnas dang ston pa chos su ni// des na ji ltar 'dod pa ru// longs spyod byed pas longs spyod sku// 'khor gyi nges pas sa bcu pa// 'ba' zhig yin zhes seng bzang gsung*// shān+ti mthong lam yan chad kyi// byang chub sems dpa' yin zhes zer// gnas ni 'og min chos de ni// theg pa chen po kho na'i chos// ston pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyis// brgyan pa'i gzugs sku kho na yin// zhes gsungs la/ slob dpon chos kyi bshes gnyen na re/ mya ngan las 'da' bar bshad pa ni sprul pa'i sku yin la/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la ni de med pas skad cig ma yin kyang*/ rgyun gyi rtag pa yin no zhes 'chad/ rgya gar snga rabs pa kha cig na re brgya byin bzhin du/ longs sku skye ba dang 'gag pa ni/ sangs rgyas min pa gzhan gyis mi shes pas rtag par bzhag go /zhes gsung bas/ nges pa lnga'i rnam gzhag bod mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad do// yon tan rgyas par bshad pa la mtshan dang dpe byad gnyis/ dang po la mdo las/ mtshan rgyu dang bcas pa lhug par gsungs pa de/ bstan bcos su tshigs su bcad par sdebs pa ni/ phyag zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan dang zhes sogs yin la/ dpe byad kyang mdo lhug par gsungs pa rnams bstan bcos su bsdud pa ni/ thub pa'i sen mo zangs mdog dang*// zhes sogs so// skyes bu chen po mtshon par byed pas na mtshan dang*/ mdzes par byed pas dpe byad ces bya ste/ rgyan las/ lus can kun gyis khyod mthong na// skyes bu dam pa legs par 'tshal// mthong ba tsam gyis rab dang bar// mdzad pa khyod pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes 'byung ba ltar ro// de yang mtshan gyis lus kyi spyi mdzes par byed la/

dpe byad kyis lus kyi bye brag mdzes par byed cing*/ mtshan ni gtso bo yin la/ dpe byad ni 'khor yin no zhes skal bzangs las bshad do// bsdus don sgron ma las ni/ mtshan ni sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*// dpe byad brgyad bcus bshad kyang de// dpag tu med pa yod pa ste// rab gnas mtshan nas dpag med bshad// gdul bya'i ngor ni 'di tsam gyis// skyes bu chen por mtshon pas na// mtshan gyi mtshan nyid dag tu bshad// ngo bo spyir ni gzugs yin kyang*// phal du dbang po lnga la 'jog /sems kyi rnam dag mtshon pas na// dpe byad zer te yang na ni// mtshan gyis brgyan par byed pas na/ dpe byad du yang 'dod pa yod// ces bshad do// mtshan dang dpe byad 'di rnams byang sems chen po rnams dang*/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po la'ang yod mod kyi/ 'dir ni de dag las khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ mdzod las/ thub mtshan yul na gnas pa dang*// gsal la rdzogs pas 'phags pa yin// zhes bshad pa ltar ro// bden smra'i mdo las/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po la 'khor los bsgyur ba'i bsod nams brgya 'gyur gyis sangs rgyas kyi ba spu'i khung bu gcig 'grub/ ba spu'i khung bu thams cad kyi bsod nams brgya 'gyur gyis dpe byad gcig 'grub/ dpe byad brgya 'gyur thams cad kyi bsod nams brgya 'gyur gyis mtshan gcig 'grub/ mtshan so gnyis po thams cad kyi bsod nams brgya 'gyur gyis/ dbu'i gtsug tor 'grub/ de bye ba phrag 'bum gyis gsung chos kyi dung 'grub bo// zhes gsung*/ gsum pa sprul pa'i sku la 'brel ni/ longs sku las sprul sku'i snang ba 'byung ba'i phyir/ longs sku'i 'og tu sprul sku 'chad ces ston pa ni/ de ltar sku gsum du bstan pa nas/ zhes sogs sogs so// dngos la/ mdo ni phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med tshad med/ mtha' med par de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa sna tshogs kyi 'phrin las kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad do// zhes so// de bsdud pa ni/

gang gis srid pa ji srid par// zhes sogs te/ gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgyar mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku chos can/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'i sku yin te/ nges pa lnga min gyi sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i don no// ji skad du/ jo bos nges pa bzhi dang bral bas na/ ji lta ba dang ji lta ru// de lta ba dang de lta ru// ston pa sprul pa'i sku yin no// zhes bshad do// brten pa 'phrin las la/ 'brel dang*/ 'brel pa can dngos so// dang po la/ gser gling pa/ gzhung snga ma 'phrin las kyi mtshams sbyor du bzhed pa ltar na/ bshad zin gyi mtshams sbyar dang*/ bshad pa la 'jug pa'i mtshams sbyar gnyis su byed la/ chos bshes ltar na gzhung snga ma don bsdur 'chad la/ gang ltar na'ang*/ sku lhag ma gsum chos can/ kun rdzob tu rnam par btags nas bzhag pa yin te/ ye shes dang*/ mtshan dpe dngos dang*/ mtshan dpe'i gzugs brnyan la brtags pa'i phyir/ gdags gzhi gsum po chos can/ khyad par gsum dang ldan te/ rang bzhin gyi khyad par ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i bdag nyid/ rgyu'i khyad par sbyor sgom pa las byung ba/ yul gyi khyad par sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i yul nyid du snang ba'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i bdag nyid zhes sogs so// gnyis pa la/ lus rnam bzhag tu/ chos sku dang phrin las 'brel chags su bshad pa ltar 'dir ma bshad pas/ mdzad pa thams cad chos sku'i mdzad par mi rtogs pa'i skyon yod do zhe na/ skyon de med de/ ye shes kho nas gzugs sku'i snang ba bskyed pa'i sgo nas/ phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir zhes ston pa ni/ kun rdzob tu ye shes kho na zhes sogs so// 'grel ba dngos la mdo ni/ rab 'byor ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi 'jig rten la rnam par gzigs nas/ shar dang lho dang nub dang byang dang*/ byang shar dang shar lho dang lho nub dang*/

nub byang dang*/ 'og dang steng gi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na/ byang sems chen po dag ched du bsams te/ sems can dmyal ba dag tu 'dong zhing*/ dmyal ba chen po'i sdug bsngal zhi bar byas nas lha dang mi rnams dang skal pa mnyam par skyes shing*/ rim gyis theg pa gsum la 'god pa mthong zhes sogs/ de bsdud pa ni/ de bzhin 'khor ba ji srid 'di// zhes sogs so// 'phags pa dang shān+ti pa ltar na/ sprul sku rgyun mi chad pa bzhin/ sprul sku 'di'i 'phrin las yang*// zhes bzhed/ slob dpon/ chos kyi sku bzhin du/ zhes bzhed/ de'i don 'grel pas 'chad pa la/ rkang pa phyi ma rnams kyi don bshad pa/ dang po dang po gnyis kyi don bshad pa'o// dang po la/ lam gyi rten la 'god/ lam la 'god/ lam gyi 'bras bu la 'god/ dang po ni/ 'gro rnams zhi la 'god pa rtsa 'grel lo// gnyis pa la/ tshogs lam la/ sbyor lam la/ mthong lam la/ sgom lam la/ 'god pa dang bzhi las/ dang po la/ sbyor ba rnam dag la 'god pa ni/ bsdu rnam bzhi la 'god pa ste/ dang por 'di'i sgo nas gzhan don byed dgos pa'i phyir/ mdo sde rgyan las/ dang po snod gyur dngos po ste// gnyis pa yi ni mos par byed// gsum pa yi ni sgrub pa ste// bzhi pa rnam par sbyor ba'o// zhes dang*/ slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa las/ sbyin pa'i g.yab mos legs bos te// snyan par smra ba'i gtam byas te// don mthun pa yi bag phab nas// don spyod gros chen gdab par bya// zhes 'byung ba ltar ro// gnyis pa lta ba rnam dag la/ 'god pa ni/ mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po dang*// rnam par byang ba rtogs pa dang*// rtsa 'grel lo// gsum pa spyod pa rnam par dag pa la 'god pa la/ gzhan don rang don gnyis don gyi spyod pa la 'god pa gsum ni/ rim pa ltar/ sems can rnams don ji bzhin gyi// don dang*/

zhes dang*/ pha rol phyin drug dang*/ zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas lam dang zhes pas bstan no// gnyis pa sbyor lam la 'god pa ni/ rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid dang*/ rtsa 'grel lo// mthong lam la 'god pa ni/ gnyis zad dang*/ rtsa 'grel lo// sgom lam la 'god pa la/ sa gnyis pa nas drug pa'i ni/ brda' dang rtsa 'grel lo// sa drug pa ni/ dmigs pa med pa dang rtsa 'grel lo// sa bdun pa la dgod pa ni/ lus can rnams ni yongs smin dang*// rtsa 'grel lo// sa brgyad pa ni/ byang chub sems pa'i lam dang ni/ mngon par zhen pa spangs pa dang*// rtsa 'grel lo// sa dgu pa la 'god pa ni/ byang chub thob dang*/ rtsa 'grel lo// sa bcu pa la 'god pa la/ sa bcu thob ma thag pa dang*/ skye ba gcig gis thogs pa dang*/ srid pa tha ma la 'god pa gsum mo// dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa dang*/ zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ nges pa dang*/ sems can don ni zad med dang*// sangs rgyas brten sogs yon tan dang*// zhes so// gsum pa la/ nus pa dang*/ spangs pa dang*/ rtogs pa dang*/ rgyu tshogs dag pa la 'god pa bzhi ni lhag ma rnams kyis ston no// lam gyi 'bras bu la 'god pa na/ mya ngan 'das la 'god pa rtsa 'grel lo// dus ni de ltar na zhes sogs so// 'o na sangs rgyas grangs med pa gcig byon nas/ sems can de snyed cig mi gnas pa'i myang 'das la 'god na/ mdzad pa rgyun chad mi srid pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ sems can gyi khams zad pa mi srid pa'i phyir te ji skad du/ dge slong dag khyed kyi lha'i mig dag pas stong gsum gyi 'jig rten ji snyed cig gnas pa mthong ba ches nyung ngo*// ngas shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam gyi phyogs na/ sems can gnas pa rnams mthong ba ni ches mang ngo*// zhes 'gro ba rigs drug tu gtogs pa'i sems can las/ ma gtogs pa'i sems can ches shin tu mang bar gsungs so// 'o na dang po sems bskyed dang*/

phrin las kyi go rim 'dir bstan nas gzhan gyi go rim mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/ med pa'am 'on te yod kyang ston mi nus pa yin zhe na/ de'i lan ston pa ni/ dang po dang tha ma'i las bstan pa'i rim pas zhes so// 'dir tha ma phrin las la 'dod pa ni/ rang tshig 'gal ba dang*/ yi ge'i don min pa'i nyes par 'gyur te/ don bdun bcur nges pa dang*/ don bdun bcu'i tha ma 'phrin las su 'dod pa 'gal ba'i phyir dang*/ tha ma'i zhes drug sgra gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na tha ma ni chos sku yin la/ de'i phrin las zhes pa'am/ yang na sems bskyed pa tha ma chos kyi sku dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed kyi las ni 'phrin las la bya'o// de ltar na/ lung gi snye ma las/ chos dbyings dri med ye shes rang bzhin chos// zab pa'i tshul ston longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// sna tshogs tshul ston sprul pa'i sku thob nas// mdzad pa lhun grub rgyun chad med par bsngo// zhes 'byung ba ltar/ chos kyi sku/ rnam pa bzhir ni yang dag brjod// ces gsungs pa de legs par bshad zin to// 'dir smras pa/ chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par// sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis// skye bar mngon par skyes pa yis// mi pham rgyal ba min no zhes// dmod pa'i bzlas brjod bzlog pa'i don// chos skur mngon par sangs rgyas na// gzugs sku phrin las lhun grub ces// ma pham rgyal ba'i gzhung gis ston// gsum pa ni/ bslab pa'i 'bras bu'i le'u'i sbas don chos sku gsal bar ston pa'i skabs te brgyad pa'o// //gnyis pa bar ma la dga' ba la mngon rtogs drug tu phye ba la/ 'brel ni/ dngos po drug tu bstan pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rkang grangs bar mar bstan pa la dga' ba'i gdul bya rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ zhes ston pa ni/ de ltar zhes sogs so// bstan pa de gang zhe na/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni// dngos po drug gis yang dag bshad// mtshan nyid de'i sbyor ba dang*// zhes so// shān+ti pa dang*/
